title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Job Description

You'll be a key early team member who owns the back end from day one, with opportunities to expand into data science, security research, and other areas if interested.

Stack: AWS, Postgres, Python (for Django, security research, and data science), open to other languages and tools

What will you do?

  • Architect, design, and implement scalable distributed systems, like...
  • Parallelized, computationally intensive modelling across flocks of lambdas
  • Complex, asynchronous data processing and enrichment using third-party APIs
  • Services for sometimes intractable combinatorial analytics ARGH WHY WON'T THESE NUMBERS BEHAVE?!

What do you need?

  • Strong programming skills in $LANGUAGES, ideally Python is in the mix
  • A feel for moderately complex asynchronous systems and building linear user experiences on top of them
  • Familiarity with AWS: Lambda, RDS, message passing, secrets management, etc.
  • Care for software engineering best practices, including code reviews and documentation
  • Care for business realities, which engineering best practices have to be balanced against
  • Care for delivering real value to users, which in Reach's case means keeping people safe — this is the most important thing of all
  • Ability to operate independently, act decisively, and adapt quickly

title: Double Backer Operator
description:
POSITION TITLE: DOUBLEBACKER OPERATOR

REPORTS TO: Corrugator Supervisor

SUMMARY

Responsible for all activities associated with running the double-backer including setup, operation, cleanup, and recommending improvements to operations.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Set up bridge guides and glue station in accordance with proper setup techniques.
  • Check wet end lineups to verify correct roll stock is received and used.
  • Put rolls of paper in mill roll stands ensuring proper size and grade of paper to be run and make splices and paper changes as necessary.
  • Make adjustments during runs for tension, alignment, adhesion, and warp control.
  • Trim only the necessary amount of paper from the rolls when preparing for splices.
  • Remove roll stock from the machine when necessary and mark the proper size, grade, diameter, and lineal footage on the roll and place core plugs in each end of the buttrolls.
  • Maximize the utilization of equipment by operating the double-backer at available capacity and speed in line with those of the corrugator.
  • Clean starch pans, metering rolls, and glue rolls when necessary.
  • Keep the doublebacker area clean.
  • Complete necessary reports in an accurate and timely manner, including but not limited to: Production Data, Machine Operational Status, Safety Data, Quality Data.
  • Turn in maintenance work orders to supervisor for needed repairs. Be proactive in the maintenance of equipment.
  • Take all paper off of cores of stub rolls.
  • Assist the Corrugator Operator as necessary.
  • Assist in the training of dry end personnel.
  • Adheres to the production schedule. Makes recommendations for optimizing the schedule to meet cost, quality, and service goals. Reports any unusual scheduling issues to Supervisor.
  • Comply with all company policies and procedures, including safety and maintaining good housekeeping.
  • Additional duties may be assigned by management.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED.

Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:

Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.

6 months’ experience on the dry end of the corrugator

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Able to read and follow instructions on factory masters.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume, and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving one or more concrete variables in standardized situations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation.

Product layouts and production specifications

Product quality specifications

Quality standards

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

The performance of the employee will be measured as follows:

Operating standards - the employee will need to meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction, and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the employee.

Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the employee to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the employee and his/her superior.

Employee relations - through observations the employee will be evaluated regarding his/her behaviors associated with appropriate human interaction, respect, and communication.

Creativity - this will be evaluated by how active the employee is in participating in advancing the business through new and innovative ideas.

title: Request for Proposal (RFP) – Macro-Fiscal and Public Financial Management Consultant (Based in Any Sub-Saharan African Country)
description:
Location: Nairobi,Nairobi County,Kenya

Proposal No: UPGI-26-PR087

Consultancy Type: Short Term

Publication Date: 14/10/2026

Clarifications Deadline: 26/10/2026

Closing Date: 30/10/2026

Engagement Period: 6 Months

Consultants Location: Sub Saharan Africa

  1. Introduction

About BRAC International

BRAC is an award-winning international non-governmental development organisation with the vision of a world free from all forms of exploitation and discrimination, where everyone can realise their potential. BRAC is a leader in developing and implementing cost-effective, evidence-based programmes to assist poor and disadvantaged communities in low-income countries, including in conflict-prone and post-disaster settings. It is an organisation of and for the people of the Global South, pioneering new development and social enterprise approaches to equip communities to achieve prosperity. As well as being the world's biggest NGO by the number of staff and people directly reached, BRAC has regularly been ranked the number one NGO in the world by the Geneva-based NGO Advisor, an independent organisation committed to highlighting innovation, impact and governance in the non-profit sector.

About BRAC’s Work Scaling Graduation through Governments

The Graduation approach is a sequenced, adaptive set of interventions that together tackle multiple constraints that trap people in extreme poverty over a two-year period. By providing people with a productive asset to generate income, basic needs support, and ongoing, intensive coaching to unlock agency, know-how, and hope, the approach enables people to build lasting trajectories out of extreme poverty.

Pioneered by BRAC in 2002, Graduation now has more than 100 studies from 40+ countries, showing it achieves transformational impacts for participants across a wide variety of contexts. A long-term study of a programme in West Bengal found that ten years after starting the programme, participants saw roughly 4x gains in household consumption compared to programme investment outlays, which may go as high as 11x over their lifetimes if those gains persist, according to Nobel Laureates Abhijit Banerjee and Esther Duflo. In 2020, BRAC was named an Audacious Project by TED, receiving a catalytic investment to lift 21 million more people out of extreme poverty by 2030. BRAC is combating extreme poverty by partnering with governments across Asia and Africa to scale the proven Graduation approach. Watch the TED talk here.

With catalytic funding from Audacious, BRAC has successfully cultivated partnerships with governments in Africa and Asia over the last few years, resulting in new models of Graduation in India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Rwanda, and South Africa. Efforts are also underway in Ethiopia with exploration to support even wider government-led uptake. Demonstrating to governments Graduation’s potential to achieve greater, more lasting impact through existing poverty reduction programmes has helped unlock significantly more resources from government partners. Yet, massive cuts in development aid means less funding is available to support these programmes, making philanthropic capital all the more critical.

BRAC has found that flexible philanthropic funding can drive transformative, catalytic government investment. Philanthropic support presents a powerful leverage opportunity: Every $1 of philanthropic support can unlock $10 to $50 of public financing and generate $65 to $200 in long-term household income gains.

In a moment when progress on extreme poverty has stalled and public budgets are under pressure, Graduation offers something rare: life-changing results that justify greater investment, and investment that reaches millions more people than either sector could achieve alone.

  1. The Assignment

2.1 Purpose:

The purpose of this consultancy is to strengthen BRAC Ultra-Poor Graduation Initiative (UPGI)’s ability to understand, influence and support the public financing of government-led Graduation programs in Sub-Saharan Africa.

The consultant will help UPGI move beyond a general understanding of whether governments have sufficient fiscal space toward a more operational understanding of how public resources are prioritized, budgeted, financed, released and executed, and therefore how Graduation can realistically be financed and institutionalized within government systems.

The work of the consultant should help BRAC’s country teams answer the following questions:

  • What are the main fiscal, financing, and public financial management constraints governments face in scaling Graduation?

  • What public resources are already available, and where are there realistic opportunities to strengthen, redirect, or mobilize financing for Graduation?

  • How can this analysis help Country Leads better position their engagement with the government?

  • What opportunities exist to influence upstream external financing, particularly through the World Bank and African Development Bank?

  • What longer-term structure and capabilities should UPGI establish to support this work over the remainder of the SGGA program?

2.3 Scope of Work:

  • Conduct country macro-fiscal and public financing analysis across 7 countries in Africa, to deepen UPGI teams’ understanding of the fiscal and financing context for scaling government-led Graduation.

  • Pilot the country assessment in Rwanda first, producing an initial country analysis and working with the Rwanda Country Team and UPGI ELT to assess how to make the analysis most useful, what additional questions it should answer, and how the approach should be refined before applying it to the remaining six countries.

  • Based on lessons from the Rwanda pilot, adapt and apply the approach to six additional priority countries, producing concise, actionable country briefs for Country Leads and the whole of UPGI.

  • Assessment and recommendations on positioning in each country.

  • Advise country teams on relevant government budget and financing processes, including engagement with Ministries of Finance and other key actors.

  • Identify upstream opportunities for multilateral influencing: finding key modes of engagement to learn and shape directions of external funders (especially the World Bank and AfDB).

  • Design long-term UPGI capabilities to shape country level and external financing and advise UPGI on how to measure large-scale public investment to Graduation.

  • The assignment will include one trip each to Rwanda, Ethiopia, South Africa, and Tanzania to conduct research, make relevant connections with government and MDBs, and debrief country teams on key findings and implications for their work.

2.4 Deliverables

  1. Seven country briefs: Produce concise macro-fiscal, PFM, and public financing assessments for seven priority countries, beginning with Rwanda as a pilot. The briefs should identify key constraints, financing opportunities, and implications for the Country Leads’ engagement with government.

  2. Country Visits: Undertake one trip each to Rwanda, Ethiopia, South Africa, and Tanzania to better understand the country context, in order to inform research and key findings for the brief.

  3. Upstream multilateral financing recommendations: Practical recommendations for how UPGI should strengthen engagement with the World Bank, African Development Bank, and other relevant external funders to help shape financing and programming over the next decade.

  4. Long-term function design: Recommendations to UPGI on a set of options on how to structure long-term UPGI capabilities, and resourcing to sustain understanding and influence of macro-fiscal, PFM, and public financing function for the next decade. This will include some recommendations on how to measure the volumes of public finance being used towards Graduation.

2.5 Desired skills and competencies:

The candidate should meet the following criteria:

  • Deep knowledge of macro-fiscal dynamics and public finance in sub-Saharan Africa

  • Experience with AfDB, World Bank senior management and planning cycles, co-financing mechanisms and country engagement processes

  • Experience working alongside country-level programme teams — comfortable operating in a support and advisory role rather than leading engagement

  • Understanding of social protection and economic inclusion programming in the African context — does not need to be a Graduation specialist

  • Able to produce clear, actionable written assessments that Country Leads and Executive Leadership Team can act on.

  • Ideally 15 years or more of experience, ideally in macroeconomics and public financial management.

2.6 Level of Effort, Duration, and Location of the assignment:

Consultancy, to be finalized by 31 August 2027. Level of effort: 70 days total, 20 days in 2026 and 50 days in 2027.

Submission Requirements

Interested and eligible consultants may obtain further information via email between 0900 and 1600 hrs EAT, Monday to Friday, until 26 November 2026. Enquiries should be sent to ankita.panda@brac.net , with a copy to getrude.kipruto@brac.net, using the subject line “Macro Fiscal and Public Financial Management Consultant”

Submission Requirements:

  1. Mandatory documents

  2. Technical Proposal

  3. Financial Proposal

Interested applicants are encouraged to review the detailed RFP document for further information on the scope of work, requirements, and submission process.

title: West Coast Editor - Law.com
description:
The Role
We are seeking an experienced editor to lead Law.com's California and West Coast regional content. This is a combination editorial and content-creator role. You will oversee a reporter, help set coverage priorities, guide content development and manage the day-to-day needs of the regional brand. You will also help shape and produce coverage focused on the lawyers, law firms, courts and cases influencing the region's legal markets. Additionally you will help lead local and national data projects, and assist with regional recognition programs.
The right candidate will be an engaged newsroom leader who can multitask, coach reporters, make confident news decisions, produce content, build relationships across the legal community and strengthen our connection with readers throughout California and the West Coast.
The Team
On Law.com's Regional Desk, we cover the lawsuits, lawyers, judges and law firms shaping major legal markets. We move quickly, collaborate closely and share sources, ideas and regional perspective. This editor will oversee a reporter and work with newsroom leaders across Law.com to connect regional developments with our broader national coverage.
What You’ll Lead
  • Lead California and West Coast coverage, setting editorial priorities and ensuring a strong mix of breaking news, analysis and enterprise journalism.
  • Manage and coach reporters, helping them develop sources, sharpen story ideas, improve execution and grow professionally.
  • Develop data-driven content, leveraging proprietary Centellic data and multimedia storytelling.
  • Oversee regional content operations, including newsletters, daily story selection, audience engagement and coordination with other Law.com teams.
  • Direct major editorial initiatives, including awards, surveys, rankings, special reports and other recurring projects.
  • Represent Law.com in the regional legal community, developing relationships with law firm leaders, judges, bar organizations and other key sources and stakeholders.
Why This Role Matters
California and the broader West Coast are among the country's most influential legal markets. This editor will define how Law.com covers the region, develop reporters and help turn local developments into journalism with regional and national impact. While editing and brand leadership are the core responsibilities, the editor will also produce selected content, including articles, analysis, interviews, podcasts and event programming.
What This Role Requires
  • Strong news judgment and experience setting coverage priorities in a fast-paced newsroom.
  • A record of successfully managing, coaching or mentoring reporters.
  • The ability to edit breaking news, analysis and enterprise journalism with clarity and precision.
  • A strong understanding of business of law and litigation coverage, or the ability to quickly develop it.
  • Creativity when it comes to finding and presenting content – not all stories are best told through words on a page, some are better as graphics, podcasts, videos, etc.
  • The organization and flexibility to balance people management, daily editing and brand responsibilities.
  • Comfort representing Law.com in meetings, at events and in conversations with the legal community.
  • The ability and willingness to produce selected content across formats, including writing, podcasts, interviews and live events.
Preferred Background
  • Experience editing coverage of law, courts, business or another complex subject area.
  • Familiarity with California or other West Coast legal markets.
  • Experience managing newsletters, digital publications or recurring editorial projects.
  • A track record of creating or contributing to written, audio, video or event content.

About Centellic
Centellic stands at the center of the markets it serves, empowering organizations with indispensable data and insight to make critical decisions on growth, risk and opportunity.

Through proprietary data, deep market expertise and AI-enabled technology, our platforms are embedded in client workflows. That capability is underpinned by our events, which bring the market together to share perspective and deepen understanding of the issues shaping each sector. Together, they give organizations earlier visibility of emerging trends, and the clarity and confidence to act when decisions matter.

At Centellic, we’re a global intelligence and information services business, setting the standard for how critical business decisions are made.

Why Centellic?
At Centellic, we help our clients make better decisions, and our people are at the heart of that work. Every individual plays an important role in this, bringing curiosity and high standards to everything they do.

Those who thrive here take ownership, care deeply about their work and are committed to excellence. Standards are high because our people set them that way. And while we have decades of expertise, we are still growing, pushing and building something extraordinary.

Centellic’s advantage is our people and the culture we’ve created together. It’s an environment where individuality is encouraged, relationships are genuine, and there’s a strong sense of purpose in what we’re building together. Collaborative, respectful and driven, we take our work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously.
Our people are our most valuable asset, as such, we offer a wide range of benefits to help ensure that all are supported:

  • Choice of three Cigna health insurance plans, two dental plans, and vision coverage.

title: Onboarding Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Onboarding Engineer based in Hungary.

We are seeking an Onboarding Engineer to lead the technical implementation and coordination of customer onboarding in a fast-growing SaaS environment. This role combines hands-on engineering expertise with project management to ensure seamless integrations and successful customer launches. You will work closely with onboarding, customer success, and engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and deliver a consistent customer experience. Your work will directly influence customer retention, product adoption, and long-term growth. You will also help build scalable processes, documentation, and metrics to improve onboarding efficiency. This is an opportunity to shape technical onboarding practices while contributing to an innovative, AI-driven approach to partnership management.

Accountabilities:

As an Onboarding Engineer, you will own the technical execution of customer implementations, ensuring that each onboarding progresses smoothly from initial kickoff to go-live and handoff. You will collaborate across teams to resolve issues, improve processes, and establish scalable technical standards.

  • Lead the technical setup of customer onboarding, including API integrations, data mapping, CRM configuration, authentication, and security setup.

  • Partner with the Onboarding Manager to coordinate the full onboarding lifecycle, from kickoff through go-live and handoff to Customer Success.

  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues, including integration failures, data synchronization problems, and configuration challenges.

  • Develop and maintain onboarding runbooks, integration guides, technical documentation, and repeatable implementation processes.

  • Collaborate with Engineering to escalate product issues, document bugs with clear reproduction steps, and advocate for product improvements that support successful onboarding.

  • Coordinate with Customer Success to ensure smooth transitions from onboarding to ongoing customer support.

  • Define, monitor, and improve onboarding success metrics, including time to first value, technical blockers, and integration completion rates.

  • Identify onboarding risks proactively, communicate potential delays, and recommend solutions to keep projects on track.

  • Support the Onboarding Manager in customer communications concerning technical requirements, implementation progress, and timelines.

  • Contribute to the growth of the onboarding function by helping establish scalable practices and mentoring future onboarding engineers.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with customer-facing implementation experience, excellent organizational abilities, and a collaborative approach. You should be comfortable managing multiple onboarding projects while communicating complex technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders.

    • 3–4 years of technical experience in B2B SaaS implementation, customer onboarding, or customer success engineering.

    • Hands-on experience with APIs, data integrations, technical configuration, and troubleshooting.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical customers and present implementation plans to leadership.

    • Experience managing customer implementations or onboarding projects throughout the full lifecycle, from kickoff to go-live.

    • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple customer onboardings and maintain close attention to detail.

    • Familiarity with CRM integrations, particularly Salesforce or HubSpot, or comparable enterprise tools, is an advantage.

    • A consultative mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs, ask thoughtful questions, and proactively recommend solutions.

    • A strong commitment to quality, including identifying potential issues early and implementing measures to prevent recurring problems.

    • Ability to collaborate effectively and build strong relationships across Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering.

    • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience demonstrating technical expertise.

      • Nice to Have:

      • Experience with Bubble.io, n8n, or other low-code/no-code platforms.

      • Familiarity with partnership management or ecosystem tools.

      • Experience creating technical documentation, implementation guides, or knowledge bases.

      • Knowledge of AWS Lambda or similar serverless architectures.

        • Benefits:

        • Competitive salary and benefits package.

        • Stock options offering an opportunity to participate in the company's growth.

        • The opportunity to directly influence customer onboarding quality, retention, and expansion.

        • A hybrid technical and operational role with potential for progression into leadership.

        • Close collaboration with experienced onboarding and Customer Success professionals.

        • The opportunity to contribute to a high-growth, profitable SaaS business operating at the forefront of AI-driven innovation.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

title: Front End Developer (React & Node.js)
description:
Location: Fully Remote (UK)

Salary: £45,000 – £50,000

Job Type: Permanent

Build Modern Digital Experiences

We’re looking for a talented Mid-Senior Front End Developer to join a growing engineering team building modern, scalable web applications used by customers across the globe.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced React developer who enjoys creating intuitive user experiences while also having the opportunity to contribute to backend services using Node.js.

Working as part of a collaborative Agile team, you’ll play a key role in developing new features, improving existing products and influencing technical decisions.

The Role

As a Front End Developer, you’ll be responsible for designing and developing high-quality user interfaces while working closely with Product Managers, UX Designers and Backend Engineers to deliver exceptional digital products.

You’ll have the opportunity to work across the full development lifecycle, contributing to architecture discussions, code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop modern, responsive web applications using React.
  • Build reusable UI components and maintain scalable front-end architecture.
  • Develop and maintain backend services using Node.js where required.
  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to deliver intuitive user experiences.
  • Consume and integrate RESTful APIs.
  • Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code.
  • Participate in code reviews and mentor junior developers where appropriate.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and architecture decisions.
  • Work within Agile Scrum teams to deliver high-quality software.
  • Continuously improve application performance, accessibility and usability.

About You

You’ll be passionate about front-end development and enjoy working in a collaborative engineering environment.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Commercial experience with React.js.
  • Good experience with JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • Experience developing backend services using Node.js.
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3 and responsive design principles.
  • Experience consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Familiarity with state management libraries such as Redux or Context API.
  • Experience using Git and modern development workflows.
  • Understanding of testing frameworks and best practices.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working within Agile teams.

Desirable Skills

  • Next.js

description:
# Deployment Strategist

## Company Overview

Scrabble is mandated to hire a  Deployment Strategist r for a fast growing AI infrastructure startup building enterprise grade AI systems in India.

## Job Summary

The Deployment Strategist will serve as a critical bridge between customers, product, sales, and engineering teams. The role involves understanding customer workflows, identifying AI opportunities, and guiding solutions from discovery through pilot, deployment, and expansion. The strategist will own customer outcomes, ensure successful AI integrations, and contribute to shaping the company's product roadmap based on customer insights.

## Responsibilities

- Engage directly with customers to understand their workflows, pain points, decision-makers, and success metrics.
- Identify and prioritize high-volume, repeatable use cases that deliver measurable improvements in quality or cost.
- Translate ambiguous business problems into clear use-case definitions, success metrics, and technical requirements for engineering teams.
- Conduct discovery sessions, demos, and walkthroughs with both business and technical stakeholders.
- Define and scope pilots, including workflow design, data requirements, evaluation criteria, timelines, and commercial terms.
- Lead the transition of successful pilots into full-scale production deployment, coordinating between customer teams and engineers.
- Collaborate with customers and engineering teams to establish evaluations measuring model quality, latency, reliability, and cost.
- Build business cases linking deployment results to key customer outcomes and value.
- Manage commercial negotiations, including proposals, pricing, and expansion opportunities.
- Provide feedback from customer deployments to influence product development, research, and model improvements.
- Track adoption, measure business outcomes, and support ongoing customer success as usage scales.
- Develop reusable playbooks, demos, case studies, and sales materials based on deployment learnings.
- Act as the primary owner of customer relationships, ensuring deployments meet or exceed expected business outcomes.
- Communicate technical trade-offs in accessible language to business leaders and align priorities with engineering teams.

## Qualifications

- 2-3 years of experience in customer-facing roles such as consulting, product management, solutions or pre-sales, enterprise sales, or a founder's office, preferably in B2B technology.
- Working technical understanding of AI application components: APIs, prompting, retrieval (RAG), evaluations, and inference costs.
- Proven ability to convert ambiguous business problems into structured, prioritized solutions with clear success metrics.
- Hands-on experience with LLM products and building prototypes using no-code or low-code tools.
- Strong commercial instincts, including experience in discovery, business case development, and stakeholder management.
- Ability to manage projects from discovery through pilot and into full production.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging with executive leadership and technical teams.
- High ownership mindset and adaptability to fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
- Educational background in engineering, computer science, or related technical fields is preferred.

## Preferred Skills

- Experience in pre-sales, solutions consulting, or customer success within AI, data, or developer products.
- Familiarity with LLM evaluation, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agents, or fine-tuning.
- Understanding of inference economics, including cost per token, latency, and hosting trade-offs.
- Experience selling to or working with enterprise customers in consulting or product roles.
- Exposure to workflow automation, document processing, or enterprise integration projects.
- Knowledge of regulated industries such as banking, financial services, or insurance, especially regarding technology evaluation and procurement.
- An engineering degree or prior technical role experience is a plus.

title: TrevorSpace Moderator
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a TrevorSpace Moderator based in the United States.

This is a meaningful opportunity to help create a safe, inclusive, and affirming online community for LGBTQ+ young people and their allies. As a TrevorSpace Moderator, you will support daily community operations, assist users with platform-related questions, and ensure that online interactions follow established safety guidelines. You will play a vital role in identifying harmful content, recognizing signs of distress, and connecting at-risk young people with appropriate support and resources. Working closely with crisis intervention professionals and external agencies, you will contribute to protecting vulnerable users and promoting positive online engagement. The role combines community management, digital safety, risk assessment, and empathetic communication in a mission-driven environment. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to make a tangible difference in young people's lives while helping strengthen a supportive and inclusive digital space.

Accountabilities

  • Community Management: Oversee daily community operations, assist users with platform functionality, approve user clubs, process account deletion requests, and respond to inquiries through the online platform.
  • Content Moderation and Safety: Review user-generated content and reports of potentially harmful behavior, including bullying, harassment, hate speech, sexual solicitation, graphic content, and other violations of community guidelines.
  • Policy Enforcement: Apply community standards consistently, fairly, and thoughtfully to maintain a safe, respectful, and affirming environment for LGBTQ+ young people and their allies.
  • Risk Identification and Escalation: Monitor community discussions for emerging safety concerns, including suicidal ideation, self-injury, violence, exploitation, and other indicators of potential harm. Share appropriate digital resources and escalate concerning content in accordance with established protocols.
  • Crisis Support Coordination: Collaborate with crisis services professionals and emergency responders when necessary to help connect young people experiencing urgent situations with appropriate support.
  • Reporting and External Coordination: Prepare and submit timely reports to law enforcement, child protective services, the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC), and other relevant agencies when required.
  • Documentation and Compliance: Maintain accurate records of moderation activities, safety incidents, escalations, and other relevant interactions, ensuring established documentation and reporting procedures are followed.
  • User Engagement and Facilitation: Respond to questions promptly, facilitate constructive discussions when appropriate, and communicate with users in an empathetic, respectful, and inclusive manner.
  • Community Insights and Improvement: Collect user feedback, identify recurring concerns and conversation trends, and share insights that can inform improvements to the platform and community experience.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with crisis intervention teams and colleagues across the organization to coordinate responses, share relevant information, and support broader prevention and safety objectives.
  • Continuous Learning and Inclusion: Strengthen LGBTQ+ cultural competency, stay informed about online safety practices, and contribute to a workplace and community grounded in diversity, inclusion, equity, and belonging.
  • Professional Accountability: Demonstrate sound judgment, ethical decision-making, attention to detail, effective time management, and the ability to handle multiple priorities within strict deadlines.

Requirements

  • Community Management Experience: Previous experience managing online communities, particularly in environments focused on harm reduction, user well-being, and digital safety.
  • Content Moderation Expertise: Hands-on experience reviewing user-generated content, identifying policy violations, and responding appropriately to harmful or inappropriate online behavior.
  • Trust and Safety Knowledge: Experience interpreting and applying online community policies, trust and safety procedures, and content moderation guidelines consistently and fairly.
  • Incident Reporting Experience: Experience preparing or submitting reports to law enforcement, child protective services, NCMEC, or other relevant authorities in accordance with established procedures.
  • Communication Skills: Strong spoken and written English proficiency, with the ability to respond clearly and professionally to user inquiries and communicate sensitive information appropriately.
  • Empathy and Emotional Intelligence: Demonstrated ability to listen actively, respond compassionately, build mutual understanding, and interact respectfully with people from diverse backgrounds.
  • Risk Recognition and Judgment: Ability to recognize potentially harmful content, identify signs of distress, follow escalation procedures, and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive situations.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong organizational skills and accuracy in reviewing content, documenting incidents, maintaining records, and following established protocols.
  • Problem-Solving and Multitasking: Ability to prioritize competing tasks, manage time-sensitive requests, adapt to changing circumstances, and work effectively under pressure.
  • Teamwork and Collaboration: Proven ability to work constructively with colleagues, share information responsibly, and coordinate with internal teams and external agencies.
  • Commitment to Inclusion: A genuine commitment to supporting LGBTQ+ young people and fostering an inclusive, affirming environment. Willingness to continue developing cultural awareness and competency is essential.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Availability to work a five-day schedule that includes at least one weekend day and non-standard hours, supporting a community that operates 24 hours a day, seven days a week, throughout the year.
  • Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. Employment visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • Remote Work Eligibility: Must be based in the continental United States, Alaska, or Hawaii and able to maintain a secure, suitable remote working environment.
  • Additional Consideration: Candidates should be prepared to review potentially distressing content involving suicide, self-harm, violence, child sexual exploitation, bullying, harassment, and other sensitive safety issues. The role may also involve coordination with law enforcement and emergency services.

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: Starting pay of $28 per hour.
  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Health insurance coverage, including plans that support gender-affirming care needs.
  • Mental Health Support: Access to mental health resources, virtual care, and a range of in-network and out-of-network support options.
  • Retirement Savings: A 403(b) retirement plan with a 3% employer match, subject to a three-year vesting schedule.
  • Paid Time Off: Generous paid leave and company holidays to support rest, recovery, and work-life balance.
  • Employee Assistance Program: Access to confidential emotional support, work-life resources, financial and legal guidance, and online assistance.
  • Remote Work Flexibility: The ability to work remotely from the continental United States, Alaska, or Hawaii.
  • Home Office Support: Work technology provided, along with a home office setup reimbursement and monthly internet reimbursement.
  • Mission-Driven Work: The opportunity to contribute directly to suicide prevention, crisis intervention, and online safety for LGBTQ+ young people.
  • Inclusive Workplace: A commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, accessibility, and belonging.
  • Union Representation: This is a union-represented position covered by a collective bargaining agreement with the Communications Workers of America (CWA).
How Jobgether works:

title: Assistant Controller
description:
ASSISTANT CONTROLLER

This is a full-time, salary exempt position. The Assistant Controller will play a key role in supporting the financial health and operational success of our plant. You will work closely with the Controller to oversee daily accounting activities, prepare accurate financial reports and contribute to budgeting and forecasting efforts. In this role, you’ll collaborate across departments to resolve invoicing issues, support inventory accuracy, and ensure timely vendor and customer transactions. This is a hands-on role where your attention to detail and problem-solving skills will directly impact the efficiency and accuracy of our financial processes.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting
  • Must be highly skilled in dealing with financial and numeric data.
  • Must be highly skilled in use of Excel Spreadsheets.
  • 2 or more years experience in accounting
  • 3 or more years related experience within a general accounting support function, preferably accounts payables or receivables.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office suite software products including Excel and Word, in addition to general knowledge of the use and application of computerized accounting software (SAP) and related database management systems
  • Manufacturing industry experience preferred

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist the Controller in managing daily accounting activities, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, general ledger, inventory, reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Prepare, review, and submit daily, weekly, and monthly financial reports, including plant-level P&L statements.
  • Support monthly financial statement processing, budgeting, forecasting, and participation in weekly forecast meetings.
  • Post and review journal entries and verify general ledger accuracy.
  • Provide support to the Senior Accountant and collaborate with staff across sales, customer service, shipping, maintenance, and operations to ensure timely payments, invoicing accuracy, and resolution of customer credit memos.
  • Oversee month-end inventory reconciliations and support operations with corrections when needed.
  • Provide guidance and training to accounting and plant staff to ensure alignment with financial processes.
  • Identify and recommend process improvements to strengthen accuracy and efficiency.
  • Collaborate with both plant teams and the corporate office to maintain alignment and compliance.
  • Conduct daily production and revenue analysis, reconciling with SAP systems.
  • Ensure precise physical inventories and cycle counts of materials.
  • Prepare weekly consumption estimates and assist in comprehensive month-end closings.
  • Collaborate on the development of the annual budget for executive presentation.
  • Engage in substantial ad hoc reporting and data analysis.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret financial statements, general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, contracts, and government regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, vendors, customers, and the general public.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, volume, and net present value. Ability to evaluate financial alternatives and recognize and interpret financial trends and performance.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Computer literate (MS Office including Word, Excel and PowerPoint as well as accounting software)

Reading and writing command of the English language

Intermediate Excel skills including: formulas, pivot tables

Proficient knowledge and application of accounting principles

Preferred skills: SAP, advanced Excel.

PERKS OF PRATT!

Competitive compensation plans, full benefits package, paid vacation, and paid holidays.

  • Benefit eligible within one month of hire. Including medical, dental, vision, life, STD, FSA, Pre-Paid Legal & Identity Theft.
  • Eligible for annual Incentive Bonus
  • 401(k) with a company match after 90-days
  • Wellness reimbursement program within ONE MONTH of hire
  • No waiting period on 9 paid holidays annually
  • PAID vacation days

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job. Those include but are not limited to the following:

  • Ability and willingness to work in a fast pace and dynamic environment.
  • Must be able to wear safety glasses, ear protection, and steel toed shoes on the job.
  • Expect and be able to accommodate short notice for overtime and weekend work schedules.
  • Ability and willingness to travel for conferences, training, etc.
  • Willingness to relocate for future advancement preferred.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Employee is regularly required to walk and talk and hear and sit. Vision requirements include: close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

The performance of the Assistant Controller will be measured as follows:

Operating standards - The employee will need to meet or exceed the Operating Standards set in the areas of quality, cost, safety, planning, customer satisfactions, supervision, efficiency, and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the manager.

Personal growth - Each year there will be professional goals developed and agreed to by the manager and supervisor.

Employee relations – The employee will be evaluated regarding his/her skills and advancements in the areas of motivational techniques and results, positive and corrective/constructive feedback, subordinate development and creating a positive work environment.

Creativity – This will be evaluated by how active the employee is in participating in advancing the business through new and innovative ideas.

Responsible for all activities associated with safely operating production machines

 Work safely at all times, be aware of surroundings and understand and comply with

responsible for safety related items. Participate in Plant Safety Committee.

 Learn and comply with Pratt Industries quality procedures and policies. Stop bad

quality being sent to customer.

capacity and speed. Improve set up times daily, improve downtime daily. Identify

Utility with job duties on the machine, downtime, setup times and quality.

limited to: Production Data, Machine Operational Status, Safety Data, Quality Data.
 Turn in maintenance work order requests to supervision for needed repairs on the
machine or machines. Be proactive in the maintenance and housekeeping of
equipment.
 Switch duties with co-workers as necessary. Learning environment to learn as many
job duties to assist with plant growth and personal and professional growth
opportunities.
 Comply with all company policies and procedures, including safety and maintaining
good housekeeping.
 Adheres to production schedule. Makes recommendations for optimizing the
schedule to meet cost, quality and service goals. Reports any unusual scheduling
issues to Supervisor.
 Must be able to work overtime as necessary, sometimes on short notice. We serve
our customers 24x7 – 365 days a year and sometimes work on holidays not
avoidable.
 Additional duties may be assigned by management.

High school diploma or GED.

Prior work experience in the packaging industry; paper, plastics, converting
6 months’ experience in some type of manufacturing operation.

Able to read and follow instructions; quality, safety, job packets


MATHEMATICAL SKILLS
Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts
such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school
math.


REASONING ABILITY
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written,
oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving one or more concrete
variables in standardized situations.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS
May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk,
and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel;
reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may
occasionally be required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50
pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision,
color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

title: Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist based in Australia.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist to manage provider enrollment, credentialing, and medical billing operations in a remote healthcare environment. In this role, you will coordinate with insurance payers, healthcare providers, and internal teams to ensure accurate documentation, timely claims processing, and reliable reimbursement. You will oversee credentialing applications and renewals while maintaining compliance with payer requirements and applicable healthcare regulations. Your expertise in insurance billing, coding, and claims resolution will help minimize denials and prevent delays in provider network participation. You will also monitor payment discrepancies, maintain comprehensive records, and identify opportunities to improve revenue cycle processes. This is an opportunity to contribute to efficient healthcare administration while supporting providers and delivering operational accuracy.

Accountabilities:

As a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist, you will oversee the full lifecycle of provider credentialing, insurance enrollment, and claims management. You will ensure that provider records remain accurate, billing activities meet payer requirements, and reimbursement issues are addressed promptly through effective coordination and follow-up.

  • Prepare and submit credentialing applications for new healthcare providers across commercial insurance carriers, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care organizations.

  • Manage provider re-credentialing within required timelines to prevent lapses in insurance network participation.

  • Maintain accurate provider information in credentialing databases, payer portals, and related systems.

  • Coordinate with providers to collect required documentation, professional licenses, certifications, and signatures.

  • Review, prepare, and submit medical insurance claims accurately using electronic health record (EHR) and billing systems.

  • Apply appropriate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes, including relevant modifiers, in accordance with applicable billing guidelines.

  • Verify patient demographics, insurance eligibility, and coverage details before submitting claims.

  • Apply payer-specific policies, fee schedules, and filing deadlines to support accurate and timely claims processing.

  • Monitor claim status through payer portals, manage claim edits and rejections, and coordinate necessary adjustments.

  • Post insurance payments, contractual adjustments, and write-offs accurately, identifying underpayments and payment discrepancies.

  • Reconcile daily, weekly, and monthly payment reports and maintain accurate billing records.

  • Investigate claim denials and rejections, prepare supporting documentation, and submit timely appeals.

  • Maintain detailed follow-up logs to track outstanding claims through resolution.

  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, CMS requirements, payer policies, and applicable federal and state regulations.

  • Collaborate with clinical, administrative, and revenue cycle teams to resolve billing and credentialing issues.

  • Serve as a liaison between healthcare providers and insurance payers, resolving enrollment discrepancies and network participation issues.

  • Monitor changes in payer requirements, credentialing policies, and coding guidelines to maintain compliance.

  • Maintain credentialing logs, spreadsheets, databases, and expiration-date trackers to ensure deadlines are met.

  • Audit credentialing files for completeness and accuracy and prepare management reports on application progress, pending items, and compliance status.

  • Identify recurring payer issues and recommend process improvements to strengthen operational efficiency and reimbursement outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines hands-on medical credentialing and billing experience with a strong understanding of insurance payer processes, coding standards, and healthcare compliance. You should be highly organized, comfortable managing multiple deadlines, and able to communicate effectively with providers, insurance representatives, and internal stakeholders.

    • High school diploma or equivalent required; an associate or bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, or a related field is preferred.

    • At least two years of experience in medical credentialing, medical billing, or both, preferably working with multiple insurance payers.

    • Strong working knowledge of commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care credentialing and reimbursement processes.

    • Familiarity with CAQH ProView, NPPES, PECOS, Availity, payer portals, and EHR or medical billing software.

    • Demonstrated experience preparing accurate claims, resolving denials, following up on outstanding payments, and maintaining compliance with payer requirements.

    • Understanding of CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding systems, including modifier requirements.

    • Knowledge of provider enrollment, re-credentialing procedures, insurance eligibility verification, claim submission deadlines, and payer-specific policies.

    • Medical billing or coding certification, such as Certified Professional Biller (CPB), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), or an equivalent qualification, is an advantage.

    • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate, complete, and well-organized records.

    • Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple applications, claims, and deadlines simultaneously.

    • Effective written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with healthcare providers, insurance representatives, patients, and colleagues.

    • Proficiency in credentialing, billing, and documentation systems, with the ability to learn new tools and workflows.

    • Understanding of HIPAA, CMS, NCQA, and other applicable healthcare compliance standards.

      • Opportunity to develop expertise across provider credentialing, medical billing, insurance claims, and revenue cycle operations.

title: Super Operator
description:
About the Role

The Converting Super Operator will help ensure the safe operations of machinery and the quality and quantity of product produced. They must have the ability to effectively operate two or more different machines in the converting department; this includes one die cutter and one Flexo folder gluer. They contribute to the complete functionality of the machine center in addition to the general maintenance of the production area. This includes all reports and/or data collection and effective operation of the machine center to its highest standard. All individuals assigned to the machine are to work together in a safe, efficient and effective manner to insure the production of a quality product. To achieve this level of operations all employees are required to comply with all applicable Plant and OSHA safety rules.

NORMAL DUTIES may include the following:

  • Monitors quality and specifications of incoming stock for flute, size; score position, color, label, label direction, print, and print direction and condition.
  • Monitors quality and specifications of plates and drawings.
  • Monitors and adjusts the pH and viscosity of the ink used for each job.
  • Mounts cutting dies, printing plates
  • Pulls rolls per the factory order
  • Sets side gates, belts, stacker attachments per factory order
  • Places machine in time
  • Read and follow correct lay down on the ink downs
  • Sets caliper for board and printing plate(s)
  • Maintains information in the computer system in a timely manner
  • Makes adjustments needed to ensure product being produced meets all quality standards.
  • Reports any inability to meet quality standards or setup standards to machine center supervisor.
  • Reports any maintenance problems to the machine center supervisor and assist as needed in the repair of the machine center.
  • Prepares for next order while monitoring current production, as time will allow.
  • Performs quality checks on product before and during production to ensure quality standards are met and maintained during production.
  • Perform any other duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For:

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE: High School diploma or general education degree (GED); or five years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read and interpret written documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, factory orders, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to communicate effectively.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS: Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure (English and Metric systems), using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to read an English and metric system tape measure.

REASONING ABILITY: Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization may exist. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

What’s the Work Environment Like?

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, an individual is regularly required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; talk or hear; and taste or smell. An individual frequently is required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. An individual must regularly lift and/or move up to ten pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to twenty-five pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to fifty pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

While performing the duties of this job, an individual regularly works near moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions and temperature variations. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the normal job functions.

Additional Information

Sustainable Careers Start Here

At Pratt Industries, we innovate to create packaging solutions that protect and deliver the products people need. Doing it in a sustainable, responsible way. That’s who we are.

  • Leading manufacturer of sustainable corrugated packaging solutions.
  • Employer of more than 7,500 green-collar workers at facilities throughout the U.S.
  • Recover more than 3 million tons of recyclable material.
  • World’s largest privately-held manufacturer of 100% recycled containerboard.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Directly supervises all employees assigned to the department. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; conflict resolution; team building; coaching and leading employees to improve; addressing complaints and resolving problems; documentation; and setting an example of superior behavior, attitude and performance.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED.

Two years prior supervisory experience.

Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation. This also supports the supervisor's role of teacher and trainer for his/her personnel.

Cost issues in order to make daily decisions that will reduce overall costs and will help the supervisor find areas that require improvement.

Quality standards.

Regulatory requirements including but not limited to wage and hour requirements, environmental and waste minimization, company policies, and personnel requirements including OSHA, DEQ and EEO.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES

The individual must posses the following:

Superior time management skills including the ability to manage multiple issues concurrently and the ability to lead an effective and efficient meeting.

Teaching skills in order to function effectively as a teacher for his personnel both in the technical and administrative parts of the position.

Excellent crisis manager who demonstrates that he/she has a high emotional control under adverse conditions and can lead his/her personnel to a successful resolution.

Excellent employee relations skills including being an active listener, understanding how to appraise personnel, applying both positive and corrective feedback, being able to resolve conflicts either involving the supervisor directly or as a third party, understands and demonstrates positive motivational skills including coaching and delegation techniques.

Demonstrated confidence including providing a consistent leadership style with an acceptable level of professional assertiveness.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

The performance of the supervisor will be measured as follows:

Operating standards - the supervisor will need to meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the supervisor.

Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the supervisor to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the supervisor and his/her superior.

Employee relations - through observations the supervisor will be evaluated regarding his/her skills and advancements in the areas of motivational techniques and results, positive and corrective/constructive feedback, subordinate development and creating a positive work environment.

Creativity - this will be evaluated by how active the supervisor is in participating in advancing the business through new and innovative ideas.

title: Onboarding Engineer
description:

We are seeking an Onboarding Engineer to lead the technical implementation and coordination of customer onboarding in a fast-growing SaaS environment. This role combines hands-on engineering expertise with project management to ensure seamless integrations and successful customer launches. You will work closely with onboarding, customer success, and engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and deliver a consistent customer experience. Your work will directly influence customer retention, product adoption, and long-term growth. You will also help build scalable processes, documentation, and metrics to improve onboarding efficiency. This is an opportunity to shape technical onboarding practices while contributing to an innovative, AI-driven approach to partnership management.

  • Partner with the Onboarding Manager to coordinate the full onboarding lifecycle, from kickoff through go-live and handoff to Customer Success.

  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues, including integration failures, data synchronization problems, and configuration challenges.

  • Develop and maintain onboarding runbooks, integration guides, technical documentation, and repeatable implementation processes.

  • Collaborate with Engineering to escalate product issues, document bugs with clear reproduction steps, and advocate for product improvements that support successful onboarding.

  • Coordinate with Customer Success to ensure smooth transitions from onboarding to ongoing customer support.

  • Define, monitor, and improve onboarding success metrics, including time to first value, technical blockers, and integration completion rates.

  • Identify onboarding risks proactively, communicate potential delays, and recommend solutions to keep projects on track.

  • Support the Onboarding Manager in customer communications concerning technical requirements, implementation progress, and timelines.

  • Contribute to the growth of the onboarding function by helping establish scalable practices and mentoring future onboarding engineers.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with customer-facing implementation experience, excellent organizational abilities, and a collaborative approach. You should be comfortable managing multiple onboarding projects while communicating complex technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders.

    • 3–4 years of technical experience in B2B SaaS implementation, customer onboarding, or customer success engineering.

    • Hands-on experience with APIs, data integrations, technical configuration, and troubleshooting.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical customers and present implementation plans to leadership.

    • Experience managing customer implementations or onboarding projects throughout the full lifecycle, from kickoff to go-live.

    • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple customer onboardings and maintain close attention to detail.

    • Familiarity with CRM integrations, particularly Salesforce or HubSpot, or comparable enterprise tools, is an advantage.

    • A consultative mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs, ask thoughtful questions, and proactively recommend solutions.

    • A strong commitment to quality, including identifying potential issues early and implementing measures to prevent recurring problems.

    • Ability to collaborate effectively and build strong relationships across Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering.

    • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience demonstrating technical expertise.

      • Nice to Have:

      • Experience with Bubble.io, n8n, or other low-code/no-code platforms.

      • Familiarity with partnership management or ecosystem tools.

      • Experience creating technical documentation, implementation guides, or knowledge bases.

      • Knowledge of AWS Lambda or similar serverless architectures.

        • Competitive salary and benefits package.

        • A hybrid technical and operational role with potential for progression into leadership.

description:
Etsimme nyt osaavia telineasentajia Turun seudulle.

Kuvaus työstä

Etsimme jo kokemusta omaavia telineasentajia pidempiaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Työtä tehdään tunti- ja urakkatöinä. Tehtävänäsi on asentaa ja purkaa telineet kohteessa, jonka lisäksi myös mm. rakentaa sääsuojia. Hakemillamme tekijöillä työote ja motivaatio on huippuluokkaa, ja erilaiset sääolosuhteetkaan ei hetkauta. Kohteet sijaitsee Turussa ja lähialueilla hyvien liikenneyhteyksien varrella.

Hakeaksesi tätä työpaikkaa, sinulla tulee olla:

  • Kokemus telineasennuksista.
  • Voimassa oleva ammattikortti (työturvallisuuskortti ) - jos ei ole, niin se on suoritettava ennen töiden aloitusta.
  • Suomen kielen taito - työnjohtokielenä on suomi.
  • Hyvä työmoraali – työ on itsenäistä ja vastaat itse työnjäljestäsi.
  • Luotettavuutta - me luotamme sinuun työntekijänä, joten toivomme että luotat meihin työnantajana.

Vision työntekijälupaus

Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, että työsopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi.

Visiolaisena saat tässä tehtävässä:

  • Osaamisesi mukaan määräytyvän palkan.
  • Määräaikaisen työsuhteen arviolta elokuuhun.
  • Palkanmaksun kaksi kertaa kuukaudessa.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!

Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

title: Senior data Engineer
description:
At Whānau Āwhina Plunket we are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our Data and Insights team.

Te Whiwhinga mahi | The opportunity

In this senior technical role, you will take ownership of maintaining, improving and extending our data warehouses, reporting artefacts, dashboards and data products. Working within our Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 and Power BI Service environment, you will help ensure our data is reliable, well governed and ready to support trusted reporting and decision-making across the organisation.

You will provide hands‑on engineering capability alongside technical leadership, setting strong standards for pipeline development, testing, documentation, deployment and operational support. You will also work closely with colleagues across Data and Insights, Digital, ICT Operations and the wider organisation to turn complex business and reporting needs into practical, sustainable data solutions.

This is a full‑time permanent position, however we are willing to consider part time hours. This role must be based in New Zealand but can be done from anywhere around the country.

Your Work Will Include

  • Building and maintaining data pipelines across raw, structured, curated and semantic layers using Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, PySpark and Spark SQL
  • Designing medallion architecture patterns, dimensional models and semantic datasets for AI use cases, analytics and Power BI reporting
  • Developing, maintaining and improving ETL processes, tools and code
  • Monitoring pipeline performance, resolving data issues and validating outputs against agreed business rules
  • Implementing data quality, reconciliation, testing, lineage and access‑control practices
  • Building reports and dashboards and automating repeatable data requests and processes
  • Contributing to CI/CD and infrastructure‑as‑code practices across Databricks and Azure
  • Providing technical guidance, coaching, peer review and quality assurance across the team

He kōrero mōu | About you

You are an experienced data engineering professional who can combine strong technical capability with sound judgement, curiosity and a collaborative approach.

You are comfortable taking ownership of complex data pipelines and working through legacy logic, reporting requirements and dataquality issues. You can explain technical concepts clearly, build trusted relationships with stakeholders and respectfully challenge thinking when needed to achieve the right outcome.

Ideally, You Will Bring

  • At least five years’ experience as a Data Engineer, Data Warehouse Developer, Database Developer or in a similar role, including experience at a senior or specialist level
  • A relevant qualification in computer science, mathematics, statistics or another related discipline
  • Strong practical experience with Azure Databricks, Delta Lake and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
  • Advanced SQL skills and production experience using PySpark and Spark SQL
  • Experience designing and building medallion architecture layers for business intelligence and analytics
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing and modelling approaches, including dimensional or Kimball modelling, star schemas and semantic‑layer design
  • Experience developing and supporting ETL processes, data warehouses, data products, reports and dashboards
  • Experience with data‑quality testing, reconciliation, schema evolution, MERGE or upsert patterns, optimisation and partitioning
  • An understanding of Power BI Service and how curated datasets and semantic models support downstream reporting
  • Familiarity with Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows and Repos, Azure DevOps CI/CD, Databricks Asset Bundles and Terraform or similar technologies

Experience working with health, social‑care or client information would be an advantage, as would proficiency in Python, R, JavaScript or Bash.

Ngā hua mahi o Te Whānau Āwhina | What we offer

Whānau Āwhina Plunket is the largest service in Aotearoa supporting the health and wellbeing of tamariki under five and their whānau. The data products you develop will support people across our organisation to better understand our services, organisational performance and the needs of the communities we serve.

You will join a collaborative Data and Insights team where you can influence technical direction, improve engineering practices and contribute to meaningful work with a genuine social impact.

We are committed to supporting your wellbeing and ongoing learning and development, we offer Two Well health Days to proactively look after your wellbeing along with EAP and access to Fitness Passport.

  • EAP
  • Access to Fitness Passport

If you are looking for a senior data engineering opportunity where your technical expertise can contribute to healthier tamariki, confident whānau and connected communities, we would love to hear from you.
