title: Threat Hunter
description:
We are seeking a highly capable and hands-on Threat Hunter to join a passionate and motivated, industry-leading team focused on identifying sophisticated adversaries through hypothesis-driven analysis and automation. You will be responsible for proactively hunting and analysing advanced threats across the customers environment using our proprietary hunting framework, ensuring our threat models and threat hunts are tightly aligned to the customer.

As a Threat Hunter, you will actively search for cyber threats that evade traditional security solutions. Your role will involve conducting in-depth intelligence-led, hypothesis-driven analysis of TTPs and behaviours, and working cross-functionally with the Security Operations Centre Analysts, Global Detection Engineers, Privacy Team and Engineering Team to mitigate risks.
  • Use NCC Group’s HITS Framework, threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK, and risk models to form hypotheses and validate them through structured hunts.
  • Leverage GitLab, Sigma, Jupyter Notebooks and other tools to automate hunts, visualise results, and create reusable artifacts for future investigations and detections.
  • Collaborate with detection engineering to convert threat hunt findings into high fidelity detection content.
  • Utilising both NCC Groups internal threat intelligence feeds and open-source threat intelligence, use these to operationalise detections for emerging threats.
  • Support the mapping of threat models to monitoring use cases in partnership with teams across the business.
  • Document and maintain a robust repository for hunting methodologies, tooling, and findings to enable continuous improvement and team scaling.
  • Provide regular reports and presentations to stakeholders, with clear articulation of threats, methods, and risk impact.
  • The ideal candidate is a highly skilled and proactive Threat Hunter with a strong background in hypothesis-driven hunting, adversary TTP analysis, and cross-functional collaboration.
  • They have hands-on experience in Threat Hunting, Red Team, Blue Team, or Incident Response roles, with a deep understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and a proven ability to detect and investigate advanced threats beyond signature-based solutions.
  • Experienced using one or more of Splunk, Microsoft, CrowdStrike and SentinelOne SIEM and EDR stacks.
  • Experience translating threat intelligence into actionable insights and working alongside detection engineers and security analysts to operationalise findings.
  • They should be driven by curiosity and methodical thinking, constantly seeking to improve visibility and detection coverage across complex environments—including hybrid or cloud-native architectures like AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • They will be comfortable presenting findings to stakeholders and documenting methodologies.
  • They thrive in fast-moving, varied and dynamic environments and are passionate about staying ahead of evolving threats.

Minimum Requirements

  • Experience within a Threat Hunter, Red Team, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Malware Analysisor Blue Team role.
  • Solid understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework, TTP analysis, and adversary emulation.
  • Deep familiarity with hypothesis-driven threat hunting frameworks and methodologies.
  • Ability to work autonomously while collaborating across security, engineering, and business teams.
  • Strong scripting/query language skills (e.g., Python, KQL, SQL, PowerShell).

Desirable Requirements

  • Hands-on experience using Jupyter Notebooks for data exploration, automation, and visualization in a security context.
  • Knowledge of cloud products and log events such as Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform.
  • Familiarity with data science and machine learning techniques in security analysis.
  • Background in building automated hunting pipelines and/or detection-as-code.

Desirable Certifications

  • GCFA
  • OSCP
  • GDAT
  • GCIH

title: Maintenance Lead
description:
POSITION TITLE: MAINTENANCE WORKER

REPORTS TO: Maintenance Manager

SUMMARY

Responsible for maintaining all converting and corrugating equipment to minimize downtime.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Practice safe work habits at all times.

Demonstrate ability to parallel all rolls, make all required settings and adjustments for optimum equipment performance to manufacture quality products.

Demonstrate ability to teach other maintenance classifications in all qualification requirements and proper maintenance procedures.

Demonstrate ability to troubleshoot programmable controllers and troubleshoot and repair all A/C and D/C drives and their control systems use.

Demonstrate ability to use all aspects of the maintenance software program.

Demonstrate ability to plan and schedule maintenance work, assign work to other maintenance classifications according to their abilities and limitations.

Follow up all work in order to insure repairs and work are performed properly.

Maximize the utilization of equipment by maintaining the machinery to run at available capacity and speed.

Complete all paperwork neatly, correctly, and in accordance with Company guidelines.

Willingly work all necessary hours and shifts.

Help maintain good housekeeping in work areas.

Comply with all company policies and procedures, including safety and maintaining good housekeeping.

Additional duties may be assigned by management.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED.

Successfully demonstrate all Class B qualifications.

Provide own tools necessary to perform maintenance tasks.

Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:

Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Able to read and follow instructions on factory masters.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving one or more concrete variables in standardized situations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation.

Product layouts and production specifications

Product quality specifications

Quality standards

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License and/or other appropriate certification to work in certain areas or on certain equipment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

The performance of the employee will be measured as follows:

Operating standards - the employee will need to meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the employee.

Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the employee to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the employee and his/her superior.

Employee relations - through observations the employee will be evaluated regarding his/her behaviors associated with appropriate human interaction, respect and communication.

Creativity - this will be evaluated by how active the employee is in participating in advancing the business through new and innovative ideas.

title: Data Engineer Fabric
description:
Voor een van onze klanten - een internationale enterprise organisatie met een sterke focus op datagedreven werken - zoeken we een Azure Data Engineer met ervaring in het Microsoft-ecosysteem.

Je werkt mee aan het uitbouwen van een modern dataplatform in Azure, waarbij je mee vorm geeft aan de datastromen, integraties en transformaties in een complexe omgeving met veel aandacht voor schaalbaarheid, performantie en security.

  • Ervaring met of een sterke interesse in Microsoft Fabric.
  • Kennis van Power BI.
  • Basiskennis van SQL.
  • Interesse in data modelling, ETL/ELT en data pipelines.
  • Een analytische en probleemoplossende ingesteldheid.
  • Je werkt gestructureerd en hebt oog voor datakwaliteit.
  • Je communiceert vlot met zowel technische als niet-technische collega's.

ELT, Windows Azure, Engelse taal, Beveiligingsdienst, SQL, Pijpleiding, Factory, Microsoft BI, Nederlands, Python, Fabric, ETL

title: AI Enablement and Learning Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Enablement and Learning Specialist based in Germany.

We are looking for an AI Enablement and Learning Specialist to transform learning strategies into practical, AI-powered solutions that improve how people access and use knowledge. In this remote contract role, you will combine artificial intelligence, workflow automation, knowledge management, and learning design to build scalable enablement experiences. You will prototype AI-supported resources, streamline onboarding, and develop systems that make learning more accessible and efficient. Working closely with stakeholders across the organization, you will turn emerging needs and open-ended ideas into practical solutions. You will have the autonomy to experiment with new technologies, improve existing processes, and implement initiatives from concept to launch. This opportunity is ideal for a proactive, systems-oriented professional who enjoys solving complex problems in a global, asynchronous-first environment.

Accountabilities:

As an AI Enablement and Learning Specialist, you will develop and maintain AI-powered learning solutions, optimize knowledge management processes, and ensure that learning systems operate efficiently. You will collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement and translate learning objectives into accessible, automated, and scalable experiences.

  • Research AI-powered approaches to learning and enablement, evaluating opportunities and recommending practical solutions aligned with organizational goals.

  • Prototype learning resources and automated workflows using Claude and other relevant AI tools, turning successful experiments into reliable, usable solutions.

  • Develop and launch learning initiatives from initial concept through implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement.

  • Manage and optimize asynchronous onboarding processes to deliver a smooth, consistent, and largely automated experience for new team members.

  • Maintain and improve learning platforms and collaboration tools, including Sana LMS, Notion, and Claude, ensuring they remain reliable and easy to use.

title: Real Estate Director
description:
About Mindspace

At Mindspace, work doesn’t feel like work. Since 2014, we’ve been creating flexible, design-led workspaces across Europe, Israel, and the US where people – startups, enterprises, entrepreneurs, and digital nomads – can thrive. With over 15,000 members in 45 locations, we blend hospitality, style, and innovation so every space feels alive.

Why you’ll love it here

Because at Mindspace, people show up, take ownership, support each other, and keep things moving – even when things change.

This is a high-impact role, working directly with the CEO and senior leadership on some of the company’s most important growth decisions.

About the position

We’re looking for an experienced Real Estate Director to drive Mindspace’s growth and strengthen our existing portfolio. You’ll own a pipeline of new opportunities, including new locations, leases, management agreements and other partnership structures with landlords. You’ll also lead renegotiations and renewals across our existing locations.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can analyze a deal, understand the numbers behind it, turn that analysis into a clear recommendation, and then help get it done.

What you’ll do

  • Build and manage a pipeline of on-market and off-market opportunities across Mindspace markets.
  • Lead transactions end to end: site selection, underwriting, negotiation, documentation and execution.
  • Lead renewals, extensions and renegotiations of existing leases to improve terms across the current portfolio.
  • Structure deals across leases, management agreements, JVs and other landlord partnership models.
  • Build financial models, business cases and scenario analyses for new locations and strategic opportunities.
  • Prepare investment memos and present recommendations, risks and deal structures to senior leadership.
  • Negotiate with landlords, developers and brokers, making sure key commercial and legal terms protect Mindspace.
  • Work closely with Mindspace’s market managers on sourcing, evaluating and executing deals in their markets, and with Finance, Legal, Design and Operations through approval and handover.
  • Support real estate due diligence and portfolio analysis for potential acquisitions.
  • Track market trends and competitors to identify new growth opportunities.

Requirements

What we need from you

  • 7+ years of experience in commercial real estate transactions, investments, acquisitions or a closely related field.
  • Strong hands-on financial modelling and underwriting skills – a must.
  • Proven track record of negotiating and closing complex real estate deals.
  • Experience with landlord partnership structures (management agreements, JVs, revenue share) – an advantage.
  • Experience in flexible workspace, hospitality or commercial office real estate – an advantage.
  • Ability to turn complex financial and commercial information into clear recommendations for senior decision-makers.
  • Strong negotiation and relationship-building skills, with a network among landlords and brokers.
  • Highly independent and hands-on, able to manage multiple deals across markets at the same time.
  • Experience working across multiple markets – an advantage. Experience in the German market – a strong advantage.
  • Fluent English.
  • Willingness to travel regularly across Mindspace markets.

Please submit your application in English.

title: Junior Set Designer I Special Projects I Milan
description:
Job Title: Junior Set Designer

Business Unit: Special Projects

Employment Type: Full-time, based at BWS Milan headquarters, with possible international travels

Salary Range: 28.000 – 35.000 euro annual salary, depending on experience


About Us:

Balich Wonder Studio is an integrated entertainment Group that conceives, produces, and delivers live experiences. We create visionary projects with long-lasting value, from large-scale Ceremonies to immersive shows, events, brand experiences, and destination experiences. With a multicultural team of over 140 individuals from 20 countries, we operate through three divisions and two companies in the Middle East, including our branches in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (BWS-KSA) and Dubai, UAE (HQWS), serving the entire MEA Region. In 2023, Balich Wonder Studio was acquired by Banijay to build a Media and Entertainment powerhouse, combining the strengths of an established content group with our pioneering capabilities.

About the role:

The BWS Special Projects Unit oversees BWS’s long-standing projects while leading the creative development and executive production of new show formats, emotional masterplanning, and attraction concepts. The Unit operates across multiple disciplines, including:

• Destination experiences and theme parks, from emotional masterplanning to iconic landmarks

• Cultural projects and exhibits

• Live events and ceremonies

• Ticketed shows, based on original IP

• Architecture and design of public spaces

• Temporary and permanent artistic installations and exhibitions

We nurture each project from its earliest conceptual stage, guiding it from an abstract opportunity into a fully realized production. Through a step-by-step process, we transform visionary ideas into tangible, impactful experiences.

The Junior Set Designer is part of the Design team within the Creative Department, reporting to the Head of Design and working closely with the Creative Team. The role works mainly on destination and cultural projects: icons and landmarks, emotional masterplans, immersive exhibitions, permanent and temporary installations, IP-based ticketed shows, theme parks.

This is a creative role before a technical one. The Set Junior Designer generates ideas and helps turn them into projects, from the first brainstorming session to the creative proposal presented to the client, through research, sketching, 3D modeling, rendering and AI driven visualization and animation.


Key Responsibilities

Concept & Creative Development

• Take part in brainstorming sessions and creative workshops with the Design, Creative and Production teams, bringing original ideas and references.

• Turn brainstorming outputs into a creative design proposal, based on strong narratives and spatial storytelling: concepts, moodboards, sketches, 3D views and presentation boards.

• Develop ideas aligned with BWS’s creative vision, the client’s brief and the project’s constraints.


Destination & Spatial Design

• Contribute to emotional masterplanning for destinations and theme parks: themed areas, attractions, iconic landmarks and visitor routes.

• Design icons, landmarks, permanent and temporary installations, exhibits and exhibition spaces.

• Model and render in 3D with Rhino and Blender: volumes, spaces, landmarks, installations and sets.

• Produce basic technical drawings to support the transition from concept to development.


Visualization & Presentation

• Sketch by hand and digitally to explore and communicate ideas in the early phases.

• Use AI image and video generation tools for fast explorations, variations and concept visuals.

• Prepare presentations, boards and creative materials for bids and client meetings, with clarity and visual quality.


Research & Innovation

• Conduct visual, thematic and technical research: references, materials, technologies, trends and benchmarks.

• Stay up to date with tools, software and trends in design, AI and live entertainment.


Collaboration

• Work closely with multi-disciplinary designers, art directors and creative directors to keep concept and development aligned.

• Keep project files, references and archives organized and accessible to the team.



Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

• Degree in Set Design, Scenography, Architecture, Exhibition or Interior Design.

• 1 to 3 years of experience in a studio or agency on immersive experiences, theme parks, exhibits, installations, events or shows.

• Strong sketching skills, by hand and digital.

• 3D modelling and rendering skills in at least one of the following software packages: Rhino with Enscape, Blender, Cinema 4D or 3ds Max.

• Knowledge of AutoCAD

• Basic technical drawing skills.

• Hands-on use of AI tools for images and video.

• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite.

• Fluency in English and Italian.

• A portfolio showing concept and design work.


Personal Qualities

• Curious, with a strong research mindset and a genuine passion for live entertainment and immersive content.

• Strong visual sensibility and attention to detail.

• Able to present ideas clearly to colleagues and clients.

• Open to feedback and willing to iterate fast on a proposal.

• Team player, comfortable working on several projects in parallel.

• Composed under pressure and able to meet tight deadlines without losing quality.

• Flexible and adaptable to changing priorities based on company, project, and client needs.

• Willingness to travel for short to medium periods when required by the project.

title: Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist based in Ireland.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist to manage provider enrollment, credentialing, and medical billing operations in a remote healthcare environment. In this role, you will coordinate with insurance payers, healthcare providers, and internal teams to ensure accurate documentation, timely claims processing, and reliable reimbursement. You will oversee credentialing applications and renewals while maintaining compliance with payer requirements and applicable healthcare regulations. Your expertise in insurance billing, coding, and claims resolution will help minimize denials and prevent delays in provider network participation. You will also monitor payment discrepancies, maintain comprehensive records, and identify opportunities to improve revenue cycle processes. This is an opportunity to contribute to efficient healthcare administration while supporting providers and delivering operational accuracy.

Accountabilities:

As a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist, you will oversee the full lifecycle of provider credentialing, insurance enrollment, and claims management. You will ensure that provider records remain accurate, billing activities meet payer requirements, and reimbursement issues are addressed promptly through effective coordination and follow-up.

  • Prepare and submit credentialing applications for new healthcare providers across commercial insurance carriers, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care organizations.

  • Manage provider re-credentialing within required timelines to prevent lapses in insurance network participation.

  • Maintain accurate provider information in credentialing databases, payer portals, and related systems.

  • Coordinate with providers to collect required documentation, professional licenses, certifications, and signatures.

  • Review, prepare, and submit medical insurance claims accurately using electronic health record (EHR) and billing systems.

  • Apply appropriate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes, including relevant modifiers, in accordance with applicable billing guidelines.

  • Verify patient demographics, insurance eligibility, and coverage details before submitting claims.

  • Apply payer-specific policies, fee schedules, and filing deadlines to support accurate and timely claims processing.

  • Monitor claim status through payer portals, manage claim edits and rejections, and coordinate necessary adjustments.

  • Post insurance payments, contractual adjustments, and write-offs accurately, identifying underpayments and payment discrepancies.

  • Reconcile daily, weekly, and monthly payment reports and maintain accurate billing records.

title: Electrical and Instrumentation Technician
description:
Electrical & Instrumentation Technician: Master the Systems that Power Our Mill!

Are you an experienced and skilled E&I Technician looking for a challenging role with excellent benefits and career growth? We’re seeking a highly motivated professional to join our team, where you’ll be responsible for installing, servicing, troubleshooting, and maintaining the cutting-edge equipment that keeps our paper mill running at peak performance.

This is a hands-on position that will test your technical expertise and problem-solving abilities. You’ll work with everything from PLC's and distributed control systems to motors, transmitters, and advanced pneumatic controls. If you are dedicated, safety-focused, and ready to contribute to a high-performing team, this is an outstanding opportunity for you.

What You’ll Do and How You’ll Succeed

As an E&I Technician, you'll be the expert responsible for the mill's electrical and instrumentation systems. Your duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • System Diagnostics: Troubleshooting mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic problems on a wide range of process equipment.
  • Electrical Expertise: Repairing and wiring 120V, 460V AC, and 24V DC circuits. Installing and maintaining distribution systems, transformers, and electrical controls like coils, contactors, and relays.
  • Advanced Equipment: Servicing and maintaining a variety of critical equipment, including PLCs, distributed control systems, overhead cranes, motors, motor control centers, and guide systems.
  • Reading and Interpretation: Skillfully interpreting P&ID, hydraulic, pneumatic, and wiring diagrams to ensure accurate installations and repairs.
  • Precision Work: Using a multimeter and Megohm meter to diagnose issues, running and bending conduit, and wiring motors according to applicable codes.
  • Safe Operations: Safely racking in and out high-voltage breakers (460V, 4160V, and 12.47kV).
  • Mobile Equipment: Operating motorized equipment such as forklifts, scissor lifts, boom lifts, hoists, and cranes to support maintenance tasks.
  • Continuous Learning: Demonstrating a strong learning aptitude by participating in ongoing educational and certificate training programs.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an experienced technician with a strong commitment to safety and excellence.

  • Education and Experience: A 2- to 4-year degree from a college, university, technical school, military, vocational, or other advanced educational institution is preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered.
  • Mental & Physical Abilities: You must have the ability to read and understand technical manuals, perform basic to intermediate math, and communicate clearly. The role is physically demanding, requiring manual dexterity, lifting up to 50 lbs, climbing ladders, and the ability to operate motorized equipment safely.
  • Safety First: A meticulous approach to safety is mandatory. This includes following lockout/tag out procedures, wearing all required PPE (Personal Protective Equipment), and adhering to strict plant safety policies for energized circuits and other hazards.
  • Team Player: You'll be expected to communicate effectively with all personnel, assist with maintenance and operational tasks, and maintain a clean and safe work area.

Your Total Compensation & Benefits Package

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package that recognizes your skills and dedication.

  • Competitive Pay: This is a Salaried Non-Exempt position, which means you qualify for overtime pay for any hours worked over 40 per week.
  • Lucrative Incentive Plan: Earn up to 100% of one month's base salary every quarter through our mill incentive program!
  • Paid Holidays & Vacation
  • Company Provided Uniforms
  • Annual Safety Allowances for Boots ($300) & Glasses ($250)
  • Excellent Benefits Package:
    • Medical (HSA Plan), Dental, and Vision Plans

    • Healthy Lifestyle Programs
      • Earn up to $1200 for you HSA annually

    • Child Bearing/Parental Leave
    • Supplemental Life, Spouse, and Child Life Insurance plans
    • Short Term & Long Term Disability Plans
    • Legal and Travel Assistance Plans
    • EAP/Home Auto Insurance Plans
    • Wireless/Auto/Discount Plans

We geven je het podium en het vertrouwen om zelfstandig te werken op hoog niveau, met de constante rugdekking van een hecht en zelfsturend team.

Jouw bijdrage

  • Prioriteren en beheren van taken bij het werken aan verschillende projecten.

Welke kwaliteiten breng je mee?

Gericht op competenties en potentieel, moedigen we je aan om te solliciteren als je denkt dat je voldoende vaardigheden bezit.

Essentiële Vaardigheden

Wat we je bieden

  • Zorg & Welzijn: Een uitgebreide hospitalisatieverzekering en een ambulante verzekering die een breed scala aan medische kosten dekt.
  • Events: Vrijblijvende sociale momenten en teamactiviteiten die openstaan voor ieders voorkeur; zoals onze zomer‑bbq, een wederkerend padeltoernooi, en nog zoveel meer. Geheel divers, maar allemaal onvergetelijk!

Solliciteren bij one16

title: ACO QA E2E Engineer
description:
Location: Ra'anana

#Hybrid

DriveNets is a leader in high-scale disaggregated networking solutions. Founded in 2015, DriveNets modernizes the way service providers, cloud providers and hyperscalers build networks. Supporting the largest network in the world, more than half of AT&T’s backbone traffic is running on DriveNets’ Network Cloud open disaggregated architecture. Raising $587 million in three funding rounds, DriveNets is disrupting the networking market from high-scale architecture to AI platforms, and is bringing onboard the most talented people. We are seeking people that want to make an impact on the world’s leading communication networks and are experienced in networking architecture or AI infrastructure solutions.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, create and execute comprehensive end-to-end testing scenarios for ACO based on detailed requirements and design documents.
  • Test ACO across its UI/UX, REST APIs, database-backed workflows and the real infrastructure it manages: switch provisioning and upgrades, inventory and topology, telemetry, alerts, configuration compliance, benchmarking and multi-tenancy.
  • Maintain and ensure functionality across the QA environments: AI fabric topologies (leaf-spine, DNOS and multi-vendor switches), GPU servers, NetBox/SLURM/Kubernetes integrations and the ACO deployments.
  • Validate network connectivity, configuration and performance across the AI cluster infrastructure: high-speed Ethernet (400/800G/1.6T), GPU nodes, leaf-spine topologies, VLAN/VXLAN, IP addressing, MTU, link status, routing and packet loss.
  • Verify BGP routing functionality (neighbor establishment, route advertisement, route propagation and convergence) and EVPN/VXLAN-based isolation on data-center fabrics.
  • Execute and analyze existing AI/HPC benchmarks (RDMA, NCCL/RCCL, MPI, RoCE, training/inference, storage) on GPU and CPU clusters through ACO's benchmarking engine; compare actual performance against established baselines.
  • Review and understand benchmarking methodologies and test procedures for high-performance networking and collective communication technologies.
  • Support telemetry collection and validate test data (gNMI/OpenConfig counters, syslog, GPU and NIC metrics) for accuracy, consistency and reliability against device state.
  • Use performance analysis tools, benchmarking frameworks and diagnostic utilities to execute tests, analyze results and troubleshoot issues.
  • Execute regression tests to verify that software updates, configuration changes and platform upgrades do not introduce new issues.
  • Collaborate closely with development teams to investigate failures, reproduce defects with clear evidence, verify fixes and ensure system quality.
  • Document test procedures, execution results, defects and performance metrics to maintain traceability and reproducibility; prepare clear QA reports highlighting deviations, failures and potential issues.
  • Use AI agents in your daily work to accelerate test design, execution, evidence collection and reporting, and help grow the team's test automation.


Requirements

What We're Looking For:

  • Minimum 3 years of application testing across UI/UX, database-backed data and multi-step workflows in web-based systems, including test design from detailed requirements (STP/STD/STR).
  • Networking knowledge at CCNP level or higher: L2/L3 switching and routing, BGP, VLAN/VXLAN/EVPN, MTU/MSS, ECMP, and troubleshooting with packet captures and device CLI.
  • AI networking: data-center fabrics for AI workloads – leaf-spine and rail-optimized Clos designs, RoCEv2/RDMA, lossless Ethernet (PFC/ECN/DCQCN), 400/800G/1.6T optics and link health.
  • GPU clusters: running, monitoring and optimizing AI workloads and benchmarks (NCCL/RCCL, RDMA, MPI, training and inference) on NVIDIA/AMD GPU servers, with schedulers such as SLURM or Kubernetes.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Linux environments (CLI, networking stack, services, logs, scripting).
  • Hands-on experience working with AI agents in daily engineering work: agent skills, rules/instruction (markdown) files, MCP servers and tools, and prompt-driven workflows (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor).
  • Agile Experience: hands-on experience in Agile work processes.

Advantages:

  • QA automation experience (Python, pytest, Playwright/Selenium, REST API testing, CI pipelines).
  • Kubernetes and containers (kubectl, Helm, Lens/OpenLens, Argo CD; monitoring pod status, reading logs, troubleshooting).
  • Cloud deployments (AWS/Azure/GCP, e.g., EKS).
  • Databases: SQL querying and data validation (PostgreSQL).
  • Familiarity with network operating systems (DNOS, SONiC, Arista EOS, Junos), observability stacks (Prometheus/Mimir, Grafana/Perses, gNMI) and traffic generators (Spirent/Ixia).

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • High-level proficiency in English (both written and verbal) and clear technical writing.
  • Self-starter who learns quickly and adapts easily to new technologies.
  • Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple priorities.
  • A strong team player with a collaborative mindset.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of the team building DriveNets' AI Cluster Orchestrator, used to deploy and run some of the most demanding AI infrastructures.
  • Work hands-on with state-of-the-art AI infrastructure: 800G/1.6T Ethernet fabrics, NVIDIA and AMD GPU clusters, RoCE and collective communication.
  • Join an AI-native engineering culture where agents are part of the daily workflow.
  • Collaborate with brilliant minds in a dynamic and supportive work environment.

If you're ready to take the next step in your career and work with a world-class team, apply now!

title: AML Specialist -ZR_2669_JOB
description:
Red Ember Recruitment is currently recruiting for an experienced AML Specialist to join an established financial services organisation in Johannesburg.

The successful candidate will support the AML Officer and Chief Compliance Officer / Money Laundering Control Officer in maintaining and strengthening the organisation’s AML/CFT/CPF control framework. The role will provide practical financial crime compliance guidance across risk assessment, KYC/CDD/EDD, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, FIC reporting and regulatory requirements.

This is a senior specialist-level opportunity suited to an AML professional with strong South African regulatory, banking and financial crime compliance experience.

  • Support the maintenance and implementation of the Risk Management and Compliance Programme (RMCP) in line with the FIC Act.
  • Develop and maintain practical AML/CFT/CPF procedures and controls.
  • Support customer and institutional ML/TF/PF risk assessments and risk-rating methodologies.
  • Provide guidance on KYC, CDD, EDD, beneficial ownership, PEPs and adverse media.
  • Conduct and review sanctions, name, payment and vessel screening.
  • Perform Level 2 reviews and sign-off of screening alerts and hits.
  • Conduct and oversee transaction monitoring investigations and assess potential reporting requirements.
  • Support the identification and reporting of STRs, CTRs and IFTRs to the FIC.
  • Manage and respond to goAML/FIC requests, including regulatory information requests and freeze orders.
  • Conduct enhanced due diligence on medium-high and high-risk clients.
  • Perform prospective client, vendor and employee screening where required.
  • Support AML Forums, governance processes, action logs and regulatory evidence.
  • Conduct AML quality assurance and identify control, process and training gaps.
  • Assess regulatory changes and translate requirements into practical procedures and control enhancements.
  • Provide AML advisory support to frontline and business teams.
  • Participate in AML-related projects, system implementations and process improvements.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Matric – Essential.
  • Relevant Money Laundering / Financial Crime Compliance certificate – Essential.
  • Relevant tertiary qualification in Law, Commerce, Risk, Compliance, Accounting, Finance or a related field – advantageous.
  • ACAMS, ICA or equivalent AML/CFT/CPF certification – advantageous.

Experience

  • Minimum 3 years' banking experience.
  • Minimum 4 years' AML/CFT/CPF compliance or financial crime operations experience.
  • At least 2 years' experience in sanctions/name/payment screening, transaction monitoring and EDD.
  • At least 2 years' experience with FIC reporting/goAML, including STR, CTR, IFTR and regulatory requests.
  • Exposure to corporate/institutional banking, trade finance or cross-border payments will be advantageous.

Technical Knowledge

The successful candidate should have strong knowledge of:

  • South African AML/CFT/CPF regulatory requirements and the FIC Act.
  • RMCP requirements and risk-based AML frameworks.
  • ML/TF/PF risk assessment and customer risk-rating methodologies.
  • KYC/CDD/EDD and beneficial ownership.
  • PEP and adverse media screening.
  • Sanctions and targeted financial sanctions.
  • Transaction monitoring and financial crime typologies.
  • STR, CTR and IFTR reporting.
  • Regulatory requests and FIC requirements.
  • AML systems such as NGS, SironAML, goAML, World-Check and PA Umoja, or equivalent platforms.

Key Skills

  • Strong analytical and investigative ability.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Sound judgement and professional scepticism.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to interpret legislation and translate regulatory requirements into practical controls.
  • Strong stakeholder management and advisory skills.
  • Ability to work with confidential and sensitive information.
  • Strong organisational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under strict regulatory and internal deadlines.
  • A proactive approach to quality assurance, training and continuous improvement.

title: Group Product Manager
description:
At Classiq Technologies, we are shaping the future of quantum computing. Our mission is to make quantum computing practical and impactful by bridging the gap between hardware and real-world applications. This is a singular moment in a groundbreaking industry: we are building the foundational software layer that enables developers and enterprises to design, optimize, and deploy quantum algorithms at scale.

As we build the software stack for the fault-tolerant era, we need a visionary product leader to drive the core engine of our entire offering. You will work alongside world-class talent, tackling bleeding-edge challenges across physics, advanced algorithms, and compiler design. Classiq is already trusted by Fortune 500 leaders and global governments. If you want to leave a permanent mark on a disruptive, category-defining technology, this is your opportunity to define it.

What you'll do

  • Own the Engine: Lead the strategy, vision, and roadmap for Classiq's core quantum software domain, encompassing compilation, execution, and our fault-tolerant computing architecture.
  • Lead the Best: Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of deeply technical product managers.
  • Bridge Deep Tech and Market Reality: Translate hyper-complex quantum research—from error correction to surface-code architectures—into market-defining products.
  • Shape the Ecosystem: Drive alignment across internal research and engineering, while partnering deeply with leading hardware vendors to cement Classiq as the universal software layer for quantum computing.

Who are you

  • Deeply Technical Product Leader: You have a formidable track record leading product teams in highly complex, bleeding-edge domains (e.g., physics, compilers, languages, or applied math).
  • Strategic Architect: You possess the sharp business acumen required to make ruthless prioritization decisions, balancing long-term research bets with immediate, scalable product execution.
  • Inspiring Manager: You have proven experience recruiting, mentoring, and inspiring top-tier technical talent in fast-moving, highly ambiguous environments.
  • Unparalleled Execution: You have a history of cutting through the noise to turn abstract, highly complex technology into tangible, successful products.

Bonus points

  • Background in quantum computing, quantum error correction, or fault tolerance (surface codes, lattice surgery, decoding, resource estimation).
  • Prior experience working directly with hardware companies or research labs as partners or customers.

title: Global Head of SDLC Solution (EMEA based)
description:

You will be Valiantys’ global owner of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Developer Experience (DevEx) practice.

Your mandate is to turn Valiantys’ Atlassian, DevOps and AI expertise into differentiated, repeatable and profitable professional services solutions. You will shape the market position, build the offering portfolio, lead global practice uplift and help clients connect people, processes, platforms and AI agents across the software delivery lifecycle.

  • Define and execute the global SDLC/DevEx practice strategy and business plan.

  • Build and lead a network of regional Practice Leads across EMEA, North America and APAC.

  • Create differentiated, go-to-market-ready offerings, Solution Blueprints, IP, accelerators and delivery playbooks.

  • Build practitioner capability through enablement, certifications, mentorship and knowledge management.

  • Maintain a strong market point of view on SDLC, DevEx, DevOps and emerging AI capabilities.

Practice focus

You will shape solutions across:

  • DevOps and CI/CD modernisation

  • Developer Experience and developer flow optimisation

  • Agentic AI and AI-assisted software development

  • SDLC governance, standardisation and quality engineering

  • Atlassian Software Collection adoption and enterprise SDLC modernisation

What success looks like

  • Has a clear, differentiated portfolio of packaged and sellable solutions.

  • Converts expertise into repeatable IP and high-quality delivery.

Familiarity with how the Software Collection is positioned and deployed across enterprise environments is essential. Atlassian partner certifications are a strong advantage.

  • Proven ability to lead structured discovery and gap analysis workshops - capturing business needs, identifying SDLC maturity gaps, and translating findings into a compelling modernization vision and roadmap.

title: Onboarding Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Onboarding Engineer based in Spain.

We are seeking an Onboarding Engineer to lead the technical implementation and coordination of customer onboarding in a fast-growing SaaS environment. This role combines hands-on engineering expertise with project management to ensure seamless integrations and successful customer launches. You will work closely with onboarding, customer success, and engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and deliver a consistent customer experience. Your work will directly influence customer retention, product adoption, and long-term growth. You will also help build scalable processes, documentation, and metrics to improve onboarding efficiency. This is an opportunity to shape technical onboarding practices while contributing to an innovative, AI-driven approach to partnership management.

Accountabilities:

As an Onboarding Engineer, you will own the technical execution of customer implementations, ensuring that each onboarding progresses smoothly from initial kickoff to go-live and handoff. You will collaborate across teams to resolve issues, improve processes, and establish scalable technical standards.

  • Lead the technical setup of customer onboarding, including API integrations, data mapping, CRM configuration, authentication, and security setup.

  • Partner with the Onboarding Manager to coordinate the full onboarding lifecycle, from kickoff through go-live and handoff to Customer Success.

  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues, including integration failures, data synchronization problems, and configuration challenges.

  • Develop and maintain onboarding runbooks, integration guides, technical documentation, and repeatable implementation processes.

  • Collaborate with Engineering to escalate product issues, document bugs with clear reproduction steps, and advocate for product improvements that support successful onboarding.

  • Coordinate with Customer Success to ensure smooth transitions from onboarding to ongoing customer support.

  • Define, monitor, and improve onboarding success metrics, including time to first value, technical blockers, and integration completion rates.

  • Identify onboarding risks proactively, communicate potential delays, and recommend solutions to keep projects on track.

  • Support the Onboarding Manager in customer communications concerning technical requirements, implementation progress, and timelines.

  • Contribute to the growth of the onboarding function by helping establish scalable practices and mentoring future onboarding engineers.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with customer-facing implementation experience, excellent organizational abilities, and a collaborative approach. You should be comfortable managing multiple onboarding projects while communicating complex technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders.

    • 3–4 years of technical experience in B2B SaaS implementation, customer onboarding, or customer success engineering.

    • Hands-on experience with APIs, data integrations, technical configuration, and troubleshooting.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical customers and present implementation plans to leadership.

title: Control Room Operator - 1st Shift Rockwall, TX
description:
POSITION: Control Room Operator

SHIFT: 1st

LOCATION: Rockwall, TX

REPORTS TO: Corrugator Supervisor

SUMMARY

Responsible for all activities associated with running the slitter/scorer, including setup, operation, cleanup, and recommending improvements to operations.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Enter information into computers to set machine for order changes, scores, speed, stack height, sheet count, and number of outs.
  • Verify accuracy of information in computer.
  • Execute order changes.
  • Cross check board being produced with the corrugator dry end lineup or order scheduling computer display to ensure it is the proper board test, size, scores are properly positioned and have the correct depth, color, and coating.
  • Visually observe and physically check board for quality, including but not limited to the following: cracked scores, cut liner or medium, loose edges or liner, oil, blisters, wrinkles, wash board, warp, clean slits, proper score depth, and appearance. Perform soak tests as needed.
  • Set slitter to bring up the next run as necessary to avoid overruns or underruns
  • Set-up tear-tape machine and preprint as needed.
  • Communicate messages to the wet end regarding necessary adjustments.
  • Clear jams safely and assist in correcting other problems.
  • Turn in maintenance work orders to supervision for needed repairs. Be proactive in the maintenance of equipment.
  • Adheres to production schedule. Makes recommendations for optimizing the schedule to meet cost, quality and service goals. Reports any unusual scheduling issues to Supervisor.
  • Assist in the training of dry end personnel.
  • Comply with all company policies and procedures, including safety and maintaining good housekeeping.
  • Additional duties may be assigned by management.

EXPERIENCE

  • Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.
  • 6 months experience on the dry end of the corrugator.
  • 6 months experience on the wet end of the corrugator

LANGUAGE SKILLS

  • Able to read and follow instructions on factory masters.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

  • Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy.
  • Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate.
  • Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form.
  • Ability to deal with problems involving one or more concrete variables in standardized situations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

  • Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation.
  • Product layouts and production specifications
  • Product quality specifications
  • Quality standards

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear.
  • The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • The employee is occasionally required to sit.
  • The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts.
  • The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions.
  • The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

title: Clamp Truck Operator

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI DevEx
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, AI DevEx based in the United States.

This is an opportunity to shape the future of software development by building an AI-powered engineering platform that enables autonomous agents to handle much of the software delivery lifecycle. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design the infrastructure, environments, integrations, and safeguards that allow AI agents to turn tickets, bug reports, support requests, and production alerts into tested, reviewable code. You will combine deep infrastructure expertise with hands-on experience using coding agents to improve engineering speed, quality, and reliability. Working within a distributed, remote-first team, you will help establish the architecture and principles that make AI-driven development scalable and secure. Your impact will be measured through faster pull request cycles, reduced review delays, and an increasing share of work completed with agent assistance. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys experimentation, solving complex platform challenges, and building tools that meaningfully improve how teams work.

Accountabilities

  • AI-Powered Developer Platform: Design and build the infrastructure that enables AI agents to participate in software development, from initial task intake through implementation, testing, and pull request review.

  • Development Environments: Build and maintain reproducible local development stacks and cloud-based coding environments that allow engineers and agents to run services and tests reliably without extensive manual setup.

  • Autonomous Coding Agents: Integrate and orchestrate AI agents that transform tickets, bug reports, and other requests into validated code changes and review-ready pull requests, including browser and native application testing where appropriate.

  • Agent Selection and Orchestration: Evaluate, select, and integrate open-source and commercial coding agents. Configure triggers, credentials, contextual information, tools, and execution workflows to ensure agents operate effectively and efficiently.

  • Workflow Integrations: Connect agent workflows to tools and systems such as Slack, Jira, GitHub, Datadog, and incident management platforms, enabling production alerts and operational issues to initiate potential fixes.

  • Infrastructure and Automation: Develop and improve cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code solutions to support reliable, scalable, and repeatable agent execution.

  • Security and Governance: Establish guardrails governing agent access to data, secrets, and personally identifiable information. Define appropriate permissions, compliance controls, and human-review requirements for a regulated, real-money contest environment.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring issues that limit agent effectiveness, including missing context, unreliable tests, insufficient tools, and environment gaps, then address their root causes.

  • Agent Evaluation and Observability: Measure agent performance across coding and non-coding tasks, track execution quality and costs, and use telemetry and evaluation results to improve reliability and efficiency.

  • Business-Wide Enablement: Develop reusable agent runtimes, triggers, and safeguards that can support teams beyond engineering, helping other functions adopt automation with appropriate guidance.

  • Performance Measurement: Improve key indicators such as pull request cycle time, review latency, and the proportion of pull requests authored or reviewed by AI agents.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work independently while communicating clearly across distributed teams, sharing progress, proactively identifying opportunities, and helping establish effective practices for AI-assisted development.

    • Requirements

    • Professional Experience: At least six years of software engineering experience, including meaningful work in infrastructure, platform engineering, developer experience, or internal tooling.

    • Advanced AI Agent Usage: Current, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar tools for at least 90% of your development work. You should understand their limitations and know how to improve their results.

    • Multi-Agent Orchestration: Experience coordinating multiple agents or delegating work to subagents is highly desirable, particularly when supported by custom skills, hooks, harness configurations, or parallel execution workflows.

    • Cloud Infrastructure: Strong experience with AWS services and infrastructure, including ECS/Fargate, RDS, Lambda, networking, and IAM.

    • Infrastructure as Code and Delivery: Practical experience with Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or comparable infrastructure-as-code tools, along with containers and CI/CD pipelines that you have built, maintained, or optimized.

    • Software Development Skills: Ability to contribute directly to TypeScript and Node.js services and work comfortably within existing codebases.

    • Data-Driven Evaluation: Familiarity with assessing AI agents across coding and non-coding tasks, interpreting performance data, and using repeatable evaluations to guide technical decisions.

    • Autonomy and Initiative: Ability to identify problems independently, move quickly from experimentation to implementation, and proactively improve engineering workflows.

    • Remote Collaboration: Strong written communication skills and the ability to keep colleagues informed while collaborating across US and Prague time zones.

    • Preferred Environment Expertise: Experience with sandboxed or ephemeral development environments using Docker, devcontainers, Kubernetes, Nix, or similar technologies.

title: Stacker Operator 2nd Shift
description:
As a Stacker Operator, you’ll be part of our corrugator team, responsible for stacking, tagging and preparing finished units for shipment. This is a hands-on role for someone who’s dependable, detail-oriented, and ready to grow in a fast-paced production environment.

Shift: 2nd Shift (4:00 PM – 2:00 AM) — Must be available for overtime and occasional weekend work as needed

Starting Pay: $18.00/hour – Eligible for pay increases at 90 days and 6 months based on performance and attendance.

What You’ll Do

  • Operate conveyor lines and unitizer to stack finished units
  • Insert protective top/bottom sheets and tie sheets when needed
  • Count and verify unit and inch count; ensure proper load tags are in each unit
  • Restack, flip stack and hand-band units as necessary
  • Communicate with operators and team about production flow
  • Help train others and cross-train on other corrugator roles
  • Submit maintenance requests and support equipment upkeep
  • Learn to read corrugator lineups and support other roles (Slitter Operator, Doublebacker)
  • Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas

Who You Are

  • You’re dependable and show up ready to work every day
  • You’re a team player who follows instructions and supports others
  • You’re comfortable staying active and working around machines
  • You can read and understand safety instructions and production documents written in English
  • You can use a tape measure accurately and consistently
  • You’re confident using basic math for counts, measurements, and simple calculations
  • You’re detail-oriented and care about doing things the right way
  • You’re eager to learn, grow, and contribute to the team’s success

What to Expect on the Job

  • You’ll be on your feet for most of you shift. This includes standing, walking, bending, kneeling and regularly or moving up to 40 pounds
  • You will work near moving mechanical parts and in an environment where noise, vibration, and airborne particles are common
  • The facility is not climate controlled, which means it can be very hot in the summer and cold in the winter
  • Personal protective equipment (PPE) such as hearing protection, protective footwear, and safety glasses must be worn at all times

What We Offer

  • We are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits program designed to support the personal and professional needs of you and your family. Among the benefits available to eligible team members are:
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Healthy lifestyles programs
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • On-the-job training
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Paid childbearing and parental leave

title: Bander Operator Night Shift
description:
Job Description

POSITION TITLE: Bander Operator

REPORTS TO: Shipping Supervisor

SUMMARY

Responsible for all activities associated with operating the unitizer and corresponding equipment, including setup, operation, cleanup, and recommending improvements to operations.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Operating the unitizer and corresponding equipment, including accurate placement of bands and stretch wrap in accordance with proper setup techniques.
Ensure proper placement of unit tags and cover sheets and correct stacking patterns.
Scan barcodes on units going through unitizer.
Make neat units with proper number of bands on each unit.
Maximize the utilization of equipment by operating the machinery at available capacity and speed.
Complete necessary reports in an accurate and timely manner, including but not limited to: Production Data, Machine Operational Status, Safety Data, Quality Data.
Ensure unit quantities are correct.
Pull excess scrap from units.
Operate a forklift in a safe manner when necessary.
Turn in maintenance orders to supervision for needed repairs. Be proactive in the maintenance of equipment.
Adheres to production schedule. Makes recommendations for optimizing the schedule to meet cost, quality and service goals. Reports any unusual scheduling issues to Supervisor.
Comply with all company policies and procedures, including safety and maintaining good housekeeping.
Additional duties may be assigned by management.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED.
Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:
Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.
6 months experience in the Press or Finishing Department.
Prior work experience as a forklift operator.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Able to read and follow instructions on factory masters.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.


REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving one or more concrete variables in standardized situations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:
Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation. Product layouts and production specifications
Product quality specifications
Quality standards

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

The performance of the employee will be measured as follows:
Operating standards - the employee will need to meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the employee.
Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the employee to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the employee and his/her superior.
Employee relations - through observations the employee will be evaluated regarding his/her behaviors associated with appropriate human interaction, respect and communication.
Creativity - this will be evaluated by how active the employee is in participating in advancing the business through new and innovative ideas.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist to manage provider enrollment, credentialing, and medical billing operations in a remote healthcare environment. In this role, you will coordinate with insurance payers, healthcare providers, and internal teams to ensure accurate documentation, timely claims processing, and reliable reimbursement. You will oversee credentialing applications and renewals while maintaining compliance with payer requirements and applicable healthcare regulations. Your expertise in insurance billing, coding, and claims resolution will help minimize denials and prevent delays in provider network participation. You will also monitor payment discrepancies, maintain comprehensive records, and identify opportunities to improve revenue cycle processes. This is an opportunity to contribute to efficient healthcare administration while supporting providers and delivering operational accuracy.

Accountabilities:

As a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist, you will oversee the full lifecycle of provider credentialing, insurance enrollment, and claims management. You will ensure that provider records remain accurate, billing activities meet payer requirements, and reimbursement issues are addressed promptly through effective coordination and follow-up.

  • Prepare and submit credentialing applications for new healthcare providers across commercial insurance carriers, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care organizations.

  • Manage provider re-credentialing within required timelines to prevent lapses in insurance network participation.

  • Maintain accurate provider information in credentialing databases, payer portals, and related systems.

  • Coordinate with providers to collect required documentation, professional licenses, certifications, and signatures.

  • Review, prepare, and submit medical insurance claims accurately using electronic health record (EHR) and billing systems.

  • Apply appropriate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes, including relevant modifiers, in accordance with applicable billing guidelines.

  • Verify patient demographics, insurance eligibility, and coverage details before submitting claims.

  • Apply payer-specific policies, fee schedules, and filing deadlines to support accurate and timely claims processing.

  • Monitor claim status through payer portals, manage claim edits and rejections, and coordinate necessary adjustments.

  • Post insurance payments, contractual adjustments, and write-offs accurately, identifying underpayments and payment discrepancies.

  • Reconcile daily, weekly, and monthly payment reports and maintain accurate billing records.

  • Investigate claim denials and rejections, prepare supporting documentation, and submit timely appeals.

  • Maintain detailed follow-up logs to track outstanding claims through resolution.

  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, CMS requirements, payer policies, and applicable federal and state regulations.

  • Collaborate with clinical, administrative, and revenue cycle teams to resolve billing and credentialing issues.

  • Serve as a liaison between healthcare providers and insurance payers, resolving enrollment discrepancies and network participation issues.

  • Monitor changes in payer requirements, credentialing policies, and coding guidelines to maintain compliance.

  • Maintain credentialing logs, spreadsheets, databases, and expiration-date trackers to ensure deadlines are met.

  • Audit credentialing files for completeness and accuracy and prepare management reports on application progress, pending items, and compliance status.

  • Identify recurring payer issues and recommend process improvements to strengthen operational efficiency and reimbursement outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines hands-on medical credentialing and billing experience with a strong understanding of insurance payer processes, coding standards, and healthcare compliance. You should be highly organized, comfortable managing multiple deadlines, and able to communicate effectively with providers, insurance representatives, and internal stakeholders.

    • High school diploma or equivalent required; an associate or bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, or a related field is preferred.

    • At least two years of experience in medical credentialing, medical billing, or both, preferably working with multiple insurance payers.

    • Strong working knowledge of commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care credentialing and reimbursement processes.

    • Familiarity with CAQH ProView, NPPES, PECOS, Availity, payer portals, and EHR or medical billing software.

    • Demonstrated experience preparing accurate claims, resolving denials, following up on outstanding payments, and maintaining compliance with payer requirements.

    • Understanding of CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding systems, including modifier requirements.

    • Knowledge of provider enrollment, re-credentialing procedures, insurance eligibility verification, claim submission deadlines, and payer-specific policies.

    • Medical billing or coding certification, such as Certified Professional Biller (CPB), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), or an equivalent qualification, is an advantage.

    • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate, complete, and well-organized records.

    • Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple applications, claims, and deadlines simultaneously.

    • Effective written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with healthcare providers, insurance representatives, patients, and colleagues.

    • Proficiency in credentialing, billing, and documentation systems, with the ability to learn new tools and workflows.

    • Understanding of HIPAA, CMS, NCQA, and other applicable healthcare compliance standards.

    • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining productivity, accuracy, and consistent follow-through.

      • Opportunity to develop expertise across provider credentialing, medical billing, insurance claims, and revenue cycle operations.

Responsible for all activities associated with running the double-backer including setup, operation, cleanup, and recommending improvements to operations.

It is the entry point to mobility and energy management for businesses, fleets, partners, utilities and drivers.

We're hiring a full-time Senior Mobile Engineer, Charging to join our global hardware team on-site in Schenectady, NY. You'll build the native Android extensions that let our React Native apps talk to our next-generation EV charging hardware. The role is focused on the native layer, not on building full native apps. You'll write the Kotlin modules that give React Native apps access to the charger hardware, which they talk to locally over a 40-pin connector.

This role requires working onsite from our Schenectady, NY office five days per week.﻿

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Build and maintain native Android modules in Kotlin that extend our React Native apps, exposing charger hardware to JavaScript/TypeScript through Turbo Modules, Fabric components or legacy native modules.
  • Implement local charger communication over the 40-pin connector between the Android device and the charger hardware, including connection handling, message parsing and error recovery.
  • Work with the Android hardware and platform APIs that reach the connector (for example serial/UART and GPIO), plus foreground services and permissions, so communication stays reliable in the field.
  • Design clear, typed JS/TS interfaces for native modules (for example Codegen specs), with predictable events, error handling and lifecycle behavior.
  • Define the app-to-hardware protocols and data contracts with the embedded and hardware engineering team.
  • Package, version and document native modules, and keep them current through React Native and Android SDK upgrades.
  • Build test harnesses, simulators and automated tests (unit, instrumentation and on-device) for native-to-hardware flows, supporting hardware and firmware validation.
  • Mentor less experienced engineers, and explain problems and solutions at every level, from deep technical dives to architecture and design discussions.
  • Work across teams inside and outside engineering, including customer support, product management, marketing and sales.

Requirements


What Makes You a Great Fit

  • A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years of professional software development, including 4+ years of Android development in Kotlin (Java a plus).
  • Experience writing native modules or extensions for React Native (Turbo Modules, Fabric or legacy native modules), or for similar frameworks such as Flutter platform channels or Capacitor plugins.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, and of how React Native's native layer (JSI, Codegen, the bridge) passes data, events and work between threads.
  • Hands-on experience integrating Android with physical hardware over wired interfaces, such as serial/UART, GPIO or USB, on phones, tablets or embedded Android devices.
  • A strong grasp of Android threading, coroutines, background execution limits and runtime permissions.
  • Comfort debugging across the app and hardware boundary, using tools like serial monitors, logic analyzers and logcat.
  • Familiarity with Scrum or Kanban, the full SDLC and testing practices.
  • Clear communication with engineering and non-engineering stakeholders, and good task management.
  • Willingness to work in person at our hardware manufacturing facility in Schenectady, NY.


﻿Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Familiarity with hardware interfaces and protocols such as UART, I2C, SPI, CAN and GPIO.
  • AOSP or custom Android hardware (kiosks, embedded displays, payment terminals).
  • Experience in EV charging, energy, IoT, connected devices or smart hardware, including OCPP or UL 1998.
  • Building test apparatus for hardware or firmware validation. • General electrical safety knowledge.


Compensation and Benefits

  • The base salary range for this position is $ 95,000-$145,000 per year
  • Eligibility for an annual performance bonus and additional benefits.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on experience and qualifications.


Why Join Nayax

  • Make a tangible impact by building tools that are used across a global support organization.
  • Take ownership from day one and see your work drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Collaborate with experienced engineers, product leaders, and support experts across the company.
  • Work in a high-growth environment where your ideas can quickly become reality.
  • Be part of a global fintech leader transforming how people pay, engage, and do business.

Learn More about Nayax

Founded in 2005, Nayax is a global fintech leader providing end‑to‑end payment, consumer engagement, and business management solutions. We help businesses grow revenue, reduce operational complexity, and deliver seamless commerce experiences across unattended, self‑service, and retail environments.

With support for 80+ payment methods across 50+ currencies, a European payment institution license, and strategic partnerships with leading global financial institutions, Nayax enables secure, scalable, and future‑ready commerce worldwide.

Operating across 120+ countries with 1,200+ employees in 13 global offices, Nayax combines innovative technology with real‑world impact. At Nayax, we build long‑term value through smart automation, loyalty solutions, and an agile ecosystem designed to scale with our customers - and our people.
