title: Referrals Coordinator
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Referrals Coordinator based in the United States.

This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to healthcare service delivery by ensuring medical referrals are processed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with established benefits and medical necessity guidelines. As a Referrals Coordinator, you will manage incoming requests, maintain accurate medical management records, and connect patients with appropriate healthcare providers. You will collaborate with medical facilities, civilian providers, nurses, and supervisors to obtain information and facilitate timely referral decisions. The role requires strong administrative skills, healthcare knowledge, and the ability to navigate complex referral procedures in a regulated environment. You will also help identify sensitive cases that require specialized attention, supporting appropriate care coordination and compliance. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to healthcare operations while working within a structured, collaborative team.

Accountabilities

  • Referral Processing and Data Entry: Process incoming medical referrals, enter accurate information into medical management systems, and assign appropriate healthcare providers based on established procedures and referral requirements.
  • Benefits and Medical Necessity Review: Review referrals for applicable healthcare benefits and medical necessity requirements, identifying cases that need further clinical assessment or additional documentation.
  • Referral Escalation and Coordination: Identify sensitive diagnoses and referrals that may require case management, and forward them to the appropriate nurse, supervisor, or case management contact for review and follow-up.
  • Medical Coding and Documentation: Assign appropriate ICD-10 diagnosis codes and CPT procedure codes to referrals, ensuring accurate classification and complete documentation.
  • Healthcare Provider Communication: Respond to referral-related inquiries, handle incoming calls, and contact military treatment facilities (MTFs) and civilian healthcare providers to obtain missing information or clarify referral details.
  • Policy and Process Compliance: Apply relevant healthcare referral procedures, utilization management policies, memoranda of understanding with military treatment facilities, and applicable benefits and coverage guidelines.
  • TRICARE Referral Support: Apply knowledge of TRICARE benefits and limitations to help ensure referrals are processed according to established military healthcare requirements.
  • Administrative Accuracy and Efficiency: Maintain organized records, manage multiple requests, and ensure referral tasks are processed within established timelines and quality standards.
  • Customer Service: Provide clear, professional assistance to individuals and healthcare partners, addressing questions and facilitating the resolution of referral-related issues.

Requirements

  • Citizenship and Security Clearance: U.S. citizenship is required due to government contract requirements. Candidates must successfully obtain interim approval for a government security clearance through the National Background Investigation Services (NBIS) process.
  • Professional Experience: At least 2 years of customer service experience and/or administrative or data entry experience.
  • Healthcare Experience: At least 2 years of healthcare experience, with an intermediate working knowledge of medical terminology, CPT codes, and ICD diagnosis coding.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, with the ability to navigate multiple computer systems and applications efficiently.
  • Medical Referral Knowledge: Understanding of referral processing, healthcare benefits, medical necessity requirements, and medical documentation practices.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong organizational skills and the ability to maintain accurate records, assign appropriate codes, and handle sensitive medical information responsibly.
  • Communication Skills: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with healthcare providers, internal clinical teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Problem-Solving and Prioritization: Ability to recognize complex or sensitive cases, determine when additional review is necessary, and manage multiple tasks accurately within established deadlines.
  • Schedule Availability: Ability to work an 8-hour shift scheduled between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with potential overtime depending on business needs.
  • Remote Work Requirements: A dedicated home workspace that protects confidential health information and supports compliance with HIPAA privacy requirements. Home internet service must provide a minimum download speed of 25 Mbps and upload speed of 10 Mbps; a wireless, wired cable, or DSL connection is suggested.
  • Preferred Qualifications: Veteran or military spouse status, experience with TRICARE, familiarity with military treatment facility agreements and referral procedures, experience in a managed care environment, and advanced knowledge of medical terminology and ICD-10 coding.
  • Location Restrictions: Applicants must reside in the United States and cannot currently reside in Puerto Rico due to government contract restrictions.

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: Annual base salary ranging from $39,000 to $49,400, depending on location, qualifications, relevant experience, education, and job-related skills.
  • Performance Incentives: Eligibility for a bonus incentive plan based on company and/or individual performance.
  • Healthcare Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance options to support employees and their families.
  • Retirement Savings: Access to a 401(k) retirement savings plan.

title: Senior Engineer, Operations
description:
JOB PURPOSE:
Plans, coordinates, and supervises the safe and efficient oil and gas production, processing, and export operations and ensuring safe and efficient operation of the water injection, Gas injection, Gas lift, ESP wells and CO2 injection and distribution. Maintain optimum operating efficiency and assure facilities and systems integrity/reliability while assuring compliance to HSE Management system. Troubleshoot and recommends corrective actions to deal with abnormalities, de-bottlenecking, upgrading and optimum operating conditions for the plant and processes.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Job Specific Accountabilities

  • Review the operating data as per the planned production targets, past and present prevailing conditions including laboratory analysis, operating plant performance; highlight any major deviations from the Design Operating Envelopes (parameters.).
  • Work closely with key stakeholders for alarm rationalization / alarm management and ensure compliance with alarm management KPIs, to ensure comprehensive plans are in the pipeline to achieve the mandated growth, to plan and carryout Field Technical Rate (FTR) / Field Capacity Test (FCT) to identify facilities’ bottlenecks, any potential problems and to establish optimum parameters for efficient and safe operation.
  • Coordinate with different stakeholders in the planning and implementation of production and injection adjustments to meet mandated oil production and gas, water, CO2 injection KPls. Ensuring data entries accuracy in PIES system related to production, injection, and export data periodically.
  • Continuous follow up with Development and planning teams to conduct Field Sustainable Oil Production Rate (FSOPR) exercise in line with the business plan, conduct Reservoir Monitoring Program (RMP) program and Water Alternating Gas Wells (WAG) changeover.
  • Coordinates with Integrated Shutdown Planning Team and other stakeholders for the 5 yearly shutdown plans, conduct shutdown optimization exercises (related to shut down, handover and start up), manpower distribution and resource management and ensure yearly shutdown scopes are identifiedand performed within the approved shutdown period.
  • Troubleshooting of plant chronic problems related to surface facilities and participates in the root cause analyses of major/critical equipment repetitive failures to ensure production availability.
  • Monitors the operation of equipment, prepares analytical reports with appropriate trends to track the performance of all processes. Highlights abnormalities and advises operation personnel on corrective actions. Checks, endorses and reviews regularly the operating procedures and standing instructions of the plant units for safe and cost-efficient operation.
  • Actively engage with Technical Center and Project & Construction Teams in all stages of the projects including Design Review, Value engineering, 3D model Reviews, Various HSE studies such as Hazard and Operability Review (HAZOP), Hazard Identification (HAZID), Occupational Hazard Identification (OHID), Inherent Safe Design (ISD), Safety Integrity Level (SIL) Review, Plot Plan review capturing and providing lessons learned and operations feedback and raising concerns and ideas to improve the overall project. Involve in Ready For Commissioning (RFC) walkdowns providing feedback and punch points, Commissioning, and post commissioning performance monitoring.
  • Represent Operations in new technology trials in the field and ensure all required reviews are completed prior to execution in the field. Ensure all temporary & permanent changes performed for the Operational excellence, is done through Change Management (MOC) processes and follow-up for appropriate approvals and execution plans. Ensuring the completion of Engineering review, Scope of Work (SoW), Budget secure, Project inclusion for MOC execution etc.
  • Direct involvement with Tactical Response Team (TRT) and Incident Management Team (IMT) Teams during emergencies by providing guidance and training, acting as On Scene Commander, and to be the main channel of information providing a holistic view about all facilities and the ongoing activities.
  • Participation in risk assessment, conduct site visits and supervise 27 Critical Work Activities/ High Risk Activities and non-routine critical activities. Participate in Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Risk Register review including meetings, reviews of the risk register, process safety committee forums, providing supporting documents and mitigation plans.
  • Ensure the Integrity of the Surface and subsurface facility is maintained by taking appropriate preventive and remedial action on the facility anomalies observed by the Integrity team and Plan & perform the integrity related subsurface activities such as communication tests / Below Cellar Inspection (BCI) / Sustained Annulus Pressure (SAP) investigations along with Well integrity team.

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

Minimum Qualification

  • Bachelor Degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent

Minimum Experience & Knowledge & Skills

  • 8 years of experience, including at least 4 years in oil & gas industry

title: Corporate Finance Director
description:
Translink Corporate Finance is a cross-border mid-market M&A advisory firm and part of the Translink Group. We advise the owners of private, typically owner-managed but some private equity owned businesses on sales, acquisitions and capital raising, with a focus on running a disciplined process and delivering the best available outcome for shareholders.

We are building out our London presence. The team draws on the wider resources of the Group, including its international buyer relationships and cross-border execution capability, while keeping the senior access and accountability of a boutique.

The Role

This is a senior, hands-on Director appointment with full ownership of live mandates. You will lead sell-side processes from pitch to completion, hold the primary relationship with business owners and their advisers, and support the Partners to build pipeline. You will also help shape how the London execution team is built and run, in a role where your commercial contribution is visible and rewarded directly.
What You Will Do

• Lead mandates end to end: own valuation, positioning, the information memorandum, buyer strategy and outreach, negotiation, and the path through due diligence and SPA to completion

• Originate and win work: over time, build and convert your own pipeline through owner-managed business networks, accountants, lawyers, banks and investors, and lead pitches and fee discussions.

• Own client relationships: act as the trusted adviser to founders and shareholders through what is often the most significant transaction of their careers.

• Execute with rigour: oversee financial modelling, valuation analysis, marketing materials and data room management, and review the team's output before it reaches the client/counterparties.

• Develop the team: coach and mentor the team, and contribute to hiring and to how the London team operates.

• Work across the Group: collaborate with colleagues across the Translink Group, including on cross-border buyer outreach where a mandate calls for it.

• Uphold standards: work within the Group's regulatory and compliance framework and maintain your professional competence.
You are an established Director, or a senior Assistant Director ready to step up, with a proven record of leading mid-market sell-side M&A and the instinct to support the build of a fast growing office.

• Significant M&A or transaction experience at a corporate finance boutique, investment bank or Big Four transaction services team, including leading sell-side processes through to completion.

• Emerging evidence of origination: sourcing, pitching or winning mandates, with a credible network among intermediaries and business owners, or a clear route to building one.

• Confidence advising shareholders, with the judgement to guide complex and personal transactions.

• Strong technical grounding in valuation, financial modelling, deal structuring and transaction documentation. A professional qualification such as ACA or equivalent is preferred.

• Entrepreneurial, collaborative and credible as a leader and mentor.

• Affinity with technology or building products is welcome but not essential.

Why Join

• Genuine ownership: you run mandates and hold client relationships, with direct access to the senior team.

• A platform being built: join as the London team grows and help shape its culture, processes and people from an early stage.

• Group backing: the brand, resources and cross-border reach of the Translink Group, within a collaborative and entrepreneurial culture.

• Reward tied to contribution: an incentive that recognises the revenue you deliver.

• Progression based on merit: for Directors who show the breadth to step up in execution, client trust and origination, there is the opportunity to progress to partner as the London team grows.

They must be able to get on & off equipment regularly, understand inventory procedures, some basic computer skills, and be able to communicate clearly with the team and their supervisor. They must be able to read orders, possess basic mathematical skills, complete documentation, and be able to operate various types of small to medium sized industrial mobile equipment.

Essential Job Functions:

They must be able to communicate orally with all personnel in the plant. They must be able to operate a calculator for basic mathematical computations. Basic typing skills are essential for basic computer use and/or computerized scanning machine.

title: Onboarding Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Onboarding Engineer based in Belgium.

We are seeking an Onboarding Engineer to lead the technical implementation and coordination of customer onboarding in a fast-growing SaaS environment. This role combines hands-on engineering expertise with project management to ensure seamless integrations and successful customer launches. You will work closely with onboarding, customer success, and engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and deliver a consistent customer experience. Your work will directly influence customer retention, product adoption, and long-term growth. You will also help build scalable processes, documentation, and metrics to improve onboarding efficiency. This is an opportunity to shape technical onboarding practices while contributing to an innovative, AI-driven approach to partnership management.

Accountabilities:

As an Onboarding Engineer, you will own the technical execution of customer implementations, ensuring that each onboarding progresses smoothly from initial kickoff to go-live and handoff. You will collaborate across teams to resolve issues, improve processes, and establish scalable technical standards.

  • Lead the technical setup of customer onboarding, including API integrations, data mapping, CRM configuration, authentication, and security setup.

  • Partner with the Onboarding Manager to coordinate the full onboarding lifecycle, from kickoff through go-live and handoff to Customer Success.

  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues, including integration failures, data synchronization problems, and configuration challenges.

  • Develop and maintain onboarding runbooks, integration guides, technical documentation, and repeatable implementation processes.

  • Collaborate with Engineering to escalate product issues, document bugs with clear reproduction steps, and advocate for product improvements that support successful onboarding.

  • Coordinate with Customer Success to ensure smooth transitions from onboarding to ongoing customer support.

  • Define, monitor, and improve onboarding success metrics, including time to first value, technical blockers, and integration completion rates.

  • Identify onboarding risks proactively, communicate potential delays, and recommend solutions to keep projects on track.

  • Support the Onboarding Manager in customer communications concerning technical requirements, implementation progress, and timelines.

  • Contribute to the growth of the onboarding function by helping establish scalable practices and mentoring future onboarding engineers.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with customer-facing implementation experience, excellent organizational abilities, and a collaborative approach. You should be comfortable managing multiple onboarding projects while communicating complex technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders.

    • 3–4 years of technical experience in B2B SaaS implementation, customer onboarding, or customer success engineering.

    • Hands-on experience with APIs, data integrations, technical configuration, and troubleshooting.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical customers and present implementation plans to leadership.

    • Experience managing customer implementations or onboarding projects throughout the full lifecycle, from kickoff to go-live.

    • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple customer onboardings and maintain close attention to detail.

    • Familiarity with CRM integrations, particularly Salesforce or HubSpot, or comparable enterprise tools, is an advantage.

    • A consultative mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs, ask thoughtful questions, and proactively recommend solutions.

    • A strong commitment to quality, including identifying potential issues early and implementing measures to prevent recurring problems.

    • Ability to collaborate effectively and build strong relationships across Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering.

    • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience demonstrating technical expertise.

      • Nice to Have:

      • Experience with Bubble.io, n8n, or other low-code/no-code platforms.

      • Familiarity with partnership management or ecosystem tools.

title: Baler Operator 3rd Shift
description:
POSITION TITLE: BALER OPERATOR 3rd Shift (11 pm - 7 am)

REPORTS TO: Corrugator Supervisor

Starting Wage $18.70 per hour *PLUS Shift Differential*

Overview

The Baler Operator is responsible for safely operating the baler and hogger systems to process scrap paper and corrugated material into neat, high-quality bales. This role requires attention to safety, housekeeping, and equipment upkeep while supporting production operations.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

Operate and Monitor Equipment
Operate the hogger and feed scrap safely into the system.
Run the baler to produce neat, consistent bales.
Watch for jams, stop equipment immediately if needed, and notify supervision or maintenance.
Follow lockout/tagout procedures before clearing jams or performing checks.

Safety & Compliance

Follow all company and OSHA safety rules, including use of PPE (gloves required in the baler room).
Never place hands or body parts in the baler or hogger areas.
Maintain awareness of forklift traffic, sound horn at cross-aisles, and drive cautiously when loading trailers.
Keep exits and walkways clear at all times.

Daily Operation & Housekeeping

Inspect baler and hogger area at the start of each shift; report issues to supervision.
Keep floors swept and free of wire, trash, or debris.
Bale and remove scrap as required, stacking bales correctly in trailers.
Maintain accurate bale reports and ensure scrap is tagged properly.

Shift Handoffs & Clean-Up

Communicate problems and concerns with incoming operator at shift change.
Clear scrap from behind ram, sweep and blow down baler and hogger, and empty trash cans.
Refuel forklift to at least half a tank before turnover.

Supplies & Maintenance

Monitor and maintain inventories of baling wire, tags, and supplies.
Turn in maintenance work orders for needed repairs; be proactive in reporting issues.
Assist with weekend clean-up by emptying buggies, baling remaining scrap, and dusting walls and support beams.

Other Duties

Perform additional tasks as assigned by management.

Qualifications

Ability to operate forklifts safely.
Strong attention to safety procedures and housekeeping standards.
Good communication skills for shift handoffs and teamwork.
Willingness to work in an industrial environment with dust, noise, and heavy equipment.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Minorities/Females/Disabled/Veterans

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Location

Dublin, Ireland (Hybrid/On-site)

Position Summary

Operating directly within our global Product & Technology organisation, this role functions as an internal Forward Deployed Software Engineer. We are looking for an adaptable, highly autonomous senior engineer to tackle rapid prototyping, architectural de-risking, and tactical engineering initiatives. Rather than maintaining a traditional product lifecycle, you will partner closely with our leadership team, including the CTO, senior engineers and architects on short-cycle strategic initiatives. Your customers are Bentley's global Product & Technology (P&T) organization – the teams responsible for building and operating the products and solutions that power our customers' success. You will take on complex, ambiguous technical challenges, rapidly evaluate solution options across the full stack, from architecture and design to hands‑on implementation, build functional proof‑of‑concepts, and transition successful solutions to our core product teams.

Responsibilities
  • Full‑Spectrum Problem Solving: Fluidly navigate across varied technical domains depending on the project. One month you may be addressing deep performance profiling and cloud reliability; the next, you may be building modern front‑end spikes or evaluating microservice patterns.
  • De‑Risk Architecture: Architect, code, and benchmark functional proof‑of‑concepts (PoCs) to validate performance and evaluate emerging technologies before Bentley makes a company‑wide commitment.
  • Operate Across the Stack & Cloud: Leverage a wide range of technologies, acting as a polyglot across multiple programming languages and major cloud platforms to deliver the right solution for the business.
  • Ensure Frictionless Hand‑offs: Package your validated architectures, write the technical summary, and hand the clean, maintainable deliverables over to our global P&T teams so you can pivot to the next strategic unknown.
Qualifications
  • 0‑to‑1 Experience: 7+ years of software engineering experience with a demonstrable track record of designing, building, and delivering complex, high‑performance software in fast‑paced environments.
  • Ownership and Bias for Action: You are highly self‑directed, comfortable operating autonomously without extensive supervision, and driven to turn ambiguity into actionable solutions.
  • Curiosity and Learning Agility: You possess an aptitude to select the best tool for the specific problem at hand. You have working fluency across multiple programming languages (such as C#, TypeScript, Python, Java, or C++) and continuously learn new ones.
  • Empathy and Partnership: You view the global P&T organization as your customer, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring your prototypes are built with their eventual operational needs in mind.
  • AI‑Amplified Output: Practical experience leveraging generative AI APIs, vector retrieval/RAG patterns, or daily integration of AI‑assisted engineering tools to amplify output.
  • High‑Signal Communication: Ability to synthesize complex technical discoveries, trade‑offs, and architectural recommendations into direct, high‑signal summaries for technical leadership.
  • Big Picture Architecture: Solid foundational knowledge of distributed systems, multi‑tenant patterns, containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes), and at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
What We Offer

title: Software Engineer, Lab Automation
description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical‑world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI‑driven wet lab experimentation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll build work‑cell orchestration, instrument drivers, protocol scheduling, error‑recovery logic, and monitoring. Physical systems fail in ways pure software doesn’t — a plate gets stuck, a liquid handler skips a well, a temperature controller drifts. Your job is to make the system handle all of it gracefully. This is a broad, hands‑on role for a strong engineer who wants their code to drive real machines and see it run the same day.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Build orchestration software that coordinates liquid handlers, plate readers, incubators, and robot arms — handling timing dependencies, state, and error recovery.
  • Reverse‑engineer and develop instrument drivers and APIs. Each instrument speaks a different protocol (serial, USB, TCP/IP); you work out how it talks and build a clean abstraction over it.
  • Model and execute complex multi‑step protocols reliably — a single run can span dozens of steps across multiple instruments.
  • Build error‑recovery logic so that when something fails mid‑run, the system retries, skips, alerts, or pauses depending on the failure mode.
  • Create monitoring and observability for work‑cell health: instrument status, run progress, error rates.
  • Debug across the software–hardware boundary — figuring out whether bad data is a comms, firmware, calibration, or code problem.
  • Work closely with lab automation engineers, the rest of the software team, and the scientists running production.

STACK

TypeScript and Python, Postgres (Supabase), Modal for compute. We control instruments with open‑source Python tooling like PyLabRobot and PyHamilton wherever we can, rather than proprietary vendor GUIs.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Strong software engineering skills. You write production code in Python and/or TypeScript — well‑structured and maintainable, not just prototypes.
  • Comfortable at the hardware‑software boundary. You’ve built software that drives physical devices, or you’re excited to. You can read a protocol spec, debug a flaky connection, and reason about timing.
  • Lab automation experience is a strong plus. Familiarity with PyHamilton, PyLabRobot, Opentrons, or similar tooling helps — as does a background in robotics, industrial automation, IoT, or embedded systems.
  • Maker and hacker attitude. You like figuring out how closed systems work and building the thing that makes them work better. Bonus if you’re comfortable with electronics, microcontrollers, or a 3D printer when an integration needs a physical fix.
  • AI‑native builder. It’s 2026 — you build with coding agents like Claude Code as a default, and you have sharp judgment about what they produce.
  • Self‑starter and independent. You define what needs building from how the lab actually works, not just what’s in the ticket.
  • Reliability‑minded. The lab runs 24/7; you design systems where one instrument failing doesn’t cascade through the whole work cell.

DETAILS

  • Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on‑site — you need hands‑on access to physical instruments).
  • Type: Full time
  • Start date: ASAP

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

title: Full Stack Microsoft Developer

You will focus primarily on backend development and system integration while contributing to responsive, user-friendly frontend experiences. Working closely with business stakeholders, architects, product owners, and technical teams, you will translate complex requirements into reliable, production-ready solutions. This position combines modern development practices, cloud technologies, and cross-functional collaboration with the opportunity to contribute to a more sustainable, circular economy.

Accountabilities:

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with developers, architects, business analysts, product owners, project management teams, quality assurance specialists, vendors, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve blockers, and deliver effective solutions.
  • Quality assurance and continuous improvement: Apply testing, observability, accessibility, localization, responsive design, and cross-browser compatibility practices to improve application reliability and user experience.
  • Technical documentation and knowledge sharing: Document architectural decisions, implementation details, integration patterns, and troubleshooting procedures to support maintainability and effective collaboration across teams.
  • Mission-driven innovation: Contribute to technology initiatives that improve operational efficiency, strengthen enterprise capabilities, and support environmental sustainability and responsible resource management.

Requirements:

  • Professional development experience: Demonstrated ability to deliver full-stack web applications through professional employment, substantial projects, technical training, military service, community experience, or another relevant pathway.

  • Frontend development skills: Ability to develop API-connected user interfaces using React, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design principles.
  • Enterprise integration experience: Ability to design, implement, and troubleshoot integrations involving Dynamics 365 CRM, Business Central, Power Platform, or comparable customer relationship management and enterprise resource planning systems.
  • Microsoft Azure knowledge: Familiarity with cloud application development and deployment, including relevant Azure services and practices for secure, reliable, and scalable solutions.
  • Preferred education and experience: A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field, combined with at least five years of relevant full-stack development, application integration, or Microsoft cloud platform experience; alternatively, seven or more years of equivalent professional experience is preferred.
  • Advanced Azure services: Experience with Azure API Management, App Services, Functions, Durable Functions, Storage, Key Vault, Application Insights, Service Bus, Event Grid, and Azure SQL is an advantage.
  • Microsoft ecosystem integrations: Experience connecting Dynamics 365 CRM and Business Central through APIs, Dataverse, Power Automate, webhooks, events, or middleware solutions is highly desirable.
  • Additional Microsoft technologies: Familiarity with Microsoft Graph, Microsoft 365 APIs, Power Platform, Power BI integrations, Power Pages, Bootstrap, JSON Forms, Liquid templates, Blazor, Entity Framework, or SignalR is beneficial.
  • Software quality and production support: Experience with automated testing, code reviews, refactoring, technical documentation, application observability, accessibility, localization, cross-browser testing, and production issue resolution.
  • Technical judgment: Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into practical technical solutions while identifying dependencies, risks, trade-offs, and implementation priorities.
  • Ownership and accountability: Willingness to take responsibility for projects from initial design through deployment and ongoing production support, following through on issues and documenting key decisions.
  • Problem-solving skills: Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities, including structured root-cause analysis and the ability to implement improvements that prevent recurring defects.
  • Communication and collaboration: Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, participate constructively in code reviews, and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Adaptability and continuous learning: Comfortable working across backend development, integrations, frontend technologies, cloud infrastructure, and production support as priorities and business needs evolve.

title: Converting Lead 2nd Shift
description:
SUMMARY

Assist Supervisor and crews in the daily process produce quality converted products in a safe, productive manner with minimum waste. Assist in the training of all new employees and cross-train employees in key positions.

Base Pay of $26.40, plus $1.00 Shift Differential.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Train and cross-train employees on machinery and processes.

Ensure that necessary tools and materials are available for crews to accomplish tasks.

Oversee crews and ensure that they are reliable, dependable, on-time.

Ensure that there is cooperation among crew members. Maintain and improve morale and make sure that they work as a team. Maintain confidentiality.

Address questions, concerns, and problems expressed by the crew.

Train crew members about the importance of running efficiently.

Communicate with crew members regarding performance.

Coordinate with your supervisor and Maintenance Superintendent on any repairs or preventive maintenance done in the department.

Keep upper management informed of problems or situations that may affect the performance of your department.

Conduct weekly Production/Safety meetings with departmental personnel.

Communicate with necessary supervision to avoid problems between shift changes.

Improve career skills by enrolling in seminars, technical courses, and related college courses.

Implement, maintain, and support all company policies and procedures, including safety programs, and good housekeeping.

Additional duties may be assigned by management.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Directly assists in the supervision of all employees assigned to the department. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; conflict resolution; team building; coaching and leading employees to improve; addressing complaints and resolving problems; documentation; and setting an example of superior behavior, attitude and performance.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED.

Two years prior leadership experience.

Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:

Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Able to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation. This also supports the supervisor's role of teacher and trainer for his/her personnel.

Cost issues in order to make daily decisions that will reduce overall costs and will help the supervisor find areas that require improvement.

QUALITY STANDARDS:

Regulatory requirements including but not limited to wage and hour requirements, environmental and waste minimization, company policies, and personnel requirements including OSHA, DEQ and EEO.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES

The individual must possess the following:

Superior time management skills including; the ability to manage multiple issues concurrently, the ability to lead an effective and efficient meeting.

Teaching skills in order to function effectively as a teacher for his personnel both in the technical and administrative parts of the position.

Excellent crisis manager who demonstrates that he/she has a high emotional control under adverse conditions and can lead his/her personnel to a successful resolution.

Excellent employee relations skills including being an active listener, understanding how to appraise personnel, applying both positive and corrective feedback, being able to resolve conflicts either involving the supervisor directly or as a third party, understands and demonstrates positive motivational skills including coaching and delegation techniques.

Demonstrated confidence including providing a consistent leadership style with an acceptable level of professional assertiveness.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

The performance of the supervisor will be measured as follows:

Operating standards - the employee will need to meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated by the supervisor.

Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the lead to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the lead and his/her supervisor/superintendent.

Employee relations - through observations the lead will be evaluated regarding his/her skills and advancements in the areas of motivational techniques and results, positive and corrective/constructive feedback, subordinate development and creating a positive work environment.

Creativity - this will be evaluated by how active the supervisor is in participating in advancing the business through new and innovative ideas.

title: Security Researcher
description:
About Us and the Role

We are a cutting-edge cybersecurity company that combines powerful scanning technologies with expert services. At OP Innovate, security research isn’t a support function - it’s at the core of how we build, think, and deliver value to help businesses stay secure through modern, practical, and innovative solutions. This role sits right at that intersection of advanced hands-on research, combined with ownership over how our work shows up in the real world.

We’re growing our research team and looking for a super talented Security Researcher! In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and analyzing security vulnerabilities across modern applications, cloud infrastructures, and mobile platforms. You will act as both an offensive operator and a defensive advisor. In this dual capacity, you will proactively exploit complex system weaknesses to validate real-world risk while simultaneously collaborating with customers and development teams.

Requirements

  • Lead and drive end-to-end security research projects across web applications, API, mobile (iOS/Android), and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) - from initial scoping through research, exploitation and final delivery
  • Conduct hands-on penetration testing and deep vulnerability research, digging into complex edge cases, validating findings with custom Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs), and setting the technical direction across engagements
  • Perform manual and static source code reviews across modern backends and microservices to identify subtle logic flaws, authorization bypasses, and data exposure vulnerabilities
  • Bridge offensive findings with defensive strategy by advising engineering teams and customers on secure coding guidelines, architecture hardening, and remediation
  • Translate technical findings into clear, actionable insights, helping clients understand risk, impact, and next steps without losing the technical depth
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by presenting findings, leading technical readout discussions, and representing the team’s work clearly to both technical leads and executive stakeholders

Skills and Experience

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in security research from either a product or services cybersecurity company
  • Deep, practical experience in Application Security (both Web and Mobile), pentesting, and vulnerability research, including strong familiarity with common attack vectors and exploitation techniques
  • Confidence working directly with clients - presenting findings, leading discussions, and representing the team’s work clearly
  • Strong communication skills in both Hebrew and English, written and verbal
  • A proactive, highly accountable self-starter with strong organizational skills and a collaborative team mindset
  • Source code analysis skills across common backend and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Go, Java, Node.js) with the ability to identify security vulnerabilities and logic flaws
  • Experience in cloud-native pentesting and automated auditing within AWS, Azure, or GCP, with a focus on identifying misconfigurations and lateral movement risks

Advantages

  • Broader experience across additional research domains such as red teaming, infrastructure testing, or incident response
  • Experience building internal tools, scripts, or automation to support research workflows
  • Track record of vulnerability discovery and disclosure (e.g., CVEs, bug bounty)
  • Experience working within secure SDLC practices, including "shift left" approaches and SAST and SCA tools (Semgrep, SonarQube, etc.)
  • B.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent hands-on experience (military background or advanced certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, etc. are a strong advantage)
  • Familiarity with DFIR practices

title: Baler Operator
description:
Position Summary

The Baler Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of the baling system and related equipment to process corrugated and paper scrap materials. This position supports production operations through equipment operation, inventory management, housekeeping, and continuous improvement initiatives. The ideal candidate is safety-focused, dependable, and committed to maintaining a clean and productive work environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Safely operate the baler and related equipment to produce quality, properly secured scrap bales.
  • Operate the hogger to process unusable paper and corrugated scrap materials.
  • Maintain accurate production and bale reporting records.
  • Monitor and maintain inventories of baling wire, scrap tags, and finished scrap bales.
  • Operate forklifts and other material handling equipment safely and efficiently as required.
  • Identify equipment issues and submit maintenance work orders promptly to minimize downtime.
  • Perform routine inspections and support preventative maintenance efforts.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area in accordance with company housekeeping standards.
  • Follow all company policies, safety procedures, and work instructions.
  • Participate in continuous improvement efforts by recommending process and operational enhancements.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.

Qualifications

Required Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Ability to work safely in a manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to perform physical work and follow established procedures and work instructions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in the corrugated packaging industry.
  • Prior experience operating a baler, recycling equipment, or similar manufacturing machinery.
  • Forklift operation experience and certification.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Communication Skills

  • Ability to read, understand, and follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Ability to accurately complete reports and production documentation.

Mathematical Skills

  • Ability to accurately read a tape measure.
  • Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations, including measurements, percentages, rates, and volumes.
  • Working knowledge of basic high school-level mathematics.

Problem Solving and Reasoning

  • Ability to apply common sense and sound judgment when carrying out written, oral, or diagram-based instructions.
  • Ability to identify and resolve routine operational issues in a manufacturing environment.

Technical Skills

Working knowledge of:

  • Manufacturing equipment operation and safe work practices.
  • Production processes and efficiency standards.
  • Product quality specifications and quality control requirements.
  • Preventative maintenance concepts and equipment care.
  • Material handling equipment and warehouse safety procedures.

Certifications and Licenses

  • Ability to obtain and maintain forklift certification as required.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position.

  • Regularly stand, walk, communicate, and hear throughout the work shift.
  • Frequently use hands and arms to handle materials, operate equipment, and perform maintenance tasks.
  • Frequently bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, and reach.
  • Occasionally sit while performing certain tasks.
  • Ability to lift and move up to 50 pounds.
  • Specific vision requirements include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described below are representative of those encountered while performing the essential functions of this position.

  • Regular exposure to an industrial manufacturing environment with moving mechanical equipment.
  • Frequent exposure to dust, humidity, and changing temperatures.
  • Occasional exposure to elevated work areas, airborne particles, vibration, and other manufacturing conditions.
  • Consistent use of required personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Noise levels are typically high and hearing protection may be required.

Performance Expectations

Success in this position will be measured by performance in the following areas:

Safety

  • Maintains an injury-free work environment and proactively identifies and addresses safety concerns.

Quality

  • Maintains accurate reporting and inventory records.

Productivity and Efficiency

  • Minimizes downtime through proactive equipment monitoring and timely maintenance reporting.

Teamwork and Communication

  • Demonstrates professionalism, respect, and effective communication with supervisors and coworkers.
  • Contributes positively to team success and plant operations.

Continuous Improvement

  • Actively participates in improving processes, reducing waste, and enhancing operational efficiency through constructive suggestions and involvement in improvement initiatives.

Professional Development

  • Takes ownership of personal growth and skill development while working toward agreed-upon annual performance goals.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
Bij Kubik willen we bewijzen dat consultancy anders kan. Jij kiest je projecten en de richting van je loopbaan. Met individuele opleidingen en persoonlijke opvolging zorgen we samen voor de volgende stap in jouw carrière.

Als fullstack developer bij Kubik kies je voor diversiteit. Je werkt voor verschillende klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren en bent de ruggengraat van de IT-afdeling. Je gaat aan de slag in zowel start-ups en scale-ups als internationale bedrijven, waar jouw takenpakket kan bestaan uit:

  • Architectuur: Je werkt samen met de tech lead aan de opzet van projectarchitecturen.
  • Technologie: Je kiest de juiste technologieën en schrijft cleane, efficiënte code.
  • Ontwikkeling: Je bouwt mee aan software-oplossingen met echte toegevoegde waarde.
  • End-to-end: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het volledige development van applicaties.
  • Gebruiksvriendelijkheid: Je vertaalt klantvragen naar praktische en toegankelijke applicaties.
  • Optimalisatie: Je denkt actief mee om de best mogelijke resultaten te leveren. Door deze veelzijdigheid bouw je snel een brede expertise op, waarbij elk project een nieuwe uitdaging biedt.

Wie ben jij?

Om in deze rol volledig tot je recht te komen, zoeken we iemand die niet alleen een stevige basis aan vakexpertise heeft, maar ook de drive heeft om zich makkelijk aan te passen aan nieuwe omgevingen.

  • Een IT-gerelateerd diploma (bij voorkeur op bachelor niveau).
  • Minimaal 8 jaar relevante werkervaring als fullstack developer.
  • Back-end: een zeer sterke kennis van Java en/of .NET.
  • Vloeiend Nederlands. Je spreekt ook wat Engels of Frans, want dat maakt de communicatie in een internationale omgeving net iets makkelijker!
  • Je bent iemand die zich moeiteloos aanpast en makkelijk schakelt tussen taken en projecten.
  • Je communiceert duidelijk, bent gedreven en hanteert steeds een klantgerichte aanpak.
  • Je hebt de wil om continu bij te leren en nieuwe informatie op te nemen.
  • Je bevat de nodige portie flexibiliteit qua mobiliteit.

Bij Kubik word je persoonlijk opgevolgd en krijg je alle ondersteuning om verder te groeien en je te ontplooien tot waar jij zelf de lat leg. En ja - we zorgen goed voor onze mensen. Zonder franjes maar met alles wat nodig is om goed te landen..

  • Diversiteit in projecten: Diverse posities bij start-, scale-ups en grote internationale bedrijven.
  • Een aantrekkelijk loon: Correct en aantrekkelijk loon, evenredig met je vaardigheden en talenten.
  • Een bedrijfswagen: Een auto en laadpas om je moeiteloos te verplaatsen.
  • Extra verzekeringen: Groeps- en hospitaliseringsverzekering, want veiligheid primeert.

title: Arabic (Gulf) Language Expert - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Arabic (Gulf) Language Expert – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Turkey.

We are seeking an Arabic (Gulf) Language Expert to help shape the next generation of artificial intelligence through specialized linguistic knowledge and cultural expertise. In this freelance role, you will evaluate advanced language models and improve their ability to understand and communicate naturally in Gulf Arabic. You will assess dialectal accuracy, grammar, vocabulary, idiomatic expressions, and cultural nuances across diverse conversational contexts. Your insights will help identify model weaknesses, strengthen reasoning capabilities, and improve language evaluation methods. Working remotely, you will contribute to AI training projects that support more authentic, culturally relevant, and linguistically accurate interactions. This opportunity is ideal for language specialists who want to apply their expertise to innovative AI development while working with flexibility.

Accountabilities:

As an Arabic (Gulf) Language Expert, you will evaluate AI-generated language, identify linguistic and cultural inaccuracies, and provide structured feedback to improve model performance. Your work will help ensure that AI systems understand the distinctive characteristics of Gulf Arabic and respond appropriately across a wide range of contexts.

  • Interact with advanced language models in Gulf Arabic across diverse topics and conversational scenarios.

  • Evaluate linguistic accuracy, including phonetics, morphology, syntax, vocabulary, grammar, and regional dialect variations.

  • Assess the appropriate use of colloquial expressions, idioms, cultural references, and context-dependent meanings.

  • Identify and document model errors, inconsistencies, and failure patterns using clear, reproducible examples.

  • Analyze contextual interpretation, semantic accuracy, dialect distinctions, and cultural relevance in AI-generated responses.

  • Provide detailed explanations of linguistic issues and demonstrate the reasoning behind evaluations and corrections.

  • Recommend improvements to prompt engineering, training approaches, and language evaluation metrics.

  • Contribute to the development of high-quality training data that strengthens AI understanding of Gulf Arabic and its cultural context.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate has a strong command of Gulf Arabic, a deep understanding of regional linguistic and cultural nuances, and the ability to communicate analytical observations clearly. Experience in linguistics, translation, teaching, language documentation, or community-based language work is valuable, particularly when combined with a structured and detail-oriented approach to evaluating AI outputs.

    • Expert-level proficiency in Arabic, with specialized knowledge of Gulf Arabic dialects and regional variations.

    • Strong understanding of phonetics, morphology, syntax, semantics, colloquial expressions, idiomatic language, and cultural references.

    • Excellent ability to assess linguistic accuracy and identify subtle differences in meaning, tone, and context.

    • Strong written communication skills and the ability to explain linguistic judgments with clear examples and evidence.

    • A methodical, analytical approach to identifying errors, documenting reproducible examples, and evaluating model performance.

    • A Master's degree in Linguistics, Middle Eastern Studies, Translation, or a related field is preferred.

    • Professional experience in language teaching, translation, linguistic research, language documentation, or community-based language work is an advantage.

    • Ability to work independently, manage assigned tasks, and deliver consistent, high-quality evaluations in a remote environment.

    • Interest in artificial intelligence, language model evaluation, and the development of culturally informed AI systems.

      • Benefits:

      • Hourly compensation ranging from $8 to $65, depending on experience, expertise, and geographic location.

      • Fully remote work arrangement.

      • Freelance contract offering flexibility in how you contribute to AI training projects.

      • Opportunity to apply specialized Gulf Arabic expertise to the development of advanced AI systems.

      • Exposure to innovative language model training, evaluation, and prompt engineering practices.

      • Meaningful contribution to improving linguistic accuracy and cultural representation in artificial intelligence.

title: Clamp Truck Operator
description:
SUMMARY

Responsible for all activities associated with safely operating and caring for the clamp truck.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Take rolls of paper to the corrugator, always taking buttrolls first, and record all rolls taken to the corrugator on the proper forms.

  • Learn to read corrugator lineups.
  • Mark buttrolls as to the size, diameter, lineal footage, and grade before returning to stock.
  • Unload rolls from trailers and/or rail cars. Check for and note any physical damage to the rolls.
  • Operate the clamp truck in a safe manner.
  • Complete clamp truck inspection report at the beginning of each shift and turn in maintenance work orders to supervision for needed repairs.
  • Keep warehouse organized and clean.
  • Turn in roll stock tallies to the corrugator supervisor or Scheduling Department.
  • Maximize the utilization of equipment by operating the machinery at available capacity and speed.
  • Adheres to daily production schedule. Makes recommendations for optimizing the schedule to meet cost, quality, delivery and service goals.
  • Assist the corrugator operator as instructed by supervision.
  • Make starch as needed per company formula.
  • Check viscosities on corrugator and at starch station as necessary.
  • Accurately record daily starch checklist.
  • Maintain the wastewater treatment facility.
  • Monitor inventory levels of starch and chemicals.
  • Read related MSDS and learn proper response for emergency chemical spills or skin contact.
  • Assist in the wet end training of the doublebacker and dry end personnel.
  • Comply with all company policies and procedures, including safety and maintaining good housekeeping.
  • Management may assign additional duties.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED.

Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:

Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.

Prior industrial power truck or heavy equipment operating experience.

6 months experience on the wet end of the corrugator.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Able to read and follow instructions on factory masters.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving one or more concrete variables in standardized situations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation.

Product layouts and production specifications

Product quality specifications

Quality standards

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

A current Lift Truck/Clamp Truck Operator License is required.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

The performance of the employee will be measured as follows:

Operating standards - the employee will need to meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the employee.

Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the employee to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the employee and his/her superior.

Employee relations - through observations the employee will be evaluated regarding his/her behaviors associated with appropriate human interaction, respect and communication.

Creativity - this will be evaluated by how active the employee is in participating in advancing the business through new and innovative ideas.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Minorities/Females/Disabled/Veterans

title: Maintenance Tech - 1st Shift

As a Maintenance Technician at Pratt Industries – Houston, you will be a crucial part of our day to day. Our Maintenance Technicians maintain and repair the machinery and building involved in turning recycled paper into sheets of corrugated board and getting them to our customers! Think boxes for Domino’s Pizzas, moving with Home Depot, Amazon deliveries, Hello Fresh meals, and more! (And yes, we make those!)   • Quality Assurance: Maintain company standards for quality, and perform inspections and ensure all parts and assemblies meet production specifications.

Perform soldering, crimping, and securing of electrical components. And conduct functional and continuity tests using an ohmmeter, test lights, and other electrical testing instruments.
  • Training & Development: Cross-train in multiple technical areas to enhance skills, and participate in continued education and training opportunities.
  • Reporting & Maintenance: Accurately complete work orders and maintenance reports, and identify potential equipment failures and proactively recommend repairs.

  • Additional duties may be assigned by management.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Experience: 2-5 years of experience within a manufacturing or maintenance environment, and preferred experience in the manufacturing industry (e.g., corrugated industry).
  • Machine Setup & Material Handling: Ability to install, maintain, and troubleshoot industrial machinery and equipment. Experience in handling electrical and mechanical components.
  • Quality Control & Production Monitoring: Familiarity with inspecting production processes and ensuring equipment reliability. Ability to interpret schematics, blueprints, and technical manuals.
  • Basic Troubleshooting: Ability to diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic issues. Proficiency in problem-solving and identifying system improvements.
  • Skills:
    • Strong mechanical and electrical aptitude
    • Ability to operate and maintain various hand and power tools
    • Knowledge of general maintenance principles and skilled trades applications
    • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow safety and operational procedures
    • Basic computer skills for tracking maintenance records and reports
    • Effective communication and teamwork abilities
    • Self-motivated with a history of good work performance and attendance
  • Physical Requirements: Regularly required to stand, walk, and work in physically demanding conditions, frequent use of hands for handling, reaching, and operating tools/machinery. Ability to lift and move up to 100 pounds occasionally, 50 pounds frequently, and 20 pounds constantly. Frequently climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, and reach.
  • Certifications: Preferred apprenticeship or associate degree in a relevant field. May be required to maintain a Lift Truck Operator License
  • Work Environment: Regular exposure to moving mechanical parts and high-noise environments, frequent exposure to wet and humid conditions. Occasional exposure to high places, airborne particles, and vibration. Fast-paced and safety-oriented work setting

Take Action and Unbox your Potential – Next Steps:

If you are ready to take the next step in your career and join a company that values growth and teamwork, apply today and help us continue to make Pratt Industries a leader in the Corrugating industry!

title: Talent Management Partner
description:

As a Talent Management Partner, you will serve as a strategic HR advisor, partnering with business leaders to strengthen talent strategies, develop leadership capabilities, and enhance organizational effectiveness. You will help translate business priorities into actionable people initiatives that improve employee engagement, performance, and long-term growth. Through workforce planning, talent development, succession planning, and organizational design, you will contribute to building high-performing teams and a resilient workforce.   • Proven ability to coach, influence, and advise leaders while developing trusted relationships across multiple organizational levels.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a collaborative, matrixed environment while balancing competing priorities and supporting multiple business stakeholders.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Direct Response Video Editor based in Israel.

Join a fast-paced creative environment where performance, experimentation, and creative volume drive results. As a Direct Response Video Editor, you will primarily produce compelling short-form video ads for paid social platforms while also creating effective static ad creatives to support rapid testing. You will transform user-generated content, testimonials, product demonstrations, and founder-led footage into conversion-focused advertising assets. Working closely with growth specialists and creative strategists, you will develop new hooks, messaging angles, and calls to action to help identify winning concepts. This role is ideal for a versatile, performance-minded creative who thrives on speed, continuous iteration, and measurable impact.

    • Requirements

    • Professional experience: At least two years of experience editing direct response video advertisements for direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands.

    • Static advertising experience: Practical experience designing static ad creatives for Meta advertising campaigns.

    • Editing software: Proficiency with at least one professional or widely used editing tool, such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or Adobe After Effects.

    • Design skills: Working knowledge of Photoshop and the ability to create clear, visually effective static advertising assets.

    • AI tool familiarity: Experience with or a strong working knowledge of AI-powered creative tools, such as ChatGPT, Runway, or Pika.

    • Time management: Ability to work quickly, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and consistently produce several creative assets per week.

    • Communication skills: Strong English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

    • Creative mindset: A performance-driven approach that prioritizes measurable results alongside visual quality.

    • Adaptability and initiative: Resourcefulness in working with raw assets, openness to feedback, and a willingness to experiment and improve continuously.

title: General Operative and Material Coordinator Opportunities - Temporary
description:
Immediate Start Opportunities – General Operatives & Material Coordinators (temporary)

We are currently recruiting General Operatives and Material Coordinators to support a range of manufacturing and production activities within a fast-paced, high-quality environment. These roles offer an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to start work immediately and gain valuable experience across assembly, paint, logistics, or material handling operations.

Positions are available on a temporary basis, with opportunities to work across multiple departments depending on business needs.

Summary
As a General Operative or Material Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting day-to-day production and operational activities. Working as part of a team, you will help ensure components, materials, and products are prepared, moved, assembled, or finished to required quality standards, while contributing to an efficient, safe, and well-organised workplace.

Roles may include:
• Assembly support
• Paint preparation and finishing
• Materials handling and stock movement
• Production line support and general factory operations

What You’ll Do
General Operatives
• Assemble, fit, or prepare component parts and panels using a variety of hand or power tools.
• Inspect, prepare, or rework components following documented processes.
• Support daily production output by meeting quality and quantity targets.
• Assist supervisors and team members in achieving build requirements and covering absences when required.
• Report issues such as shortages, defects, or process concerns to team leaders.
• Follow all operational processes accurately and work within allocated timescales.
• Maintain tools, equipment, and PPE in good working condition.
• Demonstrate flexibility to work across different production areas as needed.
Material Coordinators
• Handle, move, and distribute materials, components, and parts across production areas.
• Ensure accurate stock handling, including booking in/out, stock checks, and material tracking.
• Work closely with logistics and production teams to support continuous workflow.
• Operate manual handling equipment (training provided where necessary).
• Identify and report shortages, discrepancies, or damaged materials.
• Maintain a clean, organised, and safe work environment.

What You’ll Bring
For both General Operatives and Material Coordinators:

• Ability to follow written instructions and documented processes.
• Good hand–eye coordination and manual dexterity (for operative roles).
• Ability to work under time constraints while maintaining quality.
• Good communication skills and strong team-working approach.
• Reliable, self-disciplined, and enthusiastic attitude.
• Flexibility to adapt to changing work requirements or shift patterns.
• Good level of physical fitness, with the ability to lift, stand for long periods, and perform manual tasks.
• Ability to understand and communicate effectively in English.
Desirable experience or qualifications:
• Previous experience in manufacturing, assembly, material handling, or similar environments.
• Experience using hand/power tools or manual handling equipment.
• Knowledge of automotive, engineering, or production processes.
• C&G, NVQ, or similar qualifications in automotive, paint, assembly, logistics, or warehouse operations.
• Understanding of Business Improvement Techniques (Level 2 or equivalent).

Additional Information
• Pay: From £12.71 per hour (overtime available at enhanced rates)
• Payment: Weekly via agency
• Contract: Temporary (week-by-week)
• Duration: Expected from absence cover (week by week, up too 3 months- subject to change)
• Start Date: ASAP or immediate
• Eligibility: Must have the right to work in the UK (no sponsorship available)

Our Company:

Group Lotus is a leading sports car manufacturer with over 75-year long history of iconic designs, groundbreaking engineering and legendary victories on the F1 track. Today we are transforming into a truly global performance car brand focused on the electrical future. In 2022 we launched the Eletre, the world’s first all-electric hyper-SUV, and in 2023 our fully-electric Hyper-GT, Emeya.

As part of the Lotus team, you push boundaries. Those of the car industry and of your own. Every member of the Lotus family has some of the pioneering mindset of founder Colin Chapman in them.

Hethel, Norfolk, England has been the home of Lotus for over 60 years, ever since Colin Chapman, our founder, started making championship-winning racing cars. In conjunction with production facilities in Norwich, and research facilities near Warwick, our UK sites offer a wide breadth of roles for all disciplines.

title: Director, Northeast Field Operations
description:
About Vessel

Vessel is a New York City-based technology company on a mission to overcome the housing crisis and give every person the opportunity for an extraordinary life.

We believe the solution isn’t simply to build housing faster or cheaper. It’s to fundamentally reinvent the building itself.

By bringing together advanced design, engineering, manufacturing, and technology, we’ve created Calypso—a revolutionary new apartment building designed to deliver an exceptional living experience at a fraction of the cost and in dramatically less time than conventional construction.

Backed by institutional leaders including Lennar, we’re turning an entirely new approach to housing into reality.

And we’re just getting started.

The Role

You own everything on site for Calypso projects in the Northeast, from mobilization to certificate of occupancy: schedule, budget, safety, quality and the inspector relationship. You'll build our in-house construction management function from scratch.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the Northeast field team. You inherit a working team, raise its standard, and hire where we need depth.
  • Deliver every project. From mobilization to certificate of occupancy, you own schedule, budget, safety and quality, including cranes, deliveries, subcontractors and inspections.
  • Be the building department's first call. You build the relationships and resolve code issues on site.
  • Make the product easier to build. You give our plant and engineers direct field feedback on what installs cleanly and what doesn't, and it goes into the next design revision.
  • Build the tools that run the field. You work with our engineering and software people to develop new technology (tracking, scheduling, QC, installation guidance) that makes crews faster and sites more predictable. You say what the field needs, you test it on live projects, and you drive adoption.
  • Write the playbook. You turn each project's lessons into checklists, install sequences and quality gates that any crew in any region can run.
  • Own the numbers. You hold the field budget and forecast, and you flag variances early.
  • Run safety and QC. You build and enforce programs that make a safe site and a clean inspection the norm.

What You Bring

  • 12+ years in ground-up multifamily construction, including senior superintendent or PM time on many mid-size (roughly 20–150 unit) projects
  • A record of on-time, on-budget delivery you can quantify
  • Deep knowledge of means and methods, MEP/envelope coordination, inspections and Northeast codes (NY/NJ/CT a plus)
  • Experience hiring and managing field teams and subcontractors
  • Comfort building better tools when they fall short
  • Direct, written communication

At Vessel, we’re not interested in doing things the way they’ve always been done. We’re building an entirely new way to create housing—and that requires rethinking everything, including how buildings are delivered in the field.

We’re looking for someone with the imagination to challenge convention, the intellect to solve complex problems, and the tenacity to turn ambitious ideas into reality.

This isn’t an opportunity to manage construction as usual. It’s an opportunity to help reinvent an industry—and make extraordinary housing attainable for millions of people.

If that sounds like the kind of challenge you’ve been looking for, we’d love to meet you.
