title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform
description:
Job Description

Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and powers data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 800 of the world's leading enterprises, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io http://www.astronomer.io.

ABOUT THIS ROLE:

At Astronomer, we’re redefining how companies run Apache Airflow at scale. Our R&D organization is home to some of the most innovative minds in cloud infrastructure and open-source software. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. You get to go in at the ground level of how our production infrastructure is designed, built, tested and deployed. Your work will directly influence how we build Astro, Observe and our IDE product, as well as how global organizations orchestrate data pipelines at scale—making them faster, more reliable, and easier to manage. If you’re driven by impact, excited by scale, and ready to work on the kind of infrastructure challenges that push the boundaries of what’s possible in cloud-native systems, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

WHAT YOU GET TO DO:
  • Make high-quality, data-driven and experience-driven decisions on how we build this and the next generation of our production platform, then deliver the results.
  • Own and build how we test, build and deploy code in a high-scale PaaS environment.
  • Collaborate across the whole company on how we design production systems, set standards and make technology choices for new and existing products, and how these fit together.
  • Deliver results - we routinely “change the wheels on the bus while it’s moving”, in a predictable, safe and reliable way.
  • Be at the forefront of how we work together as a Platform Engineering team.
  • Blaze a Trail: Work on a small but growing team on building out the Platform/Reliability practice for the company
  • Be an Owner: Be directly involved in decision-making on what we work on, as well as how we work on it. Make promises, and keep them.
  • Do Sensible Things: Be directly involved in determining how our platform works. Participate in incident management and determine sensible practices as the platform evolves.
  • Garage Door Open: Create and maintain comprehensive internal documentation for systems and processes, ensuring clarity and accessibility.
WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE:
  • Strong experience in Non-Abstract Systems design https://sre.google/workbook/non-abstract-design/ and implementation.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, Golang and in-depth experience with Kubernetes (CKA or equivalent or greater).
  • Experience with observability principles and technologies, including SLI/SLO definition and tracking.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in working with a globally distributed team in delivery.
  • A passion for reliability and operational excellence. A low tolerance for toil and other nonsense.
  • Ability to estimate the scope of work accurately and coordinate with stakeholders to address risks and ensure successful project delivery.
  • Experience with (and ideally strong opinions on) software development best practices, such as code review, testing, CI/CD, version control, automation and debugging.
  • Proactive approach to identifying and addressing issues, with a focus on ownership and accountability.
BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:
  • Experience working on a SaaS/PaaS product across multiple cloud providers.
  • Experience with our particular tech stack components and technologies (deep breath): CircleCI, Chronosphere (Prometheus), Splunk, Bazel, Istio, Playwright, Karpenter, Github (Actions) …

This role combines hands-on engineering expertise with project management to ensure seamless integrations and successful customer launches. title: Fostering Coordinator
description:
Are you passionate about dog welfare and building supportive communities?

We're looking for a Fostering Coordinator to play a vital role in helping dogs thrive outside the kennel environment, by recruiting and supporting volunteer foster carers.

Interviews are provisionally scheduled for 4 November 2026 at Evesham Rehoming Centre.
As Fostering Coordinator, you will:
  • identify and place suitable dogs into foster care, including temporary placements for long-stay dogs needing respite from kennels, and carry out necessary intake assessments,
  • recruit, assess, and induct new foster carers, promoting the scheme through events, conversations, and collaboration with colleagues across Dogs Trust,
  • support foster carers with regular check-ins, arrange veterinary appointments, and provide access to behaviour or training support when needed,
  • deliver training to foster carers, either one-to-one or through organised group sessions,
  • promote dogs in foster or Home Stay settings by preparing profiles, contacting potential adopters, organising matching meetings, and completing all adoption paperwork.
To be successful in this role, you'll understand the importance of fostering, and the positive impact it can have on a dogs journey to their forever home. With experience of working with volunteers, you will have excellent communication and organisational skills, and ability to support fosterers as they provide temporary care to our dogs. You'll need some dog handling experience, as well as excellent customer service skills.

Our rehoming centres house thousands of dogs each year until they are able to find a loving new home, and the success of our centres wouldn't be possible without our dedicated team of staff and volunteers; there is a real family-community within each of our centres. Come rain or shine, our team are out in all weathers to make sure the dogs have the best possible life. Dealing with thousands of visitors each month, our rehoming centres are the face of Dogs Trust and we pride ourselves on our staff providing the very best in customer service.

title: Production Utility- 2nd Shift
description:
SUMMARY
Responsible for all activities associated with safely operating production machines
including setup, operation, cleanup, and recommending improvements to operations to
meet customer demand.


DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 Work safely at all times, be aware of surroundings and understand and comply with
Pratt Industries Safety rules, operating procedures, and help hold co-workers
responsible for safety related items. Participate in Plant Safety Committee.
 Follow at all times GMPs (Good Manufacturing Processes)
 Learn and comply with Pratt Industries quality procedures and policies. Stop bad
quality from leaving the facility to the Customer. Catch it on the front end of
manufacturing the product. Strong attention to detail for poor quality; prevent bad
quality being sent to customer.
 Maximize the utilization of equipment by operating the machinery at available
capacity and speed. Improve set up times daily, improve downtime daily. Identify
and address mechanical concerns and report to Production Supervisor or
Production Manager or Plant Mechanical Tech/Specialist
 Housekeeping and cleaning of work areas – keep clean and free of tripping hazards
during shift and end of shift cleaning of the area. In addition, good housekeeping of
areas employee utilizes; break rooms, bathrooms, refrigerators etc.
 Learn and understand capability and capacity of machine and drive efficiencies
limiting waste and downtime. Do not sacrifice quality for machine speeds – must
have both excellent quality and high efficiencies with minimal downtime.
 Train and assist Assistant Machine Operators, Machine Helpers and Production
Utility with job duties on the machine, downtime, setup times and quality.
 Cross-train on other machines and learns other positions in the plant.
 Complete necessary reports in an accurate and timely manner, including but not
limited to: Production Data, Machine Operational Status, Safety Data, Quality Data.
 Turn in maintenance work order requests to supervision for needed repairs on the
machine or machines. Be proactive in the maintenance and housekeeping of
equipment.
 Switch duties with co-workers as necessary. Learning environment to learn as many
job duties to assist with plant growth and personal and professional growth
opportunities.
 Comply with all company policies and procedures, including safety and maintaining
good housekeeping.
 Adheres to production schedule. Makes recommendations for optimizing the
schedule to meet cost, quality and service goals. Reports any unusual scheduling
issues to Supervisor.
 Must be able to work overtime as necessary, sometimes on short notice. We serve
our customers 24x7 – 365 days a year and sometimes work on holidays not
avoidable.
 Additional duties may be assigned by management.


EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE
High school diploma or GED.
Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:

Prior work experience in the packaging industry; paper, plastics, converting
6 months’ experience in some type of manufacturing operation.


LANGUAGE SKILLS
Able to read and follow instructions; quality, safety, job packets


MATHEMATICAL SKILLS
Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts
such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school
math.


REASONING ABILITY
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written,
oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving one or more concrete
variables in standardized situations.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS
May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk,
and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel;
reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may
occasionally be required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50
pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision,
color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.


WORK ENVIRONMENT
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving
mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions.
The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne
particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

title: 2nd Shift Baler Operator
description:
POSITION TITLE: BALER OPERATOR

REPORTS TO: Corrugating Supervisor

SUMMARY

Responsible for all activities associated with safely running the baler including operation, cleanup, and recommending improvements to operations.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Make good, neat bales.

Operate hogger and hog up all unusable paper and corrugated scrap.

Hand tie wax bale wires.

Maintain accurate bale reports.

High school diploma or GED.

Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.

Prior work experience as a forklift operator.

Able to read and follow instructions on factory masters.

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation.

Product layouts and production specifications

Product quality specifications

Quality standards

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

The performance of the employee will be measured as follows:

Operating standards - the employee will need to meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the employee.

Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the employee to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the employee and his/her superior.

Employee relations - through observations the employee will be evaluated regarding his/her behaviors associated with appropriate human interaction, respect and communication.

Creativity - this will be evaluated by how active the employee is in participating in advancing the business through new and innovative ideas.

title: Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist based in Netherlands.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist to manage provider enrollment, credentialing, and medical billing operations in a remote healthcare environment. In this role, you will coordinate with insurance payers, healthcare providers, and internal teams to ensure accurate documentation, timely claims processing, and reliable reimbursement. You will oversee credentialing applications and renewals while maintaining compliance with payer requirements and applicable healthcare regulations. Your expertise in insurance billing, coding, and claims resolution will help minimize denials and prevent delays in provider network participation. You will also monitor payment discrepancies, maintain comprehensive records, and identify opportunities to improve revenue cycle processes. This is an opportunity to contribute to efficient healthcare administration while supporting providers and delivering operational accuracy.

Accountabilities:

As a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist, you will oversee the full lifecycle of provider credentialing, insurance enrollment, and claims management. You will ensure that provider records remain accurate, billing activities meet payer requirements, and reimbursement issues are addressed promptly through effective coordination and follow-up.

  • Prepare and submit credentialing applications for new healthcare providers across commercial insurance carriers, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care organizations.

  • Manage provider re-credentialing within required timelines to prevent lapses in insurance network participation.

  • Maintain accurate provider information in credentialing databases, payer portals, and related systems.

  • Coordinate with providers to collect required documentation, professional licenses, certifications, and signatures.

  • Review, prepare, and submit medical insurance claims accurately using electronic health record (EHR) and billing systems.

  • Apply appropriate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes, including relevant modifiers, in accordance with applicable billing guidelines.

  • Verify patient demographics, insurance eligibility, and coverage details before submitting claims.

  • Apply payer-specific policies, fee schedules, and filing deadlines to support accurate and timely claims processing.

  • Monitor claim status through payer portals, manage claim edits and rejections, and coordinate necessary adjustments.

  • Post insurance payments, contractual adjustments, and write-offs accurately, identifying underpayments and payment discrepancies.

  • Reconcile daily, weekly, and monthly payment reports and maintain accurate billing records.

  • Investigate claim denials and rejections, prepare supporting documentation, and submit timely appeals.

  • Maintain detailed follow-up logs to track outstanding claims through resolution.

  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, CMS requirements, payer policies, and applicable federal and state regulations.

  • Collaborate with clinical, administrative, and revenue cycle teams to resolve billing and credentialing issues.

  • Serve as a liaison between healthcare providers and insurance payers, resolving enrollment discrepancies and network participation issues.

  • Monitor changes in payer requirements, credentialing policies, and coding guidelines to maintain compliance.

  • Maintain credentialing logs, spreadsheets, databases, and expiration-date trackers to ensure deadlines are met.

  • Audit credentialing files for completeness and accuracy and prepare management reports on application progress, pending items, and compliance status.

  • Identify recurring payer issues and recommend process improvements to strengthen operational efficiency and reimbursement outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines hands-on medical credentialing and billing experience with a strong understanding of insurance payer processes, coding standards, and healthcare compliance. You should be highly organized, comfortable managing multiple deadlines, and able to communicate effectively with providers, insurance representatives, and internal stakeholders.

    • High school diploma or equivalent required; an associate or bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, or a related field is preferred.

    • At least two years of experience in medical credentialing, medical billing, or both, preferably working with multiple insurance payers.

    • Strong working knowledge of commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care credentialing and reimbursement processes.

    • Familiarity with CAQH ProView, NPPES, PECOS, Availity, payer portals, and EHR or medical billing software.

    • Demonstrated experience preparing accurate claims, resolving denials, following up on outstanding payments, and maintaining compliance with payer requirements.

    • Understanding of CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding systems, including modifier requirements.

    • Knowledge of provider enrollment, re-credentialing procedures, insurance eligibility verification, claim submission deadlines, and payer-specific policies.

    • Medical billing or coding certification, such as Certified Professional Biller (CPB), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), or an equivalent qualification, is an advantage.

    • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate, complete, and well-organized records.

    • Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple applications, claims, and deadlines simultaneously.

    • Effective written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with healthcare providers, insurance representatives, patients, and colleagues.

    • Proficiency in credentialing, billing, and documentation systems, with the ability to learn new tools and workflows.

    • Understanding of HIPAA, CMS, NCQA, and other applicable healthcare compliance standards.

    • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining productivity, accuracy, and consistent follow-through.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote work arrangement.

      • Opportunity to develop expertise across provider credentialing, medical billing, insurance claims, and revenue cycle operations.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Beschrijving

Voor onze klant, een gevestigde speler binnen private banking, ben ik op zoek naar een Data Engineer. Deze organisatie investeert sterk in technologie en innovatie om haar dienstverlening continu te verbeteren. Binnen een stabiele en hoogtechnologische omgeving krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan betrouwbare dataoplossingen en innovatieve toepassingen die een concrete meerwaarde bieden voor de organisatie. Je zal deel uitmaken van een team waar je meewerkt aan de verdere uitbouw van het data-ecosysteem. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en onderhoudt robuuste datapipelines en dataproducten die data uit verschillende bronnen ontsluiten, verwerken en beschikbaar maken voor analyse en rapportering. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's uit data, IT en de business om databehoeften te vertalen naar kwalitatieve en schaalbare oplossingen. Naast klassieke data engineering krijg je ook de kans om mee te werken aan innovatieve AI-toepassingen. Denk hierbij aan het voorbereiden en ontsluiten van data voor toepassingen op basis van generatieve AI, waaronder Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) en vector search. Je waakt over de kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en herbruikbaarheid van de data en denkt actief mee over hoe nieuwe technologieën de organisatie vooruit kunnen helpen.

  • Je werkt graag samen met collega's uit verschillende teams en vertaalt technische uitdagingen naar betrouwbare dataoplossingen

title: AI Enablement and Learning Specialist

You will prototype AI-supported resources, streamline onboarding, and develop systems that make learning more accessible and efficient. Working closely with stakeholders across the organization, you will turn emerging needs and open-ended ideas into practical solutions. You will have the autonomy to experiment with new technologies, improve existing processes, and implement initiatives from concept to launch. This opportunity is ideal for a proactive, systems-oriented professional who enjoys solving complex problems in a global, asynchronous-first environment.

As an AI Enablement and Learning Specialist, you will develop and maintain AI-powered learning solutions, optimize knowledge management processes, and ensure that learning systems operate efficiently. You will collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement and translate learning objectives into accessible, automated, and scalable experiences.

You should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, connecting systems and processes, and designing solutions that prioritize the needs of learners while delivering measurable operational improvements.

    • Practical, hands-on experience building solutions with AI tools, alongside a genuine curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and their applications.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Do you want to build modern software for critical logistics and transportation processes, and follow the customer all the way from need to result?

At IMI, we deliver SaaS-based solutions that support warehousing, transportation management, delivery visibility, and checkout experiences, used every day by leading retailers and logistics providers.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who understands the customer’s world, can turn needs into precise requirements, and takes responsibility for what ships. You will work the way modern teams do, with AI as a natural part of how software gets built.

About the Role

You will be a natural part of the customer’s whole journey, from onboarding new customers to supporting and maintaining existing ones. Most of your time will be spent designing, developing, and improving our products and integrations, while also supporting customers and colleagues when technical expertise is needed.

Unlike a traditional in-house development role, you will work directly with customers, particularly within integrations and technical onboarding in real-world logistics operations. You will work on new functionality, integrations, technical improvements, troubleshooting, and the continuous development of our solutions, in a cross-functional team with software engineers, architects, business consultants, and project managers.

You will work with modern SaaS platforms, cloud-native services, distributed integrations, and business-critical systems that process large volumes of transactions every day. Our solutions are built on technologies including .NET, C#, SQL, TypeScript, Azure, and modern web frameworks, with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, maintainability, and continuous delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Translate customer and business needs into clear, testable specifications

  • Design and develop new functionality and integrations between customer systems and our solutions, using AI tools and agents as part of your daily work, and own the quality of the result

  • Develop and maintain business-critical software solutions, and troubleshoot issues in production together with customers and colleagues

  • Assess business value, risk, and impact before and after changes

  • Take part in customer onboarding, support, and maintenance as a technical specialist

  • Contribute to product improvements, roadmap initiatives, and technical enhancements

Your Profile

We believe you enjoy combining software development with a customer-focused mindset. You are curious, collaborative, and motivated by solving technical challenges. You take ownership of your work, are comfortable working independently, and are proactive in improving products, processes, and ways of working.

You can turn what you learn from customers into requirements that you or others can build and test against, and you balance business value, risk, and effort with long-term sustainability. You know what good looks like, and you can tell when code is not it, including code you did not write yourself. You are not afraid to ask for help when needed and appreciate knowledge sharing within a team environment.

We Believe You Have:

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

  • Strong ability to translate business needs into clear, actionable technical requirements

  • The ability to read, understand, and judge code, particularly in our stack (.NET, C#, SQL, TypeScript), including code you did not write yourself

  • Practical experience developing with AI tools and agents, and a good sense of where they help and where they fail

  • Several years of professional software development experience, including making independent technical decisions regarding architecture, quality, and risk

  • The ability to get up to speed quickly in a complex domain

  • Experience with integration development and customer-facing technical roles within a service-oriented organization

  • Experience with cloud platforms and modern architectural patterns

  • Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with supply chain, logistics, transportation management, or warehouse management solutions

  • Experience from a software product company

  • Experience with Vue.js and Azure DevOps

The position is primarily based in Linköping and offers a hybrid working model.

Why IMI?

IMI Supply Chain Solutions is a leading software provider specializing in sustainable logistics and order management. Our solutions are at the core of critical industries such as grocery retail and pharmaceutical supply chains. We are in an exciting phase of growth, offering you the opportunity to influence both our products and the way we work with product development going forward.

We are proud to be Great Place To Work certified and offer a workplace with a strong sense of team spirit, a high degree of autonomy, and excellent opportunities for professional development. In addition, we provide a generous benefits package, including extra vacation days, a wellness allowance, and occupational pension contributions.

Application

Is this the right role for you? We warmly welcome your application. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. If you have any questions about the position, please contact our HR Business Partner, Ebba Olofsson, at ebba.olofsson@im.se

Tarve on tällä hetkellä usean kuukauden mittainen, mutta taustalla on aukeamassa myös pitkäaikainen tarve työntekijälle. Työt alkavat marraskuun alussa. Palkkaus on kokemukseen pohjautuen noin 15,67 - 18 €/h. Palkkaa maksamme 2krt/kk.

Kohteita on niin yksityisasukkaiden kerrostaloasunnoista julkisiin rakennuksiin kuten toimistoihin sekä kouluihin. Kohteet sijaisevat pääasiassa Hämeenlinna - Riihimäki alueella sekä Lahdessa.

Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävistä niin laita meille hakemusta järjestelemäämme. Käymme hakijoita läpi jo hakuaikana ja valinnat tehdään heti sopivien tekijöiden löydettyä. Lisätietoa tehtävistä antaa Wilma Niskanen arkisin klo 9-15 sähköpostilla wilma.niskanen@visiohr.fi tai 050 391 3188.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Pirkanmaa on osa Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut -konsernia, joka on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys. Pelaamme reilua peliä ja tarjoamme töitä niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Yhdistämme työntekijät ja työnantajat niin, että molemmat löytävät juuri tarpeisiinsa sopivan ratkaisun. Yhteistyö perustuu kaikkien kolmen tahon keskinäiseen luottamukseen.

Jos haluat reilun työnantajan, joka arvostaa osaamistasi ja huomaa työpanoksesi, se on Visio.

You will be an expert on LATAM culture, be creative, self-aware, and able to draw on personal experiences to have authentic conversations and discussions with LATAM consumers, colleagues and our clients.

Together with lead Consultants you will be responsible for handling and delivering client projects by conducting analysis, writing presentations and converting community conversations into clear client recommendations. This is not a ‘back-room’ role: we are looking for someone to support the lead Consultant in building and developing the client relationship from day one. This role is a perfect stepping-stone to develop consultancy skills in the world of branding, research and innovation.


Responsibilities

Research:

  • Moderating communities: engage community members – consumers of a specific client brand, steer discussions and probe consumer comments to drive relevant insight.
  • Designing research activities for communities which will generate the right responses to meet the client’s brief: ideation sessions, brainstorms, surveys, blogs and live online workshops.
  • Conducting qualitative analysis of the activities to understand the ‘what’ and the ‘why’ behind what consumers say and do.
  • Desk research.

Report writing:

  • Driving clear recommendations and implications from your analysis and findings to clients and colleagues.
  • Creating professional & convincing client-facing documents in a range of formats.

Client management:

  • Providing support to lead Consultants and Consultancy Director in nurturing good client relationships
  • Developing good personal presentation skills, for co-presenting to client


Skills required

  • Fluent written and spoken Spanish and English language skills – an essential requirement.
  • A passion for brands, consumers and how they interact.
  • A natural knack for the online world & social media: highly empathetic & able to connect with individuals online, specifically on LATAM markets.
  • You are constantly hungry to learn and grow and have plenty of energy and enthusiasm.
  • Intellectual curiosity.
  • Excellent writing and oral communication skills
  • Strong PowerPoint, Word and Excel skills required.
  • Good numerical skills.
  • You are a real doer and a proper team player.
  • Fantastic organisational skills: ability to multi-task.


About C Space

We are the world’s leading insight community, customer strategy and innovation experts, putting relationships at the heart of business to drive growth. We make relationships count by building mutual value between people and brands as the ultimate competitive advantage.

As part of Escalent Group, we’re a team of 1,600 researchers, data scientists, moderators, creatives, developers and UX professionals. We put the power of our customer expertise, Escalent’s industry expertise and Hall & Partner’s brand expertise at your fingertips.

Over the years we have helped clients like Google, PepsiCo, IKEA, British Airways, Philips grow by developing new products, services and communication together with their customers.

title: Direct Response Video Editor
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Direct Response Video Editor based in Turkey.

Join a fast-paced creative environment where performance, experimentation, and creative volume drive results. As a Direct Response Video Editor, you will primarily produce compelling short-form video ads for paid social platforms while also creating effective static ad creatives to support rapid testing. You will transform user-generated content, testimonials, product demonstrations, and founder-led footage into conversion-focused advertising assets. Working closely with growth specialists and creative strategists, you will develop new hooks, messaging angles, and calls to action to help identify winning concepts. You will also leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate ideation, editing, and production without compromising effectiveness. This role is ideal for a versatile, performance-minded creative who thrives on speed, continuous iteration, and measurable impact.

  • Direct response video editing: Produce short-form advertising videos for Meta, TikTok, and other paid social platforms, prioritizing engagement and conversion.

  • Creative production: Edit user-generated content, testimonials, product demonstrations, and founder-led videos into compelling, audience-focused ads.

  • Creative testing and iteration: Develop multiple variations of hooks, calls to action, messaging angles, and video concepts to support ongoing performance testing.

  • AI-assisted workflows: Use tools such as ChatGPT, Runway, Pika, and Descript to accelerate ideation, scripting, editing, and content production.

  • Performance-driven improvement: Incorporate feedback and available campaign insights to refine creatives, improve production efficiency, and maintain a consistent volume of deliverables.

  • Project ownership: Manage multiple creative assignments, prioritize tasks effectively, and deliver high-quality work within agreed deadlines.

    • Professional experience: At least two years of experience editing direct response video advertisements for direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands.

    • Editing software: Proficiency with at least one professional or widely used editing tool, such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or Adobe After Effects.

    • Design skills: Working knowledge of Photoshop and the ability to create clear, visually effective static advertising assets.

    • Performance marketing knowledge: Strong understanding of hooks, calls to action, creative angles, and the principles behind conversion-focused advertising.

    • Copywriting ability: Experience writing, adapting, or refining scripts and copy for advertising creatives.

    • AI tool familiarity: Experience with or a strong working knowledge of AI-powered creative tools, such as ChatGPT, Runway, or Pika.

    • Time management: Ability to work quickly, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and consistently produce several creative assets per week.

    • Communication skills: Strong English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

    • Creative mindset: A performance-driven approach that prioritizes measurable results alongside visual quality.

    • Adaptability and initiative: Resourcefulness in working with raw assets, openness to feedback, and a willingness to experiment and improve continuously.

      • Nice to have:

      • Experience with motion graphics.

      • Familiarity with creative research and production platforms such as Creative OS, Foreplay, Butter, or AdCreative.ai.

      • Understanding of marketing funnels, offers, and paid social advertising strategy.

        • Benefits

        • Creative ownership: Contribute directly to the development and testing of advertising concepts designed to improve campaign performance.

        • AI-enabled workflows: Work with modern AI tools to accelerate creative production and explore more efficient ways of working.

        • Varied creative work: Combine video editing, static ad design, scripting, and creative experimentation.

High school diploma or GED.

Prior work experience in the packaging industry.

6 months’ experience in some type of manufacturing operation.

Able to read and follow instructions on factory masters.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving one or more concrete variables in standardized situations.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may occasionally be required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 to 60 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

title: GRC Engineer - GOV (FedRAMP 20x)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a GRC Engineer – GOV (FedRAMP 20x) based in the United States.

Join a fast-growing cybersecurity and compliance environment helping organizations strengthen their security posture and meet demanding federal requirements. In this hands-on role, you will support government compliance initiatives by translating regulatory standards into practical, technology-driven solutions. You will contribute to FedRAMP 20x certification efforts, automated evidence collection, and continuous security monitoring. Working closely with client engineering teams, compliance professionals, and independent assessors, you will help organizations identify and remediate security gaps. You will use tools and technologies such as OSCAL, JSON, YAML, cloud security platforms, and policy-as-code solutions to improve compliance efficiency. This opportunity offers close collaboration with experienced practitioners, ongoing mentorship, and exposure to evolving federal cybersecurity frameworks. If you are detail-oriented, technically curious, and passionate about security automation, this role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the security of government and defense-related systems.

Accountabilities

  • FedRAMP 20x Compliance Execution: Analyze and apply FedRAMP Consolidated Rules (CR26) and the 46 Key Security Indicators (KSIs) across 10 control families to help ensure that software architectures meet applicable federal security requirements.

  • Machine-Readable Compliance Documentation: Create, update, and maintain technical certification artifacts, including Security Decision Records, Security Configuration Guides, and OSCAL-based documentation using JSON and YAML in accordance with applicable technical specifications and federal guidance.

  • Automated Evidence Collection: Build, implement, and maintain automated evidence pipelines that continuously validate security controls and KSIs, reducing reliance on manual, point-in-time audit processes.

  • Readiness and Gap Assessments: Conduct technical readiness reviews, map security controls, and assess compliance against FedRAMP 20x Class A, Class B, and Class C baseline requirements.

  • Continuous Security Monitoring: Support Collaborative Continuous Monitoring (CCM) initiatives by integrating cloud security posture management (CSPM) and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) tools into monitoring workflows that provide ongoing security validation.

  • Third-Party Assessment Support: Coordinate evidence collection, documentation submissions, and assessment logistics for Third-Party Assessment Organization (3PAO) audits and independent security assessments under senior team guidance.

  • Security Remediation: Collaborate with client and internal technical teams to investigate compliance deficiencies and implement remediation measures across cloud and multi-cloud environments.

  • Regulatory Monitoring: Track changes to CR26 requirements, Significant Change Notifications (SCNs), and the transition from FedRAMP Rev. 5 to FedRAMP 20x to help maintain alignment with evolving federal standards.

  • Client Collaboration: Work directly with client engineering and compliance stakeholders to communicate findings, coordinate deliverables, and ensure progress across multiple compliance workstreams.

  • Project and Delivery Management: Manage concurrent technical tasks, maintain accurate documentation, meet deadlines, and escalate risks or blockers promptly while working under senior guidance.

    • Requirements

    • Professional Experience: At least 2 years of direct technical experience delivering governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) work involving NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, or federal security authorization programs.

    • FedRAMP 20x Knowledge: Foundational understanding of the FedRAMP 20x certification model, Class A/B/C classifications, CR26 rules, and KSI-based security validation.

    • Technical Documentation: Practical experience creating or maintaining machine-readable compliance artifacts using OSCAL, JSON, YAML, or comparable structured documentation formats.

    • Cloud Security Expertise: Familiarity with cloud infrastructure platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, ideally including government cloud environments such as AWS GovCloud or Azure Government.

    • Compliance Automation: Working knowledge of scripting or policy-as-code technologies, including Python, Rego/OPA, or Terraform, with the ability to contribute to automated evidence collection and control validation.

    • Security and Compliance Fundamentals: Understanding of security controls, risk assessment, remediation processes, technical evidence gathering, and federal authorization requirements.

    • Analytical and Organizational Skills: Strong attention to detail, effective problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to manage multiple compliance deliverables simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and quality.

    • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate professionally with client engineering teams, compliance stakeholders, and external assessors.

    • Preferred Security Certifications: CompTIA Security+, Certified in Governance, Risk and Compliance (CGRC), Certified Authorization Professional (CAP), or Associate of CISSP credentials are advantageous.

    • Preferred Cloud Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect – Associate, Azure Security Engineer Associate, Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer, or comparable technical certifications are beneficial.

    • Preferred Assessment Experience: Previous involvement in 3PAO audits, agency Authority to Operate (ATO) evaluations, FedRAMP continuous monitoring, or Collaborative Continuous Monitoring workflows is a plus.

    • Additional Framework Knowledge: Familiarity with CMMC 2.0 and NIST SP 800-171 requirements, particularly in defense supply chain environments, is desirable.

    • Remote Work Readiness: Ability to work remotely with a reliable, high-speed internet connection and a professional home office suitable for confidential discussions and uninterrupted collaboration.

    • Working Hours and Travel: Availability to work a standard schedule of 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, with occasional flexibility to accommodate business needs, and willingness to travel locally for occasional in-person meetings or team activities.

    • Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer-sponsored visa support or transfer.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive Compensation: Competitive base salary, regular performance reviews, merit-based compensation adjustments, and bonus opportunities.

      • Career Development: Opportunities for professional growth within a fast-growing organization, with a clear path for career advancement.

      • Training and Certifications: Reimbursement for approved training programs and professional certification courses relevant to the role.

      • Mentorship: Opportunities to learn from experienced cybersecurity and GRC practitioners while developing specialized expertise in federal compliance and security automation.

      • Remote-First Flexibility: Work remotely from the United States while collaborating with a global team.

      • Technical Exposure: Hands-on experience with FedRAMP 20x, automated compliance workflows, cloud security environments, and emerging compliance-as-code practices.

      • Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a supportive team that values technical excellence, continuous learning, clear communication, and high-quality client delivery.

      • Meaningful Impact: Contribute to strengthening cybersecurity and compliance across government organizations, federal service providers, and defense-related environments.

title: Senior Specialist, Talent Partnership, Enterprise
description:
Randstad Enterprise Solutions — including Randstad Sourceright, Global Enterprise Strategic Accounts Team and Randstad RiseSmart — provides solutions and expertise that help enterprise clients position for growth, execute on strategy and improve business agility. Working across the broad spectrum of Randstad Enterprise Solutions, the collective experience of the teams encompasses all facets of the global talent spectrum, from the acquisition of talent to skilling and coaching to outplacement solutions. Enabled by innovative technologies, key offerings include HR and recruitment solutions, recruitment process outsourcing (RPO), managed services programs (MSP), statement of work (SOW), outplacement, skilling/coaching and total talent solutions.

We are looking for a Talent Advisor who will help us support our client who is a global market leader in industrial automation, and rail transport, the largest company in the European engineering sector. As a Talent Advisor working on our MSP program you will be part of a dynamic team working on site one day per week in Birmingham. Some travel to client sites across the UK is also expected.

You will recruit for contract employees and agency work across blue collar and white collar positions. You will actively promote our Client’s values in the market, be an ambassador for its culture and bring also the Client experience to life for its stakeholders. Proactivity is essential. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-governance environment and can balance niche technical requirements with high-volume delivery.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Agile Delivery: Manage a diverse portfolio of requisitions, shifting seamlessly between high-volume surges and specialised, niche roles.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Act as a talent consultant to hiring managers, providing market data and guiding them through the contingent lifecycle.
  • Governance & Compliance: Operate within a highly regulated framework, ensuring all hiring meets the audit standards of the rail and mobility sector.
  • Relationship Management: Build deep-rooted trust with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to ensure a seamless "one team" approach.
  • Process Excellence: Drive VMS engagement and maintain data integrity to ensure reporting is accurate and actionable.

Your profile:

  • Proven experience working in a MSP and using VMS systems, Fieldglass experience is a plus.
  • Confident with data - running reports and presenting data.
  • Experience in partnering with suppliers.
  • Exposure to projects involving international collaboration.
  • Compelling and clear communicator; you provide insights that help hiring managers make better workforce decisions.
  • Excellent organisational skills and agility to work in a fast-paced and innovative environment.
  • Fantastic attention to detail.
  • Proactive, autonomous, and curious with a resilient "can-do" attitude and a continuous desire to learn.
  • Happy to be on site in Birmingham one day per week and ability to travel to client’s site in Manchester.

What we can offer:

  • An inspiring working environment in which you, together with your team and colleagues, will make a difference for our customers.
  • We value your hard work by providing a competitive salary, with a comprehensive benefits package.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
We're part of the Builder Platform - the team building the foundation Remitly's engineering runs on. That foundation is no longer just for people: we're building for AI agents as first-class users of our platform too. It's a real shift in how software gets built here, and we're on the leading edge of it. If you want to shape cloud infrastructure for both the developers and the agents that will build on it, this is that seat.

The Cloud Team designs, builds, and operates Remitly's AWS cloud foundation - the networking fabric and infrastructure tooling that every product team depends on. We manage cloud infrastructure at significant scale (hundreds to thousands of accounts), move money for millions of customers, and treat reliability, security, and operational excellence as non-negotiable. As a Cloud Engineer, you'll focus on our cloud networking stack and the infrastructure-as-code that defines it. You'll design and build network topology in Terraform, operate connectivity that every product team and payments partner depends on, and troubleshoot complex issues across a large multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You'll work alongside senior engineers who lead our larger architecture and platform-software efforts, growing your depth as you take on more ownership over time.

This is also a great fit if you're a strong networking or DevOps engineer who wants to grow into writing code. You'll manage and operate networks at real scale, and you'll get the room - and the support - to level up from Terraform into building and maintaining Go services that run our platform. We'll back you learning to code here, not just tolerate it.


About Remitly:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we’ve tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it’s supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we’re not just here to move money— we’re here to move our global customers forward. We’re looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that’s you and you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

  • Deep knowledge of cloud networking: VPC design and subnetting, routing, Transit Gateway, DNS, and load balancing.
  • Solid understanding of TCP/IP and network traffic flow analysis, with the ability to troubleshoot connectivity issues across distributed environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and operating infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred).
  • 3+ years of experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure, with hands-on AWS depth.
  • Experience operating production infrastructure, and an understanding of best practices for versioning, deployment, and CI/CD.
  • Familiarity with edge services (CloudFront, WAF, Shield) or partner connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect, BGP) is a plus.
  • Understanding of multi-account governance and organizational tooling; Kubernetes/EKS familiarity is a plus.
  • A desire to grow into writing code (we use Go); existing backend/scripting experience is a plus, but we'll help you build this skill on the job.

title: Osa-aikainen Myyjä Nummelaan
description:
Etsimme nyt Nummelan myymälään

osa-aikaista myyjää määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen

Myyjän työtehtävät Puuilossa sisältävät muun muassa

  • Asiakaspalvelua Myyjät ovat Puuilon kasvot arkisissa asiakaskohtaamisissa. Asiakaskunta on laaja ja moninainen, joten työpäivä sisältää erilaisia asiakaskohtaamisia ja -tilanteita. Asiakkaamme arvostavat auttamishalua ja ongelmanratkaisukykyä jokaisessa tilanteessa.

  • Kassa- ja infotyötä Työpäivät sisältävät niin kassa- kuin infotyötä. Infotyöskentelyyn kuuluu asiakkaiden reklamaatioiden käsittelyä, mahdollisten ongelmien ratkaiseminen sekä peräkärryjen vuokraaminen.

  • Hyllyttämistä ja esillepanoja Yksi myyjän tärkeimmistä tehtävistä on varmistaa, että kuormat puretaan hyllyyn asiakkaiden saataville. Esillepanojen avulla varmistetaan, että ajankohtaiset tuotteet ovat helposti asiakkaiden näkyvillä ja saatavilla.

  • Monipuolisia asiakaspalvelutilanteita ja työtehtäviä Puuilon myyjien työtehtävät ovat hyvin monipuolisia sisältäen muun muassa verkkokauppakeräilyä, maton ja metritavaran leikkaamista, kaasujen vaihtoa sekä tuotteisiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä auttamista.

  • Siivousta Puuilossa myymälähenkilökunta huolehtii oman myymälänsä siisteydestä. Kerran viikossa on siivouspäivä, minkä lisäksi henkilökunta huolehtii päivittäin yleissiisteydestä asiakas- ja henkilökunnan tilojen osalta.

Puuilossa piisaa vauhtia ja radiopuhelimen rätinää, jotka ovat suuri osa Puuilon kulttuuria. Haluat tehdä kaikkia myyjän työtehtäviä ja nautit siitä, että työsi on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa. Olet valmis hyppäämään välillä trukin puikkoihin nostaaksesi asiakkaalle tupauunin auton kyytiin tai ajamaan siivouskoneella myymälässä.

Mitä Puuilo tarjoaa Sinulle?

  • Määräaikaisen osa-aikaisen työsuhteen ajalle 4.1.-28.2.2027 (20h/vko)

  • Iloisen ja osallistavan työympäristön

  • Monipuolisen ja vaihtelevan työnkuvan

  • Laadukkaat työvaatteet ja Sievin turvakengät skannatuilla pohjallisilla

  • Henkilöstöedut (ePassi ja henkilöstöetujärjestelmä)

  • Palkkaus TES:n taulukkopalkkaluokka B:n mukaan, jolloin palkka sijoittuu välille 11,16€/h-15,64€/h. Palkan määräytymiseen vaikuttavat aikaisempi työkokemus ja koulutus. Lisäksi maksetaan TES:n mukaiset ilta- ja viikonloppulisät.

  • Kattavan perehdytyksen

” Minulla oli aivan ihanat perehdyttäjät ja ylipäätään koko työtiimi loistava, sain kaiken tarvittavan neuvon ja avun.” – Myyjä, kesätöissä 2025 Puuilossa

  • Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet

”Etenin myyjän tehtävistä apulaismyymäläpäällikön tehtävien kautta myymäläpäällikön tehtäviin” – Myymäläpäällikkö, töissä Puuilossa 6 vuotta

Mitä toivomme Sinulta?

  • Oma-aloitteista ja reipasta työotetta

  • Paineensietokykyä, sillä työ on ajoittain hektistä

  • Kohtuullista tai hyvää fyysistä kuntoa, sillä työ on hyvin fyysistä ja askeleita tulee työpäivän aikana runsaasti, jopa 15 000 askelta

  • Kiinnostusta Puuilon tuotteita kohtaan, saatat itsekin nikkaroida silloin tällöin

  • Nautit ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja kykenet toimimaan erilaisissa tilanteissa

  • Kaupan alan kokemus katsotaan eduksi, muttei ole pakollista.

  • Mahdollisuutta työskennellä aikavälillä 6-20 arkisin sekä viikonloppuisin

Tuemme tavoitetta savuttomasta Suomesta 2030, emmekä käytä työaikana mitään tupakkatuotteita.

Olisitko Sinä Nummelan Puuilon uusi työkaveri?

Lähetä hakemuksesi meille pikimmiten oheisesta linkistä. Myy itsesi meille

  • Vapaamuotoisella hakemuksella

  • CV:llä

  • Vapaaehtoisella videoesittelyllä

Hae viimeistään sunnuntaihin 1.11.2026 mennessä. Nummelan myymäläpäällikkö Elisa Vornanen puh 0406671490 kertoo tarvittaessa lisää meistä, avoimesta tehtävästä ja myymälästään arkisin klo 13-15.

Tuutko töihin? En...Tuun!

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
At roboticket, we provide ticketing technology to sports clubs and leagues around the world. We’re looking for a Technical Project Manager dedicated to our strategic clients across Europe, building close, long-term relationships and helping them turn business needs and technical requirements into successful projects.

You’ll be a key point of contact for these clubs, staying close to their teams, understanding their priorities and supporting their ongoing development. You’ll guide them through implementations, integrations and projects they lead themselves, working alongside our product and development teams. This requires a supportive approach and the confidence to challenge requests constructively, recommend practical solutions and agree on realistic expectations and clear responsibilities.

You’ll join a small, agile team with the freedom to organise your work, take initiative and make a visible impact. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working directly with clients, understands technology and wants to play an important role in our most strategic partnerships.

  • Experience in client-facing project management within SaaS, software or digital services.
  • Ability to work closely with clubs, understand their business needs and translate them into clear technical requirements.
  • Practical understanding of APIs, system integrations and data flows, with the confidence to communicate with developers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong relationship management skills, including setting clear expectations, agreeing responsibilities and challenging requests constructively.
  • Ability to balance client needs with project scope, development capacity and product priorities.
  • An independent, proactive approach: you set priorities, identify problems and propose solutions without waiting for detailed instructions.
  • Strong organisational skills and the flexibility to manage several projects in a small, agile team.
  • Fluent English and either French or Dutch are required. Polish is welcome but not mandatory.
  • Experience in sports, ticketing or club operations would be an advantage.

description:
About the role

Do you want to put your financial and analytical skills into practice in a diverse and global manufacturing company? We are currently looking for an Intern to support our Business Intelligence and Finance Excellence team! Being part of this international team, you will provide reporting and analytical support to our European sales, marketing organization and internal finance. This internship is scheduled to start on 15th of January 2027 for a duration of 6 months. The role requires a minimum commitment of 2 days per week on-site, with the flexibility to work from home 3 days per week.

Key Responsibilities

This is a hybrid role based at our European Headquarters in Oegstgeest.

  • Support the Business Intelligence team by generating all regular reporting required by our internal and external stakeholders
  • Partner with customers/stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into new dashboards/reports that generate valuable insights efficiently.

Required:

  • Advanced Excel (Pivot, VLookups, Conditional Operations) and Google Sheets skills

Skills you need to succeed:

With more than 1,200 employees across 13 offices worldwide. At Nayax, you’ll be part of a diverse and innovative community where your work makes a real impact and helps shape the future of payments.

Operating across 120+ countries with 1,200+ employees in 13 global offices, Nayax combines innovative technology with real‑world impact. At Nayax, we build long‑term value through smart automation, loyalty solutions, and an agile ecosystem designed to scale with our customers - and our people.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Job Description

Reinventing Geospatial (RGi) is a leading expert in geospatial solutions for Defense, Intelligence, and Federal clients. We enhance situational awareness for soldiers and analysts by integrating software development with geospatial intelligence. Our projects range from data collection to advanced deep learning, leveraging tools like Python, Java, and ArcGIS.

We don't just fill roles we build teams of high performers and leaders who make an immediate impact. At our core, we're driven by innovation and powered by people who work at the intersection of passion and performance. Here, you'll collaborate with bold thinkers, leverage cutting edge technology, and tackle meaningful challenges from day one.

Our culture is defined and anchored by three pillars:

Energy: We bring passion, purpose, and urgency to our work.

Edge: We take initiative, embrace growth, and step outside our comfort zone.

Execution: We get things done smartly, decisively, and with real results.

If you're the kind of person who leads with initiative, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is eager to create real impact, we want you on our team.

Clearance:

Active Top Secret clearance with an ability to obtain SCI access and willingness to obtain CI Polygraph

US Citizenship Required

*This job posting is for a potential upcoming opening, and we encourage interested candidates to apply for future consideration.

As a Software Engineer, you will...
  • Lead full-stack software development of enterprise applications and services supporting our customer’s GEOINT mission.
  • Design and implement secure, scalable microservices in cloud environments such as AWS GovCloud or C2S.
  • Guide and mentor junior and mid-level engineers, enforce code quality, and lead peer reviews.
  • Build and deploy applications using DevSecOps pipelines, container orchestration, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including analysts, UI/UX designers, DevOps engineers, and product owners.
  • Translate mission requirements into technical implementations that meet security, performance, and scalability needs.
  • Ensure compliance with our customer and IC cybersecurity and accreditation standards (e.g., RMF, STIGs).
Software Engineer Qualifications...
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field and 6+ years experience.
  • Strong proficiency with: HTML, CSS, JSON, Ajax, and REST APIs
  • Object-oriented Programming: Python, Java, or JavaScript and Go
  • Front-end and Back-end Frameworks: React, Angular, Vue.js, jQuery, Spring Boot, Django, Node.js, Flask, or Svelte.
  • A strong working knowledge of: AWS, Azure, or similar cloud platforms, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server
  • Hands on experience with: Windows, Linux, Git
  • Deep understanding of modern software design patterns and coding standards.
  • Experience architecting, developing, and delivering complex software systems into production.
  • Hands on experience developing containerized applications with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience deploying to and developing in classified cloud environments (e.g., C2S, AWS GovCloud).
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps tools and practices (e.g., GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, SonarQube, Nexus, Terraform).
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies and secure software lifecycle principles.
  • Strong, self-motivated desire to learn new programming languages, tools, frameworks, and techniques.
Additional Skills We'd Like to See:
  • Frontend Web Development: UI/UX
  • NoSQL Database: OpenSearch/Elasticsearch.
  • Cloud Exposure: AWS, IBM, Google, Azure, and Oracle and S3, SQS, SNS, EC2, CloudFormation and RDS.
  • Knowledge of geospatial data formats, tools, and standards (e.g., OGC, GeoServer, PostGIS, ESRI).
  • Experience with IC enterprise environments and tools (e.g., Keycloak, Vault, CloudFormation)
  • Certifications such as AWS Certified Developer, CISSP, Security+, SAFe Agile or similar.

Who we are:

Reinventing Geospatial, Inc. (RGi) is a fast-paced small business that has the environment and culture of a start-up, with the stability and benefits of a well-established firm. We solve complex problems within geospatial software development and national defense to make an Immediate Impact for our nation’s soldiers and analysts.


We pride ourselves on giving employees an exceptional life experience, where creativity thrives, and challenges are simply part of the fun. We provide truly excellent benefits, including:


· 100% paid employee healthcare & dental insurance

· Paid parental leave

· 401k with matching

· Escalating vacation time

· Referral bonuses

· Tuition reimbursement

· Professional development training

· Free beverages and snacks

· Weekly catered lunches and breakfast on Fridays

Grow to be our next leader:

At RGi, fostering a strong and organic corporate culture is paramount and serves as a compass on the decisions we make and how we operate the company. We believe our culture of camaraderie, innovation, and collaboration reflects the caliber of our employees and their dedication to the mission of providing quality software to our customers. As such, we want our employees to feel empowered to seek growth and leadership opportunities within the company and position us to maintain our culture as we grow. RGi provides opportunities, resources, training, and mentorship to all our employees to let them take control of their careers and become a leader or a crucial member of our company. If this is what you are looking for in a company, then you are what we are looking for in an employee.


Reinventing Geospatial, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Production Utility - 3rd Shift
description:
SUMMARY

Responsible for all activities associated with safely operating production machines including setup, operation, cleanup, and recommending improvements to operations to meet customer demand.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work safely at all times, be aware of surroundings and understand and comply with Pratt Industries Safety rules, operating procedures, and help hold co-workers responsible for safety related items. Participate in Plant Safety Committee.
  • Follow at all times GMPs (Good Manufacturing Processes)
  • Learn and comply with Pratt Industries quality procedures and policies. Stop bad quality from leaving the facility to the Customer. Catch it on the front end of manufacturing the product. Strong attention to detail for poor quality; prevent bad quality being sent to customer.
  • Performs a variety of tasks in the assigned department. Possible to be in multiple areas of the plant during the week working on varied projects and customer orders.
  • Performs general duties and responsibilities as required.
  • Housekeeping and cleaning of work areas – keep clean and free of tripping hazards during shift and end of shift cleaning of the area. In addition, good housekeeping of areas employee utilizes; break rooms, bathrooms, refrigerators etc.
  • Learn and understand from Machine Operators capability and capacity of machines and assist with driving efficiencies limiting waste and downtime. Do not sacrifice quality for machine speeds – must have both excellent quality and high efficiencies with minimal downtime.
  • Learn from Machine Operators and Production Supervisor the job duties on the machines, downtime, setup times and quality.
  • Cross-train on other machines and learns other positions in the plant.
  • Assist with completing necessary reports in an accurate and timely manner, including but not limited to: Production Data, Machine Operational Status, Safety Data, Quality Data.
  • Switch duties with co-workers as necessary. Learning environment to learn as many job duties to assist with plant growth and personal and professional growth opportunities.
  • Comply with all company policies and procedures, including safety and maintaining good housekeeping.
  • Adheres to production schedule.
  • Must be able to work overtime as necessary, sometimes on short notice. We serve our customers 24x7 – 365 days a year and sometimes work on holidays not avoidable.
  • Additional duties may be assigned by management.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED.

Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:

Prior work experience in the packaging industry; paper, plastics, converting

6 months’ experience in some type of manufacturing operation.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Able to read and follow instructions; quality, safety, job packets

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving one or more concrete variables in standardized situations.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may occasionally be required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.
