title: Loader Operator
description:
Pratt Perks:
Paid Holidays from DAY ONE
Insurance benefits and wellness reimbursement program within ONE MONTH of hire
3 Months: 401(k) with match
12 months: FULL tuition reimbursement and PAID childbearing/parenting leave

Position Summary:

Operates straight or articulated rubber-tired tractor-type vehicle equipped with front-mounted hydraulically powered bucket or scoop to lift and transport bulk materials to and from storage or processing areas, to feed conveyors, hoppers, or chutes, and to load trucks or railcars: Starts engine, shifts gears, presses pedals, and turns steering wheel to operate loader. Moves levers to lower and tilt bucket and drives front-end loader forward to force bucket into bulk material. Moves levers to raise and tilt bucket when filled, drives vehicle to work site, and moves levers to dump material. Performs routine maintenance on loader, such as lubricating, fueling, and cleaning.

Essential Functions/Position Responsibilities:

  • Operate equipment in accordance with O&M manual
  • Check material (incoming and outgoing) for quality and conformity
  • Take material to designated storage area safely
  • Load material onto lines and trailers safely
  • Keep material stacked neatly and safely
  • Must keep up with general housekeeping
  • Check oil and fluids daily
  • Perform inspections on equipment daily
  • Follow all company policies per Employee Handbook & Code of Conduct.
  • Follow all company safety guidelines.
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities: none

Hiring Requirements/Preferences:

  • High school education or equivalent (additional experience may be substituted for education)
  • Minimum of six (6) months experience operating machinery
  • Professional Attitude & conduct
  • Multi-task, interpersonal communication, problem solving, and time management skills are needed.
  • High degree of safety awareness and safety discipline
  • Display a professional and courteous attitude to co-workers, supervisors and the general public at all times.
  • Willing to travel and work away from home when and if required.
  • Be willing to work nights and weekends when necessary.
  • Strictly adhere to safety requirements and the policies and procedures as outlined in the Employee Handbook.
  • Have the willingness to work in a team environment and assist co–workers or supervisors with other duties as required.
  • Wear personal protective equipment (PPE) in designated operations and production areas as stated by PRATT Safety and OSHA.
  • Be at least age 18 years of age due to nature of working environment.
  • You will be expected to be flexible to the needs of our business, as we continually strive to meet and exceed the needs of our customers.
  • Please be aware that you must successfully complete a drug screen and background check in order to be hired into the Pratt Industries.

title: Corrugator Supervisor
description:
POSITION TITLE: CORRUGATOR SUPERVISOR

REPORTS TO: Plant Superintendent

SUMMARY

  • Supervise approximately ten people in the daily routine of producing quality board in a safe, productive manner with minimum waste. Cross-train employees in key positions.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain quality, efficiencies, and production levels set by management. Communicate these standards to your staff.
  • Report quality concerns to Plant Superintendent. Assist in determining quality guidelines.
  • Build engagement and maintain high morale within your department by showing fairness, consistency, and an interest in employee problems. Maintain confidentiality.
  • Manage inventories of rollstock and corrugator supplies.
  • Coordinate with your supervisor and Maintenance Superintendent on any repairs or preventive maintenance done in the department.
  • Keep upper management informed of problems or situations that may affect the performance of your department.
  • Enforce the corrective action procedures when applicable and conduct meetings with the violating employees.
  • Conduct weekly Production/Safety meetings with departmental personnel.
  • Communicate with necessary supervision to avoid problems between departments or shift changes.
  • Improve career skills by enrolling yourself in seminars, technical courses, and related college courses.
  • Implement, maintain, and support all company policies and procedures, including safety program, and good housekeeping.
  • Complies with all company policies and procedures
  • Additional duties may be assigned by management.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Directly supervises all employees assigned to the department. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; conflict resolution; team building; coaching and leading employees to improve; addressing complaints and resolving problems; documentation; and setting an example of superior behavior, attitude and performance.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED.

Two years prior supervisory experience.

Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following: Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Able to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:
  • Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation. This also supports the supervisor's role of teacher and trainer for his/her personnel.
  • Cost issues in order to make daily decisions that will reduce overall costs and will help the supervisor find areas that require improvement.
  • Quality standards.
  • Regulatory requirements including but not limited to wage and hour requirements, environmental and waste minimization, company policies, and personnel requirements including OSHA, DEQ and EEO.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES

  • The individual must possess the following:
  • Superior time management skills including the ability to manage multiple issues concurrently and the ability to lead an effective and efficient meeting.
  • Teaching skills in order to function effectively as a teacher for his personnel both in the technical and administrative parts of the position.
  • Excellent crisis manager who demonstrates that he/she has a high emotional control under adverse conditions and can lead his/her personnel to a successful resolution.
  • Excellent employee relations skills including being an active listener, understanding how to appraise personnel, applying both positive and corrective feedback, being able to resolve conflicts either involving the supervisor directly or as a third party, understands and demonstrates positive motivational skills including coaching and delegation techniques.
  • Demonstrated confidence including providing a consistent leadership style with an acceptable level of professional assertiveness.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

The performance of the supervisor will be measured as follows:

title: Software Engineer III - Test Framework
description:
Job Description

Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connected Vehicle Services) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.


We are proud to be launching a new state-of-the-art technology facility in Dublin, Ireland. The Dublin-based team will play a critical role in our continued digital transformation and will function as a center of excellence for SiriusXM’s global Product and Technology organization.


SiriusXM’s new Dublin facility will comprise a workforce primarily focused on software development, automotive technology and engineering, adtech, data science, and analytics. Talent based in the new technology hub will be charged with developing and implementing best-in-class standards for high-quality, scalable software deliveries for SiriusXM’s streaming and in-vehicle audio entertainment platforms.


How you’ll make an impact:

As a member of the software test team at SiriusXM, you will be joining a team of Software Development Engineers and Test Engineers responsible for developing the SiriusXM test automation framework, and testing of SiriusXM software and products related, but not limited to in-vehicle infotainment systems and aftermarket SiriusXM products.


The Software Engineer III role will be responsible for developing test scripts, triaging and fixing issues, and designing test procedures to ensure that software programs work as intended. This position will be a part of the software development team. The successful candidate will have the ability to work in a cooperative manner with software engineers, product, and program managers.


What you’ll do:

  • Work with software engineers, program managers, requirements managers, and other product stakeholders to understand product features and the complete set of requirements to the software.

  • Development of automated test cases to test the middleware

  • Work closely with development and test teams to ensure the effectiveness and quality of the components and systems developed.

  • Develop, maintain, and execute test scripts, ensuring the quality and stability of the system throughout the project

  • Generate testing completion metrics and analysis, as well as status read-outs to upper management

  • Develop, implement, maintain, and enhance test plans, test scripts, traceability matrices, and test methodologies that ensure exhaustive testing of all assigned software systems to ensure compliance with software/system specifications.

  • Anticipate potential software problems by creating test scenarios.


What you’ll need:

  • BS Engineering or SW Engineering, Computer Science, computer Engineering or equivalent experience required. MS Engineering is desired.

  • At least 3-5 years of experience inmodern C/C++

  • Troubleshooting - Good skills in identifying and resolving technicaland networking/communicationissues throughout the entire technology stack

  • Experience with automated testing methodologies and frameworks, preferably Google Test

  • Solid understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles

  • Skilled in utilizing CMake for efficient build configuration and dependencymanagement

  • Troubleshooting - Exceptional ability to isolate & troubleshoot technical issues across the full technology stack by leveraging automated testing methodologies

  • Strong communication skills, verbal and written

  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.

  • Commitment to \"internal client\" and customer service principles.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • History working with automation frameworks creating automated test scripts


What is a plus:

  • Understanding of dependency injection andSoftware Design Patterns

  • Experience with proxy servers and related technologies, Charles(It is an HTTP proxy / HTTP monitor / Reverse Proxy that lets a developer view all of the HTTP and SSL / HTTPS traffic between their machine and the Internet.) and virtualization port tools like VSPE, COM2COM

  • Experience in test automation Experience with unit testing frameworks (e.g., MSTest NUnit)

  • Experience with Code Coverage tools and procedures is a plus

  • Experience with Python scripts Ability to work seamlessly across both Linux and Windows development environments, and experience with cross-compilation and Android build tools

  • Experience with embedded systems or device-specific testing frameworks for the structured, device-oriented automated test framework

  • Experience with Git

title: Scale House Clerk
description:
Scale House Operator (Recycling Division)

Are you a master organizer with an eye for detail and a knack for keeping things moving? Pratt Paper, a leader in the sustainable recycling and packaging industry, is looking for a highly motivated and precise individual to join our team as a Scale House Operator.

In this crucial role, you'll be the nerve center of our Recycling division's inbound and outbound traffic, ensuring the seamless and compliant flow of materials. You are the first impression for our drivers and the gatekeeper of our inventory data. If you thrive in a dynamic, 24/7 environment and take pride in your accuracy, this is your chance to contribute to a greener future!

What You'll Do: Your Essential Role

You will be the core communicator and data entry specialist for all loads entering and exiting our facility. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

Traffic Management: Be the central coordinator for all truck traffic. You'll expertly manage the flow, ensuring both inbound and outbound loads move efficiently to prevent delays and maintain a smooth operation.

Data & Logistics Gatekeeper: Precisely key in all incoming load data for recycling materials. This includes issuing drop tickets for trailers, logging details on the receiving log, and maintaining excellent communication with drivers and management regarding release numbers, rejections, and necessary notifications (e.g., chemical loads).

Operational Oversight: Utilize our camera systems to monitor dock availability and proactively communicate with the yard to keep the flow of materials constant—as one truck pulls out, you ensure the next is ready to pull in.

Team Communication: Act as the radio contact point for the Reject Yard and maintain open, clear communication with managers on any operational issues or critical load details.

Scale House Stewardship: Maintain an organized and fully stocked scale house environment, ensuring you have the tools and resources needed to succeed.

Qualifications for Success

The Skills You Bring

Tech Savvy: Proficient with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word. Experience with 10-Key data entry is a definite plus.

Sharp Thinking: The ability to solve practical problems and interpret a variety of instructions (written, oral, or diagram) is essential.

Math Aptitude: Strong numerical reasoning, including the ability to calculate percentages, proportions, and volume.

Communication Power: Excellent verbal and written English language skills are a must for clear driver and team communication.

Education & Experience

A post-secondary degree (Associate's, Bachelor's, or Technical School certification) is preferred, but we value equivalent experience and a proven track record of success in logistics, data entry, or a similar high-volume coordination role.

Work Environment & Perks

This position offers a base salary of $35,580. With built-in overtime, the annual earnings reach $48,293, complemented by a monthly incentive

Physical Demands & Environment

This is a fast-paced, high-energy environment. You must be able to work Monday through Friday, 2:00pm to 10:00pm and occasionally support a 4-shift rotational schedule covering our 24/7 operation, which includes 12-hour shifts. You will frequently be required to walk, talk, and use your hands for keying/handling. The work environment can be loud and involves exposure to wet/humid conditions and airborne particles characteristic of a major recycling facility.

Unmatched Benefits Package

We invest in our people. Join the Pratt team and receive a comprehensive package that includes:

Financial Growth: A competitive 401K Plan with Company Match and a generous Recycling Incentive Program that offers a maximum of 15% of your Base Salary paid out monthly!

Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans, a Healthy Lifestyles Program, and a Gym Reimbursement Program.

Work/Life Balance: Paid Holidays and Paid Vacation time, plus our Child Bearing/Parental Leave program.

Professional Development: Take advantage of our Tuition Reimbursement/Assistance Program to further your career.

Employee Support: Provided Safety Shoes and Prescription Safety Glasses, along with access to our EAP and various discount plans (Wireless/Auto/Insurance).

Ready to be the engine that drives our Recycling Division? Apply today!

title: Associate Controls Technician
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Controls Technician based in the United States.

This is an excellent entry-level opportunity for aspiring controls technicians to build hands-on technical skills and launch a career in industrial automation and building controls. In this field-based role, you will work alongside experienced technicians on active projects, gaining practical exposure to Direct Digital Controls (DDC), Building Automation Systems (BAS), and Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC). Through structured classroom instruction and on-the-job training, you will develop the foundational knowledge needed to support system installation, verification, commissioning, and troubleshooting. You will learn to interpret technical drawings, identify controls components, follow safety procedures, and contribute to quality project delivery. This position offers a clear pathway toward becoming a Control Technician, with opportunities to pursue further specialization as your skills develop. Regular travel, hands-on learning, and exposure to complex technical environments will provide valuable experience in the growing data center and automation industries.

Accountabilities:

  • Complete the structured Control Technician training program, including classroom instruction and supervised on-the-job training.
  • Support senior and lead DDC and PLC technicians on active project sites, assisting with installation verification, system configuration, commissioning, troubleshooting, and coordination activities.
  • Learn to interpret project drawings, technical documentation, and system specifications while developing the ability to plan daily tasks, coordinate with other trades, and prioritize work in active construction environments.
  • Identify and become familiar with controls components and systems, including controllers, sensors, field devices, electrical panels, wiring, and network connections.
  • Assist with point-to-point verification of installed systems, documenting observations and escalating questions, discrepancies, or technical issues to supervising technicians.
  • Develop a foundational understanding of low-voltage controls, input/output (I/O) systems, networking principles, DDC and PLC controllers, commissioning processes, and quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) documentation.
  • Maintain a detailed field notebook recording tools, equipment, systems, jobsite workflows, questions, and learning objectives to support ongoing development and regular reflection.
  • Follow all jobsite safety protocols, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, lockout/tagout (LOTO) instructions, and professional conduct standards.
  • Apply classroom learning to real-world technical situations while progressively taking responsibility for basic field tasks as training milestones are completed.
  • Work collaboratively with technicians, project managers, and other jobsite personnel to support safe, efficient, and high-quality project execution.

Requirements:

  • No prior controls experience is required; candidates should demonstrate a strong willingness to learn and develop a career in controls technology, automation, or related technical fields.
  • Previous exposure to construction, electrical systems, HVAC, networking, industrial automation, or technical training is preferred.
  • Ability and enthusiasm to learn foundational concepts in electricity, wiring, input/output systems, controllers, networking fundamentals, technical drawings, and commissioning procedures.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

POLITICO is seeking an experienced Software Engineer to join our Technology team in Brussels.

The way information is produced, discovered, and consumed is changing rapidly. At POLITICO, we build products that help our users understand complex political environments and make better-informed decisions. Today, that means rethinking how AI can improve access to our content and data, how our products can become smarter and more personalized, and how we build a consistent experience for our audience across our transatlantic organization.

We are looking first and foremost for a Software Engineer who can design systems, rather than a specialist in a particular language or framework. We fully embrace AI-generated code as part of modern software engineering. What matters is the ability to understand a problem, design the right system, give AI tools the right context and constraints, critically evaluate their output, and take ownership of the result.

We also believe great engineering happens through close collaboration. Being together makes it easier to exchange ideas, challenge assumptions, make decisions quickly, and solve complex problems as a team. That is why this is a Brussels-based role with a hybrid setup of four days in the office and up to one day remote.

What You’ll Do

You will join one of our transatlantic engineering teams, each with different areas of ownership across POLITICO. The team hiring for this role is currently focused on two main areas. As our products and priorities evolve, we expect engineers to evolve with them and take on new challenges.

Reinvent How Our Users Access POLITICO Intelligence

AI is changing how people discover, consume, and interact with information. You will help us explore and build new ways for our users to access POLITICO’s journalism, data, and intelligence.

You will work on systems that combine our content and data with modern AI capabilities, with a strong focus on building experiences that are useful, reliable, and worthy of our users’ trust.

This involves more than integrating models into products. You will think about how these systems are designed, how they interact with our data and services, and how we evaluate their quality and reliability.

Trust is fundamental to journalism, and the systems we build must reflect that same standard.

Build a unified audience across POLITICO

POLITICO operates across products and markets in Europe and the United States. You will help us build a more consistent understanding of our users and how they interact with POLITICO across this ecosystem.

This includes working on systems around identity, authentication, access, user preferences, and personalization, and helping simplify and consolidate how these capabilities work across our products.

The goal is to build reliable foundations that let our products recognize and serve users consistently while maintaining strong security and privacy standards.

What You’ll Need

We are looking for strong Software Engineers, not specialists in a single technology. You should be comfortable designing complex systems, moving across different parts of the stack, and choosing the right tools for the problem.

We Are Looking For

  • Strong software engineering and system design skills
  • Experience building backend services, APIs, or distributed systems
  • A solid understanding of asynchronous and event-driven architectures
  • The ability to reason about security, identity, data, and integrations
  • The ability to contribute to frontend applications when needed
  • Experience using AI tools as part of the software development process
  • The ability to evaluate generated code and systems through testing, observability, and other quality mechanisms

Additional Assets Include

  • Experience with AWS, serverless architectures, Terraform, or Kubernetes
  • Experience with JavaScript (frontend and backend), Java, or Ruby on Rails
  • Experience with identity systems and SSO/OAuth/OIDC/SAML
  • Experience with LLM-powered applications, RAG, agents, search, or speech processing
  • Experience building evaluation or observability systems for AI-powered applications

We do not expect you to know everything on this list. What matters most is your ability to understand complex problems, design good systems, and learn and adapt as the technology evolves.

Other Requirements

  • Fluency in English; additional European languages are a plus
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Comfortable working in an international environment
  • Willingness to challenge existing approaches and actively contribute to technical decisions

We value our people

Our Benefits Package Is Built For You, And Includes

  • Our teams benefit from country-specific, competitive compensation and benefits packages—including pension, healthcare, training opportunities and more.
  • With a multinational team, strong ties to EU institutions, and flexible work options including working from abroad, we offer our employees an environment that supports both professional and personal development.

About Us

POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital.

Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes.

Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist.

Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself.

These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization.

POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles - first articulated as The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II - remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today. Learn more about Axel Springer.

title: [LTA-ITCD] LEAD / PRINCIPAL / SENIOR FULL STACK DEVELOPER
description:
(What the role is) LEAD / PRINCIPAL / SENIOR FULL STACK DEVELOPER

What you will be working on

We are seeking a capable Full Stack Developer to join our development team and build secure, scalable and resilient cloud-based digital solutions. The role covers traditional software development, low-code/no-code delivery, cloud services setup for leveraging cloud native solutions, system integration and application Security Operations. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of digital solutions that provide a central platform for engineering project information sharing and collaboration, enabling seamless coordination among LTA, contractors, and government agencies across rail and road infrastructure projects.

Software Development & AI Implementation

Develop, enhance and maintain scalable, resilient and secure low-code/no-code platforms using modern programming languages and frameworks. Design and implement responsive web, workflow and mobile solutions with intuitive user interfaces that address business and user needs. Implement AI features by integrating machine learning models, APIs, and cloud AI services into production applications built on both traditional and low-code/no-code platforms. Write clean, maintainable and well-documented code in accordance with established coding standards and software engineering practices. Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions and architecture reviews, and contribute to continuous improvement of engineering practices. Develop automated tests and maintain technical documentation, configuration records and architecture decision records.

Low-Code/No-Code Development

Work with business analysts and stakeholders to translate business requirements into fit-for-purpose solutions using low-code/no-code platforms. Configure and develop workflows, forms, dashboards and business applications while ensuring maintainability, scalability, security and appropriate governance. Integrate low-code/no-code applications with external systems, databases, cloud services and APIs. Assess when to use low-code/no-code, custom development or a hybrid approach based on functional, security, performance and supportability needs. Troubleshoot application and platform issues and apply platform-agnostic development and governance best practices.

Cloud Services Setup and Deployment

Build applications leveraging cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, utilising their core & cloud-native services and AI capabilities. Develop and deploy microservices, containerised applications and serverless functions as part of enterprise system architectures. Implement cloud services’ configuration and deployment practices that promote consistency, security and repeatability across development, test and production environments. Collaborate with DevSecOps and infrastructure teams to implement CI/CD pipelines, release applications and monitor application deployment governance process.

Security Operations and Application Assurance

Support day-to-day security operations for applications and cloud environments, including security monitoring, vulnerability remediation and operational risk follow-up. Coordinate Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VA/PT), review findings, track remediation actions and support closure validation. Plan and coordinate operating system, middleware, database, platform and application patch management, including impact assessment, testing, deployment and status tracking. Support cybersecurity incident management, including detection, triage, containment, investigation, recovery, evidence collection, root-cause analysis and post-incident improvement actions. Implement secure coding, access control, secrets management, and audit logging, while conducting monthly application log reviews, user account reviews, and privileged account activity reviews to ensure compliance and security governance.

System Integration and APIs

Design, implement, test and maintain APIs for secure and reliable system-to-system integration. Develop integration solutions using REST and/or SOAP web services, event-driven patterns and suitable authentication and authorisation mechanisms. Prepare and maintain API specifications, interface documentation, error-handling standards and integration test cases. Work with internal teams, government agencies and vendors to troubleshoot interface issues and ensure data integrity across integrated systems.

Agile Team Participation and Continuous Improvement

Experience working in agile development environments using Scrum or Kanban methods. Participate actively in agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews and retrospectives. Collaborate with product owners, project teams and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver agreed features and outcomes. Contribute to estimation, task breakdown, sprint goals, proof-of-concept work and technical investigations. Stay current with developments in cloud engineering, cybersecurity, AI-enabled solutions, low-code/no-code platforms and software engineering practices.

What we are looking for

  • Knowledge in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in software development, cloud-based application delivery or application operations.
  • Good understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, algorithms and object-oriented programming principles.
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C# or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, web technologies, version control, automated testing and CI/CD practices.
  • Preferably possess knowledge of the Building Information Modelling (BIM) lifecycle and a good understanding of Common Data Environment (CDE) concepts and practices.
  • Low-Code/No-Code and Cloud Knowledge of low-code/no-code concepts and experience developing or supporting solutions on one or more low-code/no-code platforms.
  • Hands-on experience setting up or configuring application environments on AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Understanding of cloud architecture, identity and access management, networking, compute, storage, logging, monitoring, containerisation and serverless services.
  • Relevant cloud or low-code/no-code certification is advantageous.
  • Security Operations Knowledge or practical experience in application Security Operations, including VA/PT coordination, vulnerability remediation and patch management.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity incident management processes, secure coding practices and application security controls.
  • Ability to work with security, infrastructure, operations and vendor teams to track and close security risks and operational issues.
  • API and Integration Experience Experience in API design and implementation for system-to-system integration is preferred. Familiarity with REST/SOAP APIs, API authentication and authorisation, interface specifications, integration testing and error handling is advantageous.

Personal Qualities

Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with a systematic approach to problem solving. Attention to detail and ability to communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders. Ability to work independently and collaboratively, manage competing priorities and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team. Self-motivated, curious and willing to learn. Receptive to feedback and guidance from senior team members. Collaborative, dependable and committed to delivering quality work within agreed timelines. Detail-oriented, with a strong focus on secure, clean and maintainable solutions. Reliable and committed to delivering quality work within established timelines.

Give and Get

  • Paid holidays from day one and 401(k) with match at 3 months
  • Tuition reimbursement at one year
  • Excellent benefits package including medical, dental, short-term disability and HSA
  • Paid Childbearing/parental leave at one year
  • Healthy Lifestyle program with up to $1,200 awarded each year to your HSA
  • Employee Assistance Programs to help you manage your life at work and at home
  • Safety and PPE Reimbursements
  • Cell phone discount with 2 major providers

  • Operational Efficiency: Set up slotting, feed, and die-cut sections on machines accurately, assist machine operators with equipment operation, work at the pace set by the machine operator, monitor machine performance and report malfunctions, and turn in maintenance work orders for necessary repairs
  • Training & Development: Participate in periodic training sessions to enhance skills, cross-train on different machines and processes, and show initiative in learning new tasks and procedures
  • Reporting & Maintenance: Document production data accurately and in a timely manner, communicate with supervisors regarding production progress and challenges, and proactively maintain and report equipment issues

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Experience: High school diploma or GED required, prior experience in the corrugating industry preferred, 6 months of experience as a Flexo or a DieCut Helper preferred, and 6 months of experience in Press and Finishing Departments preferred

  • Material Handling: Load and unload materials safely and efficiently, and operate forklifts and other equipment as needed (training provided)
  • Quality Control: Conduct visual inspections and measurements using basic tools, and maintain accuracy and consistency in production processes
  • Production Monitoring: Observe and track machine performance for optimal efficiency.
  • Basic Troubleshooting: Identify minor equipment issues and communicate with maintenance personnel
  • Skills:
    • Ability to follow directions with minimal supervision
    • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
    • Basic computer skills for data entry and reporting

Ability to lift regularly, and vision requirements include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
  • Certifications: May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License and compliance with physical, drug screening, and background check requirements
  • Work Environment: Regular exposure to moving mechanical parts, frequent exposure to wet and humid conditions, occasionally exposed to high places, airborne particles, and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

title: Onboarding Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Onboarding Engineer based in Luxembourg.

We are seeking an Onboarding Engineer to lead the technical implementation and coordination of customer onboarding in a fast-growing SaaS environment. This role combines hands-on engineering expertise with project management to ensure seamless integrations and successful customer launches. You will work closely with onboarding, customer success, and engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and deliver a consistent customer experience. Your work will directly influence customer retention, product adoption, and long-term growth. You will also help build scalable processes, documentation, and metrics to improve onboarding efficiency. This is an opportunity to shape technical onboarding practices while contributing to an innovative, AI-driven approach to partnership management.

Accountabilities:

As an Onboarding Engineer, you will own the technical execution of customer implementations, ensuring that each onboarding progresses smoothly from initial kickoff to go-live and handoff. You will collaborate across teams to resolve issues, improve processes, and establish scalable technical standards.

  • Lead the technical setup of customer onboarding, including API integrations, data mapping, CRM configuration, authentication, and security setup.

  • Partner with the Onboarding Manager to coordinate the full onboarding lifecycle, from kickoff through go-live and handoff to Customer Success.

  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues, including integration failures, data synchronization problems, and configuration challenges.

  • Develop and maintain onboarding runbooks, integration guides, technical documentation, and repeatable implementation processes.

  • Collaborate with Engineering to escalate product issues, document bugs with clear reproduction steps, and advocate for product improvements that support successful onboarding.

  • Coordinate with Customer Success to ensure smooth transitions from onboarding to ongoing customer support.

  • Define, monitor, and improve onboarding success metrics, including time to first value, technical blockers, and integration completion rates.

  • Identify onboarding risks proactively, communicate potential delays, and recommend solutions to keep projects on track.

  • Support the Onboarding Manager in customer communications concerning technical requirements, implementation progress, and timelines.

  • Contribute to the growth of the onboarding function by helping establish scalable practices and mentoring future onboarding engineers.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with customer-facing implementation experience, excellent organizational abilities, and a collaborative approach. You should be comfortable managing multiple onboarding projects while communicating complex technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders.

    • 3–4 years of technical experience in B2B SaaS implementation, customer onboarding, or customer success engineering.

    • Hands-on experience with APIs, data integrations, technical configuration, and troubleshooting.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical customers and present implementation plans to leadership.

    • Experience managing customer implementations or onboarding projects throughout the full lifecycle, from kickoff to go-live.

    • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple customer onboardings and maintain close attention to detail.

    • Familiarity with CRM integrations, particularly Salesforce or HubSpot, or comparable enterprise tools, is an advantage.

    • A consultative mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs, ask thoughtful questions, and proactively recommend solutions.

    • A strong commitment to quality, including identifying potential issues early and implementing measures to prevent recurring problems.

    • Ability to collaborate effectively and build strong relationships across Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering.

    • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience demonstrating technical expertise.

      • Nice to Have:

      • Experience with Bubble.io, n8n, or other low-code/no-code platforms.

      • Familiarity with partnership management or ecosystem tools.

      • Experience creating technical documentation, implementation guides, or knowledge bases.

      • Knowledge of AWS Lambda or similar serverless architectures.

        • Benefits:

        • Competitive salary and benefits package.

        • Stock options offering an opportunity to participate in the company's growth.

        • The opportunity to directly influence customer onboarding quality, retention, and expansion.

        • A hybrid technical and operational role with potential for progression into leadership.

        • Close collaboration with experienced onboarding and Customer Success professionals.

        • The opportunity to contribute to a high-growth, profitable SaaS business operating at the forefront of AI-driven innovation.

title: Ciudad de México | Glosa Supervisor (Customs Brokerage)
description:
SUMMARY DESCRIPTION:

The Customs Brokerage – Glosa Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the accurate and timely preparation, review, validation and payment of customs entries, while ensuring compliance with applicable customs regulations, internal procedures and customer requirements.

This position leads the Glosa and Pedimentos team, allocates workloads, monitors operational performance, reviews customs documentation and provides technical guidance on classification, valuation, origin and customs entry requirements. The Supervisor supports the Customs Brokerage Manager in the effective management of operations, people, systems, financial controls, compliance and customer service.

The role is also responsible for identifying operational risks and errors before customs entry payment, driving process improvements and developing team members to ensure consistent service quality and business continuity

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

EXPEDITORS CORE COMPETENCIES

Exceptional Customer Service

Exceeds customer expectations by anticipating, understanding and meeting needs. Is proactive and when issues arise, is timely and resolute in solving problems, including escalating to management when necessary. Builds rapport and exhibits empathy during interactions, and consistently strives to improve customer satisfaction with customers.

This skill expectation applies both externally (customers, service providers) and internally (other Expeditors offices/employees).

Job Execution

Consistently completes quality work that matches job expectations. Is committed to operational excellence and continuous improvement for own job function and across the network. All activities are compliant with company policies/procedures and code of business conduct and with government regulations.

Reliability

Consistently meets deadlines. Is punctual and can be relied on for planning purposes. Is organized, manages own time effectively and can prioritize.

Collaboration

Displays a willingness to accomplish not only his/her own job responsibilities without the need for constant prodding but is willing, without request, to aid and assist others to the benefit of the company and/or customers. Works in harmony with superiors and fellow workers without incident or delay.

Communication

Effectively listens to others and communicates (verbal and written) in a professional manner, both internally and externally. Provides relevant and timely information to co-workers, customers and service providers. Answers phone calls and respond to voicemails, emails and other communication according to Expeditors' standards.

Culture

Exhibits and promotes the company’s 10 cultural attributes: Appearance, Attitude, Confidence, Curiosity, Excellence, Integrity, Pride, Resolute, Sense of Humor, and Visionary.

Personal Growth and Development

Participates in training within the company’s guidelines, completing at least 52 hours of relevant training per year. Completes required training in a timely manner with minimal reminders. Pursues professional development goals for self, including participating in a development plan as appropriate.

SUPERVISOR CORE COMPETENCIES

Glosa and Pedimento Operations

Supervise the creation, review, validation and payment of customs entries in the applicable customs system.

Ensure that customs entries are prepared accurately and within the required timeframes.

Review customs entries and support commercial documentation before payment.

Verify tariff classification, customs valuation, country of origin, Incoterms and applicable regulations.

Identify and coordinate the correction of errors or discrepancies before customs entry payment.

Supervise the preparation and validation of the required calculation worksheets in the customs system.

Verify that import and export documentation is complete, accurate and compliant with customs requirements.

Monitor customs files and ensure proper tracking and tracing throughout the clearance process.

Ensure all required documentation is available for operational, compliance and archiving purposes.

Provide technical guidance to the Glosa and Pedimentos team regarding complex customs entries or documentation issues.

Escalate significant operational, regulatory or customer-related issues to the Customs Brokerage Manager.

Ensure the smooth and timely flow of the customs clearance process.

Operational Excellence

Monitor the department’s operational flow and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy and customer service.

Ensure customer standard operating procedures and Desk Level Standard Operating Procedures are followed.

Monitor operational reports and performance indicators to identify delays, errors, exceptions and areas requiring corrective action.

Conduct periodic audits of customs entries and files to verify accuracy, completeness and regulatory compliance.

Monitor team capacity and productivity and allocate workloads according to operational priorities.

Ensure adequate coverage during peak activity periods, vacations and employee absences.

Support the implementation of corrective and preventive actions resulting from operational audits or identified errors.

Promote continuous improvement and standardization of Glosa and Pedimentos processes.

Participate in the implementation of new operational systems, process changes and system enhancements.

Promote the appropriate use of productivity tools, customs databases, document-management tools and reporting systems.

Compliance

title: Thesis: Governance-Aware AI Orchestration in Public Sector Workflows
description:
High Level Description
This thesis project investigates multi-agent AI orchestration architectures tailored for public administration. The study focuses on integrating specialized Large Language Model (LLM) agents with deterministic compliance controls, auditable decision trails, and cross-institutional adaptability to automate complex administrative workflows without compromising legal sufficiency or transparency.


Project Description
Modern administrative processes rely heavily on unstructured data, complex regulatory frameworks, and multi-step reviews. While single-agent LLM systems struggle with hallucinations, legal precision, and long-context compliance, modular multi-agent orchestration offers structured decomposition of administrative tasks.

This project involves prototyping and evaluating a multi-agent framework where specialized LLM agents (e.g., retrieval agents, policy critics, document extractors) collaborate under a central orchestrator. The system will process domain-specific public sector inputs (such as permit applications or policy documents) and enforce deterministic legal guardrails before presenting recommendations to human caseworkers.


Who are we looking for?

  • Bachelor or Master of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or related fields.

  • Graduation in June 2027

  • Fluency in Swedish, both written and spoken

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Purpose
In this thesis, the candidate will investigate the following core areas:

- Evaluation of Orchestration Frameworks and Tooling

  • Compare state-of-the-art multi-agent orchestration frameworks regarding task routing efficiency, latency, and system reliability within public sector constraints.

  • Comparative Performance: Multi-Agent vs. Monolithic LLM Implementations

  • Measure performance, hallucination rates, and legal/policy compliance when handling complex, rule-heavy administrative workflows using modular multi-agent pipelines versus monolithic prompting.

  • Governance, Auditability, and Human-in-the-Loop Integration

  • Design and evaluate audit logging and explainability mechanisms that trace agent decision paths, tool usage, and human caseworker edits.

title: Thesis: Name of the project
description:
High Level Description
As software development becomes increasingly agent-based, cloud AI agents can pick up a ticket and carry it through refinement, planning, implementation, testing, and review. However, to ensure quality and correct implementation developers still need to check that requirements are understood, quality holds, and design choices fit the project. This thesis aims to design and implement a reusable cloud-agent based development process with checkpoints where developers can inspect progress, correct decisions, and approve changes before the work continues.

Project Description
In this thesis, design and implement an automated agentic workflow using cloud-based agents. The workflow should orchestrate multiple agents to autonomously manage the end-to-end process of transforming a human-written feature request into a completed implementation. This process includes retrieving a ticket describing the requested feature, refining the requirements, planning the implementation, integrating the changes into an existing codebase, creating and executing tests, and reviewing the results.

To ensure that the agents correctly interpret the requirements and make appropriate decisions, the workflow should incorporate human-in-the-loop checkpoints at key stages. These checkpoints should allow a human operator to review, approve, or reject the agents’ decisions and proposed actions when necessary. The workflow should also provide clear and structured reporting that enables the operator to understand the changes made and the rationale behind them. This reporting should facilitate switching between multiple concurrent implementations while minimizing the cognitive overhead associated with context switching.

Since agentic workflows can enable developers to manage multiple projects more efficiently and establish new projects more easily, the proposed solution should be straightforward to integrate into both existing and new projects. The prototype will be evaluated through practical testing, focusing on usability, integration, reusability across projects, and the effectiveness of the human-in-the-loop checkpoints in supporting oversight and control.


Who are we looking for?

  • Bachelor/Master of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.

  • Graduation in June 2027

  • Fluency in Swedish, both written and spoken

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken

Purpose
In this thesis, investigate these questions:

  • Design and implement a reusable cloud-agent based process that can develop software from feature request to reviewed implementation.

  • Add human checkpoints and reporting so a developer can review, correct, and approve work across concurrent implementations.

  • Make the prototype easy to integrate into existing and new projects.

  • Evaluate usability, integration, reuse, and checkpoint effectiveness in practical use.

title: Junior Java Software Developer
description:
About Fasanara

Founded in 2011, Fasanara is a global asset manager and technology platform.

We manage c. USD 6 billion AUM (as of December 31, 2025) in Fintech strategies on behalf of pension funds and insurance companies in Europe and North America.

With c.110 employees globally, we are a pioneer investor in Fintech Lending, enabling Real Economy Impact.

Fasanara manages the largest and longest standing Fintech Lending fund in Europe and invests in early-stage Fintech companies via its venture capital vehicles, using its central role in the Fintech ecosystem to identify and back revolutionary new businesses.

Our Culture

We are strong believers in meritocracy, and we seek to reward people based on impact and excellence. There is no bureaucracy, typical of large organisations. The environment is collaborative, entrepreneurial, and trust based. We set ambitious goals, work extremely hard, stress the importance of teamwork, and adhere to the highest level of excellence in everything we do. We are only as good as our team. Thus, we are building the firm around exceptional talent.

The role

We are looking for a Junior Java Software Developer to join Fasanara Digital and contribute to systems supporting our 24/7 trading activity, with guidance from experienced engineers.

The role will focus on contributing to the development and maintenance of our multi-venue collateral management platform, alongside new reference data and accounting infrastructure supporting both digital assets and traditional financial markets.

This is a hands-on engineering role within a small, high-performing team, with opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues. You will work on well-defined tasks across both new development and existing production systems, helping to build new functionality and maintain and improve established code. We are looking for a self-starter who takes initiative, follows through on tasks, and asks for guidance when needed.

Experience in financial services, trading, banking, or digital assets is welcome but not required. We are interested in candidates with a solid foundation in Java development and a willingness to learn about our systems and markets.

Responsibilities

  • Help develop, maintain, and enhance our multi-venue collateral management system supporting 24/7 trading activity, with guidance from experienced engineers.
  • Contribute to improvements in distributed, real-time, and event-driven systems, learning how to support their reliability and availability.
  • Help build and maintain integrations with trading venues to source account, position, collateral, and other operational data.
  • Assist with implementing reference data frameworks and accounting pipelines supporting both traditional financial instruments and digital assets.
  • Develop primarily in Java and Kotlin, following established patterns and participating in code reviews and technical discussions.
  • Maintain, debug, and improve existing production code alongside developing new functionality, with support and code review from the team.
  • Take initiative on well-defined tasks, follow through on agreed work, and raise questions or blockers promptly.
  • Work closely with experienced engineers to understand business requirements and contribute to practical technical solutions.
  • Use modern AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality.

Technical Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Practical experience developing in Java or Kotlin in a professional environment.
  • Functional understanding of distributed systems concepts and an interest in developing practical experience.
  • Interest in learning about real-time, event-driven, and high-availability systems; prior exposure is helpful but not required.
  • Sound understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented programming, testing, and version control.
  • Experience debugging and improving existing code and developing new functionality, with guidance when needed.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • A self-starter who takes initiative, works independently on well-defined tasks, and seeks support when needed.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Desired Skills

  • Commercial Kotlin experience.
  • Previous experience within financial services, trading, banking, hedge funds, or fintech.
  • Experience within cryptocurrency or digital assets.
  • Knowledge of crypto exchanges, trading venues, protocols, or market infrastructure.
  • Experience developing collateral, position, accounting, market data, or reference data systems.
  • Experience with Python.
  • Experience with Apache, Kafka or other event streaming technologies.
  • Experience using AI-assisted software development tools.
  • Understanding of traditional financial instruments and financial market infrastructure.

Our benefits include:

  • Performance-related Bonus Scheme
  • Private Medical & Dental Insurance throughBupa(including children's cover)
  • Life Insurance, Income Protection & Critical Illness Cover
  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
  • Salary sacrifice pension withHargreaves Lansdown(currently matched up to 10%)
  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave
  • Emergency Parental Leave, Emergency Childcare & Nursery Benefit
  • Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Charity Giving through CAF
  • Annual Wellbeing Budget
  • Team socials, annual Summer & Christmas parties,and other events throughout the year

title: 3rd Shift Machine Assistant
description:
Machine Assistant

Reports to: Production Supervisor

Summary: Responsible for all activities associated with assisting the machine operator in running the assigned machine including setup, operation, cleanup, and recommending improvements to operations.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Accurate and efficient set-up of all folding and gluing operations of the machine in accordance with proper setup techniques.
  • Minimize waste of sheet stock and glue.
  • Properly operate machine to run efficiently and produce quality products.
  • Maximize the utilization of equipment by operating the machinery at available capacity and speed.
  • Learn to run a variety of box styles.
  • Check quality of boxes during the run, including - mis-slotted boxes, loose liner, misprints, and any other defects.
  • Complete necessary reports in an accurate and timely manner, including but not limited to: Production Data, Machine Operational Status, Safety Data, Quality Data.
  • Turn in maintenance work orders to supervision for needed repairs. Be proactive in the maintenance of equipment.
  • Adheres to production schedule. Makes recommendations for optimizing the schedule to meet cost, quality and service goals. Reports any unusual scheduling issues to Supervisor.
  • Comply with all company policies and procedures, including safety and maintaining good housekeeping.
  • Excellent attendance and organizational skills are a must
  • Additional duties may be assigned by management.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

  • High school diploma or GED.

Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:

  • Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.

LANGUAGE SKILLS:

  • Ability to read, comprehend and interpret operating instructions, training and procedure manuals.
  • Excellent communication skills; ability to speak effectively to employees, managers and internal/external customers
  • Excellent listening skills; ability to provide positive and corrective feedback

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:

  • Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy.
  • Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate.
  • Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY:

  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form.
  • Ability to deal with problems involving one or more concrete variables in standardized situations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS:

  • The individual must have a working knowledge of the following: Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation.
  • Product layouts and production specifications. Product quality specifications. Quality standards.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS: May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS” The performance of the employee will be measured as follows:

  • Operating standards - the employee will need to meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the employee.
  • Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the employee to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the employee and his/her superior.
  • Employee relations - through observations the employee will be evaluated regarding his/her behaviors associated with appropriate human interaction, respect and communication.
  • Creativity - this will be evaluated by how active the employee is in participating in advancing the business through new and innovative ideas.

title: Stacker Operator
description:
SUMMARY

As a Stacker Operator, you will support machine operators by helping prepare equipment, stack finished products, monitor quality, and keep the work area safe and organized. This is a hands-on role that offers opportunities to learn manufacturing processes and develop skills for advancement within the company.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Follow work instructions, production orders, and safety procedures.
  • Assist with machine setup and preparation before production runs.
  • Load materials and supplies needed for production, including cover sheets, tie sheets, and load tags.
  • Stack finished boxes and materials according to production requirements.
  • Verify that each unit is properly labeled and packaged.
  • Check product quality during production and report any issues to the machine operator.
  • Help operators and team members as needed to keep production running smoothly.
  • Maintain accurate counts of bundles, units, and finished products.
  • Report production counts and completed work to the operator.
  • Complete required paperwork accurately and on time.
  • Identify equipment issues and report maintenance needs to supervisors.
  • Keep equipment and work areas clean, organized, and safe.
  • Follow all company policies, procedures, and safety guidelines.
  • Support production schedules by helping meet quality, service, and productivity goals.
  • Be willing to learn new skills and advance into higher-level production positions.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Required

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Ability to work safely in a manufacturing environment.
  • Willingness to learn and follow instructions.

Preferred

  • Previous manufacturing or warehouse experience.
  • Experience in the corrugated packaging industry.
  • Previous experience working as a Bundler or Production Helper.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

  • Ability to read, understand, and follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with operators, supervisors, and team members.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

  • Ability to read a tape measure accurately.
  • Basic math skills, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and measurement calculations.
  • Ability to understand production counts and quantities.

PROBLEM-SOLVING SKILLS

  • Ability to follow instructions and make sound decisions in routine work situations.
  • Ability to recognize and report quality, safety, or equipment concerns.

TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE

Training will be provided; however, successful candidates should be willing to learn:

  • Basic machine operation and production processes.
  • Product specifications and quality requirements.
  • Manufacturing safety practices.
  • Equipment capabilities and proper operating procedures.

CERTIFICATIONS

  • Forklift certification may be required or provided based on business needs.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, employees must be able to:

  • Stand and walk for extended periods of time.
  • Frequently use hands and arms to handle materials and products.
  • Bend, stoop, reach, kneel, and lift throughout the shift.
  • Regularly lift and move materials weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Maintain visual focus for inspecting products and operating safely around equipment.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Work is performed in a manufacturing facility around operating machinery and equipment.
  • Employees may be exposed to noise, humidity, dust, vibration, and moving mechanical parts.
  • Appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn as required.
  • Safety is a top priority, and all employees are expected to follow established safety procedures at all times.

Career Growth Opportunity

This position offers an excellent opportunity for individuals starting a manufacturing career. Employees are encouraged to learn new skills, take on additional responsibilities, and pursue advancement opportunities within production operations.

title: Direct Response Video Editor
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Direct Response Video Editor based in Sweden.

Join a fast-paced creative environment where performance, experimentation, and creative volume drive results. As a Direct Response Video Editor, you will primarily produce compelling short-form video ads for paid social platforms while also creating effective static ad creatives to support rapid testing. You will transform user-generated content, testimonials, product demonstrations, and founder-led footage into conversion-focused advertising assets. Working closely with growth specialists and creative strategists, you will develop new hooks, messaging angles, and calls to action to help identify winning concepts. You will also leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate ideation, editing, and production without compromising effectiveness. This role is ideal for a versatile, performance-minded creative who thrives on speed, continuous iteration, and measurable impact.

Accountabilities

  • Direct response video editing: Produce short-form advertising videos for Meta, TikTok, and other paid social platforms, prioritizing engagement and conversion.

  • Creative production: Edit user-generated content, testimonials, product demonstrations, and founder-led videos into compelling, audience-focused ads.

  • Creative testing and iteration: Develop multiple variations of hooks, calls to action, messaging angles, and video concepts to support ongoing performance testing.

  • AI-assisted workflows: Use tools such as ChatGPT, Runway, Pika, and Descript to accelerate ideation, scripting, editing, and content production.

  • Scriptwriting and ad copy: Write or adapt scripts and advertising copy to communicate product benefits, strengthen messaging, and encourage action.

  • Static ad design: Create high-converting static creatives for paid social campaigns, adapting layouts, headlines, and offers to generate multiple testable variations.

  • Creative systems and templates: Use established templates, creative production systems, and inspiration libraries to produce consistent, on-brand assets efficiently.

  • Asset sourcing and organization: Gather, organize, and manage user-generated content, stock footage, B-roll, hooks, and other creative materials.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with strategists and growth teams to execute creative concepts aligned with campaign objectives and performance goals.

  • Performance-driven improvement: Incorporate feedback and available campaign insights to refine creatives, improve production efficiency, and maintain a consistent volume of deliverables.

  • Project ownership: Manage multiple creative assignments, prioritize tasks effectively, and deliver high-quality work within agreed deadlines.

    • Requirements

    • Professional experience: At least two years of experience editing direct response video advertisements for direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands.

    • Video editing portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating paid social video advertising, creative versatility, and performance-oriented storytelling.

    • Static advertising experience: Practical experience designing static ad creatives for Meta advertising campaigns.

    • Editing software: Proficiency with at least one professional or widely used editing tool, such as CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or Adobe After Effects.

    • Design skills: Working knowledge of Photoshop and the ability to create clear, visually effective static advertising assets.

    • Performance marketing knowledge: Strong understanding of hooks, calls to action, creative angles, and the principles behind conversion-focused advertising.

    • Copywriting ability: Experience writing, adapting, or refining scripts and copy for advertising creatives.

    • AI tool familiarity: Experience with or a strong working knowledge of AI-powered creative tools, such as ChatGPT, Runway, or Pika.

    • Time management: Ability to work quickly, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and consistently produce several creative assets per week.

    • Communication skills: Strong English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

    • Creative mindset: A performance-driven approach that prioritizes measurable results alongside visual quality.

    • Adaptability and initiative: Resourcefulness in working with raw assets, openness to feedback, and a willingness to experiment and improve continuously.

      • Nice to have:

      • Experience with motion graphics.

      • Familiarity with creative research and production platforms such as Creative OS, Foreplay, Butter, or AdCreative.ai.

      • Understanding of marketing funnels, offers, and paid social advertising strategy.

        • Benefits

        • Creative ownership: Contribute directly to the development and testing of advertising concepts designed to improve campaign performance.

        • AI-enabled workflows: Work with modern AI tools to accelerate creative production and explore more efficient ways of working.

title: Qualitative Insight Associate (German Markets)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a bright, committed, and passionate Insight Associate, with fluent written and spoken German and English language skills to join our team.

You will be an expert on German culture, be creative, self-aware, and able to draw on personal experiences to have authentic conversations and discussions with German consumers, colleagues and our clients.

Together with lead Consultants you will be responsible for handling and delivering client projects by conducting analysis, writing presentations and converting community conversations into clear client recommendations. This is not a ‘back-room’ role: we are looking for someone to support the lead Consultant in building and developing the client relationship from day one. This role is a perfect stepping-stone to develop consultancy skills in the world of branding, research and innovation.


Responsibilities

Research:

  • Moderating communities: engage community members – consumers of a specific client brand, steer discussions and probe consumer comments to drive relevant insight.
  • Designing research activities for communities which will generate the right responses to meet the client’s brief: ideation sessions, brainstorms, surveys, blogs and live online workshops.
  • Conducting qualitative analysis of the activities to understand the ‘what’ and the ‘why’ behind what consumers say and do.
  • Desk research.

Report writing:

  • Driving clear recommendations and implications from your analysis and findings to clients and colleagues.
  • Creating professional & convincing client-facing documents in a range of formats.

Client management:

  • Providing support to lead Consultants and Consultancy Director in nurturing good client relationships
  • Developing good personal presentation skills, for co-presenting to client


Skills required

  • Fluent written and spoken German and English language skills – an essential requirement.
  • A passion for brands, consumers and how they interact.
  • A natural knack for the online world & social media: highly empathetic & able to connect with individuals online, specifically on German markets.
  • You are constantly hungry to learn and grow and have plenty of energy and enthusiasm.
  • Intellectual curiosity.
  • Excellent writing and oral communication skills
  • Strong PowerPoint, Word and Excel skills required.
  • Good numerical skills.
  • You are a real doer and a proper team player.
  • Fantastic organisational skills: ability to multi-task.


About C Space

We are the world’s leading insight community, customer strategy and innovation experts, putting relationships at the heart of business to drive growth. We make relationships count by building mutual value between people and brands as the ultimate competitive advantage.

As part of Escalent Group, we’re a team of 1,600 researchers, data scientists, moderators, creatives, developers and UX professionals. We put the power of our customer expertise, Escalent’s industry expertise and Hall & Partner’s brand expertise at your fingertips.

Over the years we have helped clients like Google, PepsiCo, IKEA, British Airways, Philips grow by developing new products, services and communication together with their customers.

title: Yard Operator
location: Staten Island, New York, United States
description:
Position: Yard Operator

Salary - $27.43 per hour

Shift - 12 Hour Rotation, 645am-7 pm and 645pm - 7 am
