Double Backer Machine Operator / Corrugator Specialist
Are you a detail-oriented operator with a knack for precision and a drive to optimize production? We are looking for a dedicated Double-Backer Operator to be a central part of our high-speed corrugator team. In this hands-on role, you will not just run the machine—you'll be the expert ensuring superior quality, maximum efficiency, and smooth operations from setup to final product. If you are ready to take ownership of a critical phase in our manufacturing process, we want to hear from you!

What You'll Be Doing: The Core Responsibilities

As the Double-Backer Operator, you will be the master of the machine, responsible for the entire double-backer process, from material staging to final quality checks.

  • Expert Setup & Operation: Perform precision setup of bridge guides and the glue station, ensuring the machine is perfectly aligned for each run.
    Quality Control & Precision: Monitor and adjust machine settings for tension, alignment, adhesion, and warp control mid-run to maintain our high-quality standards.
  • Material Management: Handle paper roll stock, confirm correct sizing and grade, expertly execute necessary splices, and ensure efficient material usage.
  • Maximize Efficiency: Proactively operate the double-backer at maximum available capacity and speed, in sync with the overall corrugator flow to meet ambitious production goals.
  • Maintenance & Improvement: Perform routine cleaning (starch pans, glue rolls, etc.), identify and report necessary equipment repairs, and proactively recommend process improvements to boost performance.
  • Documentation & Teamwork: Accurately complete production, quality, and safety reports. You'll also work closely with the Corrugator Operator and help train new dry-end personnel.

Skills & Experience We're Looking For
Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Proven mathematical ability to quickly read a tape measure and calculate figures such as percentages, volume, and rate.
    Strong mechanical aptitude and the ability to apply common sense understanding to detailed written or oral instructions.
  • Working knowledge of manufacturing equipment design, product quality specifications, and production layouts.

Preferred Qualifications (A Bonus, But Not Required!)

  • Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.
  • At least 6 months of experience on the dry end of a corrugator.

The Work Environment & Benefits

Physical Demands (What to Expect)
This is a physically active, demanding, and rewarding role. You must be able to regularly stand, walk, use hands for handling/feeling, reach, stoop, kneel, and occasionally lift/move materials. The work environment involves exposure to moving mechanical parts and is typically loud. Safety and proper housekeeping are always our top priorities.

Growth & Performance
We believe in investing in our people. Your performance will be measured not just on meeting operating standards (quality, cost, safety), but also on:

Personal Growth: Setting and achieving professional development goals each year.
Creativity: Actively participating in advancing the business through innovative ideas and solutions.
Ready to become an essential part of our high-speed manufacturing team? Apply today!

SUMMARY

The Mechanical Technician position is part of a Maintenance Team that supports the paper machine. The position coordinates closely with the paper machine operations teams as customers of the reliability centered maintenance support services the maintenance team is responsible for delivering. The Mechanical Technician position reports to the Mechanical Maintenance Supervisor. This is a position in our high performance work system that works a rotating 24 hour, 7 day per week shift schedule. There are both day (Monday through Friday) assignments and shift assignments. It is expected that all of our Mechanical Technician positions will fill both day and shift roles over the course of time.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The principal responsibilities of the Mechanical Technician position is to ensure that the processes are maintained in a preventive fashion to ensure optimum reliability and up time. This position troubleshoots processes and has the ability to diagnose mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic problems associated with process equipment. The Mechanical Technician is responsible for repairing malfunctioning equipment such as pumps, transmissions and other components.

Mechanical Technician must be able to operate motorized equipment such as forklifts, scissor lifts, Genie lifts, hoists and cranes. The Mechanical Technician must possess basic to intermediate math skills. Must be able to read and understand blue prints, technical manuals and literature. Must be able to read orders and prepare reports legibly and properly.

title: Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist based in Romania.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist to manage provider enrollment, credentialing, and medical billing operations in a remote healthcare environment. In this role, you will coordinate with insurance payers, healthcare providers, and internal teams to ensure accurate documentation, timely claims processing, and reliable reimbursement. You will oversee credentialing applications and renewals while maintaining compliance with payer requirements and applicable healthcare regulations. Your expertise in insurance billing, coding, and claims resolution will help minimize denials and prevent delays in provider network participation. You will also monitor payment discrepancies, maintain comprehensive records, and identify opportunities to improve revenue cycle processes. This is an opportunity to contribute to efficient healthcare administration while supporting providers and delivering operational accuracy.

Accountabilities:

As a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist, you will oversee the full lifecycle of provider credentialing, insurance enrollment, and claims management. You will ensure that provider records remain accurate, billing activities meet payer requirements, and reimbursement issues are addressed promptly through effective coordination and follow-up.

  • Prepare and submit credentialing applications for new healthcare providers across commercial insurance carriers, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care organizations.

  • Manage provider re-credentialing within required timelines to prevent lapses in insurance network participation.

  • Maintain accurate provider information in credentialing databases, payer portals, and related systems.

  • Coordinate with providers to collect required documentation, professional licenses, certifications, and signatures.

  • Review, prepare, and submit medical insurance claims accurately using electronic health record (EHR) and billing systems.

  • Apply appropriate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes, including relevant modifiers, in accordance with applicable billing guidelines.

  • Verify patient demographics, insurance eligibility, and coverage details before submitting claims.

  • Apply payer-specific policies, fee schedules, and filing deadlines to support accurate and timely claims processing.

  • Monitor claim status through payer portals, manage claim edits and rejections, and coordinate necessary adjustments.

  • Post insurance payments, contractual adjustments, and write-offs accurately, identifying underpayments and payment discrepancies.

  • Reconcile daily, weekly, and monthly payment reports and maintain accurate billing records.

  • Investigate claim denials and rejections, prepare supporting documentation, and submit timely appeals.

  • Maintain detailed follow-up logs to track outstanding claims through resolution.

  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, CMS requirements, payer policies, and applicable federal and state regulations.

  • Collaborate with clinical, administrative, and revenue cycle teams to resolve billing and credentialing issues.

  • Serve as a liaison between healthcare providers and insurance payers, resolving enrollment discrepancies and network participation issues.

  • Monitor changes in payer requirements, credentialing policies, and coding guidelines to maintain compliance.

  • Maintain credentialing logs, spreadsheets, databases, and expiration-date trackers to ensure deadlines are met.

  • Audit credentialing files for completeness and accuracy and prepare management reports on application progress, pending items, and compliance status.

  • Identify recurring payer issues and recommend process improvements to strengthen operational efficiency and reimbursement outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines hands-on medical credentialing and billing experience with a strong understanding of insurance payer processes, coding standards, and healthcare compliance. You should be highly organized, comfortable managing multiple deadlines, and able to communicate effectively with providers, insurance representatives, and internal stakeholders.

    • High school diploma or equivalent required; an associate or bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, or a related field is preferred.

    • At least two years of experience in medical credentialing, medical billing, or both, preferably working with multiple insurance payers.

    • Strong working knowledge of commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care credentialing and reimbursement processes.

    • Familiarity with CAQH ProView, NPPES, PECOS, Availity, payer portals, and EHR or medical billing software.

    • Demonstrated experience preparing accurate claims, resolving denials, following up on outstanding payments, and maintaining compliance with payer requirements.

    • Understanding of CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding systems, including modifier requirements.

    • Knowledge of provider enrollment, re-credentialing procedures, insurance eligibility verification, claim submission deadlines, and payer-specific policies.

    • Medical billing or coding certification, such as Certified Professional Biller (CPB), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), or an equivalent qualification, is an advantage.

    • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate, complete, and well-organized records.

    • Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple applications, claims, and deadlines simultaneously.

    • Effective written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with healthcare providers, insurance representatives, patients, and colleagues.

    • Proficiency in credentialing, billing, and documentation systems, with the ability to learn new tools and workflows.

    • Understanding of HIPAA, CMS, NCQA, and other applicable healthcare compliance standards.

    • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining productivity, accuracy, and consistent follow-through.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote work arrangement.

      • Full-time employment.

      • Standard Monday-to-Friday business hours.

      • Opportunity to develop expertise across provider credentialing, medical billing, insurance claims, and revenue cycle operations.

      • Collaborative work with healthcare providers and administrative, clinical, and revenue cycle professionals.

      • Opportunity to contribute to improved reimbursement accuracy, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.

title: Module Facer - 2nd Shift
description:
POSITION TITLE: Module Facer Operator
REPORTS TO: Corrugator Supervisor/Superintendent


SUMMARY
The Module Facer Operator is responsible for all activities associated with running the single-facer and assisting in wet-end and dry-end operations, including setup, operation, cleanup, and recommending improvements to operations.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Operate the single-facers to produce the highest level of production and quality.
  • Check wet end line-ups to verify correct roll stock is received and used.
  • Put rolls of paper in mill roll stands ensuring proper size and grade of paper to be run and make splices
    and paper changes as necessary.
  • Trim only the necessary amount of paper from the rolls when preparing for splices.
  • Remove roll stock from the machine when necessary and mark the proper size, grade, diameter and lineal
    footage on the roll and place core plugs in each end of the butt rolls.
  • Continuously monitor the board during runs to ensure quality and make adjustments as necessary.
  • Turn in maintenance work orders to supervision for needed repairs.
  • Clean starch pan, glue roll and singlefacer area after changing flutes and at the end of the production
    week.
  • Take all paper off of cores of stub rolls.
  • Assist in the wet end training of the Doublebacker and dry end personnel.
  • Comply with all company policies and procedures, including safety and maintaining good housekeeping.
  • Additional duties may be assigned by management.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.

Candidates are preferred who offer the following experience:

  • 6 months experience on the dry end of the corrugator.
  • 6 months experience as a Doublebacker Operator.
  • Eligible to bid for this position under the present labor/management agreement or have current workrelated experience.


LANGUAGE SKILLS
Able to read and follow instructions on factory masters.


MATHEMATICAL SKILLS
Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as
percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.


REASONING ABILITY
Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or
graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving one or more concrete variables in standardized
situations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation.
  • Product layouts and production specifications
  • Product quality specifications
  • Quality standards


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS
May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear.
The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms;
and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must
regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific
vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision,
depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.


WORK ENVIRONMENT
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts.
The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally
exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work
environment is usually loud.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

  • Operating standards - the employee will need to meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of
    quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and
    communicated to the employee.
  • Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the employee to grow professionally
    the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed
    and agreed to by the employee and his/her superior.
  • Employee relations - through observations the employee will be evaluated regarding his/her behaviors
    associated with appropriate human interaction, respect and communication.
  • Creativity - this will be evaluated by how active the employee is in participating in advancing the business
    through new and innovative ideas.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React/TypeScript, AWS)
description:
Our client is supporting a government-related digital transformation project in Singapore, focused on maintaining, enhancing, and modernising large-scale digital platforms used across the public sector.

The project involves a portfolio of enterprise applications supporting a large user base, with a strong emphasis on system reliability, security, application modernisation, and long-term maintainability.

This opportunity offers an experienced engineer the chance to take technical ownership of critical digital services, contribute to architecture and migration decisions, and work closely with engineering teams and stakeholders.

About the Role

This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you will take ownership of multiple applications, including both modern and legacy systems.

You will be responsible for maintaining and enhancing existing platforms, leading application migration initiatives, improving engineering standards, and ensuring production stability.

Working closely with engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders, you will provide technical direction while remaining actively involved in software development, troubleshooting, and delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Development & Application Maintenance

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend APIs, services, and relational databases.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex application issues across multiple codebases and technology stacks.
  • Deliver bug fixes, security patches, performance improvements, and application enhancements.
  • Provide L2/L3 production support, monitoring, and incident resolution to ensure system reliability.
  • Lead application migration and legacy system modernisation initiatives.
  • Evaluate existing architectures and recommend improvements to scalability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.
  • Make technical design decisions and manage trade-offs between performance, reliability, security, and development efficiency.
  • Support application lifecycle management, including system transitions, migrations, and decommissioning.
  • Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, and handover materials.
  • Work with cloud-hosted applications and containerised environments using AWS and Docker.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support reliable software releases.
  • Monitor application health and troubleshoot production issues using tools such as AWS CloudWatch and OpenTelemetry.
  • Establish and maintain engineering best practices, including code reviews, automated testing, version control, and release management.
  • Ensure applications follow appropriate security and compliance standards.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers.
  • Lead code reviews and promote high-quality software engineering practices.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams, product stakeholders, and business users to align technical solutions with business requirements.
  • Identify technical risks, resolve engineering challenges, and contribute to technical planning and prioritisation.
  • Take ownership of the technical health, stability, and long-term maintainability of assigned applications.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Minimum 7 years of hands-on experience in Full Stack Software Engineering, including experience in a senior or technical lead capacity.
  • Solid experience in backend API development, service integration, and relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
  • Experience working across multiple applications, technology stacks, and legacy codebases.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, system design, and application modernisation.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with application monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support.
  • Strong knowledge of Git, code reviews, automated testing, and software engineering best practices.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Ability to independently drive technical decisions, troubleshoot complex issues, and provide technical guidance to other engineers.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS ECS, CloudWatch, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Experience leading legacy application migrations or system decommissioning initiatives.
  • Familiarity with government or public-sector technology projects.
  • Experience supporting enterprise applications with large user bases.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and regulatory compliance requirements.

What Makes This Opportunity Interesting?

  • Technical Ownership: Take responsibility for the architecture, stability, and technical direction of multiple enterprise applications.
  • Hands-on Leadership: Combine active software development with technical decision-making and engineering mentorship.
  • Modernisation Challenges: Work across modern and legacy technology stacks, leading migration and system improvement initiatives.
  • Meaningful Impact: Support large-scale digital platforms used within Singapore's public sector.
  • Collaborative Environment: Work closely with experienced engineers and stakeholders on critical technology systems.

Interested?

If you are an experienced Full Stack Engineer with strong React/TypeScript expertise and enjoy solving complex engineering challenges, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Transportation Finance & Claims Analyst (Customer Onsite)
description:

  • Leading payment analysis
  • Conducting forensic weekly SOA reconciliations to reduce aged balances
  • Resolving complex invoice exceptions within strict SLAs
  • Driving quarterly continuous improvement projects for strategic portfolios.

  • Synthesize high-volume transaction data into executive-ready insights, operational throughput models, and provide key analytics for Weekly Operations Reviews, Carrier QBRs, and Monthly Steering.

  • Conduct weekly deep-dive forensic reconciliations of carrier Statements of Account (SOA) against internal FAP
  • Aggressively burn down aged liabilities to maintain Customers health benchmark of >99% open inventory under 30 days old (85% within 0–7 days).

  • Minimum 3+ years of direct supervisory or team management experience overseeing high-throughput financial operations teams or TVC/BPO vendor pods.
  • Demonstrated background managing multi-million-dollar freight spend portfolios and driving high-volume transaction exceptions at global scale.

Proven ability to transform raw data into intuitive, executive-level visuals. Advanced expertise in Google Sheets (complex formulas, XLOOKUP, and dynamic pivot tables
  • Decisive operational leader with expertise in workflow load-balancing, capacity planning, process re-engineering, and root-cause defect elimination.Capable of mentoring a team of analysts while balancing daily operational queue adherence with strategic quarterly automation projects
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the executive presence to present complex financial and operational metrics to executive leadership, using SCQA framework. Independently lead contentious billing dispute sessions with carrier AR leadership.

title: CBHW I-FAST
description:
We are seeking an I-FAST Community Behavioral Health Worker!

Franklin County, OH

Join our Team!

Integrated Services for Behavioral Health (ISBH) is a community-minded, forward-thinking behavioral health organization helping people along the road to health and well-being. We meet people in their homes and communities and help connect them to resources. We serve Southeastern and Central Ohio with a comprehensive array of behavioral health and other services, working with local partners to promote healthy people and strong communities. Our services are intended to be collaborative and personalized for the individual.

I-FAST Community Behavioral Health Workers work in collaboration with all involved to address the needs of youth and families that are experiencing a wide range of DSM diagnoses, including complex cases of children at risdk for out-of-home placement. This role empowers families to address challenging and/or problematic behavior and to help children/youth aged 5-21 make life-transforming changes. Treatment progress is made through intensive interventions such as skill building, changing unhelpful family interactions, and increasing social support, to name a few. This role receives ongoing training in the Integrated Family and Systems Treatment (I-FAST) model as you work with families, children/youth, their communities, and other key members of their ecology to implement I-FAST as designed.

The pay range for this position is $19.00 to $22.26 per hour based on experience, education, and/or licensure.

Essential Functions:

  • Engage individuals and families in the home and community to identify strengths, barriers, and goals related to behavioral health and daily functioning.

  • Provide direct interventions using the I-FAST treatment model and principles. Some principles include leveraging strengths and focusing on the positive, understanding sequences of behavior, and increasing mature behavior

  • Conduct treatment planning and participate in regular collaboration with members of the treatment team including schools, courts, care management entity, etc.

  • Experience working with multisystems such as: Court Systems, Child Protective Services, Schools, OhioRise, Family and Children First Council is required

  • Experience working with complex family systems and youth who are experiencing severe emotional/mental health issues is preferred

  • Experience with multi-need individuals and families is preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Advanced communication skills, both oral and written is required

  • Advanced organizational skills are required

  • Ability to maintain confidential information is required

  • Willingness to participate in and lead cross-systems team-building activities

  • Ability to bill Medicaid without restrictions is required

  • A valid driver's license and the ability to operate a motor vehicle is required

  • An appropriate level of auto insurance coverage is required

  • Must be able to use a personal vehicle or company vehicle to provide services in homes, schools, and community settings.

  • Ability to manage deadlines within a fast-paced, high-volume environment is required

  • Ability to operate in an Internet-based, automated office environment is required

  • Ability to maintain high-speed internet connection is required

Physical Requirements:

title: Data Engineer (Consultant)
description:
The Data Engineer works closely with statisticians, analytical teams, and business stakeholders to design, build, and maintain the data infrastructure needed to support rigorous statistical production processes. The role centres on building reliable and maintainable data pipelines, validation and frameworks that support statistical production processes.

You will contribute to the migration and modernisation of legacy processes, ensuring that existing business logic is preserved and that outputs are accurately reconciled against current production results. You will also contribute to the engineering practices required to operate the platform reliably in production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain efficient and reliable ETL processes and data pipelines for the ingestion, transformation, and integration of data from multiple source agencies.
  • Develop and maintain modular, production-quality code for statistical production processes, including optimising legacy processes while preserving business logic and reconciling outputs against existing results.
  • Design and maintain database schemas, data models and storage structures to support efficient ingestion, validation, transformation and retrieval of large datasets.
  • Build reusable data engineering components such as common libraries, configuration frameworks, logging standards, and utilities to streamline production workflows.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data engineering workflows, including automated testing and deployment, and establish workflows to safely isolate and synchronise Development, UAT, and Production environments.
  • Design and configure complex pipeline workflows and schedules using enterprise tools, including dependencies, failure handling, recovery and operational monitoring.
  • Establish version control structures using GitLab, set up code review frameworks, and produce technical documentation.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot pipelines, perform root-case analysis and continuously improve operational reliability and system performance for large-scale datasets.
  • Collaborate with technical team, business users and other stakeholders to translate business and statistical processing requirements into robust technical implementations.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 4-7 years of professional experience in data engineering, data platform development, or a related software engineering role.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience in complex data transformations, analysis, and quality monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience with dataframe processing libraries (e.g. Polars, pandas) for high-performance execution and memory-efficient processing of large datasets
  • Experience with database management, data warehousing and developing ETL processes for data ingestion and integration
  • Experience with version control using Git, including branching strategies, merge requests, code review, and CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment
  • Working knowledge of Linux/Unix environments, shell scripting and command-line tools for data processing
  • Familiar with data governance policies, access control and security best practices.
  • Understanding of software engineering practices such as modular design, configuration management, logging, exception handling, testing, and technical documentation.
  • Experience with cloud technologies and orchestration/CI-CD tooling is an advantage
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently in an agile team environment

title: Rotary Die Cutter / Flexo Operator
description:
Description

Rotary Die Cutter / Flexo Operator

What do our Rotary Die Cutter / Flexo Operator do at Pratt Industries?

Our Rotary Die Cutter / Flexo Operators are responsible for all activities associated with safely operating corrugated die cutting equipment including setup, make-ready, operation, quality inspections, troubleshooting, cleanup, and recommending improvements to operations to meet customer demand. Operators are expected to maximize productivity while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and equipment performance.

Jump on the path of a lifelong career!

Job Type – Full Time!

Starting Pay: $23+ per hour based on experience

  • Paid vacation and holidays
  • Opportunity for advancement

Schedule:

  • Monday to Friday
  • Daily or Weekend OT as required

Education/Experience:

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience operating die cutting equipment in a corrugated manufacturing environment
  • Experience with Bobst, Baysek, Apstar, Ward, Martin, or similar equipment
  • Previous experience in the corrugation packaging industry a plus

Able to read and follow instructions, production schedules, job tickets, quality specifications, and safety requirements.

title: Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist based in Brazil.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist to manage provider enrollment, credentialing, and medical billing operations in a remote healthcare environment. In this role, you will coordinate with insurance payers, healthcare providers, and internal teams to ensure accurate documentation, timely claims processing, and reliable reimbursement. You will oversee credentialing applications and renewals while maintaining compliance with payer requirements and applicable healthcare regulations. Your expertise in insurance billing, coding, and claims resolution will help minimize denials and prevent delays in provider network participation. You will also monitor payment discrepancies, maintain comprehensive records, and identify opportunities to improve revenue cycle processes. This is an opportunity to contribute to efficient healthcare administration while supporting providers and delivering operational accuracy.

Accountabilities:

As a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist, you will oversee the full lifecycle of provider credentialing, insurance enrollment, and claims management. You will ensure that provider records remain accurate, billing activities meet payer requirements, and reimbursement issues are addressed promptly through effective coordination and follow-up.

  • Prepare and submit credentialing applications for new healthcare providers across commercial insurance carriers, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care organizations.

  • Manage provider re-credentialing within required timelines to prevent lapses in insurance network participation.

  • Maintain accurate provider information in credentialing databases, payer portals, and related systems.

  • Coordinate with providers to collect required documentation, professional licenses, certifications, and signatures.

  • Review, prepare, and submit medical insurance claims accurately using electronic health record (EHR) and billing systems.

  • Apply appropriate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes, including relevant modifiers, in accordance with applicable billing guidelines.

  • Verify patient demographics, insurance eligibility, and coverage details before submitting claims.

  • Apply payer-specific policies, fee schedules, and filing deadlines to support accurate and timely claims processing.

  • Monitor claim status through payer portals, manage claim edits and rejections, and coordinate necessary adjustments.

  • Post insurance payments, contractual adjustments, and write-offs accurately, identifying underpayments and payment discrepancies.

  • Reconcile daily, weekly, and monthly payment reports and maintain accurate billing records.

  • Investigate claim denials and rejections, prepare supporting documentation, and submit timely appeals.

  • Maintain detailed follow-up logs to track outstanding claims through resolution.

  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, CMS requirements, payer policies, and applicable federal and state regulations.

  • Collaborate with clinical, administrative, and revenue cycle teams to resolve billing and credentialing issues.

  • Serve as a liaison between healthcare providers and insurance payers, resolving enrollment discrepancies and network participation issues.

  • Monitor changes in payer requirements, credentialing policies, and coding guidelines to maintain compliance.

  • Maintain credentialing logs, spreadsheets, databases, and expiration-date trackers to ensure deadlines are met.

  • Audit credentialing files for completeness and accuracy and prepare management reports on application progress, pending items, and compliance status.

  • Identify recurring payer issues and recommend process improvements to strengthen operational efficiency and reimbursement outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines hands-on medical credentialing and billing experience with a strong understanding of insurance payer processes, coding standards, and healthcare compliance. You should be highly organized, comfortable managing multiple deadlines, and able to communicate effectively with providers, insurance representatives, and internal stakeholders.

    • High school diploma or equivalent required; an associate or bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, or a related field is preferred.

    • At least two years of experience in medical credentialing, medical billing, or both, preferably working with multiple insurance payers.

    • Strong working knowledge of commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care credentialing and reimbursement processes.

    • Familiarity with CAQH ProView, NPPES, PECOS, Availity, payer portals, and EHR or medical billing software.

    • Demonstrated experience preparing accurate claims, resolving denials, following up on outstanding payments, and maintaining compliance with payer requirements.

    • Understanding of CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding systems, including modifier requirements.

    • Knowledge of provider enrollment, re-credentialing procedures, insurance eligibility verification, claim submission deadlines, and payer-specific policies.

    • Medical billing or coding certification, such as Certified Professional Biller (CPB), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), or an equivalent qualification, is an advantage.

    • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate, complete, and well-organized records.

    • Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple applications, claims, and deadlines simultaneously.

    • Effective written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with healthcare providers, insurance representatives, patients, and colleagues.

    • Proficiency in credentialing, billing, and documentation systems, with the ability to learn new tools and workflows.

    • Understanding of HIPAA, CMS, NCQA, and other applicable healthcare compliance standards.

    • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining productivity, accuracy, and consistent follow-through.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote work arrangement.

      • Full-time employment.

      • Standard Monday-to-Friday business hours.

      • Opportunity to develop expertise across provider credentialing, medical billing, insurance claims, and revenue cycle operations.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Job Description

Software Engineer, AI-Accelerated Development

You're already reaching for AI tools before you write a line of code. What if your next team was built entirely around that instinct?

About the Company:

Our client is a cloud communications API platform (CPaaS) powering voice and text messaging for more than 1,500 companies, from contact centers to fintech platforms to mobile carriers. Their platform includes voice APIs, SMS/MMS messaging, RCS for Business, branded calling solutions, and bring-your-own-carrier (BYOC) options, all built on carrier redundancy, compliance, and U.S.-based support. When a call or text absolutely has to go through, their customers count on this team to make it happen.

The Opportunity:

We are looking for a software engineer who's already comfortable working alongside AI tools day to day and wants to build that fluency further inside a small, senior engineering team. You'll work across their Voice, Messaging, and Platform Services stack, using AI coding assistants for scaffolding, code review, test generation, debugging, and documentation, while sharpening your own judgment about when to trust the output and when to override it. This is a great fit for someone early in their AI-assisted development journey who wants to grow into it quickly, surrounded by people who've already been doing this daily.

What You'll Actually Do:

  • Design, build, and ship features across Voice, Messaging, and Platform Services systems (APIs, routing logic, carrier integrations, messaging pipelines)
  • Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as part of your daily workflow
  • Start experimenting with AI agents for real engineering tasks (testing, documentation upkeep, code migration) under guidance from more senior teammates
  • Support production systems handling real-time voice and messaging traffic, including a weekly on-call rotation
  • Work closely with product management on scoping and estimation
  • Write clear documentation, including notes on what worked and didn't with AI-assisted workflows

What You Bring:
  • 3 to 5 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally including backend/API work or distributed systems
  • Regular, hands-on use of AI coding tools, with a genuine interest in getting sharper with them, not just occasional use
  • Solid fundamentals in data structures, testing, and system design, so you can catch AI-generated code that's wrong, not just accept it
  • Experience with a modern backend language/framework (Node.js, Python, Go, or Java); this team is primarily Node with some Python
  • Strong written communication skills
  • Able to be in the Raleigh, NC office Wednesdays and Thursdays each week; unfortunately, this role is not able to sponsor work visas
  • Bonus: any exposure to telecom protocols (SIP, SMPP) or messaging standards (SMS/MMS/RCS)

Why You'll Want This One:
  • Work on infrastructure that's genuinely mission-critical: real calls, real texts, real customers, at scale
  • Be part of a thriving company at the center of the rapidly growing CPaaS industry
  • Join a small, senior team with real ownership and visibility into the roadmap
  • Room to grow your AI-assisted development skills fast, with senior engineers around you who can teach it
  • Your future path here is wide open, with real room for professional growth
  • Hybrid schedule based in Raleigh, NC (in-office Wednesdays and Thursdays)

Benefits & Perks:
  • Comprehensive health coverage: medical (100% covered), dental, and vision for you and your family
  • Generous PTO plus 10+ paid company holidays
  • 401(k) with a 4% company match
  • Competitive compensation
  • A fun, collaborative culture with team-building events and company-wide volunteer days

If that sounds like how you already work, we want to hear from you. Send your resume and a quick note on how AI tools show up in your day-to-day development.

title: Sr GRC & Compliance Manager (CST & EST considered)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. GRC & Compliance Manager (CST & EST considered) based in the United States.

The Sr. GRC & Compliance Manager will lead the operational execution and continuous improvement of enterprise security compliance and governance programs. This role is responsible for managing external audits, coordinating control owners, validating evidence, tracking remediation, and ensuring organizational readiness across multiple regulatory and security frameworks. An immediate priority is overseeing the current PCI-DSS audit cycle while establishing a structured AI Governance program. The successful candidate will help transform compliance from a periodic audit exercise into a sustainable, year-round operating model supported by clear ownership, reliable documentation, and proactive risk management. Working closely with security, IT, legal, finance, HR, and business stakeholders, this professional will improve control maturity and provide leadership with clear visibility into risks and compliance progress. This is a remote opportunity for an experienced GRC professional who combines strong technical knowledge with effective cross-functional coordination and program management skills.

Accountabilities

  • Lead the day-to-day execution of security, risk, compliance, and AI governance programs across the organization.

  • Manage compliance activities related to SOC 2, ISO 27001, HITRUST, FISMA, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS, ensuring applicable requirements are mapped to relevant controls and business processes.

  • Prioritize and coordinate the current PCI-DSS audit cycle, including scope definition, control ownership, evidence collection, readiness assessments, remediation, auditor requests, fieldwork, and report completion.

  • Establish and develop an AI Governance program, defining appropriate controls, accountability, documentation, and risk management processes.

  • Maintain a consolidated mapping of audit requirements and controls across applicable business units, systems, and reports.

  • Assign and monitor control ownership across technology, security, HR, finance, legal, and other relevant stakeholder groups.

  • Coordinate with control owners to collect, review, organize, and validate audit evidence before submission, ensuring documentation demonstrates that controls are operating as intended.

  • Manage communications with external auditors, including evidence requests, sample submissions, follow-up questions, status updates, and issue resolution.

  • Identify control deficiencies, evidence gaps, exceptions, dependencies, and risks, then drive remediation plans with accountable owners, deadlines, and escalation paths.

  • Maintain a centralized risk register and evidence-tracking process that provides clear visibility into open items, due dates, ownership, and progress.

  • Develop and maintain compliance policies, standards, control narratives, system descriptions, and other governance documentation.

  • Establish an annual compliance calendar and recurring control testing and evidence-validation procedures to improve audit readiness throughout the year.

  • Provide regular reporting to security and technology leadership on audit status, control effectiveness, risks, blockers, remediation progress, and decisions requiring attention.

  • Partner with Security, IT, Legal, HR, Finance, Internal Audit, and business teams to strengthen control maturity, improve accountability, and address evolving regulatory, customer, and security requirements.

  • Following the PCI-DSS audit, implement a repeatable year-round compliance operating model that supports future audit cycles and continuous improvement.

    • Requirements

    • At least five years of professional experience in information security governance, risk management, compliance, auditing, or a closely related discipline.

    • Hands-on experience managing SOC 2 or comparable security audits, including control mapping, evidence collection and validation, auditor coordination, and remediation tracking.

    • Strong understanding of security and IT controls covering identity and access management, change management, vulnerability management, incident response, logging and monitoring, backup and recovery, third-party risk, and security governance.

    • Demonstrated ability to coordinate compliance activities across technical teams and business functions, establish clear control ownership, and maintain stakeholder accountability.

    • Strong evidence-review skills, including the ability to assess whether supporting documentation adequately demonstrates that a control operated as expected.

    • Proven project and program management capabilities, with experience managing deadlines, dependencies, competing priorities, remediation activities, and escalations.

    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical audit findings, compliance risks, and remediation needs to both technical teams and executive leadership.

    • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to maintain structured documentation, track numerous open items, and provide reliable status reporting.

    • Preferred: Experience managing enterprise compliance programs across multiple entities, departments, or business units.

    • Preferred: Familiarity with GRC or audit management platforms and structured evidence repositories.

    • Preferred: Knowledge of complementary security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF), CIS Controls, and ISO 27001.

    • Preferred: Relevant professional certifications such as CISA, CISM, CRISC, CISSP, or equivalent practical experience.

    • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment, primarily using a computer for extended periods, and provide occasional after-hours support for production implementations or critical system issues when required.

    • Ability to perform the essential responsibilities of the role with or without reasonable accommodation.

      • Benefits

      • Annual salary: $125,000–$150,000 USD, depending on experience.

      • Work arrangement: Remote position.

      • Location and time-zone consideration: Candidates based in the United States, particularly those aligned with Central Standard Time (CST) or Eastern Standard Time (EST), are considered.

      • Healthcare coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

      • Retirement savings: 401(k) plan with employer matching.

      • Paid time off: PTO and paid holidays.

      • Additional perks: A comprehensive benefits package and opportunities for professional growth.

      • Work environment: A team-oriented setting with opportunities to contribute to security governance, risk management, and enterprise compliance initiatives.

      • Work conditions: Primarily remote or office-based computer work, with occasional after-hours support potentially required for critical implementations or system issues.

title: Senior Full-Stack & Data Solutions Engineer, Innovation Team
description:
Allkin Singapore is a community-driven social service agency dedicated to empowering individuals and families to build a brighter future. We are building our core technical team to drive innovation and digital transformation within the agency and across the social service sector. The team’s work will impact tens of thousands of lives in the years to come.

In this role, you will work closely with senior leadership, internal stakeholders, and external partners to identify needs, assess technologies, and design scalable digital solutions that enhance service delivery and organisational effectiveness. You will have the opportunity to collaborate and work with advisors from established entities such as the Open Government Products and Google etc.

This is a hands-on role suited for an experienced full-stack engineer with strong systems integration and data engineering expertise. You will focus on evaluating, adapting, and operationalising existing technologies, rather than building from scratch, while implementing customised systems that strengthen organisational capabilities in a lean and evolving environment.

We require a highly resourceful, adaptive, and self-directed individual who is comfortable operating independently in a lean environment and building foundational capabilities from the ground up. The ideal candidate is motivated not only by technology, but by the opportunity to strengthen the ecosystem of care through thoughtful and sustainable digital transformation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assess organisational workflows, operational pain points, and service delivery needs
  • Identify, evaluate, and recommend suitable digital technologies, platforms, and tools
  • Configure, customise, integrate, and operationalise selected technologies to meet agency requirements
  • Lead end-to-end implementation of digital solutions, including user onboarding and adoption support
  • Translate non-technical operational requirements into practical technology solutions

Full-Stack Engineering & Technical Implementation

  • Develop and maintain internal applications, portals, dashboards, automation workflows, and APIs where required
  • Integrate systems across platforms using APIs, middleware, workflow tools, and data connectors
  • Support frontend and backend development activities as needed
  • Ensure solutions are maintainable, secure, scalable, and fit-for-purpose within a resource-constrained environment
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues independently
  • Establish foundational data architecture and data pipelines to support operational reporting and decision-making
  • Design and maintain relational databases and data storage structures
  • Consolidate and integrate data from multiple operational systems
  • Support data quality, governance, and accessibility initiatives
  • Implement basic reporting and analytics workflows
  • Continuously strengthen the agency’s internal data capabilities and infrastructure

title: OT Cybersecurity Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced OT Cybersecurity Specialist to serve as a Subject Matter Expert in protecting operational technology (OT) and industrial control systems (ICS/IACS) across global operations.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between information security and automation engineering. You will be responsible for establishing security controls, designing resilient architectures, conducting risk assessments, and ensuring compliance with international industrial cybersecurity standards. Additionally, you will act as the regional OT Security Representative for Poland and Norway, guiding cross-functional teams to safeguard critical infrastructure, R&D environments, and offshore assets.

Technical Background:

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, network engineering, or automation engineering within OT/ICS environments.
  • Deep familiarity with specialized industrial software, including PLC engineering platforms, version control tools (e.g., versiondog/Octoplant), HMIs, and OPC/OPC UA protocols.
  • Practical expertise in network security, including switch/router configurations, firewall policy reviews, network segmentation (Purdue Model), system hardening, and industrial patch management.
  • Strong understanding of international OT security standards (e.g., ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82).

Certifications (Highly Desirable):

  • OT/ICS Security: SANS GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443 Risk Assessment Specialist, or GRID.
  • General Security: CISSP, CISM, or CRISC.

Soft Skills & Other Requirements:

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) with excellent presentation and technical writing skills.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex security concepts to both non-technical stakeholders and automation engineers.
  • Flexibility to travel occasionally (up to 5%).

title: Associate AP
description:

  • Timely and accurate processing of supplier invoices, payments, GL coding, reconciliations & month end activities within any of the ERPs in use across the Business Units in scope of the SSC

title: Management Trainee
description:
Job Title: Management Trainee

Division: Logistics

Reports To: Logistics Manager

Hours: Sunday - Thursday

Job Title: Management Trainee

The Management Trainee is responsible for all driver load assignments and other delivery service tasks for the fleet supporting the operations. This position will report to the Southwest Regional Manager.

Responsibilities:

  • Daily communication and interaction with 60+ CDL Class A Truck Drivers including yard spotters, local delivery drivers, and over-the-road drivers.
  • Assign work to all drivers during a specific shift.
  • Maintain positive relations with drivers and customers.
  • Responsible for influencing positive employee morale and quality customer service. Address driver problems as they arise and report issues to management and HR as needed.
  • Manage drivers’ use of PeopleNet system for eLogs and Trip Management.
  • Utilize TMW to manage all aspects of customer deliveries, backhauls, returns, and special transportation requests.
  • Ensure all trips in TMW are properly coded for billing accuracy.
  • Utilize TMW and TotalMail to ensure all TMW orders are completed in real-time.
  • Complete the Shift Pass-On Log on a daily basis to ensure a smooth transition between Dispatch shifts.
  • Work with Management to increase backhaul percentage and minimize empty miles and dead-head lanes.
  • Ensure all loads are Dispatched in a timely manner in compliance with the Dispatch Schedule provided by Shipping.
  • Document all late shipments in TMW Remarks including the reason for the shipment dispatching after the Scheduled Dispatch Time.
  • Work with Dispatch Supervisor to ensure the most efficient and cost-effective mode of delivery is used for all shipments.
  • Work with Management and Drivers to follow company Safety Program and Policies to measure and reduce the occurrence and cost of collisions, injuries, near-misses, and equipment damage.
  • Track equipment usage to ensure good utilization and ensure repairs are made in a timely manner.
  • Report all equipment repair needs and damages to Management in a timely manner.
  • Track and report all driver attendance incidents to ensure staffing levels are adequate to meet customer demand.
  • Ensure all payroll and timekeeping records are accurate and reported in a timely manner to Management and Payroll Department.
  • Ensure Continuity is maintained for all drivers. Manage the Continuity Report for assigned drivers and ensure any errors are corrected within 24 hours.
  • Ensure DOT and Company Policy compliance is maintained for all Drivers (Random Drug Screening, Certification of Violations/MVR, Annual Medical Reviews, etc.)
  • Ensure all equipment inspections are completed and vehicle registration and Inspection Reports are updated in TMW and are physically located onboard the equipment.
  • Ensure all Accident Reporting procedures are followed per company policy.
  • Organize and conduct activities to assure safe, cost-effective, on-time operating performance.
  • Track and report sign-in/sign-out times, assure routes are timely, and communicate service issues to management and customer service.
  • Handle all incoming calls and ensure timely responses to customers, vendors, drivers, carriers, etc., and communicate issues with drivers and Dispatch Supervisor.
  • Monitor driver performance and report issues to Management.
  • Process and file all paperwork handled during on assigned shift.
  • Create, monitor, and update reports on a daily basis as needed.
  • Communicate all pertinent issues to the incoming Dispatcher to ensure all issues are handled.
  • All other duties, as assigned.

Requirements

The company assesses applicants on standards for performance, stability, dependability, and honesty. College degree is preferred but not required. Previous dispatch experience is preferred.

This is a first shift position but must be flexible if help is needed on another shift. Must be open to travel to other locations within the company.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Employee is regularly required to walk and talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to sit. Vision requirements include: close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

title: Member Navigator
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Member Navigator based in the United States.

This is an excellent opportunity for a customer-focused professional who wants to make healthcare easier to navigate and improve the experience of members accessing essential services. As a Member Navigator, you will serve as a primary point of contact, helping members understand their benefits, access appropriate providers, coordinate appointments, and resolve routine questions. You will manage cases from initial contact through resolution, ensuring accurate documentation, timely follow-ups, and effective communication across healthcare teams. Working closely with members, providers, clinical professionals, and internal partners, you will help remove barriers to care and support a seamless healthcare journey. This role combines customer service, administrative coordination, and problem-solving in a technology-driven healthcare environment. With a fully remote setup, structured weekday hours, and comprehensive benefits, you will have the opportunity to contribute to better healthcare access while developing your professional skills.

Accountabilities

  • Member Support and Communication: Serve as the primary non-clinical contact for members through phone, email, and other communication channels, providing timely, professional, empathetic, and accurate assistance.
  • Benefits and Program Education: Explain healthcare programs, eligibility requirements, benefits, available services, provider options, applicable processes, and next steps in clear, accessible language.
  • Information Collection and Verification: Gather, verify, and document member demographics, eligibility details, benefits information, referrals, service requirements, and other relevant case information.
  • Case Management and Resolution: Manage assigned member cases from initial intake through resolution, research questions, resolve routine issues independently, monitor progress, and coordinate follow-ups to ensure timely outcomes.
  • Appointment and Service Coordination: Coordinate imaging appointments and other applicable healthcare services by identifying appropriate providers, facilitating scheduling, confirming appointment details, and communicating updates to members and providers.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with case management, clinical staff, clients, providers, and internal departments to coordinate services, support members requiring additional assistance, and facilitate appropriate clinical review when needed.
  • Escalation and Barrier Resolution: Identify potential obstacles to care, service delays, sensitive issues, and non-standard requests, escalating clinical or complex matters to the appropriate teams in accordance with established procedures.
  • Documentation and System Management: Maintain accurate, complete, and timely records of member interactions, scheduling activities, case progress, outcomes, and follow-up requirements in CRM, scheduling, case management, and other departmental systems.
  • Provider and Partner Relationships: Build productive working relationships with healthcare facilities, providers, clients, and external partners to promote effective communication and timely service delivery.
  • Administrative and Operational Support: Assist with claims-related activities, administrative tasks, and other operational processes associated with member cases as required.
  • Quality and Performance: Meet established service-level agreements, productivity targets, quality standards, documentation requirements, and member satisfaction expectations.
  • Program Flexibility and Cross-Training: Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supported programs, policies, systems, and business initiatives, and adapt to different workflows, queues, and responsibilities as operational needs change.
  • Process Improvement: Collaborate with colleagues and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities to improve workflows, increase operational efficiency, and enhance the overall member experience.
  • Compliance and Confidentiality: Follow established security procedures and applicable healthcare privacy requirements, including protecting sensitive member information in accordance with HIPAA and organizational policies.

Requirements

  • Education: High school diploma or GED required.
  • Relevant Experience: At least 2 years of experience working in a remote call center environment.
  • Healthcare or Customer Service Background: Experience in healthcare scheduling, patient or member access, healthcare operations, insurance, medical office administration, or another related customer support environment.
  • Customer Service Excellence: Demonstrated ability to provide courteous, professional, accurate, and timely assistance while maintaining a positive member experience.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex information, healthcare processes, and administrative requirements in an understandable manner.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong organizational skills and a high level of accuracy when collecting information, documenting cases, coordinating appointments, and managing follow-up activities.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to research questions, resolve routine issues, recognize situations requiring escalation, and follow established procedures to achieve appropriate outcomes.
  • Time Management and Multitasking: Ability to manage multiple cases, meet deadlines, prioritize tasks, and maintain productivity in a fast-paced, service-oriented environment.
  • Independent Work: Demonstrated ability to work independently, follow instructions and established workflows, exercise sound judgment within the role's scope, and complete assignments reliably.
  • Technology Proficiency: Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and PowerPoint, and the ability to navigate multiple computer systems and learn new platforms.
  • Remote Work Readiness: Must be based in the United States and able to maintain a quiet, distraction-free workspace, reliable internet connectivity, and a secure working environment.
  • Schedule Availability: Ability to work full-time, Monday through Friday, during the required hours for your time zone:
  • Eastern Time: 9:30 a.m. – 6:15 p.m.
  • Central Time: 8:30 a.m. – 5:15 p.m.
  • Mountain Time: 7:30 a.m. – 4:15 p.m.
  • Pacific Time: 6:30 a.m. – 3:15 p.m.
  • Data Security and Compliance: Willingness to follow company security policies, use approved devices and software, apply secure access practices such as VPNs and strong passwords, and protect confidential health information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate degree or additional relevant education.
  • Healthcare experience combined with medical, claims, or collections call center experience.
  • Medical terminology certification.
  • Experience reading, interpreting, and explaining Explanation of Benefits (EOB) documents.
  • Certified Benefits Professional Associate (BCPA) certification.
  • Experience coordinating healthcare services, navigating insurance benefits, or supporting patient access and care coordination.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: Generously subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance, including access to services through company healthcare products.
  • Health and Spending Accounts: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (DCFSA) options.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with company matching contributions and immediate vesting.
  • Fully Remote Work: Work from home anywhere in the United States, with the necessary equipment provided.
  • Flexible Work Environment: Remote working arrangements designed to support productivity and work-life balance.
  • Paid Time Off: Generous PTO, including vacation, sick leave, and paid holidays.
  • Parental Leave: Paid maternity and paternity leave to support growing families.
  • Employee Assistance Program: Access to professional counseling, referrals, and additional personal and work-life support services.
  • Pet Insurance: Optional coverage to help manage eligible veterinary expenses.
  • Employee Discounts: Savings on phone plans, car rentals, computers, and other eligible purchases.
  • Community Engagement: Opportunities to participate in philanthropic initiatives, including paid time off for community service.
  • Professional Development: Opportunities to gain experience across healthcare programs, strengthen member service skills, and develop knowledge of healthcare operations.

title: Senior Product Manager, Personal Loans
description:
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 25 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.

The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.

Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion.

About the role
Tabby is known for BNPL, but credit is our fastest-growing business. Saudi Arabia is our biggest market, and we want to build a full consumer lending line there.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager based in Saudi Arabia to build that business from the ground up and own its P&L.

This is not a feature role. You will define what the product is, how it is priced, who qualifies, how it stays compliant.
The product construct. Define the lending products we launch in KSA and across Tabby's other markets, including eligibility, tenors, limits, repayment structure, and what happens at every edge of the flow.

The P&L. Revenue and cost are yours: profit rates and pricing etc. You build the business case, commit to the numbers, and explain every month why they moved.

Work with legal, compliance and external partners, and so the customer experience does not suffer for it.

Billing and servicing logic. Billing logic, repayment options, early settlement, late fees, collections hand-offs. This is detailed work: you will sit with engineering and specify, case by case, what lands where and why.

Strategy. Where this business should be in 12 and 24 months, which segments we serve, what we build next, and what we deliberately do not build.
  • Saudi Arabia residency, familiarity with the market and an understanding of local culture
  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager. Experience with credit or lending products matters most, but strong experience in fin-tech or tech products also works
  • A proven track record of managing complex product lifecycles and delivering successful products
  • Attention to detail, our products work with people's money, so precision matters at every step
  • Comfort working with risk, compliance and legal to get a product approved, not just designed
  • Resilience and the ability to adapt in a rapidly changing environment
  • Fluency in English and Arabic
What you can expect
  • Ownership & Impact: A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
  • Culture: Collaborative, inclusive, and driven environment where your voice matters.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy flexible working hours designed to optimize productivity and balance.
  • Growth: Participate in the company’s employee stock options program and shape your career trajectory.
  • Support: Comprehensive health insurance, generous PTO and a Flexible Benefits budget to meet your personal needs.
We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals (whatever they may be).

If this sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you!

You will prototype AI-supported resources, streamline onboarding, and develop systems that make learning more accessible and efficient. Working closely with stakeholders across the organization, you will turn emerging needs and open-ended ideas into practical solutions. You will have the autonomy to experiment with new technologies, improve existing processes, and implement initiatives from concept to launch. This opportunity is ideal for a proactive, systems-oriented professional who enjoys solving complex problems in a global, asynchronous-first environment.

As an AI Enablement and Learning Specialist, you will develop and maintain AI-powered learning solutions, optimize knowledge management processes, and ensure that learning systems operate efficiently. You will collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement and translate learning objectives into accessible, automated, and scalable experiences.

  • Research AI-powered approaches to learning and enablement, evaluating opportunities and recommending practical solutions aligned with organizational goals.

  • Prototype learning resources and automated workflows using Claude and other relevant AI tools, turning successful experiments into reliable, usable solutions.

  • Develop and launch learning initiatives from initial concept through implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement.

  • Manage and optimize asynchronous onboarding processes to deliver a smooth, consistent, and largely automated experience for new team members.

title: Clean Energy Mechanical Technician
description:
MAINTENANCE MECHANIC

SUMMARY

The Maintenance Mechanic position is part of a Maintenance Team that supports the paper machine. The position coordinates closely with the paper machine operations teams as customers of the reliability centered maintenance support services the maintenance team is responsible for delivering. The Mechanical Technician position reports to the Mechanical Maintenance Superintendent. This is a position in our high performance work system that works a rotating 24 hour, 7 day per week shift schedule. There are both day (Monday through Friday) assignments and shift assignments. It is expected that all of our Mechanical Technician positions will fill both day and shift roles over the course of time.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

The principal responsibilities of the Maintenance Mechanic position are to ensure that the processes are maintained in a preventive fashion to ensure optimum reliability and up time. This position troubleshoots processes and has the ability to diagnose mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic problems associated with process equipment. The Maintenance Mechanic is responsible for repairing malfunctioning equipment such as pumps, transmissions and other components.

Maintenance Mechanic must be able to operate motorized equipment such as forklifts, scissor lifts, Genie lifts, hoists and cranes. The Mechanical Technician must possess basic to intermediate math skills. Must be able to read and understand blue prints, technical manuals and literature. Must be able to read orders and prepare reports legibly and properly.

The candidate should be able to:

  • Apply safe working practices and understand the principles of preventive and first-line maintenance
  • Correctly diagnose a range of mechanical faults and plan a suitable course of action
  • Understand the principles of power transmission systems; recognize, remove and refit taper-lock bushes, keyed shafts, belts, chains & couplings; install & align shafts; tension drive train components
  • Correctly remove and refit various types of bearings (roller, ball, etc) identify various bearing types, understand their typical applications & recognize common defects
  • Recognize stripped threads and correctly use thread repair equipment
  • Manufacture gaskets and understand how to remove and replace seals and gland packing
  • Understand the operation of various gearboxes, (helical, spur and worm-wheel)
  • Correctly dismantle and replace drive belts
  • Recognize various types of conveyor systems and their main components
  • Identify typical faults and correctly remove, replace and track a conveyor belt
  • Employ the appropriate welding process (MIG, TIG, or Stick, as appropriate)
  • Pipe fitting duties as necessary
  • Other duties as assigned

The position is also responsible for the safe use of hoists, lift trucks, hand tools and power tools.

EDUCATION and/or REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Post-secondary educational degree (2 to 4 year degree from college, university, technical school, military, vocational or other advanced educational institution)
  • Computer/Data entry skills.

Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:

Bachelor's degree or higher in Industrial, Mechanical, Electrical, Pulp/Paper or Chemical Engineering

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Able to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, blue prints, P&ID’s, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations. Leading root cause analysis and problem solving teams. Analytical and field troubleshooting skills.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Working knowledge of mechanical and electrical machinery, including conveyer systems, breakers, boilers, hydraulic and pneumatic systems, etc. Knowledge of computer systems and the ability to learn new complex applications.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License and/or other appropriate certification to work in certain areas or on certain equipment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

ADDITIONAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES, & REQUIREMENTS

  1. Practical application training may require some out-of-state travel to various other Pratt Paper Mills
  2. Wear all required Personal Protective Equipment (glasses, ear plugs, shoes, gloves, etc.)
