description:
POSITION TITLE: SHIPPING SUPERVISOR - 2nd Shift

SCHEDULE: 2nd Shift (2:00 PM - 10:30 PM | Monday - Friday + overtime/weekends as required)

REPORTS TO: SHIPPING MANAGER

LOCATION: LATHROP, CA

Salary: ($73K-85K)

SUMMARY:

Direct frontline shipping and dock operations during 2nd Shift within a fast-paced, 24-hour manufacturing environment. Lead forklift operators, loaders, and staging personnel while ensuring safe operations, efficient product flow, accurate shipments, and strong employee engagement.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on leader who values accountability, leads by example, and creates an environment where safety, quality, and performance are non-negotiable.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Safety Leadership

  • Conduct daily shift-start safety meetings and reinforce safe work practices throughout the shift.
  • Ensure compliance with all PPE requirements, equipment inspections, and company safety procedures.
  • Immediately address unsafe conditions, unsafe behaviors, and near misses.
  • Promote a culture where employees feel responsible for one another's safety.

Team Leadership & Accountability

  • Lead by example and establish clear expectations for performance, attendance, safety, and conduct.
  • Provide coaching, training, and constructive feedback to shift personnel.
  • Recognize strong performance while consistently addressing performance issues.
  • Foster a positive work environment built on fairness, consistency, and respect.

Shipping & Dock Operations

  • Direct daily loading, staging, and shipping activities during peak evening dispatch hours.
  • Coordinate freight movement to ensure on-time shipments and efficient dock flow.
  • Monitor trailer utilization, load quality, and shipping accuracy.
  • Minimize delays and improve overall dock performance.

Attendance & Scheduling

  • Monitor daily attendance and staffing requirements.
  • Address attendance issues promptly and consistently according to company policy.
  • Support staffing adjustments necessary to meet customer and operational requirements.

Quality & Customer Focus

  • Verify outgoing shipments meet quality and customer requirements.
  • Perform routine audits of staged product and completed loads.
  • Work closely with production teams to resolve issues before product is shipped.

Equipment & Asset Management

  • Review and enforce completion of daily equipment inspections.
  • Ensure forklifts, scanners, dock equipment, and related assets remain safe and operational.
  • Report maintenance needs promptly and remove unsafe equipment from service when necessary.

Shift Communication

  • Conduct effective shift handovers with incoming and outgoing supervisors.
  • Complete accurate shift reports documenting safety, production, quality, staffing, and operational concerns.
  • Communicate issues clearly to management and supporting departments.

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a manufacturing, distribution, warehouse, or shipping environment.
  • Minimum of 2 years of direct leadership, supervisory, lead, or team leadership experience.
  • Strong understanding of shipping operations, forklift safety, dock management, and warehouse processes.
  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and computerized inventory or warehouse management systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in heavy manufacturing or high-volume industrial shipping operations.
  • Experience leading teams of 8 or more employees.
  • Demonstrated success improving safety, productivity, attendance, or employee retention.
  • Bilingual Spanish/English communication skills a plus.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Able to read and interpret documents such as sales, business and performance reports, operating and maintenance instructions, training and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to write business reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to speak effectively.

REASONING ABILITY

  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form.
  • Ability to solve a variety of problems and deal with situations where limited information or standardization exists.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, divide in all units of measure.
  • Ability to compute rates, ratios, and percentages and calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, costs, proportions, and volumes.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

  • Computer literate (MS Office including Word and Excel), data entry skills
  • Application knowledge of products and production processes
  • Quality standards – both ISO and QS

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position operates in a fast-paced manufacturing and shipping environment with active forklift traffic, moving equipment, and varying temperatures.

The successful candidate must be able to:

  • Stand and walk for extended periods, frequently up to 8-10 hours per shift.
  • Climb on and off equipment and loading platforms.
  • Bend, reach, push, pull, and perform repetitive movements throughout the workday.
  • Lift and move up to 50 pounds.
  • Work in a non-climate-controlled industrial environment.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving equipment in the work area. The employee is sometimes exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, along with hot and cold temperatures depending upon the season. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

REQUIRED LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES

Integrity

You do the right thing even when nobody is watching. You own mistakes, communicate honestly, and address problems directly.

Accountability

You accept responsibility for the results of your shift and help others do the same.

Coach & Teacher Mindset

You understand that developing people is one of the most important responsibilities of leadership.

Calm Under Pressure

You remain focused and professional during high-volume shipping periods, customer demands, equipment issues, and changing priorities.

Operational Discipline

You understand that consistency creates results and that standards matter every day, not just when leadership is present.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

Safety

  • Incident-free performance
  • Equipment inspection compliance
  • Safety engagement and participation

Operational Excellence

  • On-time shipment performance
  • Shipping accuracy
  • Dock efficiency and trailer utilization

Leadership Effectiveness

  • Employee engagement
  • Attendance management
  • Team development and retention

Accountability

  • Quality of shift communication
  • Execution of operational priorities
  • Consistent adherence to company standards

title: Vice President, Digital (Political)
description:

This is an exciting leadership opportunity for an experienced political digital marketer passionate about driving fundraising, advocacy, and supporter engagement for progressive causes. As Vice President, Digital, you will shape and execute high-impact, cross-channel digital strategies that help political campaigns and mission-driven organizations maximize fundraising results and mobilize supporters. You will lead client relationships, develop innovative direct-response campaigns, and collaborate with creative, technology, strategy, and production teams to deliver measurable outcomes. From email and SMS to social media, web, and search, your work will help partners connect with audiences and achieve ambitious campaign goals. You will also contribute to business development, identify new partnership opportunities, and advise clients on emerging trends and best practices. Join a collaborative, results-driven environment where strategic thinking, creative experimentation, and a commitment to meaningful social and political change are central to the work.

Accountabilities

  • Digital Strategy and Fundraising: Develop and implement innovative digital fundraising, advocacy, and communications strategies that maximize grassroots engagement, supporter participation, and revenue for political campaigns and partner organizations.

  • Client Relationship Management: Serve as a senior strategic partner to clients, building trusted relationships, understanding their objectives, and providing proactive recommendations that support campaign success and long-term collaboration.
  • Team Leadership and Collaboration: Manage and guide cross-functional teams of associates, strategists, writers, and production professionals, ensuring clear priorities, effective coordination, and high-quality campaign delivery.
  • Performance Measurement and Optimization: Monitor client key performance indicators, analyze campaign results, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement data-driven strategies to maximize return on investment and fundraising performance.
  • Strategic Planning and Forecasting: Advise clients on digital marketing best practices, emerging industry trends, revenue projections, budget planning, resource allocation, and campaign development.
  • Project and Resource Management: Coordinate with client-facing, creative, and technical teams to manage project timelines, deliverables, budgets, and resources while maintaining quality and meeting critical deadlines.
  • Business Development: Identify prospective partners that could benefit from digital fundraising and marketing services, develop new business relationships, and contribute to pitching and securing new client engagements.
  • Client Reporting and Service Excellence: Deliver consistent, high-quality client service through regular performance reporting, clear communication, invoicing coordination, and ongoing strategic support.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Explore emerging technologies, proprietary solutions, and new direct-response marketing approaches to strengthen campaign effectiveness and maintain a competitive advantage.
  • Mission-Driven Leadership: Support organizations advancing progressive political priorities and social change while fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and results-oriented team culture.

Requirements

  • Professional Experience: At least 5 years of in-house political or agency experience in digital fundraising, political communications, or a closely related field.
  • Political Digital Marketing Expertise: Demonstrated understanding of political campaigns, grassroots fundraising, supporter engagement, and direct-response digital marketing, ideally across multiple election cycles or political organizations.
  • Client Management: Proven experience managing client relationships, advising stakeholders, translating organizational objectives into marketing strategies, and delivering measurable results.
  • Team and Project Leadership: Experience leading cross-functional project teams, coordinating multiple stakeholders, and managing competing priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Digital Campaign Execution: Ability to design, implement, evaluate, and optimize campaigns across digital channels, including email, SMS, web, social media, and search.
  • eCRM Platform Proficiency: Experience working with digital fundraising and customer relationship management platforms such as ActionKit, NGP, Salesforce, or Luminate.
  • Analytical and Strategic Skills: Strong ability to interpret campaign performance metrics, assess key performance indicators, forecast revenue, manage budgets, and develop actionable recommendations based on data.
  • Communication and Presentation: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex strategies clearly and persuasively to clients, executives, and internal teams.
  • Organizational Skills: Strong planning, prioritization, and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple projects, maintain attention to detail, and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.
  • Business Development: Confidence in identifying potential clients, building professional relationships, presenting service offerings, and contributing to new business opportunities.

description:

  • Build practitioner capability through enablement, certifications, mentorship and knowledge management.

  • Maintain a strong market point of view on SDLC, DevEx, DevOps and emerging AI capabilities.

Practice focus

You will shape solutions across:

  • DevOps and CI/CD modernisation

  • Developer Experience and developer flow optimisation

  • Agentic AI and AI-assisted software development

  • SDLC governance, standardisation and quality engineering

  • Atlassian Software Collection adoption and enterprise SDLC modernisation

What success looks like

You will build a recognised global practice that:

  • Has a clear, differentiated portfolio of packaged and sellable solutions.

  • Converts expertise into repeatable IP and high-quality delivery.

  • Helps regional teams win and deliver strategic SDLC/DevEx engagements.

  • Creates measurable client value while supporting Valiantys’ growth and Next Generation revenue ambition.

Familiarity with how the Software Collection is positioned and deployed across enterprise environments is essential. Atlassian partner certifications are a strong advantage.

title: Internal Auditor
description:
Atlanta - Brookhaven

The Senior Internal Auditor is responsible for ensuring the integrity of our internal control environment, enhancing business processes, and managing risk across our diverse manufacturing and distribution operations. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a strong foundation in accounting principles and internal controls who can effectively partner with management across all levels of the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Conduct in-depth risk assessments and develop tailored, risk-based audit programs (scope, objectives, and testing procedures) in conformance with The IIA Standards.
  • Plan, lead and execute complex financial and operational audits, including comprehensive reviews at manufacturing sites and other limited IT/compliance audits.
  • Perform process walkthroughs, evaluate the design, and execute testing of internal controls to assess their adequacy and operating effectiveness against the COSO framework.
  • Prepare clear, concise, and persuasive audit observations that detail findings, articulate the root cause of issues, and provide actionable, practical recommendations.
  • Present and discuss audit findings and control gaps with process owners and senior management, actively influencing action to improve the control environment.
  • Participate in special projects, investigations, and advisory engagements related to process enhancement efforts, new plant set-up and segregation of duties (SOD) analysis.
  • Utilize data analytics and tools (e.g., Power BI) and leverage AI models (e.g., Gemini, Copilot) to enhance audit efficiency, gain deeper insights, and identify potential risks.
  • Mentor junior auditors, providing guidance on audit methodology, documentation standards, and professional development.
  • Coordinate internal audit activities with Manufacturing Plants, Divisions and Corporate Functions as needed to ensure efficient coverage.

Experience and Skill Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related business field.
  • Minimum of 4 to 6 years of relevant experience in internal audit or public accounting.
  • Professional certification is preferred: CPA (Certified Public Accountant), CIA (Certified Internal Auditor) and/or CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner).
  • In-depth knowledge of GAAP, internal control frameworks (COSO) and Global Internal Audit standards, practices, and techniques.
  • Proven experience in a large-scale enterprise, preferably within a manufacturing environment.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and experience applying data analytics tools in audit work, in addition to familiarity with audit platforms (e.g., AuditBoard, Workiva).
  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and project management skills.
  • Excellent communication skills (written/verbal) to interface effectively within the organization.
  • Leadership and ability to manage audit teams and projects.
  • High level of integrity, objectivity, and professional skepticism.
  • Flexibility and ability to travel domestically up to 40% of the time to manufacturing facilities.

title: ACO QA E2E Team Leader
description:
Location: Ra'anana

#Hybrid

DriveNets is a leader in high-scale disaggregated networking solutions. Founded in 2015, DriveNets modernizes the way service providers, cloud providers and hyperscalers build networks. Supporting the largest network in the world, more than half of AT&T’s backbone traffic is running on DriveNets’ Network Cloud open disaggregated architecture. Raising $587 million in three funding rounds, DriveNets is disrupting the networking market from high-scale architecture to AI platforms, and is bringing onboard the most talented people. We are seeking people that want to make an impact on the world’s leading communication networks and are experienced in networking architecture or AI infrastructure solutions.

Job Summary:

What You'll Do:

  • Build, lead and mentor the ACO E2E QA team; own the quality of every ACO release from test planning to Go/No-Go sign-off.
  • Define the E2E test strategy, test plans (STP/STD/STR) and acceptance criteria for ACO features based on requirements and design documents, and present them to R&D and Product.
  • Lead manual end-to-end testing of ACO across its UI/UX, REST APIs, database-backed workflows and the real infrastructure it manages: switch provisioning and upgrades, inventory and topology, telemetry, alerts, configuration compliance, benchmarking and multi-tenancy.
  • Own and maintain the QA lab environments: AI fabric topologies (leaf-spine, DNOS and multi-vendor switches), GPU servers, NetBox/SLURM/Kubernetes integrations and the ACO deployments themselves (single server, HA cluster, cloud).
  • Validate network connectivity, configuration and performance across the AI cluster infrastructure: high-speed Ethernet (400/800G/1.6T), GPU nodes, leaf-spine topologies, VLAN/VXLAN, IP addressing, MTU, link status, routing and packet loss.
  • Verify BGP routing functionality (neighbor establishment, route advertisement, route propagation and convergence) and EVPN/VXLAN-based isolation on data-center fabrics.
  • Execute and analyze AI/HPC benchmarks (RDMA, NCCL/RCCL, MPI, RoCE, training/inference, storage) on GPU and CPU clusters through ACO's benchmarking engine; compare results against established baselines and report deviations.
  • Validate telemetry collection (gNMI/OpenConfig, syslog, GPU and NIC exporters) for accuracy, consistency and reliability against device state and live traffic.
  • Drive the defect lifecycle: reproduction with evidence, prioritization, root-cause investigation with developers, fix verification and regression; publish clear quality reports and release-readiness metrics.
  • Define and execute the automation roadmap, moving the team from manual E2E testing to automated API, UI and device-level test suites integrated into CI.
  • Make AI agents part of the team's daily work (test design, execution, evidence collection, reporting) and set the practices for AI-assisted QA.
  • Represent QA in planning, agile ceremonies, customer escalations and field deployments.


Requirements

What We're Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience leading QA engineers (hiring, mentoring, planning, delivery) on top of 5+ years of hands-on QA.
  • Minimum 3 years of application testing across UI/UX, database-backed data and multi-step workflows in web-based systems, including test design from detailed requirements.
  • Networking knowledge at CCNP level or higher: L2/L3 switching and routing, BGP, VLAN/VXLAN/EVPN, MTU/MSS, ECMP, and troubleshooting with packet captures and device CLI.
  • AI networking: data-center fabrics for AI workloads – leaf-spine and rail-optimized Clos designs, RoCEv2/RDMA, lossless Ethernet (PFC/ECN/DCQCN), 400/800G/1.6T optics and link health.
  • GPU clusters: running, monitoring and optimizing AI workloads and benchmarks (NCCL/RCCL, RDMA, MPI, training and inference) on NVIDIA/AMD GPU servers, with schedulers such as SLURM or Kubernetes.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Linux environments (CLI, networking stack, services, logs, scripting).
  • Hands-on experience working with AI agents in daily engineering work: agent skills, rules/instruction (markdown) files, MCP servers and tools, and prompt-driven workflows (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor).

Advantages:

  • QA automation experience (Python, pytest, Playwright/Selenium, REST API testing, CI pipelines).
  • Kubernetes and containers (kubectl, Helm, Lens/OpenLens, Argo CD; monitoring pod status, reading logs, troubleshooting).
  • Cloud deployments (AWS/Azure/GCP, e.g., EKS).
  • Databases: SQL querying and data validation (PostgreSQL).
  • Familiarity with network operating systems (DNOS, SONiC, Arista EOS, Junos), observability stacks (Prometheus/Mimir, Grafana/Perses, gNMI) and traffic generators (Spirent/Ixia).

Soft Skills:

  • Proven leadership: builds a team, sets priorities, makes decisions and owns outcomes.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with R&D, Product, Support and customers.
  • High-level proficiency in English (both written and verbal) and clear technical writing.
  • Self-starter who learns quickly and adapts easily to new technologies.
  • Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple priorities.
  • A strong team player with a collaborative mindset.

Why Join Us?

  • Build the QA team of a new product – DriveNets' AI Cluster Orchestrator – used to deploy and run some of the most demanding AI infrastructures.
  • Work hands-on with state-of-the-art AI infrastructure: 800G/1.6T Ethernet fabrics, NVIDIA and AMD GPU clusters, RoCE and collective communication.
  • Join an AI-native engineering culture where agents are part of the daily workflow.
  • Collaborate with brilliant minds in a dynamic and supportive work environment.
  • If you're ready to take the next step in your career and work with a world-class team, apply now!

title: Mechanical Technician
description:
Mechanical Technician: Master the Controls of a State-of-the-Art Paper Mill!

SUMMARY

Join our dynamic Maintenance Team as a Mechanical Technician, providing essential reliability-centered maintenance support to our paper machine operations. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a high-performance work system, working a rotating 24/7 shift schedule that includes both day and shift assignments. All Mechanical Technicians are expected to experience both day and shift roles over time. You will report directly to the Mechanical Maintenance Superintendent.

BENEFITS

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and professional growth, including:

  • Health & Wellness: Participating Medical/Dental/Vision Plans, Healthy Lifestyles Program/Personify Health Fitness Tracking, Gym Reimbursement Program, Short Term Disability/Long Term Disability, Annual $300 Work Boot reimbursement, and Annual $250 Prescription Safety Glasses reimbursement.
  • Financial Security: 401K Plan with Company Match, Mill Incentive Program (up to 80% of one month’s base salary, paid quarterly), Supplemental Life Insurance Plans, Supplemental Spouse and Child Life Insurance plans, Income Protection Plans.
  • Professional Development: Tuition Reimbursement/Assistance Program.
  • Work-Life Balance: Child Bearing & Parental Leave, Legal and Travel Assistance Plans, EAP/Home Auto Insurance Plans, Wireless/Auto/Discount Plans.

SALARY COMPENSATION

Mechanical Technicians are Salaried Non-Exempt, qualifying for overtime beyond 40 hours per week.

  • New Hire Base: $60,000 annual base salary
    • With built-in overtime and incentive, you will typically earn $90,000+ annually

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Mechanical Technician, your primary responsibility is to ensure the optimal reliability and uptime of our processes through preventive maintenance. You will be instrumental in:

  • Troubleshooting & Repair: Diagnosing and repairing mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues in process equipment, including pumps, transmissions, and other components.
  • Equipment Operation: Safely operating motorized equipment such as forklifts, scissor lifts, Genie lifts, hoists, and cranes.
  • Technical Proficiency: Applying safe working practices, understanding preventive and first-line maintenance principles, and interpreting blueprints, technical manuals, and literature.
  • Mechanical Expertise:
    • Diagnosing mechanical faults and planning effective solutions.
    • Understanding power transmission systems, including the removal, refitting, installation, and alignment of shafts, belts, chains, and couplings.
    • Correctly removing and refitting various bearing types, identifying applications, and recognizing defects.
    • Recognizing stripped threads and utilizing thread repair equipment.
    • Manufacturing gaskets, removing, and replacing seals and gland packing.
    • Understanding the operation of various gearboxes (helical, spur, and worm-wheel).
    • Dismantling and replacing drive belts.
    • Identifying conveyor systems and their components, including troubleshooting, removal, replacement, and tracking of conveyor belts.
  • Welding & Pipefitting: Employing appropriate welding processes (MIG, TIG, or Stick) and performing pipe fitting duties as needed.
  • Documentation: Reading orders and preparing legible and accurate reports.
  • Additional Responsibilities: Performing other tasks as assigned by Mill Management.

Education and/or Required Experience

  • Post-secondary educational degree (2 to 4 year degree from college, university, technical school, military, vocational or other advanced educational institution)
  • Computer/Data entry skills.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

title: Design Intern
description:
POSITION TITLE: Design Intern
REPORTS TO: Sales Manager/General Manager

LOCATION: Rockwall, TX

SUMMARY

This internship offers a valuable opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the design aspects of corrugated box manufacturing. The Design Intern will work closely with the General Manager, Sales Manager, and Design Manager, learning about industry practices and contributing to various departments within the Rockwall Corrugated Box Plant. This position is ideal for college students pursuing a career in drafting, design, engineering, or a related field.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and Engineering:

  • Learn box specification: Gain experience in defining the specifications for different box designs.
  • CAD Operation: Operate the CAD table and assist in drafting designs for corrugated packaging.
  • Routing and Machinery: Learn basic routing techniques and machine operations involved in the design process.
  • Board Grades: Understand the different grades of corrugated board and their specific uses in packaging.
  • Graphics and Visual Design: Get an introduction to box graphics and the basics of design for visual appeal.
  • Box Styles: Learn about the various box styles and their applications in the packaging industry.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: Currently enrolled in college with a focus on drafting, design, engineering, or a related field.
  • Skills:
    • Strong communication skills to work effectively with customers, sales teams, and management.
    • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret business documents, reports, and technical instructions.
    • Proficiency in basic mathematical concepts, including geometry and statistical analysis, is a plus.
    • Familiarity with CAD software or willingness to learn.
  • Personal Attributes:
    • Strong problem-solving abilities and analytical thinking.
    • Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
    • Interest in learning about the manufacturing process and packaging industry.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The intern will be required to perform tasks in a dynamic plant environment. Specific physical demands may include:

  • Regular sitting, standing, and walking.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Network Engineer to be a hands-on, day-to-day owner of our network infrastructure — not a desk-bound architect and not a narrowly scoped project hire. You'll troubleshoot live production issues, lead network projects from design through cutover, travel to sites to support deployments and resolve issues that need boots on the ground, and share in an on-call rotation supporting a nationwide, always-on manufacturing network.

This role also plays a significant part in our ongoing network modernization efforts. We need someone who's equally comfortable running toward a 2am outage at a plant, leading a multi-site rollout, and mentoring newer engineers on the team, as they are working alongside our outside consulting partners on the bigger architectural initiatives.

What You'll Do

Day-to-day operations

  • Serve as a hands-on escalation point for Layer 2/3 issues across our Cisco Catalyst, Nexus, and Meraki environment
  • Participate in an on-call rotation supporting a nationwide network running 24/7 manufacturing and business operations
  • Travel to sites as needed to support new deployments, troubleshoot issues that require physical presence, and assist with cutovers — this is a genuinely hands-on role, not a remote/desk position
  • Maintain and improve security hardening practices across the campus and branch switch hierarchy

Project leadership

  • Lead network projects end-to-end — scoping, design, implementation, and validation — across our branch, data center, and cloud environments
  • Take ownership of specific initiatives within our broader modernization roadmap, including SD-WAN migration, SD-Access/identity-based segmentation, data center fabric modernization (EVPN-VXLAN leaf-spine), cloud connectivity (AWS Transit Gateway, DirectConnect), and remote access modernization (ZTNA/VPNaaS)
  • Partner with our outside consulting engagement as an internal technical lead during assessment and implementation phases — including actively absorbing and documenting their design rationale and methodology — with full long-term operational ownership of what's built transferring to you and the team as that engagement concludes

Team & cross-functional collaboration

  • Mentor and support other engineers on the network team
  • Work with observability tooling (ThousandEyes, NetFlow-based platforms, Zabbix/PagerDuty) to build and maintain visibility across the environment
  • Collaborate with security, systems, and OT/plant teams on IT/OT segmentation and cross-domain issues

What You'll Bring

  • CCNP Enterprise certification required
  • 10+ years of hands-on enterprise network engineering experience, ideally across multi-site/branch environments
  • Experience with large-scale network modernization initiatives — SD-WAN transformation, identity-based segmentation rollouts, cloud connectivity projects, or data center upgrades
  • Demonstrated experience leading network projects, not just executing tickets — you should be comfortable owning a design and seeing it through
  • Willingness and ability to travel to sites as needed, and to participate in an on-call rotation
  • Solid grounding in core routing/switching (OSPF, BGP, STP, VLANs) plus working knowledge of modern fabric- and identity-based architectures (SD-WAN, SD-Access/ISE, VXLAN/EVPN)
  • Comfort working in a live production environment — this is an operational role first, with project work layered on top, not the reverse
  • Strong documentation habits and clear communication, especially when coordinating across teams and with outside partners

Strongly Preferred

  • AWS networking experience (Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPC architecture)

Nice to Have

  • CCIE (Enterprise Infrastructure, Data Center, or Security)
  • Experience with Cisco ISE policy design at scale
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
  • Familiarity with NetBox or similar infrastructure-as-source-of-truth tooling
  • Experience in a manufacturing or industrial (OT/IT convergence) environment
  • Exposure to ThousandEyes, LiveAction, or similar network observability platforms
  • Prior on-call experience in a 24/7 operational environment

title: Program Manager
description:
The Program Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of projects and strategic initiatives for one of our largest customers, from initial planning through execution, monitoring, governance, and closure. This position requires a highly motivated and self-directed individual who will take ownership of the customer account and make sure that operations are aligned with their needs. You will manage the existing business, take in new improvement ideas, and collaborate with both the customer and the internal business teams to prioritize them. You will ensure that projects are appropriately sized and measurable, and confirm that the right people and resources are available and assigned. You will also engage actively with your sales, business operations, and command center peers to enhance best practices, standards, tools, processes, and training related to project, program, and portfolio management.

title: Converting Lead Person
description:
POSITION TITLE: CONVERTING LEAD PERSON

REPORTS TO: Converting Supervisor

SUMMARY

Be able to perform any of the positions on the corrugator in the daily routine of producing quality corrugated products in a safe, productive manner with minimum waste. Cross-train in all key positions to be able to cover for any position on the corrugator. In addition, this position is a trainee position for Corrugator Supervisory position as the need may arise.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Maintain quality, efficiencies, and production levels set by management. Able to perform any job duty and role on the corrugator on both the dry end and wet end.

Report quality concerns to Corrugator Superintendent and Plant Manager. Assist in determining quality guidelines.

Maintain inventories of sheets, inks and other converting supplies.

Coordinate with your supervisor and Maintenance Superintendent on any repairs or preventive maintenance done in the department.

Keep upper management informed of problems or situations that may affect the performance of your shift.

Communicate with necessary supervision to avoid problems between shift changes.

Improve career skills by enrolling yourself in seminars, technical courses, and related college courses.

Implement, maintain, and support all company policies and procedures, safety program, and good housekeeping.

Train and support all new hires assigned to the corrugator.

Comply with company policies and procedures.

Additional duties may be assigned by management.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED.

Two years prior supervisory experience.

Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:

Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Able to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy.

Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation.

Cost issues in order to make daily decisions that will reduce overall costs and will help the supervisor find areas that require improvement.

Quality and Food Safety standards.

Regulatory requirements including but not limited to wage and hour requirements, environmental and waste minimization, company policies, and personnel requirements including OSHA, DEQ and EEO.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 to 65 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES

The individual must posses the following:

Superior time management skills including the ability to manage multiple issues concurrently.

Excellent crisis manager who demonstrates that he/she has a high emotional control under adverse conditions and can lead his/her personnel to a successful resolution.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

The performance of the supervisor will be measured as follows:

Operating standards - the supervisor will need to meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the supervisor.

Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the supervisor to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the supervisor and his/her superior.

Employee relations - through observations the supervisor will be evaluated regarding his/her skills and advancements in the areas of motivational techniques and results, positive and corrective/constructive feedback, subordinate development and creating a positive work environment.

Creativity - this will be evaluated by how active the supervisor is in participating in advancing the business through new and innovative ideas.

title: Packaging Automation Shop Technician
description:
Location: Dundee, Florida

Summary:

The Packaging Automation Shop Technician is a hands-on technical role responsible for the assembly maintenance, repair, testing, and preparation of automated packaging machinery and related equipment within the shop environment. This position supports field service operations by ensuring automation systems are properly built, configured, inspected, and ready for installation at customer facilities. The Shop Technician reports directly to the Shop Foreman and works closely with Field Technicians and Operations to maintain equipment quality, reliability, and deployment readiness. This role requires strong mechanical and technical aptitude and foundational knowledge of electrical systems, pneumatics, hydraulics, motor controls, and PLC-based equipment, along with the ability to work with industrial automation machinery while following company standards and procedures.

Key Position Responsibilities:

  • Assemble, install, and configure automated packaging machinery, subassemblies, and components according to engineering drawings and specifications
  • Troubleshoot and resolve mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, hydraulic, PLC, motor, and control-related issues within the shop environment
  • Perform preventive maintenance, inspections, and functional testing on packaging automation systems prior to deployment
  • Support equipment rebuilds, refurbishments, retrofits, and upgrade projects
  • Prepare machines for shipment and field installation, ensuring completeness, quality, and operational readiness
  • Assist with the reception and staging of equipment
  • Assist with the reception of spare parts from OEM’s and the shipment of spare parts for Field Technicians
  • Maintain shop organization, cleanliness, and inventory of tools, parts, documentation, and consumables
  • Document work performed, parts usage, and testing results accurately
  • Coordinate and facilitate shop workflow to support project timeliness and operational priorities
  • Follow all company safety policies, procedures, and Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) requirements
  • Identify opportunities for equipment improvements, reliability enhancements, and cost savings
  • Assist with and play a primary role in managing the Spare Parts Room, including organization, inventory control, receiving, and issuing parts to Field Technicians
  • Act as a user for our Computer Maintenance Management System (CMMS) software
  • Support occasional field service activities as needed

Position Qualifications and Demands:

  • Experience in packaging automation, industrial maintenance, military maintenance, or graduation from a technical college with a degree in Mechatronics or Industrial Maintenance
  • Strong mechanical, technical, and electrical aptitude
  • Familiarity with PLC-controlled machinery and industrial sensors at a troubleshooting level

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we're guided by a shared purpose- helping people be their best in the moments that matter. We live up to our purpose every day by solving for safer, building mission-critical communications devices and networks, AI-powered video security, and integrated command center views. The work we do connects public safety agencies and enterprises to enable vital collaboration when it matters the most. Our RFSite Software Engineering organization, a key component of the Critical Communications Networks business segment, consists of a diverse group of software engineers, product architects, system architects, and test engineers across global locations. We leverage the latest virtualization technologies on a robust Linux platform, following modern software development practices such as Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD), DevOps, and automated testing. Operating within Agile/Scrum methodologies, our team is responsible for the end-to-end software development lifecycle of next-generation Radio Frequency (RF) Site solutions.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join an Agile Scrum team developing containerized Linux user-space applications and services for mission-critical land mobile radio communications products. In this role, you will focus on writing high-quality modern Python services deployed in container environments and leveraging AI tools/technologies to accelerate development, while interfacing with and debugging existing C++ subsystems. You will apply solid Linux OS and networking fundamentals, leverage multiple automated testing frameworks, and work in an RF telecommunications context alongside modern CI/CD tooling.

Key Responsibilities
  • Containerized Service Development: Design, implement, and maintain Linux user-space applications using modern Python constructs within containerized environments.
  • AI Tooling & Integration: Utilize approved AI-assisted development tools and integrate AI/ML capabilities or automated analytics into engineering workflows where applicable.
  • Linux OS & Networking: Develop networking applications utilizing socket programming, network protocol handling (TCP/IP, UDP), and Linux OS user-space interactions.
  • Automated Testing Ecosystem: Build and expand test suites for unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • System Interfacing & Debugging: Read, interface with, and debug lower-level legacy or embedded C/C++ codebases and APIs.
  • RF & Telecommunications Context: Work with RF domain concepts, radio infrastructure, and network protocols during product integration.
  • CI/CD & Quality Assurance: Integrate code into automated build pipelines and enforce code quality standards using static analysis.
  • On-Site Lab Testing: Engage in hands-on testing, configuration, and debugging across virtualized environments and physical RF site equipment/network gear.
Basic Requirements
  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s (BS) degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field with relevant software engineering experience, OR Master’s (MS) degree with relevant work experience.
  • Primary Language: Demonstrated proficiency in software development using modern Python.
  • Linux OS & Networking: Strong understanding of Linux operating system concepts, user-space architecture, and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, sockets, network protocols).
  • Containers: Practical experience with Linux user-space development and containerization platforms.
  • Automated Testing: Hands-on experience automated testing frameworks.
  • C/C++ Knowledge: Ability to read, interface with, and debug C/C++ codebases.
Desired Skills & Experience
  • Exposure to AI/ML tools (e.g., AI coding assistants, prompt engineering for developer tooling, or integration of AI APIs/frameworks).
  • Familiarity or background in RF / Telecommunications / Land Mobile Radio (LMR) systems.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools and static code analysis tools.
  • Version control and task management using Git and Jira.
  • Experience with network diagnostic tools.
  • Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills in a cross-functional team.
Job Details

Work Model: On-site. Environment: Direct access to modern containerized Linux server environments alongside physical RF test lab facilities. #LI-Onsite #LI-ST2 Travel Requirements None Relocation Provided None Position Type Experienced Referral Payment Plan Yes Company Motorola Solutions Ireland Limited

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic. We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

title: Strategic Project Manager
description:
Jouw projecten veranderen de toekomst van Schiphol

Vliegtuigen zie je opstijgen. Passagiers zie je vertrekken. Maar achter de schermen draait een complete wereld van techniek, logistiek en dienstverlening die ervoor zorgt dat alles veilig, efficiënt en op tijd verloopt.

Bij KES (Onderdeel van de TCR Group) zijn wij verantwoordelijk voor het beheer, onderhoud en de beschikbaarheid van Ground Support Equipment (GSE) op Schiphol Airport. Denk aan pushback tractors, GPU's, bagagetrekkers, passagierstrappen en elektrische voertuigen die dagelijks worden ingezet om vliegtuigen operationeel te houden.

De luchtvaart staat niet stil. Elektrificatie, duurzaamheid, digitalisering en groei zorgen continu voor nieuwe uitdagingen en kansen. Daarom zoeken wij een Strategic Project Manager die samen met de Managing Director Nederland richting geeft aan de toekomst van onze organisatie.

Geen rol waarin je vanaf de zijlijn adviseert, maar een functie waarin je strategie omzet in concrete resultaten.

Als Strategic Project Manager werk je aan uiteenlopende vraagstukken zoals:

  • Verbeteren van bedrijfsprocessen en operationele prestaties;

  • Ondersteunen van commerciële groei en nieuwe businesskansen;

  • Leiden van verander- en organisatieontwikkelingsprojecten;

  • Opstellen van business cases en strategische aanbevelingen;

  • Vertalen van operationele en financiële analyses naar verbeteracties;

  • Samenbrengen van stakeholders uit Operations, Sales, Finance en HR;

  • Ondersteunen van de Managing Director bij strategische besluitvorming;

  • Initiëren van projecten op het gebied van innovatie, duurzaamheid en digitalisering.

Door de veelzijdigheid van de projecten krijg je een uniek inzicht in alle onderdelen van de organisatie en draag je direct bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van KES en de TCR Group.

Ben jij 'equipped' voor deze uitdaging?

Je bent analytisch sterk, ondernemend en krijgt energie van complexe vraagstukken. Je denkt strategisch, maar vindt het minstens zo belangrijk om zaken daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd te krijgen.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Een afgeronde WO-opleiding, bij voorkeur in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Technology Management, Business Engineering of vergelijkbaar;

  • Tussen de 3 en 7 jaar relevante werkervaring;

  • Affiniteit met techniek, engineering of industriële omgevingen;

  • Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden;

  • Het vermogen om strategie en uitvoering met elkaar te verbinden;

  • Een uitstekende beheersing van zowel Nederlands als Engels.

Ervaring binnen consultancy, projectmanagement, engineering of de luchtvaartsector is een pre.

Welke omgeving bieden wij

  • Directe samenwerking met de Managing Director Nederland;

  • Een sleutelrol binnen strategische projecten met zichtbare impact;

  • Veel zelfstandigheid, verantwoordelijkheid en beslissingsruimte;

  • Intensieve samenwerking met management en internationale stakeholders;

  • Uitstekende mogelijkheden voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling;

  • Een internationale en ondernemende werkomgeving;

  • Een marktconform salaris en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden;

  • De kans om mee te bouwen aan de duurzame toekomst van de luchtvaart.

Onze waarden

Bij KES geloven we in vier kernwaarden:

Integrity. Passion. Accountability. Open-mindedness.

Herken jij jezelf hierin en wil je een zichtbare bijdrage leveren aan de verdere groei en ontwikkeling van KES? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Handig om te weten

Een assessment en een achtergrond screening is onderdeel van ons selectieproces.

title: Guest Services Assistant - Reception
description:
Picture this: you’re the friendly face that sets the tone for every guest’s stay — creating a warm welcome from the very first moment. You deliver service that’s both efficient and personal, anticipating needs, sharing recommendations, and making every interaction feel effortless.

You move confidently between tasks — handling bookings, answering questions, and supporting across departments — always bringing a calm, informed, and approachable style. No two shifts are ever the same: new guests, new stories, and new opportunities to make someone’s day that little bit brighter.

As a Guest Service Team Member, you’re more than just part of the team — you’re part of the experience, shaping the moments and memories our guests will carry with them long after they leave.
As the first point of contact, you’ll play a key role in shaping our guests’ stay, offering a warm welcome and support that turn good visits into great ones. Here’s what you’ll be doing:
  • Using your approachable personality to build great connections with guests.
  • Demonstrating your confidence in handling check-ins, bookings and guest requests.
  • You’ll bring great communication skills and love sharing your local know-how to help guests make the most of their stay.
  • Being a team player who’s flexible and happy to help wherever needed.
We live by our values – and we’d love you to bring them to life every day:
  • Open - You’re friendly and welcoming, helping guests feel right at home.
  • Nimble – You adapt quickly, handling whatever the day brings with ease.
  • Brilliant - You take pride in the little touches that make a big difference.
  • Honest - You’re reliable and trustworthy, building confidence through your actions.
Show up with your spark and care for others, and we’ll provide the tools for you to thrive.
When you join Splendid, you will enjoy a reward package to support your lifestyle, wellbeing and career. Here are just some of the benefits on offer:
  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) - confidential wellbeing support whenever you need it with 24/7 access to remote GP appointments.
  • Hotel Room Discounts - stay with us or our partner hotels at special team rates including discounted rates for friends and family.
  • Food & Beverage Discounts - enjoy meals and drinks at reduced prices across our hotels.
  • Life Assurance - peace of mind for you and your loved ones.
  • Salary Sacrifice - Car Scheme: our team members can enjoy the ultimate benefit of driving a brand new, full insured and maintained car for a fixed monthly amount taken from their salary.
  • Stream - access your earned wages up to 50% whenever you need them giving you financial flexibility and Highstreet discounts available.
  • Pension - auto enrolment into the company pension scheme.
  • Learning & Development - opportunities available to progress your skills and career.

title: Stacker 2nd Shift
description:
SUMMARY - 2nd Shift

Wage Starting at $17.60 per hour

Responsible for all activities associated with stacking the equipment and helping the operators including setup, operation, cleanup, and recommending improvements to operations.

Read and follow instructions on factory masters.

    • English proficiency sufficient to understand project instructions and guidelines.

    • Current residence in Slovenia for this opportunity.

    • Confidence using digital tools and online platforms.

    • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a willingness to learn.

title: AI Enablement and Learning Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Enablement and Learning Specialist based in Netherlands.

We are looking for an AI Enablement and Learning Specialist to transform learning strategies into practical, AI-powered solutions that improve how people access and use knowledge. In this remote contract role, you will combine artificial intelligence, workflow automation, knowledge management, and learning design to build scalable enablement experiences. You will prototype AI-supported resources, streamline onboarding, and develop systems that make learning more accessible and efficient. Working closely with stakeholders across the organization, you will turn emerging needs and open-ended ideas into practical solutions. You will have the autonomy to experiment with new technologies, improve existing processes, and implement initiatives from concept to launch. This opportunity is ideal for a proactive, systems-oriented professional who enjoys solving complex problems in a global, asynchronous-first environment.

Accountabilities:

As an AI Enablement and Learning Specialist, you will develop and maintain AI-powered learning solutions, optimize knowledge management processes, and ensure that learning systems operate efficiently. You will collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for improvement and translate learning objectives into accessible, automated, and scalable experiences.

  • Research AI-powered approaches to learning and enablement, evaluating opportunities and recommending practical solutions aligned with organizational goals.

  • Prototype learning resources and automated workflows using Claude and other relevant AI tools, turning successful experiments into reliable, usable solutions.

  • Develop and launch learning initiatives from initial concept through implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement.

  • Manage and optimize asynchronous onboarding processes to deliver a smooth, consistent, and largely automated experience for new team members.

  • Structure, organize, and maintain learning knowledge repositories to ensure information is accurate, accessible, trustworthy, and up to date.

  • Automate learning administration tasks, including enrolments, reminders, progress tracking, and reporting across learning systems.

  • Maintain and improve learning platforms and collaboration tools, including Sana LMS, Notion, and Claude, ensuring they remain reliable and easy to use.

  • Create clear, practical learning materials when needed, including short learning modules, guides, documentation, and digital resources.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across teams to understand learning needs, identify operational challenges, and design effective enablement solutions.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, simplify workflows, and improve the overall learner experience through AI and automation.

  • Work independently to investigate ambiguous problems, establish priorities, and deliver solutions without requiring step-by-step instructions.

  • Monitor the effectiveness of learning systems and workflows, incorporating feedback and refining solutions to improve usability and efficiency.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong knowledge management capabilities with hands-on experience using AI tools and workflow automation. You should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, connecting systems and processes, and designing solutions that prioritize the needs of learners while delivering measurable operational improvements.

    • Strong experience organizing and managing knowledge, including structuring information, maintaining accurate documentation, and making resources easy to discover and use.

    • Practical, hands-on experience building solutions with AI tools, alongside a genuine curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and their applications.

    • Experience with workflow automation tools and confidence working with technical systems, integrations, and process optimization.

    • A systems-oriented mindset, with the ability to understand dependencies, connect workflows, troubleshoot problems, and follow through to implementation.

    • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn broad objectives, incomplete requirements, or ambiguous ideas into actionable plans.

    • A learner-focused approach, with an understanding of how people access information, develop skills, and engage with learning experiences.

    • Ability to create clear, concise, and engaging learning content, guides, documentation, and internal communications.

    • Strong written English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in asynchronous remote environments.

    • A proactive and independent working style, with the initiative to identify opportunities, test ideas, and deliver practical solutions.

    • Experience in learning and development, human resources, employee enablement, or a related field is an advantage.

    • Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms is a plus.

    • Ability to collaborate across functions, incorporate stakeholder feedback, and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote working environment, with a distributed team operating across multiple countries and time zones.

      • Contract engagement offering the opportunity to contribute to innovative AI-powered learning initiatives.

      • Significant autonomy to experiment with AI tools, develop new workflows, and bring ideas from concept to implementation.

      • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on employee learning, knowledge accessibility, and operational efficiency.

      • Collaboration with an international team representing diverse cultures, disciplines, and professional backgrounds.

      • High-trust, feedback-oriented work environment that encourages continuous improvement and collaborative problem-solving.

title: Packaging Intern
location: Rock Hill, South Carolina, United States
description:
Job Title: Packaging Intern

Location: Rock Hill, SC

Position Summary

The Process Improvement Intern will work directly with the Process Improvement Manager in a corrugated packaging manufacturing environment. This role provides hands-on exposure to operational excellence, Lean manufacturing systems, quality management systems, production analytics, and cross-functional collaboration. The intern will observe, support, and participate in real-time improvement initiatives across corrugator and converting operations.

This is not a clerical position and will be embedded on the production floor and in data analysis activities.

Key Responsibilities

Shadow the Process Improvement Manager during:

Daily production meetings

Gemba walks

Downtime reviews

Quality investigations

Cross-functional improvement discussions

Assist in collecting and organizing operational data (waste %, downtime minutes, setup time, throughput, etc.)

Support analysis of machine performance across corrugator and converting equipment

Help build and update dashboards in Excel or Google Sheets

Observe and document standard work processes

Participate in Lean initiatives (5S audits, DMS boards, layered process audits, etc.)

Assist with development of work instructions and visual management tools

Support root cause analysis efforts using structured problem-solving methods

Prepare summary reports or one-page presentations on assigned projects

Learning Outcomes

By the end of the internship, the intern should understand:

Basic corrugated manufacturing flow (paper roll → corrugator → converting → shipping)

Key production KPIs (waste %, run rate, unplanned downtime, setup time)

Fundamentals of Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement

How quality systems integrate into daily operations

How data drives operational decision-making in manufacturing

Qualifications

Currently pursuing a degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or related field

Strong analytical mindset

Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets

Comfortable working in a manufacturing environment

Strong communication skills

Willingness to ask questions and engage on the production floor

Physical Requirements

Ability to walk production floor for extended periods

Ability to wear required PPE (safety glasses, hearing protection, steel-toe footwear)

Professional Expectations

Maintain professional conduct on the production floor

Respect safety protocols at all times

Demonstrate curiosity and initiative

Maintain confidentiality of operational data

title: Machine Helper - 1st Shift
description:
Machine Helper

Responsible for all activities associated with assisting Machine Operator and Machine Helpers with running production machines including setup, operation, cleanup, and recommending improvements to operations.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Monitor quality.

• Maximize the utilization of equipment by operating the machinery at available capacity and speed.

• Train and assist First and Second Helpers with job duties on the machine.

• Cross-train on other machines.

• Complete necessary reports in an accurate and timely manner, including but not limited to: Production Data, Machine Operational Status, Safety Data, Quality Data.

• Turn in maintenance work orders to supervision for needed repairs. Be proactive in the maintenance of equipment.

• Switch duties with First Helper as necessary.

• Comply with all company policies and procedures, including safety and maintaining good housekeeping.

• Adheres to production schedule. Makes recommendations for optimizing the schedule to meet cost, quality and service goals. Reports any unusual scheduling issues to Supervisor.

• Additional duties may be assigned by management.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED.

Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:

Prior work experience in the packaging industry.

6 months’ experience in some type of manufacturing operation.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Able to read and follow instructions on factory masters.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving one or more concrete variables in standardized situations.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may occasionally be required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 to 60 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

title: Onboarding Engineer
description:

We are seeking an Onboarding Engineer to lead the technical implementation and coordination of customer onboarding in a fast-growing SaaS environment. This role combines hands-on engineering expertise with project management to ensure seamless integrations and successful customer launches. You will work closely with onboarding, customer success, and engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and deliver a consistent customer experience.     • Requirements:

You should be comfortable managing multiple onboarding projects while communicating complex technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders.

    • 3–4 years of technical experience in B2B SaaS implementation, customer onboarding, or customer success engineering.

    • Hands-on experience with APIs, data integrations, technical configuration, and troubleshooting.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical customers and present implementation plans to leadership.

title: Production Lead
description:
Job Title
Lead Man / Production Lead
Reports To
Production Supervisor or Department Manager
Job Summary
The Lead Man is responsible for coordinating daily production activities within the assigned department of the corrugated box plant. This position provides leadership and direction to machine operators and production personnel, ensures production schedules are met, maintains quality standards, promotes workplace safety, and supports continuous improvement initiatives. The Lead Man serves as the primary point of contact between production employees and management during the shift.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Production Leadership
  • Lead and coordinate the activities of production employees within the assigned area.
  • Ensure production schedules are completed efficiently and on time.
  • Monitor machine performance and workflow to maximize productivity.
  • Assist with machine setup, changeovers, troubleshooting, and operational issues.
  • Communicate production priorities and goals to team members.
  • Ensure proper staffing and work assignments throughout the shift.
Safety Responsibilities
  • Promote and enforce all plant safety policies and procedures.
  • Conduct routine safety inspections and address unsafe conditions immediately.
  • Ensure employees use required personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Report accidents, near misses, and safety concerns to management.
  • Participate in safety meetings and training programs.
Quality Control
  • Verify products meet customer specifications and quality standards.
  • Inspect work in process and finished products.
  • Address quality concerns and implement corrective actions when necessary.
  • Ensure proper documentation of quality checks and production records.
Employee Support and Training
  • Train new employees on equipment operation, safety procedures, and quality expectations.
  • Provide coaching and guidance to team members.
  • Monitor employee performance and provide feedback.
  • Assist supervisors with employee evaluations and development initiatives.
  • Foster teamwork and positive employee relations.
Equipment and Maintenance
  • Monitor equipment condition and report maintenance needs.
  • Assist maintenance personnel during repairs and troubleshooting activities.
  • Ensure operators perform routine machine cleaning and preventive maintenance tasks.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work area in accordance with housekeeping standards.
Administrative Responsibilities
  • Complete production reports and shift documentation accurately.
  • Monitor production metrics, downtime, waste, and efficiency.
  • Communicate shift activities, concerns, and performance to supervisors.
  • Participate in continuous improvement and waste reduction initiatives.
Required Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in corrugated manufacturing or industrial production.
  • Strong knowledge of corrugated converting, printing, die-cutting, folder-gluer, or corrugator operations.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to read production schedules, specifications, and work orders.
  • Basic computer skills for reporting and production tracking.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Lean Manufacturing or Continuous Improvement programs.
  • Forklift certification.
  • First Aid/CPR certification.
  • Experience with ERP or production management systems.
Skills and Competencies
  • Leadership and team-building skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Organizational and time-management skills.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet production deadlines.
Physical Requirements
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to bend, stoop, reach, and climb as required.
  • Ability to work in a manufacturing environment with exposure to noise, dust, heat, and moving equipment.
Performance Expectations
  • Meet production, quality, and safety targets.
  • Maintain efficient workflow and minimize downtime.
  • Demonstrate effective leadership and employee engagement.
  • Support a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
