title: Strategic Account Representative
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Strategic Account Representative based in the United States.

This is an exciting opportunity for a results-driven sales professional to grow strategic healthcare partnerships and expand access to flexible patient financing solutions. In this role, you will collaborate with Strategic Account Managers to onboard enterprise healthcare locations, drive platform adoption, and develop long-term customer relationships. You will work directly with healthcare providers and their teams to deliver engaging product training, strengthen sales capabilities, and help practices increase treatment acceptance. Through a combination of consultative selling, account management, and territory development, you will contribute directly to revenue growth and customer success. This remote position offers a dynamic, fast-paced environment where adaptability, initiative, and technology-driven sales expertise are essential. With regular in-territory travel and opportunities to attend industry events, you will play a key role in expanding partnerships across the elective healthcare market.

Accountabilities:

  • Sales performance and revenue growth: Meet and exceed quarterly territory sales quotas by identifying opportunities, driving platform adoption, and generating revenue across assigned healthcare accounts.
  • Strategic account development: Partner with Strategic Account Managers to onboard enterprise client locations, strengthen existing relationships, and support long-term account growth.
  • Client onboarding and training: Guide newly onboarded healthcare practices through platform implementation and adoption, providing practical training on available financing solutions and strategies to improve treatment acceptance and membership sales.
  • Consultative selling: Conduct sales meetings and presentations both in person and through virtual platforms such as Zoom, clearly communicating product value, addressing objections, and helping healthcare providers identify solutions that meet their business needs.
  • Territory management: Develop and execute territory sales activities, prioritize opportunities, maintain an active pipeline, and ensure consistent progress toward sales objectives.
  • Customer relationship management: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of customer interactions, sales activities, opportunities, and follow-up actions within the company's CRM platform.
  • Industry networking and lead generation: Attend trade shows, regional events, and in-territory industry gatherings to generate leads, build relationships, increase product awareness, and encourage platform adoption.
  • Customer engagement and retention: Maintain regular communication with healthcare practices, identify opportunities to improve platform utilization, and support ongoing customer satisfaction and account expansion.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with internal account management and commercial teams to coordinate onboarding, share customer insights, resolve challenges, and support broader business objectives.
  • Adaptability and continuous improvement: Navigate evolving processes, systems, tools, and commercial priorities while maintaining a high standard of sales execution and customer service.

Requirements:

  • Professional experience: Three to five years of sales-related experience, preferably in account management, business development, healthcare technology, medical financing, or a comparable commercial environment.
  • Proven sales performance: Demonstrated success exceeding sales quotas and consistently delivering strong results, with a track record of high performance in a target-driven environment.
  • Sales process expertise: Strong understanding of structured sales methodologies, pipeline management, prospect engagement, objection handling, and closing techniques.
  • Relationship-building skills: Excellent interpersonal and communication abilities, with the confidence to engage healthcare providers, practice owners, administrators, and other key decision-makers.
  • Consultative selling capabilities: Ability to understand customer needs, communicate product benefits effectively, overcome objections, and position technology-based financing solutions as valuable tools for business growth.
  • Industry knowledge: A thorough understanding of the aesthetic healthcare industry or elective medical financing is required, with familiarity with specialties such as plastic surgery, dermatology, ophthalmology, dentistry, fertility, or medical spas considered valuable.
  • Technology proficiency: Strong aptitude for technology-based platforms, including the ability to demonstrate products, train customers, encourage adoption, and communicate technical features in a practical, accessible way.
  • CRM and organizational skills: Excellent attention to detail and experience using customer relationship management systems to document sales activity, monitor opportunities, and manage customer interactions.
  • Self-management and adaptability: Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and remain productive in a fast-paced environment where processes, systems, and commercial strategies may evolve.
  • Communication and presentation: Confidence conducting sales calls, virtual demonstrations, in-person meetings, and customer training sessions.
  • Travel flexibility: Willingness to travel within the assigned territory monthly and attend relevant trade shows, regional meetings, and industry events as required.
  • Work authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States, as employment visa sponsorship or transfer is not available for this position.

Benefits:

  • Quarterly variable compensation: Eligibility for a performance-based variable compensation program, providing additional earning potential based on the applicable program terms.
  • Healthcare coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums covered at 80% for employees and their eligible dependents.
  • Flexible paid time off: Unlimited PTO to support work-life balance and personal flexibility.
  • Retirement savings: Access to a 401(k) retirement savings plan.
  • Parental leave: Leave benefits to support employees as they welcome and care for a child.
  • Accidental death and dismemberment insurance: AD&D coverage provided at no cost to employees.
  • Remote work arrangement: The flexibility to work remotely within the United States while managing customer relationships and territory activities.
  • Professional growth: Opportunities to develop sales expertise, build strategic healthcare partnerships, and contribute to the adoption of innovative patient financing technology.
  • Dynamic work environment: The opportunity to work in a fast-moving, technology-driven business focused on improving access to elective healthcare treatments.

  • Interact with advanced language models in Gulf Arabic across diverse topics and conversational scenarios.

  • Evaluate linguistic accuracy, including phonetics, morphology, syntax, vocabulary, grammar, and regional dialect variations.

  • Assess the appropriate use of colloquial expressions, idioms, cultural references, and context-dependent meanings.

  • Identify and document model errors, inconsistencies, and failure patterns using clear, reproducible examples.

  • Analyze contextual interpretation, semantic accuracy, dialect distinctions, and cultural relevance in AI-generated responses.

    • Expert-level proficiency in Arabic, with specialized knowledge of Gulf Arabic dialects and regional variations.

    • Strong understanding of phonetics, morphology, syntax, semantics, colloquial expressions, idiomatic language, and cultural references.

    • Excellent ability to assess linguistic accuracy and identify subtle differences in meaning, tone, and context.

    • Strong written communication skills and the ability to explain linguistic judgments with clear examples and evidence.

    • A methodical, analytical approach to identifying errors, documenting reproducible examples, and evaluating model performance.

    • A Master's degree in Linguistics, Middle Eastern Studies, Translation, or a related field is preferred.

    • Professional experience in language teaching, translation, linguistic research, language documentation, or community-based language work is an advantage.

    • Ability to work independently, manage assigned tasks, and deliver consistent, high-quality evaluations in a remote environment.

    • Interest in artificial intelligence, language model evaluation, and the development of culturally informed AI systems.

      • Benefits:

      • Hourly compensation ranging from $8 to $65, depending on experience, expertise, and geographic location.

      • Fully remote work arrangement.

      • Freelance contract offering flexibility in how you contribute to AI training projects.

      • Opportunity to apply specialized Gulf Arabic expertise to the development of advanced AI systems.

title: Thesis: Hack Yourself First: Autonomous LLM Agents for Continuous Penetration Testing
description:
High Level Description
Insecure systems are everywhere. What matters is who finds the exploit first. Internal networks, such as an office LAN, are often assumed to be secure, but a single rogue or insecure IoT device, such as a smart TV, can give an attacker a way in. Penetration testing means trying to break into your own systems, with permission, to find security issues before an attacker does. It needs skilled people, so it is often done only now and then, while the systems keep changing.

Large Language Model (LLM) agents can now use tools and solve tasks in several steps. They are starting to be used for attacks, but how useful they are for defence is not yet well studied.

This thesis will investigate how an LLM agent can secure a network by acting as an attacker. The agent finds issues, investigates them and sends a report to the person responsible for the security posture.

Project Description
This thesis aims to evaluate LLM penetration testing as a way to continuously secure networks and environments.

An LLM agent will run from a jump host inside a test environment with known vulnerabilities. The agent does the whole process by itself. It performs reconnaissance such as port scanning, finds vulnerabilities, tries to exploit them and sends a report. The reports are compared with the known vulnerabilities, and the actions of the agent are checked for anything unsafe.

Security is easy to deprioritise when schedules are busy. Testing continuously instead of now and then means issues can be found sooner, by the right people rather than by attackers.

Examples of relevant technologies include MCP (Model Context Protocol), Linux and Nmap. Examples of relevant vulnerabilities include weak or default credentials, poor network segmentation, misconfigurations, and web vulnerabilities from OWASP Top 10.


Who are we looking for?

  • Bachelor/Master of Science in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.

  • Graduation in June 2027

  • Fluency in Swedish, both written and spoken

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken

  • Interest in cybersecurity and artificial intelligence is a plus!

Purpose
This thesis will investigate the following areas:

1. Automated penetration testing – Investigate how well an LLM agent can do a whole penetration test by itself, from reconnaissance to exploitation and reporting. Measure how many of the known vulnerabilities it finds and exploits, and how long it takes.

2. Reliability of findings – Are the reports useful, or full of false positives? Can multi-agent orchestration be used to verify the reports?

3. Trust in LLM agents – Can agents be trusted in sensitive environments, and what if they break something? A human tester knows not to cause a denial of service, but an agent might not. Investigate if cloned environments or sandboxing the agent reduce this risk.

Limitations

The implementations are proof-of-concept, not finished products, and are meant for experimentation and evaluation. The long-term goal is that the results can later be developed into a useful solution for businesses.

  • The agent accesses the environment from a single jump host, not from several points. It runs through a managed agent CLI, such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot CLI, or in a setup we host ourselves.

  • The agent only needs to find known vulnerabilities and common weaknesses. Finding zero-day vulnerabilities is out of scope.

  • Testing is only done on authorised targets, with a defined threat model, such as an attacker inside the local network or from the outside.

  • The study uses existing models. Training our own models is out of scope, and fine-tuning is only considered if there is a clear reason for it.

description:
Are you an organised, positive person who is passionate about the impact volunteers can have?
We're looking for a Volunteer Coordinator to coordinate and manage the recruitment, induction and support of our amazing volunteers, who generously donate their time and skills to support our rehoming centre teams.
As Volunteer Coordinator, you’ll:
  • recruit and induct volunteers, from advertising opportunities to delivering welcoming induction sessions at the centre,

title: Finance Systems Software Engineer - AI
description:
Job Description

About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role:

Halter runs on a capable finance tech stack, and we want to push it further. This newly created role centres on NetSuite and the platforms around it, including the EPM tool we’re currently selecting. You’ll layer real AI-powered automation on top: not demos or one-off scripts, but tools that ship, run in production, and change how our finance team works day to day.

We’re after someone who loves AI and automation but cares just as much about doing it properly: understanding the problem, building something that holds up, and maintaining it afterwards.

You’ll sit within Finance Systems, working closely with the Senior Manager and partnering with FP&A and accounting to figure out what’s worth automating and why. That could mean getting more out of native AI features or building custom automation with enterprise Claude and other platforms.

To build tools that work, you’ll spend time with the team learning how finance actually gets done. Occasionally, you’ll need to reprioritise and build something quickly—a tool, script or automation—to unblock a bottleneck.

If you want to own your work end to end and see its impact in a live finance environment, this is your kind of role.

Who we're looking for:

  • Experience shipping automation or AI-powered tools into production and supporting them once live

  • Some background or genuine interest in accounting and finance, with a willingness to help during busy periods; you don’t need to be a qualified accountant

  • A good feel for where AI helps a process and where it just adds noise

  • A track record of owning work from scoping and testing through to delivery and maintenance

  • Comfort with a role that’s still taking shape—you’ll help define it

  • Strong communication skills and patience with people who don’t speak your technical language

Bonus things you could bring:

  • Exposure to NetSuite, EPM or planning tools, or a willingness to get up to speed quickly

  • Experience with AI frameworks, agent tooling or workflow orchestration

  • Exposure to system implementations, UAT or structured project work

  • Progress towards, or completion of, a professional accounting qualification (CA or equivalent)

What your day could look like:

  • Design, build and deploy finance automations using enterprise AI tools, including Claude, and own their ongoing maintenance and support

  • Track native AI capabilities across NetSuite and our EPM tool, recommending what’s worth adopting

  • Partner with FP&A, accounting and Finance Systems to scope opportunities around real problems, informed by time spent learning their processes

  • Occasionally reprioritise to build a quick tool, script or automation that gets finance unblocked

  • Contribute to broader finance systems work, including platform upgrades, NetSuite’s evolving AI and agentic capabilities, and new market entry

  • Work with the Senior Manager, Finance Systems, on scope and priorities, bringing your own judgement as the team’s AI and automation specialist

Our Benefits:

  • Delicious snacks and drinks are available for your daily flow.

  • Healthy body, healthy mind. We're partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.

  • We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

  • Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

  • Our time to recharge is valued, we're offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

  • Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

Our Office First Approach

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter.

Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other.

Halter in Australia:

Halter entered Tasmania two years ago and has rapidly expanded to now have 20% of the state's dairy herd with Halter - a thriving customer base managed by a talented, local team. Halter recently entered Queensland and NSW, and now has a growing team and customer base across both states.

In Victoria and South Australia, Halter is preparing to launch operations following recent regulatory approval for virtual fencing. In Western Australia, Halter does not yet have customers. In these states there is a groundswell of demand for Halter across thousands of farmers. In Australia, virtual fencing is regulated by individual states' animal welfare legislation. Until recently, several states had legislation that did not permit farmers to use high-quality virtual fencing technology. With NSW parliament's announcement regulating virtual fencing, and Victoria and South Australia following suit, these barriers are now lifting.

Join our team

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

title: Software Engineering Team Lead
description:
Job Description

Take technical ownership of a new digital marketplace built to scale.

A new New Zealand-built peer-to-peer marketplace is preparing to launch, with the potential to become something significantly bigger than a typical software product.

Think less internal business system and more the early growth story of platforms such as Uber, Airbnb or Trade Me. The technology is built, the market opportunity is there, and the next phase is about users, transactions, scale and rapid product evolution.

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineering Team Lead to take technical ownership at the point where things could start moving very quickly.

The platform has undergone substantial development with an external software partner, who will remain involved. Your role will be to get across the architecture and codebase quickly, then increasingly take the lead on development, technical direction and delivery internally.

A key part of the role will also be working closely with the external software development team, coordinating priorities, managing technical requirements and ensuring internal and external development activity stays aligned.

This is not a maintenance role, and it is not a management position for someone who has stopped coding.

You'll be expected to remain firmly hands-on while providing the technical leadership needed to take the platform forward.

The Role

Initially, you'll work closely with the external development team to build a thorough understanding of the platform, architecture and existing codebase.

From there, you'll increasingly take ownership across the product, including:

  • Supporting the platform as it moves into live operation
  • Investigating and resolving bugs, production issues and integration problems
  • Developing new features and product improvements
  • Maintaining the mobile application, backend and administration environment
  • Managing APIs and third-party integrations
  • Supporting iOS and Android releases
  • Monitoring performance, errors, reliability and scalability
  • Making sound technical and architectural decisions as the platform evolves
  • Translating user feedback and commercial priorities into development outcomes
  • Setting development priorities and helping steer the technical roadmap
  • Leading internal development activity while coordinating closely with the external software development team and specialist suppliers
  • Managing development delivery across both internal and external resources
  • Building and potentially leading an internal software engineering capability as the business grows

You'll be writing code today while helping shape how development is delivered tomorrow.

The Technology

The platform is built primarily in TypeScript, with a common language across the mobile application, backend functions and administration environment.

The current stack includes:

  • React Native + Expo
  • TypeScript
  • Supabase
  • PostgreSQL
  • PostGIS
  • Stripe, Stripe Connect and Stripe Identity
  • AWS Location Service
  • React Admin
  • Vercel
  • Resend + React Email
  • Sentry

We are deliberately targeting someone already comfortable in this type of modern full stack environment.

Strong TypeScript, React and React Native experience will be particularly important, together with solid capability across databases, APIs and backend development.

Experience with Expo, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Stripe, PostGIS or high-volume marketplace platforms will be highly regarded.

About You

This is a senior appointment, and we need someone capable of getting up to speed quickly rather than learning the fundamentals on the job.

You'll ideally bring:

  • At least 5 years' commercial software development experience
  • Strong TypeScript and React experience
  • Strong React Native or mobile application development experience
  • Solid PostgreSQL, database and API capability
  • Strong frontend and backend development experience
  • Proven experience taking ownership of an existing production codebase
  • Experience troubleshooting live applications and complex integrations
  • Strong understanding of scalable software architecture
  • Proven technical leadership experience
  • Experience guiding developers, external development partners or technical suppliers
  • Confidence setting technical priorities and challenging decisions where required
  • Strong communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • A practical understanding of modern AI-assisted software development

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is energised by ownership and scale.

You'll need to be comfortable making decisions, solving difficult problems and taking responsibility for a platform that could become significantly larger, more complex and more visible as adoption grows.

Why This Opportunity?

The heavy initial build has been completed.

Now comes the interesting part.

Real users. Real transactions. Real feedback. Real scale.

You'll be joining early enough to genuinely influence the architecture, product and development direction, but with an established platform already underneath you.

If adoption grows as planned, so will the technical challenge. That creates the opportunity to build an internal engineering capability and establish yourself as a central technical leader within the business.

For the right person, this is the chance to help shape the technology behind a potentially significant New Zealand digital platform rather than simply inherit another mature corporate system.

Location

This is a full-time, office-based position in Dunedin.

Applicants must already be based in Dunedin or genuinely prepared to relocate.

Remote working is not available.

title: HR - Business Admin
description:
Location: Bengaluru,Karnataka,India

About Signeasy

Contracts run businesses. We're unlocking the intelligence inside them.

Signeasy began 16 years ago with a simple idea: signing should be easy. That idea helped the world go paperless. But signatures were only the beginning.

Today, the real problem isn't signing contracts. It's what happens after. In most companies, contracts sit scattered across inboxes, shared drives, CLMs, ERPs, and filing systems. They're static, forgotten, and underused, yet they quietly define revenue, risk, compliance, and growth. We believe contracts are one of the most powerful and most overlooked sources of truth in a business.

2025 changed everything. While others continued to treat contracts as paperwork, we began turning them into living, searchable, and intelligent systems of record. We shipped more than 250 product releases, achieved 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, and were featured at Apple's WWDC, all while building the foundation for what comes next.

2026 is our biggest year yet. With the launch of Intelligent Contract Management, we're going to market with an AI-powered contract management platform built for modern teams who expect more than storage, signatures, or status quo software.

This is the moment, and this is the team building it. If you want to help shape the future of contracts with us, read on.

Your role

As our Business Admin, you'll be part of the People team and the operational backbone of Signeasy. You'll own the employee experience from offer acceptance to exit, work directly with our C-suite on their calendars and travel, keep our workplace and tools running well, and support our Finance team as the role grows. This is a 1-year, full-time contract position.

It's a broad role with plenty of variety. On any given day, you might be getting a new joiner ready for Day 1, planning an executive's trip to Dallas, and closing out a laptop return. You'll bring structure to all of it, and you'll use AI to work faster and smarter along the way.

If you enjoy being the person others rely on to get things done, and you'd like visibility across the whole business, you'll find a lot to love here.

What you'll do

People operations

  • Manage employee records, documentation, and HRIS data so they're always accurate and current and maintain HR trackers and reports
  • Act as the first point of contact for employee questions on HR processes, policies, and tools
  • Plan and coordinate engagement activities, celebrations, and internal events

Onboarding and offboarding

  • Own onboarding and offboarding end to end, tracking every step to completion - Coordinate pre-joining logistics: offer documentation, swag, laptop setup, and Day 1 readiness
  • Grant and revoke access to tools and systems, making sure each person has only the access their role requires
  • Run structured exits: laptop recovery, access removal, and clean handovers
  • Maintain a single source of truth for every joiner and exit

C-suite support

  • Manage calendars for our C-suite executives, including scheduling, rescheduling, and prioritizing meetings
  • Plan and book domestic and international travel end to end: flights, hotels, visas, local transport, and itineraries
  • Plan and coordinate meetings and offsites for the C-suite, from scheduling and venues to on-the-day logistics
  • Handle confidential information with discretion and sound judgment

Workplace and admin operations

  • Keep the office well managed, well stocked, and organized
  • Coordinate with vendors on supplies, equipment, and services
  • Prepare the work-from-office analysis report in partnership with our workspace vendor

Laptops and tools

  • Manage the laptop lifecycle: forecasting needs, procurement, allocation, servicing, and recovery
  • Maintain the laptop asset sheet as the master record: device, serial number, owner, condition, and status
  • Support device enrollment and compliance through Kandji
  • Administer everyday tools like Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, and Zoom, and keep track of licenses and accessories

Finance support

  • Support the Finance team with documentation, records, and routine admin tasks as you settle in
  • No prior finance experience is required. You'll learn on the job.

AI and automation

  • Use AI tools for drafting, summarizing, data cleanup, and reporting
  • Build simple automations and templates that reduce manual, repetitive work
  • Keep improving our trackers and workflows so they're smarter, not busier

Who you are

We're looking for someone structured, detail-oriented, and people-first: a dependable operator who takes ownership and keeps things moving.

  • 2 to 3 years of experience in HR operations, business administration, or executive support (a blend is ideal)
  • Excellent organization and documentation skills, with a track record of keeping trackers and calendars accurate
  • Hands-on experience with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365
  • A basic understanding of access management and device setup
  • Comfort using AI tools to work more efficiently
  • Discretion and sound judgment with confidential information
  • Strong written and spoken English, schooled in an English-medium institution, with a clear, service-minded communication style
  • Self-driven, reliable, and calm under pressure, with the ability to manage multiple priorities

Why you'll love this role

This role gives you a rare view of the whole company. You'll work closely with our C-suite, partner with every team, and see firsthand how HR, operations, and finance come together as we scale.

Your work will directly shape the employee experience at Signeasy: how smoothly people join, how reliably their tools work, and how efficiently the business runs day to day. That's what lets our product, engineering, and sales teams stay focused on building the future of contracts.

It's a high-trust role with real ownership and clear room to grow, starting in HR and admin and expanding into broader operations over time.

Why work with Signeasy

Our values make us a TIGER: Trust, Integrity, Growth mindset, Empathy, and Responsibility.

We're a lean, close-knit, and nimble team. We're opinionated but collaborative: we disagree, then commit to a shared decision. We're modern, but we don't follow trends blindly. We're easy to work with, and we believe in having difficult conversations. We ask lots of questions, experiment, and learn fast. And we're deeply empathetic toward our customers, our colleagues, and ourselves.

Our people are our greatest asset. You'll work alongside some of the smartest, most humble people around the world, who come from diverse backgrounds and bring a wide range of experiences. We're a hybrid-friendly organization that values flexibility, with a mix of in-person collaboration at the office and focused work from home.

We are the #SigneasyTribe. Ask us plenty of questions about our culture, so we can both see whether there's a real connection that makes this a great experience for both of us.


We'd love to hear from you

Great talent comes from all kinds of paths. If this role speaks to you, please apply, even if you don't match every line on paper. We review every application and will get back to you within a week.

  • Hear what it's like to work at Signeasy
  • Meet Signeasy's leadership team
  • Read our origin story
  • Take a peek at Signeasy's culture
  • Learn more about growth at Signeasy

Signeasy is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Reporting to the Customer Strategy Manager, this role serves as the primary liaison between Account Management and cross-functional teams, ensuring all projects remain on schedule, on budget, and aligned with customer expectations.

title: Data Engineer (Senior Consultant)
description:
The Data Engineer works closely with statisticians, analytical teams, and business stakeholders to design, build, and maintain the data infrastructure needed to support rigorous statistical production processes. The role centres on building reliable and maintainable data pipelines, validation and frameworks that support statistical production processes, while providing technical leadership across the engineering team.

You will work closely with the user team on the business needs, translate them into robust technical solutions and lead in the modernisation of legacy processes. This includes ensuring that existing business logic is preserved and that outputs are accurately reconciled against current production results. In addition, you will provide technical guidance on solution design, engineering standards, and implementation approaches to ensure the team delivers production-quality solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leads the architecture, design, and implementation of ETL processes, workflows, and data pipelines for the ingestion, transformation, and integration of data from multiple source agencies.
  • Build and maintain efficient and reliable large-scale batch and real-time data pipelines with data processing frameworks, including dependency management, failure handling, recovery, and operational monitoring.
  • Develop and maintain modular, production-quality code for statistical production processes, including uplifting of legacy processes while preserving business logic and reconciling outputs against existing results. Review complex business logic and provide technical direction for migration and modernisation activities.
  • Lead database and data model design, including schema design, storage patterns and performance optimisation for large-scale statistical datasets.
  • Design and drive the adoption of reusable data engineering components such as common libraries, configuration frameworks, logging standards, and utilities to streamline production workflows and promote consistent engineering practices across the team.
  • Design and implement CI/CD for data engineering workflows to automate testing and deployment, and establish workflows to safely isolate and synchronise Development, UAT, and Production environments.
  • Lead the design and configuration of complex pipeline workflows and schedules using enterprise tools, including dependency management, failure handling, recovery and operational monitoring.
  • Establish version control structures using GitLab, set up code review frameworks, and document technical architectures. Provide technical reviews for solution designs, merge requests and implementation approaches, and promote appropriate engineering standards across the development team.
  • Troubleshoot production incidents, monitor pipeline health, and continuously optimise system performance for large-scale datasets. Lead the investigation of complex production issues, identify root causes, and implement preventive and performance improvement measures.
  • Lead and provide technical guidance and mentoring to data engineers, including support on coding practices, solution design, troubleshooting and implementation decisions.
  • Collaborate with technical team, business users and other stakeholders to translate complex business and statistical processing requirements into robust technical solutions.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies and improvement opportunities, and recommend appropriate design or implementation approaches.

Required Skills & Experience

  • At least 7 years of professional experience in data engineering, data platform development, or a related software engineering role, with demonstrated experience designing and implementing production-grade data solutions at scale.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience in complex data transformations, analysis, and quality monitoring, with the ability to design, review and optimise complex processing logic.
  • Strong experience with batch processing, ETL, data integration and data pipeline architecture.
  • Strong working knowledge of Linux/Unix environments, shell scripting and command-line tools for data processing
  • Strong understanding and practical application of software engineering practices such as modular design, configuration management, logging, exception handling, testing, and technical documentation, with experience defining or applying engineering standards for production systems.
  • Experience with designing technical solutions and making engineering trade-off decisions involving performance, maintainability, scalability and operational reliability.
  • Experience with leading or providing technical guidance for data pipeline development, system migration or modernisation initiatives.
  • Experience with conducting code reviews and mentoring or providing technical guidance.
  • Experience with version control using Git, including branching strategies, merge requests, code review, and CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment
  • Experience with cloud platforms and orchestration/CI-CD tooling is preferred.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently in an agile team environment while providing technical leadership when resolving complex engineering problems.

title: Paper Roll Clamp Operator
description:
POSITION: Clamp Truck Operator

Location: Pratt Specialty Sheets - PSS

Shift: 2nd Shift (3PM - 11PM) OT may be required

3rd Shift (11PM - 7AM) OT may be required

POSITION SUMMARY

We are seeking an experienced, precision-driven Clamp Truck Operator to anchor our material handling and roll stock operations. In this role, you won't just move paper, you will optimize warehouse flow, manage high-value roll stock inventory with zero-damage efficiency, and serve as a critical link in keeping our high-speed corrugator running at peak performance. If you are a safety-first operator who thrives in a fast-paced environment and knows how to manage a warehouse layout strategically, we want you on our team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Precision Operation: Expertly operate clamp trucks and heavy-duty forklifts to transport, stack, and stage massive paper rolls safely and efficiently.
  • Inventory & Schedule Optimization: Read and interpret corrugator lineups fluidly. Adhere to the daily production schedule while proactively recommending adjustments to optimize cost, quality, delivery, and service goals.
  • Smart Stock Management: Strategic staging of rolls to the corrugator (prioritizing buttrolls), accurately recording inventory movement, and meticulously grading/marking returning stock (size, diameter, lineal footage).
  • Inbound Logistics & Quality Control: Unload incoming trailers, expertly inspecting rolls for physical damage and documenting discrepancies to protect product integrity.
  • Warehouse Leadership: Maintain a highly organized, clean, and audit-ready warehouse layout to maximize space utilization and operational speed.
  • Equipment Stewardship: Conduct thorough pre-shift inspections, identifying and submitting detailed maintenance work orders to minimize equipment downtime.
  • Mentorship & Collaboration: Assist in the training of doublebacker and dry-end personnel, sharing your expertise to elevate team safety and efficiency.
  • Safety & Compliance: Serve as a champion for plant safety, maintaining full compliance with company policies, MSDS protocols, and emergency chemical spill procedures.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Education: High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Proven Expertise: Demonstrated, hands-on experience safely operating clamp trucks and forklifts in a heavy industrial, manufacturing, or paper/corrugated environment (highly preferred).
  • Technical Savvy: Strong understanding of roll stock management, inventory tracking, and corrugator production flows.
  • Leadership Traits: A proactive problem-solver who can work autonomously, guide junior team members, and interface effectively with corrugator supervisors.
  • Fast-Paced Resilience: Proven ability to manage competing priorities calmly and safely in a high-volume, continuous manufacturing environment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

Physical Demands: This role requires active, hands-on engagement. Operators are regularly required to stand, walk, climb in/out of equipment, and use hands/arms to manipulate controls and tools. Frequent stooping, kneeling, or crouching may be required. Must possess excellent spatial awareness, depth perception, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment: You will operate in a dynamic, high-energy industrial manufacturing plant. Expect regular exposure to moving mechanical parts, varying humidity/temperatures, and loud noise levels. Safety gear (PPE) is strictly required and provided.

Is this your next role?

Heartland is an NZX/ASX-listed financial services group with big growth plans. Heartland owns both Heartland Bank in New Zealand and Heartland Bank in Australia. Heartland's strategy is to digitalise everything we do, enabling us to provide customers with what they need in a scalable way. We can then pass those benefits onto the customer through faster service and better rates.

Can you see yourself here?

We're committed to creating a culture of inclusivity that celebrates our diverse backgrounds and supports the wellbeing of our people. We offer real opportunities for learning and career development. At Heartland, we're proud to celebrate the many characteristics that make each of us different. Heartland is an equal opportunity employer. We strongly encourage everyone to apply and we welcome everyone to the team. description:
Job Description

POSITION TITLE: Corrugating Lead

REPORTS TO: Corrugating Supervisor

SUMMARY

Assist Supervisor on the floor with approximately 2 – 30 people in the daily routine of producing quality corrugated products in a safe, productive manner with minimum waste. Also, he/she will need to Cross-train employees in key positions.

Base Pay of $26.40, plus $1.00 Shift Differential

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain quality, efficiencies, and production levels set by management. Communicate these standards to your staff.
  • Report quality concerns to Corrugating and Plant Superintendent. Assist in determining quality guidelines.
  • Establish high morale within your department by showing fairness, consistency, and an interest in employee problems. Maintain confidentiality.
  • Maintain inventories of sheets, inks and other converting supplies.
  • Coordinate with your supervisor and Maintenance Superintendent on any repairs or preventive maintenance done in the department.
  • Keep upper management informed of problems or situations that may affect the performance of your department.
  • Enforce the corrective action procedures when applicable and conduct meetings with the violating employees.
  • Assist with weekly Production/Safety meetings with departmental personnel.
  • Communicate with necessary supervision to avoid problems between shift changes.
  • Improve career skills by enrolling yourself in seminars, technical courses, and related college courses.
  • Implement, maintain, and support all company policies and procedures, safety program, and good housekeeping.
  • Comply with company policies and procedures.
  • Additional duties may be assigned by management.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:

Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Able to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.

The ability to write routine reports and correspondence.

The ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation. This also supports the supervisor's role of teacher and trainer for his/her personnel.

Cost issues in order to make daily decisions that will reduce overall costs and will help the supervisor find areas that require improvement.

Quality standards.

Regulatory requirements including but not limited to wage and hour requirements, environmental and waste minimization, company policies, and personnel requirements including OSHA, DEQ and EEO.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES

The individual must possess the following:

  • Superior time management skills including the ability to manage multiple issues concurrently and the ability to lead an effective and efficient meeting.
  • Teaching skills in order to function effectively as a teacher for his the technical and administrative parts of the position.
  • Excellent crisis manager who demonstrates that he/she has a high emotional control under adverse conditions and can lead his/her personnel to a successful resolution.
  • Demonstrated confidence including providing a consistent leadership style with an acceptable level of professional assertiveness.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

The performance of the supervisor will be measured as follows:

  • Operating standards - the Production Lead will need to meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the supervisor.
  • Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the supervisor to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the supervisor and his/her superior.
  • Employee relations - through observations the supervisor will be evaluated regarding his/her skills and advancements in the areas of motivational techniques and results, positive and corrective/constructive feedback, subordinate development and creating a positive work environment.
  • Creativity - this will be evaluated by how active the supervisor is in participating in advancing the business through new and innovative ideas.

title: Sisustusrakentaja, vakituinen, UUSIMAA
description:
Haemme ammattitaitoista sisustusrakentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Työmaat sijaitsevat pääasiassa Uudellamaalla. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme Epassin.
Kaikki sisustustimpurin työt tulee olla hallussa. Työnkuva on monipuolinen ja tehtäviin kuuluu myös esimerkiksi siivoamista ja tavaroiden hakua. Vähintään B-kortti tulee löytyä, mutta oma auto ei ole välttämätön. Työkielenä on suomen kieli.
Tässä tehtävässä noudatetaan rakennusalan työehtosopimusta. Palkka on tessin mukaan vähintään 17,12 € / h.
Työstä, asiakkaastamme ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää työhaastattelussa.
Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!


---



Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.

Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?

9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökysely

Muutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.

Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.

Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.

Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.

Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.

Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.

Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

Review and Analysis

1.Analyse the credit quality activities for Business Banking Credit Risk, identify early warning signals and recommend action plans to address any incident of breaching and anomalies while abiding by all the policies, SOPs, procedures & CBE Regulations to maintain and enhance the portfolio quality.

Risk Employees’ Awareness

13.Update all awareness materials with any relevant credit policies, processes and procedures amendments / update to cover the gaps identified from the conducted quality check, and ensure delivering comprehensive and accurate awareness sessions to maintain an outstanding performance of all employees.

Compliance

18.Comply with all relevant CBE regulations, banking laws, AML regulations and internal CIB policies and code of conduct in order to maintain CIB’s sound legal position and mitigate any potential risks.

title: Onboarding Engineer
description:

We are seeking an Onboarding Engineer to lead the technical implementation and coordination of customer onboarding in a fast-growing SaaS environment. This role combines hands-on engineering expertise with project management to ensure seamless integrations and successful customer launches. You will work closely with onboarding, customer success, and engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and deliver a consistent customer experience. Your work will directly influence customer retention, product adoption, and long-term growth. You will also help build scalable processes, documentation, and metrics to improve onboarding efficiency. This is an opportunity to shape technical onboarding practices while contributing to an innovative, AI-driven approach to partnership management.

  • Partner with the Onboarding Manager to coordinate the full onboarding lifecycle, from kickoff through go-live and handoff to Customer Success.

  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues, including integration failures, data synchronization problems, and configuration challenges.

  • Coordinate with Customer Success to ensure smooth transitions from onboarding to ongoing customer support.

  • Define, monitor, and improve onboarding success metrics, including time to first value, technical blockers, and integration completion rates.

  • Identify onboarding risks proactively, communicate potential delays, and recommend solutions to keep projects on track.

  • Support the Onboarding Manager in customer communications concerning technical requirements, implementation progress, and timelines.

  • Contribute to the growth of the onboarding function by helping establish scalable practices and mentoring future onboarding engineers.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with customer-facing implementation experience, excellent organizational abilities, and a collaborative approach. You should be comfortable managing multiple onboarding projects while communicating complex technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders.

    • 3–4 years of technical experience in B2B SaaS implementation, customer onboarding, or customer success engineering.

    • Hands-on experience with APIs, data integrations, technical configuration, and troubleshooting.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical customers and present implementation plans to leadership.

    • Experience managing customer implementations or onboarding projects throughout the full lifecycle, from kickoff to go-live.

    • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple customer onboardings and maintain close attention to detail.

    • Ability to collaborate effectively and build strong relationships across Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering.

    • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience demonstrating technical expertise.

      • Familiarity with partnership management or ecosystem tools.

title: Onboarding Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Onboarding Engineer based in Ireland.

We are seeking an Onboarding Engineer to lead the technical implementation and coordination of customer onboarding in a fast-growing SaaS environment. This role combines hands-on engineering expertise with project management to ensure seamless integrations and successful customer launches. You will work closely with onboarding, customer success, and engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and deliver a consistent customer experience. Your work will directly influence customer retention, product adoption, and long-term growth. You will also help build scalable processes, documentation, and metrics to improve onboarding efficiency. This is an opportunity to shape technical onboarding practices while contributing to an innovative, AI-driven approach to partnership management.

Accountabilities:

As an Onboarding Engineer, you will own the technical execution of customer implementations, ensuring that each onboarding progresses smoothly from initial kickoff to go-live and handoff. You will collaborate across teams to resolve issues, improve processes, and establish scalable technical standards.

  • Lead the technical setup of customer onboarding, including API integrations, data mapping, CRM configuration, authentication, and security setup.

  • Partner with the Onboarding Manager to coordinate the full onboarding lifecycle, from kickoff through go-live and handoff to Customer Success.

  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues, including integration failures, data synchronization problems, and configuration challenges.

  • Develop and maintain onboarding runbooks, integration guides, technical documentation, and repeatable implementation processes.

  • Collaborate with Engineering to escalate product issues, document bugs with clear reproduction steps, and advocate for product improvements that support successful onboarding.

  • Coordinate with Customer Success to ensure smooth transitions from onboarding to ongoing customer support.

  • Define, monitor, and improve onboarding success metrics, including time to first value, technical blockers, and integration completion rates.

  • Identify onboarding risks proactively, communicate potential delays, and recommend solutions to keep projects on track.

  • Support the Onboarding Manager in customer communications concerning technical requirements, implementation progress, and timelines.

  • Contribute to the growth of the onboarding function by helping establish scalable practices and mentoring future onboarding engineers.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with customer-facing implementation experience, excellent organizational abilities, and a collaborative approach. You should be comfortable managing multiple onboarding projects while communicating complex technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders.

    • 3–4 years of technical experience in B2B SaaS implementation, customer onboarding, or customer success engineering.

    • Hands-on experience with APIs, data integrations, technical configuration, and troubleshooting.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical customers and present implementation plans to leadership.

    • Experience managing customer implementations or onboarding projects throughout the full lifecycle, from kickoff to go-live.

    • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple customer onboardings and maintain close attention to detail.

    • Familiarity with CRM integrations, particularly Salesforce or HubSpot, or comparable enterprise tools, is an advantage.

    • A consultative mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs, ask thoughtful questions, and proactively recommend solutions.

    • A strong commitment to quality, including identifying potential issues early and implementing measures to prevent recurring problems.

    • Ability to collaborate effectively and build strong relationships across Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering.

    • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience demonstrating technical expertise.

      • Nice to Have:

      • Experience with Bubble.io, n8n, or other low-code/no-code platforms.

      • Familiarity with partnership management or ecosystem tools.

      • Experience creating technical documentation, implementation guides, or knowledge bases.

      • Knowledge of AWS Lambda or similar serverless architectures.

        • Benefits:

        • Competitive salary and benefits package.

        • Stock options offering an opportunity to participate in the company's growth.

        • The opportunity to directly influence customer onboarding quality, retention, and expansion.

        • A hybrid technical and operational role with potential for progression into leadership.

        • Close collaboration with experienced onboarding and Customer Success professionals.

        • The opportunity to contribute to a high-growth, profitable SaaS business operating at the forefront of AI-driven innovation.

title: Senior Data Engineers
description:
Job Responsibilities



  1. Own the construction and maintenance of the company’s business data ingestion system. Responsible for the full lifecycle development of real-time collection, cleaning, and warehousing of business logs, user behavioral data, and database operational data, ensuring the completeness, timeliness, and stability of end-to-end data ingestion pipelines.


  2. Lead the implementation and iterative optimization of the real-time data warehouse architecture. Design multi-layer real-time data models, develop and tune streaming ETL pipelines, and support the stable output of real-time metrics, dashboards, and business monitoring data.


  3. Collaborate closely with business teams, data analysts, and data product managers. Fully understand business logic and statistical calibers, independently complete data requirement decomposition, logical sorting, development implementation, release verification, and continuous iteration.


  4. Maintain and optimize Kafka streaming pipelines for real-time data ingestion and consumption. Troubleshoot and resolve core online issues including message backlog, data skew, data loss and duplication, and ensure high availability and stability of real-time data pipelines.


  5. Develop, tune, and operate Spark real-time tasks. Continuously optimize computing resource utilization, data latency, and throughput, and improve the overall performance and stability of streaming data pipelines.


  6. Participate in data standardization construction, real-time data quality governance, and pipeline redundancy optimization. Summarize and standardize data ingestion specifications and development best practices to improve the overall team’s data development efficiency.


  7. Provide stable real-time data support for downstream business scenarios including BI dashboards, data services, user portrait platforms, and business effectiveness measurement, ensuring reliable online data service delivery.



Job Requirements



  1. Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or related majors. 3+ years of professional big data development experience in the internet industry, with proven experience in end-to-end real-time data warehouse implementation and data ingestion system construction.


  2. Proficient in English reading, writing and verbal communication skills, capable of collaborating with overseas teams and business stakeholders. Overseas study or work experience is highly preferred.


  3. Expert-level knowledge of Kafka. Familiar with real-time data ingestion, partition strategy, consumer mechanism, and capable of diagnosing and optimizing online risks such as message backlog, data skew, data loss and duplication; experienced in large-scale streaming pipeline stability governance.


  4. Hands-on experience with Spark, Spark SQL, Flink and Flink SQL. Solid capabilities in streaming task development, resource tuning, latency and throughput optimization, and online troubleshooting. Familiar with real-time data warehouse layered architecture and dimensional modeling methodologies.


  5. Deep understanding of the big data ingestion system. Experienced in full-process real-time processing of multi-source data, including user behavior logs and business database data, proficient in real-time collection, CDC synchronization, data cleaning, and exception handling with standardized implementation capabilities.


  6. Practical experience with cloud-native data tools including BigQuery (BQ), DBT and Databricks. Capable of data warehouse modeling, pipeline orchestration, metric iteration and dashboard development in cloud data environments.


  7. Proficient in at least one programming language among Python, Scala and Java with solid hands-on big data development capabilities. Familiar with Linux commands and Shell scripting, able to independently complete task deployment, log analysis and daily operation maintenance.


  8. Familiar with mainstream relational databases and Binlog/CDC real-time synchronization principles. Experienced in business database real-time ingestion implementation. Knowledgeable in real-time data SLA governance, data quality monitoring, alert configuration and incident review mechanisms.


  9. Experience with Google Cloud, Azure or other mainstream cloud big data platforms, as well as overseas team collaboration and real-time data governance experience is highly preferred.

title: Finance Director
description:
As Finance Director, you will be responsible for overseeing and optimizing the Company's financial standing by guiding financial policies, assessing risks, determining funding opportunities, and advising on investment opportunities. This position requires a deep understanding of financial markets, risk management, liquidity management, capital structure and international financial regulations. The position will serve as a member of the Finance Leadership Team and collaborate closely across the finance department to ensure effective cash management, financial risk mitigation, and capital deployment.

You will also have responsibility for ad hoc finance related projects and programs related to the operation of the organization, as determined by executive leadership.

Key Responsibilities Include:

Strategic, Financial and Operational Planning and Execution

  • Assess and recommend improvements to the company’s capital structure to optimize cost of capital, balance financial risk, and support growth initiatives.
  • Lead the assessment of the financial implications of mergers and acquisitions, capital investments, and other strategic initiatives.

Cash Management

  • Manage the company's cash flows, ensuring that there is sufficient liquidity to meet operational needs and strategic objectives. This includes overseeing cash forecasting, optimizing cash positions, and managing bank relationships.
  • Identify day-to-day operations improvements to improve internal efficiencies, increase internal controls and reduce risks.

Risk Management

  • Develop and implement strategies to manage financial and operational risks related to currency fluctuations and interest rate exposures.
  • Monitor and analyze market trends to proactively identify potential risks and opportunities.
  • Implement hedging strategies to mitigate the impact of foreign exchange and interest rate fluctuations. Evaluate foreign exchange risk and risk mitigation strategies including fx hedging opportunities.
  • Establish and maintain financial risk management policies, procedures, and guidelines; ensure compliance with applicable regulations, reporting requirements, and disclosure standards.

External Financial Relations

  • Manage external relationships with financial institutions and 3rd party service providers to optimize service and cost.
  • Maintain and cultivate relationships with existing lenders, while onboarding new strategic lenders to support the growth of our organization.
  • Actively respond to lenders requests for information.

Compliance and Regulatory Reporting

  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulations and reporting requirements related to treasury activities. This includes staying updated on relevant regulatory changes and implementing necessary controls and procedure.

Qualifications:

  • 8-10 years minimum of Finance and/or Accounting or Treasury required
  • Strong broad-based knowledge of capital and currency markets, accounting, finance, and tax
  • Excellent business-savvy; ability to influence and collaborate with senior level leaders
  • Collaborative team player with a hands-on approach; a roll-up-the-sleeves mentality
  • Strong track record of success in driving execution and delivering business results
  • Solid analytical and quantitative skills.
  • Excellent verbal, written and presentation communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy, for dealing with company funds and managing substantial contracts and capital funding projects

Preferred:

  • Advanced education or certification such as MBA, CTP, or CFA is preferred

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Full-time, permanent | Hybrid: two days a week in our Chandlers Ford office | £40,000 to £52,000 depending on experience

The opportunity

We're looking for a full-stack developer who can build and own production web applications, and who wants to grow into leading the technical side of client projects, from the first conversation through to a fully scoped, documented and working application.

You’ll work with Next.js, React and TypeScript, using Claude Code and similar tools as part of your everyday workflow. From day one you’ll take real ownership of builds. Over time, with support from the Managing Director and our business analyst, you’ll take the lead on technical discovery, specifications and estimates. This is a hands‑on role with real influence over our technical decisions and how we deliver projects.

About Onlined

Onlined is a digital agency based in Chandlers Ford, with around 20 years of experience in web design, development, SEO and digital marketing.

We’re a small team with long-standing client relationships and a growing portfolio of bespoke application development. You’ll work directly with the Managing Director and alongside colleagues in design, development, business analysis and project management.

You’ll see projects through from beginning to end, know the people you’re building for and have the freedom to improve how we work. We often have several client projects running at once, so balancing priorities and communicating clearly matters.

What you’ll do: development and delivery

  • Own technical delivery from the agreed specification through architecture, development, testing, deployment and ongoing improvements.
  • Build applications using Next.js, React and TypeScript, working across interfaces, APIs, databases and integrations.
  • Set up and maintain repositories, development environments and deployment pipelines.
  • Use Claude Code and other AI development tools effectively, reviewing and validating their output.
  • Build security, accessibility, performance and maintainability into your work.
  • Test applications against the agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Communicate progress, risks and scope changes clearly with colleagues and clients.

What you’ll grow into: discovery, scoping and documentation

  • Join client discovery meetings and, over time, lead the technical side of them.
  • Turn requirements into clear technical documentation: functionality, user roles and permissions, user journeys, data structures, integrations and non‑functional requirements.
  • Identify gaps, assumptions, dependencies and edge cases, and help resolve them before development starts.
  • Help produce scopes of work with clear acceptance criteria, break them into practical phases and contribute to realistic estimates.
  • Keep documentation up to date as decisions are made and requirements evolve.

You’ll work closely with our business analyst and project managers, and agree estimates and delivery plans with the Managing Director. Commercial negotiations and closing sales remain with the Managing Director.

Some existing client websites use WordPress and WooCommerce. Other team members handle their day‑to‑day development and maintenance, but you may occasionally help with a more complex issue or integration.

What we’re looking for

  • Commercial experience building and maintaining production web applications, typically three years or more.
  • Strong React experience, with Next.js and TypeScript experience or the technical depth to become productive in them quickly.
  • Confidence across the full stack, including APIs, databases, data modelling, authentication and deployment.
  • Practical experience building software with Claude Code or equivalent AI coding tools, and a willingness to use Claude Code in this role.
  • Sound engineering judgement: you can understand, review, debug and improve AI‑generated code.
  • A practical approach to testing, validation and reliable releases.
  • Strong attention to detail across code, documentation and interface quality.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical decisions to clients and non‑technical colleagues.
  • An interest in working with clients and growing into discovery, scoping and specification.
  • The ability to work independently, take responsibility and ask for input when needed.

Useful additional experience

  • Taking client requirements through discovery, scoping and technical documentation.
  • Working in a digital agency or consultancy across multiple client projects.
  • Experience with Astro for building fast, content‑focused websites.
  • Reviewing code, mentoring developers or helping improve development practices.
  • Third‑party integrations and connecting business systems.
  • An eye for interface quality, usability and detail.
  • WordPress or WooCommerce experience.

How we work with AI

AI is central to how we plan, document and build. We want someone who enjoys exploring what these tools make possible and can recognise where they fall short.

You’ll have room to experiment with better workflows and help shape our approach. You’ll also be responsible for checking the accuracy of AI‑assisted documentation and understanding the code that gets shipped. Specifications must reflect agreed client requirements, and applications must be reviewed and tested against them.

What we offer

  • £40,000 to £52,000 depending on experience.
  • A clear path into technical leadership, client discovery and solution design.
  • Hybrid working: two days a week in our Chandlers Ford office, with flexibility around how those days are arranged.
  • Flexible working around core hours.
  • 31 days' holiday including bank holidays, plus your birthday off.
  • Budget and time for learning, tools and experimentation.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions and how we deliver projects.
  • A small, friendly team where your contribution is visible and your ideas are heard.

Links to live projects, GitHub or a portfolio are welcome, but not essential. If your work is confidential, a brief description of the project and your role is absolutely fine.

You must have the right to work in the UK. We’re unable to offer visa sponsorship. This is a hybrid position, so you’ll need to be able to attend our Chandlers Ford office two days a week.

title: Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist
description:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist to manage provider enrollment, credentialing, and medical billing operations in a remote healthcare environment. In this role, you will coordinate with insurance payers, healthcare providers, and internal teams to ensure accurate documentation, timely claims processing, and reliable reimbursement. You will oversee credentialing applications and renewals while maintaining compliance with payer requirements and applicable healthcare regulations. Your expertise in insurance billing, coding, and claims resolution will help minimize denials and prevent delays in provider network participation. You will also monitor payment discrepancies, maintain comprehensive records, and identify opportunities to improve revenue cycle processes. This is an opportunity to contribute to efficient healthcare administration while supporting providers and delivering operational accuracy.

Accountabilities:

As a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist, you will oversee the full lifecycle of provider credentialing, insurance enrollment, and claims management. You will ensure that provider records remain accurate, billing activities meet payer requirements, and reimbursement issues are addressed promptly through effective coordination and follow-up.

  • Prepare and submit credentialing applications for new healthcare providers across commercial insurance carriers, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care organizations.

  • Manage provider re-credentialing within required timelines to prevent lapses in insurance network participation.

  • Maintain accurate provider information in credentialing databases, payer portals, and related systems.

  • Coordinate with providers to collect required documentation, professional licenses, certifications, and signatures.

  • Review, prepare, and submit medical insurance claims accurately using electronic health record (EHR) and billing systems.

  • Monitor claim status through payer portals, manage claim edits and rejections, and coordinate necessary adjustments.
