  • Reconcile daily, weekly, and monthly payment reports and maintain accurate billing records.

  • Investigate claim denials and rejections, prepare supporting documentation, and submit timely appeals.

  • Maintain detailed follow-up logs to track outstanding claims through resolution.

  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, CMS requirements, payer policies, and applicable federal and state regulations.

  • Collaborate with clinical, administrative, and revenue cycle teams to resolve billing and credentialing issues.

  • Monitor changes in payer requirements, credentialing policies, and coding guidelines to maintain compliance.

  • Audit credentialing files for completeness and accuracy and prepare management reports on application progress, pending items, and compliance status.

  • Identify recurring payer issues and recommend process improvements to strengthen operational efficiency and reimbursement outcomes.

You should be highly organized, comfortable managing multiple deadlines, and able to communicate effectively with providers, insurance representatives, and internal stakeholders.

    • High school diploma or equivalent required; an associate or bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, or a related field is preferred.

    • At least two years of experience in medical credentialing, medical billing, or both, preferably working with multiple insurance payers.

    • Strong working knowledge of commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care credentialing and reimbursement processes.

    • Familiarity with CAQH ProView, NPPES, PECOS, Availity, payer portals, and EHR or medical billing software.

    • Demonstrated experience preparing accurate claims, resolving denials, following up on outstanding payments, and maintaining compliance with payer requirements.

    • Understanding of CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding systems, including modifier requirements.

    • Knowledge of provider enrollment, re-credentialing procedures, insurance eligibility verification, claim submission deadlines, and payer-specific policies.

    • Medical billing or coding certification, such as Certified Professional Biller (CPB), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), or an equivalent qualification, is an advantage.

    • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate, complete, and well-organized records.

    • Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple applications, claims, and deadlines simultaneously.

    • Effective written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with healthcare providers, insurance representatives, patients, and colleagues.

    • Proficiency in credentialing, billing, and documentation systems, with the ability to learn new tools and workflows.

    • Understanding of HIPAA, CMS, NCQA, and other applicable healthcare compliance standards.

Atlantic Health Strategies is recruiting on behalf of a specialized revenue cycle management (RCM) organization that partners with behavioral health and substance use disorder treatment providers to optimize financial performance and streamline administrative operations.

The organization provides comprehensive revenue cycle solutions, including medical billing, claims management, utilization review, provider credentialing, and reimbursement optimization. title: Baler Operator 2nd Shift
description:
POSITION TITLE: BALER OPERATOR - 2nd Shift (3pm-11pm)

Starting Wage: $17.60 per hour

REPORTS TO: Corrugator Supervisor

Overview
The Baler Operator is responsible for safely operating the baler and hogger systems to process scrap paper and corrugated material into neat, high-quality bales. This role requires attention to safety, housekeeping, and equipment upkeep while supporting production operations.


Key Duties & Responsibilities
Operate and Monitor Equipment
Operate the hogger and feed scrap safely into the system.
Run the baler to produce neat, consistent bales.
Watch for jams, stop equipment immediately if needed, and notify supervision or maintenance.
Follow lockout/tagout procedures before clearing jams or performing checks.


Safety & Compliance
Follow all company and OSHA safety rules, including use of PPE (gloves required in the baler room).
Never place hands or body parts in the baler or hogger areas.
Maintain awareness of forklift traffic, sound horn at cross-aisles, and drive cautiously when loading trailers.
Keep exits and walkways clear at all times.


Daily Operation & Housekeeping
Inspect baler and hogger area at the start of each shift; report issues to supervision.
Keep floors swept and free of wire, trash, or debris.
Bale and remove scrap as required, stacking bales correctly in trailers.
Maintain accurate bale reports and ensure scrap is tagged properly.


Shift Handoffs & Clean-Up
Communicate problems and concerns with incoming operator at shift change.
Clear scrap from behind ram, sweep and blow down baler and hogger, and empty trash cans.
Refuel forklift to at least half a tank before turnover.


Supplies & Maintenance
Monitor and maintain inventories of baling wire, tags, and supplies.
Turn in maintenance work orders for needed repairs; be proactive in reporting issues.
Assist with weekend clean-up by emptying buggies, baling remaining scrap, and dusting walls and support beams.


Other Duties
Perform additional tasks as assigned by management.


Qualifications
Ability to operate forklifts safely.
Strong attention to safety procedures and housekeeping standards.
Good communication skills for shift handoffs and teamwork.
Willingness to work in an industrial environment with dust, noise, and heavy equipment.

title: AI & DevOps Platform Engineer
description:
Bouw jij graag systemen die niet alleen technisch sterk zijn, maar ook écht het verschil maken? Dan hebben wij een bijzonder interessant project voor jou!

Voor een gevestigde Belgische transport- en logistieke groep in de regio Brugge zoeken we een AI Platform Engineer die mee de digitale toekomst van de organisatie vormgeeft.

Onze klant is een familiaal bedrijf met een sterke aanwezigheid binnen transport, distributie en warehousing. Dagelijks zorgen honderden medewerkers ervoor dat goederen efficiënt en betrouwbaar hun bestemming bereiken, zowel in België als internationaal.

Om die logistieke processen nog slimmer, efficiënter en transparanter te maken, investeert de organisatie volop in digitalisering, automatisering en artificiële intelligentie.

En daar kom jij in beeld.

Je krijgt de kans om een nieuw, bedrijfskritisch platform verder uit te bouwen, naar productie te brengen en technisch mee vorm te geven. Geen klassieke developmentfunctie waarin je uitsluitend tickets afwerkt, maar een rol waarin je zelf richting geeft aan de architectuur, technologie en toekomst van een innovatief platform.

Het project: een slimme Dispatching Hub

In een transportomgeving gebeurt er ontzettend veel tegelijk. Van vrachtwagens en magazijnen tot planningssystemen, klantenportalen en externe logistieke partners: alles moet op elkaar afgestemd blijven.

Om dat proces te vereenvoudigen, ontwikkelt onze klant een eigen Transport Hub.

Dit centrale platform brengt informatie uit verschillende systemen samen en helpt medewerkers om sneller beslissingen te nemen, afwijkingen proactief te detecteren en klanten beter te informeren.

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

  • Het samenbrengen van operationele data uit verschillende transport- en logistieke systemen.
  • Het automatiseren van manuele processen en repetitieve handelingen.
  • Het sneller detecteren en opvolgen van uitzonderingen binnen transportprocessen.
  • Het inzetten van AI om medewerkers te ondersteunen bij analyses en beslissingen.
  • Het ontwikkelen van betrouwbare integraties tussen interne toepassingen, klanten en externe partners.

Een eerste versie van het platform bestaat al. Aan jou om het verder te ontwikkelen, naar productie te brengen en klaar te maken voor de toekomst.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Transport Hub Engineer neem je een centrale rol op binnen het interne IT-team. Je combineert hands-on development met architectuur, integraties en technisch eigenaarschap. Je krijgt daarbij veel autonomie en werkt rechtstreeks samen met zowel technische collega's als de operationele business.

Concreet betekent dit:

  • Architectuur & technologie: Je analyseert de bestaande oplossing en bepaalt mee welke architectuur, technologieën en hostingomgeving het meest geschikt zijn.
  • Backend & platformontwikkeling: Je ontwikkelt schaalbare, onderhoudbare en betrouwbare backendfunctionaliteiten.
  • Integraties: Je bouwt en onderhoudt koppelingen tussen het Transport Management System (TMS), ERP, klantenportaal en externe logistieke partners.
  • AI & automatisering: Je integreert AI-toepassingen waar die concrete meerwaarde bieden en gebruikt AI-agents actief binnen je eigen developmentproces.
  • Productie & betrouwbaarheid: Je zorgt voor een stabiele productieomgeving met geautomatiseerde deployments, monitoring, alerting en een doordachte foutafhandeling.
  • Security & data: Je houdt rekening met databescherming, traceerbaarheid en relevante beveiligingsvereisten, waaronder NIS2 en GDPR.
  • Samenwerking met de business: Je overlegt met planners, klantendienst en logistieke medewerkers om hun uitdagingen te vertalen naar slimme technische oplossingen.

Je kijkt dus verder dan de code alleen. Je begrijpt waarom iets gebouwd wordt, kiest hoe je dat het best realiseert en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat.

Wie zoeken we?

We zoeken een ervaren Backend Developer, Software Engineer of Platform Engineer die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van complexe technische vraagstukken.

Je hoeft niet alle technologieën hieronder te beheersen. Sterke technische fundamenten, zelfstandigheid en de juiste mindset zijn minstens even belangrijk.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Minstens 5 jaar ervaring binnen backend development, software engineering of platform engineering.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen, naar productie brengen en onderhouden van backend- of integratiesystemen.
  • Grondige kennis van minstens één moderne, getypeerde programmeertaal, bijvoorbeeld C#/.NET, TypeScript/Node.js of Go.
  • Sterke ervaring met relationele databanken en SQL, inclusief datamodellering, transacties en performantieoptimalisatie.
  • Ervaring met API-integraties, asynchrone verwerking en betrouwbare systeemcommunicatie.
  • Kennis van softwarekwaliteit, testing, CI/CD en monitoring.
  • Praktische ervaring met AI coding agents binnen je dagelijkse ontwikkelwerk, waarbij je gegenereerde code kritisch evalueert.
  • Het vermogen om zelfstandig technische beslissingen te nemen en deze helder toe te lichten.
  • Een zeer goede kennis van het Nederlands.

Daarbij zijn volgende ervaringen mooi meegenomen:

  • Containertechnologieën zoals Docker of Kubernetes.
  • Infrastructure as Code en GitOps.
  • Event-driven architectuur en message processing.
  • EDI-integraties of andere B2B-koppelingen.
  • LLM-integraties en AI-functionaliteiten in productie.
  • Ervaring met logistieke software, TMS, WMS of ERP.
  • Modernisering of integratie van bestaande legacysystemen.
  • Basiskennis Frans.

Waarom is deze functie interessant?

Dit is geen rol waarin je instapt in een volledig vastgelegde technische omgeving. Je komt terecht in een organisatie die bewust ruimte laat om technologische keuzes te maken. De focus ligt niet op zoveel mogelijk tools gebruiken, maar op slimme, betrouwbare en toekomstgerichte software bouwen.

Je werkt vanuit enkele duidelijke principes: open standaarden, Europese hosting, security by design, sterke automatisering en een platform dat ook door een compact team beheerd kan worden.

Bovendien krijg je de kans om een platform mee uit te bouwen dat rechtstreeks invloed heeft op de dagelijkse werking van een grote transportorganisatie.

Wat mag je verwachten?

  • Echte technische autonomie: Je denkt mee over architectuur, technologie en de verdere evolutie van het platform.
  • Zichtbare impact: Wat je ontwikkelt, wordt dagelijks gebruikt door medewerkers in planning, logistiek en klantendienst.
  • Een innovatief AI-project: Je werkt in een omgeving waar AI en automatisering actief worden ingezet en verder ontwikkeld.
  • Een compact en toegankelijk IT-team: Je werkt nauw samen met andere developers, IT-specialisten en het management.
  • Korte beslissingslijnen: Geen eindeloze goedkeuringsprocessen, maar ruimte om initiatief te nemen en ideeën te realiseren.
  • Persoonlijke ontwikkeling: Mogelijkheden voor opleidingen, certificeringen en doorgroei naar technisch eigenaarschap.
  • Een stabiele, familiale werkomgeving: Je komt terecht in een gevestigde organisatie met een mensgerichte cultuur en langetermijnvisie.
  • Een marktconform salarispakket, afgestemd op jouw ervaring en expertise.

Praktisch

  • Locatie: Regio Brugge, West-Vlaanderen
  • Werkregime: Voltijds
  • Ervaringsniveau: Medior tot senior (minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring)
  • Startdatum: Zo snel mogelijk, in onderling overleg

Klaar om meer te bouwen dan alleen software?

Ben jij een engineer die graag zelf beslissingen neemt, complexe integraties doorgrondt en technologie wil inzetten om echte operationele uitdagingen op te lossen?

Dan is dit een mooie kans om jouw technische expertise te combineren met autonomie, innovatie en tastbare impact.

We vertellen je graag meer over het project, het team en de mogelijkheden.

title: Tooling Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Tooling Coordinator- 3rd Shift

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 11:00 PM – 7:00 AM

Occasionally Saturdays and Overtime

Primary Responsibilities:

As a Tooling Coordinator you will play a crucial role in maintaining and organizing tooling for production machinery. Your responsibilities will include inspecting, staging, and storing cutting dies and print plates, ensuring all necessary tools are available for scheduled jobs, and coordinating tooling repairs or replacements. You’ll work in a fast-paced environment, ensuring operational efficiency, safety, and compliance with quality standards.

Key Duties and Success Factors

  • Ensure all tooling and equipment are properly handled, stored, and maintained to prevent workplace hazards. Follow all safety protocols when lifting or moving heavy dies and plates.
  • Inspect all dies and plates for damage or wear, ensuring only quality tooling is used in production. Document and report any repairs or replacements needed.
  • Conduct scheduled walkthroughs to verify tooling availability at machines, remove unused tools, and organize storage locations. Assign and log tooling numbers for easy tracking.
  • Maintain accurate records of tooling assignments and updates. Assist with scanning and documenting print cards and CADs in the system when applicable.
  • Notify supervisors and relevant departments about tooling repairs or modifications, ensuring smooth production operations. Maintain die spreadsheets and track inventory.
  • Collaborate with supervisors, machine operators, and other team members to ensure tooling readiness. Assist in lifting and moving heavier tools as needed.
  • Additional duties may be assigned by management.

title: Nonpoint Source and Wetlands Section Supervisor
description:
The Montana Department of Environmental Quality is seeking a Section Supervisor to lead the Nonpoint Source and Wetlands Section within the Water Quality Planning Bureau. The section administers programs that protect and restore water quality from the harmful effects of nonpoint source pollution and provides statewide leadership for wetland conservation activities.

The Section Supervisor provides strategic, operational, and personnel leadership for the section; ensures effective implementation of agency, division, and bureau priorities; and works closely with the Bureau Chief to establish direction, identify emerging issues and controversy, and evaluate program effectiveness.

Core duties

  • Lead, supervise, and support staff by communicating priorities and expectations; developing annual work plans; providing timely performance feedback; and advancing professional development.
  • Direct day-to-day section operations and align work with DEQ strategic plans, Water Quality Division priorities, and applicable state and federal requirements.
  • Coordinate with Water Quality Division programs—including monitoring and assessment, water-quality standards and modeling, permitting programs, and TMDL development—to support an integrated water-quality improvement process.
  • Provide statewide leadership for nonpoint source pollution management and wetland conservation, including water-quality protection, restoration, planning, outreach, and project support.
  • Manage program funding and budgets in accordance with statutory, grant, and other funding-source requirements; establish fiscally responsible goals; monitor expenditures; and evaluate results.
  • Implement policies, procedures, and continuous-improvement practices that promote efficient operations, accountability, and effective program delivery.
  • Build and maintain productive relationships with local, state, federal, Tribal, nonprofit, and other stakeholders; foster communication among diverse interests; and pursue collaborative, locally supported solutions to water-quality challenges.
  • Represent the Section in internal and external coordination efforts, communicate program needs and accomplishments, and keep the Bureau Chief informed of significant issues, risks, and opportunities.

Program context

Montana’s Nonpoint Source and Wetlands Section addresses diffuse sources of water pollution and supports watershed-based protection and restoration efforts. The program emphasizes collaboration, community-driven watershed approaches, voluntary implementation of best practices, and coordination with partners to protect beneficial uses of Montana waters.

DEQ’s mission is to champion a healthy environment for a thriving Montana. The Department values leadership, accountability, customer service, efficiency, excellence, sound decision-making, professional growth, and cross-agency collaboration.

This position includes a career ladder that supports professional development and pay progression.

Support the development of future Technical Leads and Managers through structured opportunities, clear accountability, and ongoing feedback.

Collaborate with Technical Leads and Project Managers to identify delivery risks, capacity constraints, dependencies, and recovery needs without taking over their respective responsibilities.

  • Hiring and onboarding: Partner with senior leadership to define workforce needs, establish role requirements, develop structured interview processes, and evaluate candidates using consistent criteria. Coordinate onboarding plans, including role expectations, access, learning objectives, stakeholder introductions, and 30-, 60-, and 90-day milestones.
  • Leadership collaboration and role clarity: Work closely with Technical Leads responsible for team-level technical direction, Architects responsible for cross-team architecture, Project Managers responsible for integrated delivery coordination, and Product Owners and Business Analysts responsible for product priorities and requirements.   • Team culture and employee engagement: Foster an environment where employees can raise concerns, discuss risks, challenge assumptions, and share mistakes without fear of retaliation. Address interpersonal conflicts, workload imbalances, employee relations concerns, and retention risks through appropriate management processes while maintaining confidentiality.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist based in Italy.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist to manage provider enrollment, credentialing, and medical billing operations in a remote healthcare environment. In this role, you will coordinate with insurance payers, healthcare providers, and internal teams to ensure accurate documentation, timely claims processing, and reliable reimbursement. You will oversee credentialing applications and renewals while maintaining compliance with payer requirements and applicable healthcare regulations. Your expertise in insurance billing, coding, and claims resolution will help minimize denials and prevent delays in provider network participation. You will also monitor payment discrepancies, maintain comprehensive records, and identify opportunities to improve revenue cycle processes. This is an opportunity to contribute to efficient healthcare administration while supporting providers and delivering operational accuracy.

Accountabilities:

As a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist, you will oversee the full lifecycle of provider credentialing, insurance enrollment, and claims management. You will ensure that provider records remain accurate, billing activities meet payer requirements, and reimbursement issues are addressed promptly through effective coordination and follow-up.

  • Prepare and submit credentialing applications for new healthcare providers across commercial insurance carriers, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care organizations.

  • Manage provider re-credentialing within required timelines to prevent lapses in insurance network participation.

  • Maintain accurate provider information in credentialing databases, payer portals, and related systems.

  • Coordinate with providers to collect required documentation, professional licenses, certifications, and signatures.

  • Review, prepare, and submit medical insurance claims accurately using electronic health record (EHR) and billing systems.

  • Apply appropriate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes, including relevant modifiers, in accordance with applicable billing guidelines.

  • Apply payer-specific policies, fee schedules, and filing deadlines to support accurate and timely claims processing.

  • Monitor claim status through payer portals, manage claim edits and rejections, and coordinate necessary adjustments.

  • Post insurance payments, contractual adjustments, and write-offs accurately, identifying underpayments and payment discrepancies.

  • Reconcile daily, weekly, and monthly payment reports and maintain accurate billing records.

  • Investigate claim denials and rejections, prepare supporting documentation, and submit timely appeals.

  • Maintain detailed follow-up logs to track outstanding claims through resolution.

  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, CMS requirements, payer policies, and applicable federal and state regulations.

  • Collaborate with clinical, administrative, and revenue cycle teams to resolve billing and credentialing issues.

  • Serve as a liaison between healthcare providers and insurance payers, resolving enrollment discrepancies and network participation issues.

  • Monitor changes in payer requirements, credentialing policies, and coding guidelines to maintain compliance.

  • Maintain credentialing logs, spreadsheets, databases, and expiration-date trackers to ensure deadlines are met.

  • Audit credentialing files for completeness and accuracy and prepare management reports on application progress, pending items, and compliance status.

  • Identify recurring payer issues and recommend process improvements to strengthen operational efficiency and reimbursement outcomes.

You should be highly organized, comfortable managing multiple deadlines, and able to communicate effectively with providers, insurance representatives, and internal stakeholders.

    • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate, complete, and well-organized records.

    • Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple applications, claims, and deadlines simultaneously.

    • Effective written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with healthcare providers, insurance representatives, patients, and colleagues.

    • Proficiency in credentialing, billing, and documentation systems, with the ability to learn new tools and workflows.

    • Understanding of HIPAA, CMS, NCQA, and other applicable healthcare compliance standards.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform
description:
Job Description

About Empyrean

Empyrean Solutions is the fastest growing financial risk management and performance solutions platform, specifically designed for banks and credit unions. Since 2008, we've been trusted by financial institutions across the globe to deliver cutting-edge ALM, budgeting, profitability analysis, and compliance tools through our unified Empyrean Dataverse® platform. Our solutions emphasize speed, accuracy, and ease of use to help financial institutions make faster, more informed decisions.

At Empyrean Solutions, you won't just have a seat at the table - you'll help build it. Every person here has a direct, visible impact on where we go next. You'll work alongside a genuinely collaborative team, backed by AI tools available to every employee from day one.

The role

The Data Platform will be the home of all Empyrean data. Some products already run on it, others are moving over now, and new products, including our AI and reporting products, will be built on it from the start. The services, interfaces and patterns you build now are the ones they'll all run on. Over the next two to three years, volume per customer grows from a few million rows a month to more than 100 million rows a day.

We're hiring a senior software engineer to build that platform the way you'd build any enterprise SaaS backend, with services that load each record exactly once, contracts that don't break the products downstream, and tenants that can't see each other's data. You don't need a data engineering background. You do need to have shipped and run production backend systems, and you need to care whether the data is correct.

You'll join a platform team of four to five engineers and test automation engineers, working with a data architect who sets platform direction.

The role is hybrid requiring three 3 days a week in our office in Cork, Ireland.

What you'll work on

  • Event-driven ingestion services. Build the services that bring customer data onto the platform, delivering exactly-once results over at-least-once delivery. You know how they behave when things fail: retries, redelivery, reordering and late changes.

  • Versioned contracts and APIs. Build the interfaces, shared SDKs and data feeds that Empyrean products, and later our customers, use to read platform data. Keep them versioned, tested in CI and safe to evolve, so a platform change never surprises a team downstream.

  • Correct, reproducible results. Build point-in-time history and exact decimal arithmetic into the platform's types, tests and interfaces, so every product gets them by default, and any result can be reproduced exactly as it was on any past date.

  • Scale without runaway cost. Grow services and storage by orders of magnitude while keeping queries fast and costs rising more slowly than volume. Measure first, and back changes with load tests and cost data.

  • Self-service onboarding. Build the control-plane services and tooling that bring a new product or a new customer onto the platform in days, not months, within our multi-tenant model.

  • Data ready for AI and ML. Make customer data usable by models and AI features, with the same contracts, tenant separation and reproducibility as everything else on the platform.

  • Operability built in. Ship SLOs, alerting and CI gates with every service, and take part in incident response for what you own. Each incident ends with a fix that stops it recurring.

What you bring

  • 5+ years building software professionally, including backend services you designed, deployed and ran in production. We care more about what you've built and operated than about the count.

  • Production experience in Python, C#/.NET, Java or a similar backend language. Our platform services are mostly Python, and our shared data SDK and the products that use it are .NET. We use AI tooling heavily, so if you come from Java or another language, you'll pick up Python and C# quickly.

  • Instincts for distributed systems: idempotency, ordering, concurrency, retries, and what "exactly once" costs.

  • Testing as a habit: unit tests, integration tests against real dependencies, and CI that fails when it should.

  • Experience evolving APIs and schemas: versioning, backward compatibility, and moving consumers over without a big-bang cutover.

  • Strong SQL, and a working understanding of how a cloud data warehouse executes and bills a query.

  • You understand how multi-tenant software keeps each customer's data separate, and you build within that model: scoped service identities, least-privilege access, and no shortcuts.

  • You mentor through code review and pairing, and you leave behind patterns and docs that others can follow without you.

  • You write clearly. You measure before you propose a design, and your PRs say what changed, why, how you tested it and what could go wrong.

Nice to have

  • Experience with systems where exact numbers and audit history matter, such as payments, billing, ledgers or accounting.

Our stack

Python and C#/.NET, Snowflake, dbt, Terraform, Azure (Functions, Container Apps, Service Bus), GitHub Actions. Beyond a strong backend language, you don't need experience with any of these. You'll pick them up here.

How we work

  • Small team, high autonomy. You know how your area is designed, built and run in production. Our data architect owns the overall platform direction, and you bring evidence to those decisions.

  • AI-first. Claude Code and Cursor are part of how we build. We expect you to use them well, and to review what they produce as hard as you review your own work.

  • Significant decisions go through written RFCs with measured evidence.

  • Someone other than the author verifies every change, and code reviews have substance.

This probably isn't the role for you if

  • Your production experience is mostly notebooks or scheduled SQL, with no service you've had to keep running.

  • You'd rather deduplicate in a downstream query than fix why the duplicates arrive.

  • You work best from fully specified tickets.

description:
Company


We are a full service digital partner to our clients, working with them at every stage of a project lifecycle. We cover diverse problems including data science, artificial intelligence, digital first and digital by default.


From discovering user needs, designing and prototyping personalised experiences, to helping them build contemporary digital services, we are experts in user research and experience, service design, front and back-end development, secure continuous deployment on cloud, DevOps and more. Our specialists are familiar with the breadth of contemporary technology patterns. Our programmes have developed new pattern libraries, design systems and development aspects, many of which are open source. We support the transition to live running, for critical services dealing with millions of transactions every day, including 24/7 support.


We are experts in agile working, helping our clients work in an agile user centred way; transparent, open and honest.

title: Data & AI Engineer
description:
MEET AVIOBOOK

AvioBook is a global leader in cutting-edge software and unique hardware for the aviation industry. We revolutionised the Electronic Flight Bag (EFB) market with a product designed by pilots, for pilots. Today, we keep building smart, user-centric solutions that make airlines more efficient and simplify work for flight crews and operational teams.

For our HQ in Hasselt, we're looking for an experienced Data & AI Engineer who wants to build something from the ground up. Airlines worldwide use AvioBook every flight day, and every flight generates operational data. Turning that data into reliable, governed and AI-ready assets will power the next generation of intelligence in our products.

Your role

As our Data & AI Engineer, you own AvioBook's data foundation. Reporting to the CTO, you turn operational aviation data into the pipelines, models and datasets that power our AI products.

You'll tackle challenges such as:

  • Designing and building a data lake using a medallion architecture
  • Setting up end-to-end data governance: access control, lineage, cataloging, quality and retention
  • Building, training and evaluating predictive ML models for operational aviation use cases
  • Preparing datasets for RAG architectures, AI agents and LLM fine-tuning
  • Ensuring data is managed according to policy and industry expectations

As a founding engineer for data and AI, you set the architectural standards. You remain responsible for the quality and reliability of the data and models that our products and customers depend on.

How you'll work

You'll collaborate closely with Product Engineering, Operations and the teams managing data ingestion to understand their data and use cases and to ensure data reliability at the source. Together with our Compliance team, you make sure our data is governed the right way.

You'll package and hand off trained models to production, and work with Product Engineering to get them implemented and serving our customers.

YOU

  • Have proven experience owning data governance in a modern data lake or lakehouse, ideally Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake)
  • Have hands-on experience designing and building medallion-architecture pipelines, including schema design and automated data quality and validation
  • Have experience building, training, evaluating and packaging predictive ML models used in production
  • Have experience preparing datasets for GenAI use cases such as RAG and AI agents
  • Have strong Python and SQL skills and are comfortable in a cloud data platform environment
  • Are self-directed and enjoy setting standards where none exist yet
  • Communicate well across teams and departments, including non-technical stakeholders
  • Proactively solve problems, identify risks and improve processes
  • Are eager to learn and keep up with a fast-moving AI landscape
  • Are organized, flexible, positive and result-driven
  • Want to contribute to a fun, motivated and growing team

OUR TECH STACK

  • Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake)
  • Python & SQL
  • AWS
  • ML / MLOps tooling

description:
Elastic Stack Platform Engineer (Logstash, Kafka, Linux)

Permanent Job

We are looking for a hands-onElastic Platform Engineer to join our technology team in Singapore to run and automate our clients' enterprise-scale log collection platform. You will own the Elastic Stack ingestion layer (Logstash, Kafka and Elasticsearch), which collects security and infrastructure logs from thousands of servers, endpoints, and network and security devices across the region.This is an engineering and operations role, not a SOC or monitoring role. You will build, tune, automate and support the platform, not triage alerts.

ABOUT THE JOB

  • Operate and support a large-scale, high-throughput, near real-time log ingestion platform on Linux (physical and virtual servers).
  • Manage and tune many Logstash instances and pipelines, including pipeline design, persistent queues, load balancing and troubleshooting performance bottlenecks.
  • Work with Kafka in the ingestion flow: topics, consumers and throughput handling.
  • Monitor platform health and capacity, and proactively resolve issues before they affect log collection.
  • Automate deployments, configuration and rollouts across many servers using Ansible (or equivalent) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Write Python or Bash scripts to automate operations, health checks and maintenance.
  • Provide production support and root-cause analysis for incidents, and document fixes and runbooks.

title: Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist based in Mexico.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist to manage provider enrollment, credentialing, and medical billing operations in a remote healthcare environment. In this role, you will coordinate with insurance payers, healthcare providers, and internal teams to ensure accurate documentation, timely claims processing, and reliable reimbursement. You will oversee credentialing applications and renewals while maintaining compliance with payer requirements and applicable healthcare regulations. Your expertise in insurance billing, coding, and claims resolution will help minimize denials and prevent delays in provider network participation. You will also monitor payment discrepancies, maintain comprehensive records, and identify opportunities to improve revenue cycle processes. This is an opportunity to contribute to efficient healthcare administration while supporting providers and delivering operational accuracy.

Accountabilities:

As a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist, you will oversee the full lifecycle of provider credentialing, insurance enrollment, and claims management. You will ensure that provider records remain accurate, billing activities meet payer requirements, and reimbursement issues are addressed promptly through effective coordination and follow-up.

  • Prepare and submit credentialing applications for new healthcare providers across commercial insurance carriers, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care organizations.

  • Manage provider re-credentialing within required timelines to prevent lapses in insurance network participation.

  • Maintain accurate provider information in credentialing databases, payer portals, and related systems.

  • Coordinate with providers to collect required documentation, professional licenses, certifications, and signatures.

  • Review, prepare, and submit medical insurance claims accurately using electronic health record (EHR) and billing systems.

  • Apply appropriate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes, including relevant modifiers, in accordance with applicable billing guidelines.

  • Verify patient demographics, insurance eligibility, and coverage details before submitting claims.

  • Apply payer-specific policies, fee schedules, and filing deadlines to support accurate and timely claims processing.

  • Monitor claim status through payer portals, manage claim edits and rejections, and coordinate necessary adjustments.

  • Post insurance payments, contractual adjustments, and write-offs accurately, identifying underpayments and payment discrepancies.

  • Reconcile daily, weekly, and monthly payment reports and maintain accurate billing records.

  • Investigate claim denials and rejections, prepare supporting documentation, and submit timely appeals.

  • Maintain detailed follow-up logs to track outstanding claims through resolution.

  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, CMS requirements, payer policies, and applicable federal and state regulations.

  • Collaborate with clinical, administrative, and revenue cycle teams to resolve billing and credentialing issues.

  • Serve as a liaison between healthcare providers and insurance payers, resolving enrollment discrepancies and network participation issues.

  • Monitor changes in payer requirements, credentialing policies, and coding guidelines to maintain compliance.

  • Maintain credentialing logs, spreadsheets, databases, and expiration-date trackers to ensure deadlines are met.

  • Audit credentialing files for completeness and accuracy and prepare management reports on application progress, pending items, and compliance status.

  • Identify recurring payer issues and recommend process improvements to strengthen operational efficiency and reimbursement outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines hands-on medical credentialing and billing experience with a strong understanding of insurance payer processes, coding standards, and healthcare compliance. You should be highly organized, comfortable managing multiple deadlines, and able to communicate effectively with providers, insurance representatives, and internal stakeholders.

    • High school diploma or equivalent required; an associate or bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, or a related field is preferred.

    • At least two years of experience in medical credentialing, medical billing, or both, preferably working with multiple insurance payers.

    • Strong working knowledge of commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care credentialing and reimbursement processes.

    • Familiarity with CAQH ProView, NPPES, PECOS, Availity, payer portals, and EHR or medical billing software.

    • Demonstrated experience preparing accurate claims, resolving denials, following up on outstanding payments, and maintaining compliance with payer requirements.

    • Understanding of CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding systems, including modifier requirements.

    • Knowledge of provider enrollment, re-credentialing procedures, insurance eligibility verification, claim submission deadlines, and payer-specific policies.

    • Medical billing or coding certification, such as Certified Professional Biller (CPB), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), or an equivalent qualification, is an advantage.

    • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate, complete, and well-organized records.

    • Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple applications, claims, and deadlines simultaneously.

    • Effective written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with healthcare providers, insurance representatives, patients, and colleagues.

    • Proficiency in credentialing, billing, and documentation systems, with the ability to learn new tools and workflows.

    • Understanding of HIPAA, CMS, NCQA, and other applicable healthcare compliance standards.

    • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining productivity, accuracy, and consistent follow-through.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote work arrangement.

      • Full-time employment.

      • Standard Monday-to-Friday business hours.

      • Opportunity to develop expertise across provider credentialing, medical billing, insurance claims, and revenue cycle operations.

      • Collaborative work with healthcare providers and administrative, clinical, and revenue cycle professionals.

      • Opportunity to contribute to improved reimbursement accuracy, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.

title: Thesis: Name of the project
description:
High Level Description
This thesis project investigates where AI agents should run inside Azure CI/CD pipelines. The study compares execution environments for an agent that diagnoses failed builds, focusing on startup time, cost per task, and resistance to prompt-injection attacks, without compromising the quality of the diagnoses.


Project Description
 The project will involve... The research will focus on....


Who are we looking for?

  • Bachelor/Master of Science student in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science or related fields.

  • Graduation in June 2027

  • Fluency in Swedish, both written and spoken

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken

  • The candidate should be comfortable with Git, basic CI/CD concepts, Python (or a similar scripting language) and containers. No prior Azure experience is required.

Purpose
CI/CD pipelines produce large volumes of unstructured logs, and diagnosing failed builds costs developers time. AI agents can suggest a root cause, but they read untrusted text and may call tools, so a manipulated agent can leak secrets or act beyond its remit. Where the agent runs therefore matters for cost, speed and security.

The candidate will build one simple failure-triage agent and run it unchanged in several Azure environments: the pipeline agent (baseline), a standard container on Azure Container Apps, Container Apps Sandboxes, and optionally a Foundry Hosted Agent. It will process logs from failed open-source CI runs and face a suite of prompt-injection attacks in a dedicated test subscription.

The supervisor provides Azure budget and model API access, and no company data is used.

An Exciting Journey with Knightec Group
Semcon and Knightec have joined forces as Knightec Group. Together, we are Northern Europe’s leading strategic partner in product and digital service development. With a unique combination of cross-functional expertise and a holistic business understanding, we help our clients realize their strategies – from idea to complete solution.

Practical Information
This is a thesis position, located at our office in Sundsvall. Start date January or March 2027.

Please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-11-30. If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact johanna.edstrom@knightec.se. Note that due to GDPR, we only accept applications through our careers page.

Directly supervises all employees assigned to the department. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. High school diploma or GED.

Two years prior supervisory experience.

Able to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.

title: Director of Client Experience
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Client Experience based in the United States.

The Director of Client Experience will lead the development and implementation of a comprehensive client experience strategy within a rapidly growing, fully remote legal services organization. This role offers the opportunity to build a dedicated client experience function from the ground up, ensuring client feedback drives continuous improvement across the entire case lifecycle. You will oversee client escalations, satisfaction measurement, and detractor recovery initiatives while establishing clear service standards and accountability frameworks. Working closely with senior attorneys, operational leaders, and cross-functional teams, you will turn client insights into actionable improvements. The position combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, requiring strong analytical capabilities, operational ownership, and the ability to influence stakeholders. Your work will directly strengthen client trust, improve service quality, and support long-term growth through stronger relationships, referrals, and client advocacy.

Accountabilities

  • Client Experience Strategy: Own the execution of the client experience strategy across every stage of the case lifecycle, including intake, prelitigation, litigation, settlement, and disbursement. Define service standards, establish clear expectations, and ensure consistent, high-quality client interactions throughout the process.
  • Client Escalation Management: Design, implement, and manage the end-to-end client escalation process, including issue detection, prioritization, routing, and resolution. Establish a tiered escalation framework based on severity and case value, ensuring concerns reach the appropriate case managers, team leaders, or attorneys.
  • Stakeholder Accountability: Partner with managing attorneys and market or regional leaders to monitor service-level agreement (SLA) adherence, track resolution progress, and ensure timely follow-up. Maintain centralized visibility into escalations across multiple states and identify recurring issues requiring operational intervention.
  • NPS and Client Feedback Programs: Develop and manage the Net Promoter Score (NPS) program, including survey touchpoints aligned with key case milestones. Integrate survey results, client comments, online reviews, and feedback from client-facing teams into a comprehensive listening strategy.
  • Detractor Recovery: Own the full recovery process for dissatisfied clients, from identifying low satisfaction scores to assigning follow-up actions and monitoring resolution. Analyze feedback trends and communicate recurring concerns to relevant stakeholders to drive measurable improvements.
  • Case Closure and Client Advocacy: Manage the client experience from settlement through final disbursement, ensuring clear communication, appropriate expectation setting, and timely resolution of outstanding concerns. Oversee closing surveys and personalized client appreciation initiatives while creating opportunities for satisfied clients to provide reviews and referrals.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with compliance, technology, operations, analytics, and learning and development teams to ensure client experience initiatives meet regulatory and ethical requirements. Coordinate data flows between case management systems and centralized dashboards, and develop playbooks, training materials, and coaching resources to improve service consistency.
  • Performance Reporting and Optimization: Monitor key performance indicators, including escalation volume, SLA adherence, resolution rates, and client satisfaction, across teams and markets. Collaborate with analytics partners to maintain reporting dashboards, identify improvement opportunities, and prioritize initiatives based on measurable business impact.
  • AI-Enabled Process Improvement: Explore and implement AI-enabled service design and workflow improvements that strengthen operational efficiency, enhance feedback analysis, and support a more consistent client experience.

Requirements

  • Professional Experience: 7–10 years of experience building, managing, or improving client experience, customer escalation, or complaint-resolution programs in a complex, high-touch service environment. Experience in hospitality, healthcare, legal services, or another regulated industry is particularly valuable.
  • Client Experience Expertise: Demonstrated experience designing and operating client satisfaction measurement programs, including NPS surveys, feedback collection, and customer recovery workflows.
  • Operational Leadership: Proven ability to establish processes, service standards, escalation frameworks, and accountability mechanisms from the ground up, with a strong focus on execution and continuous improvement.
  • Data and Performance Management: Strong analytical skills and experience managing KPIs, interpreting client feedback, developing performance reports, and using data to drive operational decisions and measurable outcomes.
  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to operate independently and influence senior stakeholders, including attorneys and business leaders, without relying on direct reporting authority. Skilled at building relationships, resolving conflicts, and driving alignment across teams.
  • Technology and Process Innovation: Experience with service design, workflow development, and AI-enabled operational processes. Ability to collaborate with technology and analytics teams to improve systems, reporting, and information flow.
  • Compliance Awareness: Comfortable working with legal, compliance, and other stakeholders in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments, ensuring client communications and resolution processes meet applicable standards.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, negotiation, and persuasion skills, with the ability to communicate insights clearly and influence decision-making at senior levels.
  • Leadership Mindset: Strong ownership, organization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, move quickly, adapt to change, and maintain high standards in a fast-paced environment.
  • Cultural Alignment: A proactive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented approach, characterized by accountability, openness to feedback, a commitment to team success, and a genuine focus on delivering exceptional client outcomes.

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation: Annual base salary ranging from $155,000 to $205,000, depending on experience and geographic market.
  • Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement Planning: 401(k) plan with company matching and access to a Health Savings Account (HSA).
  • Insurance Protection: Company benefits include life insurance and disability coverage.
  • Work-Life Balance: Paid time off and parental leave.
  • Remote Flexibility: Fully remote working environment within the United States.
  • Career Impact: Opportunity to build and lead a new client experience function within a rapidly expanding legal services organization.
  • Leadership and Influence: Direct collaboration with senior attorneys and business leaders, with the opportunity to shape service standards, operational strategy, and client satisfaction initiatives.
  • Professional Growth: A fast-paced, ownership-driven environment that values continuous improvement, collaboration, accountability, and innovative problem-solving.

title: Onboarding Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Onboarding Engineer based in Denmark.

We are seeking an Onboarding Engineer to lead the technical implementation and coordination of customer onboarding in a fast-growing SaaS environment. This role combines hands-on engineering expertise with project management to ensure seamless integrations and successful customer launches. You will work closely with onboarding, customer success, and engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and deliver a consistent customer experience. Your work will directly influence customer retention, product adoption, and long-term growth. You will also help build scalable processes, documentation, and metrics to improve onboarding efficiency. This is an opportunity to shape technical onboarding practices while contributing to an innovative, AI-driven approach to partnership management.

Accountabilities:

As an Onboarding Engineer, you will own the technical execution of customer implementations, ensuring that each onboarding progresses smoothly from initial kickoff to go-live and handoff. You will collaborate across teams to resolve issues, improve processes, and establish scalable technical standards.

  • Lead the technical setup of customer onboarding, including API integrations, data mapping, CRM configuration, authentication, and security setup.

  • Partner with the Onboarding Manager to coordinate the full onboarding lifecycle, from kickoff through go-live and handoff to Customer Success.

  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues, including integration failures, data synchronization problems, and configuration challenges.

  • Develop and maintain onboarding runbooks, integration guides, technical documentation, and repeatable implementation processes.

  • Collaborate with Engineering to escalate product issues, document bugs with clear reproduction steps, and advocate for product improvements that support successful onboarding.

  • Coordinate with Customer Success to ensure smooth transitions from onboarding to ongoing customer support.

  • Define, monitor, and improve onboarding success metrics, including time to first value, technical blockers, and integration completion rates.

  • Identify onboarding risks proactively, communicate potential delays, and recommend solutions to keep projects on track.

  • Support the Onboarding Manager in customer communications concerning technical requirements, implementation progress, and timelines.

  • Contribute to the growth of the onboarding function by helping establish scalable practices and mentoring future onboarding engineers.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with customer-facing implementation experience, excellent organizational abilities, and a collaborative approach. You should be comfortable managing multiple onboarding projects while communicating complex technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders.

    • 3–4 years of technical experience in B2B SaaS implementation, customer onboarding, or customer success engineering.

    • Hands-on experience with APIs, data integrations, technical configuration, and troubleshooting.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical customers and present implementation plans to leadership.

    • Experience managing customer implementations or onboarding projects throughout the full lifecycle, from kickoff to go-live.

    • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple customer onboardings and maintain close attention to detail.

    • Familiarity with CRM integrations, particularly Salesforce or HubSpot, or comparable enterprise tools, is an advantage.

    • A consultative mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs, ask thoughtful questions, and proactively recommend solutions.

    • A strong commitment to quality, including identifying potential issues early and implementing measures to prevent recurring problems.

    • Ability to collaborate effectively and build strong relationships across Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering.

    • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience demonstrating technical expertise.

      • Experience with Bubble.io, n8n, or other low-code/no-code platforms.

      • Familiarity with partnership management or ecosystem tools.

      • Experience creating technical documentation, implementation guides, or knowledge bases.

      • Knowledge of AWS Lambda or similar serverless architectures.

        • Benefits:

        • Competitive salary and benefits package.

        • Stock options offering an opportunity to participate in the company's growth.

        • The opportunity to directly influence customer onboarding quality, retention, and expansion.

        • A hybrid technical and operational role with potential for progression into leadership.

        • Close collaboration with experienced onboarding and Customer Success professionals.

    • Communication skills: Strong English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

    • Creative mindset: A performance-driven approach that prioritizes measurable results alongside visual quality.

description:
APP Surgical

The majority of this role’s time will be spent supporting surgical procedures, with shared call responsibilities.


Come work where we specialize in you! We have nearly 2,000 reasons for you to consider a career with Prevea Health—they're our employees. We're an organization that values kindness, responsibility, inclusivity, wellness and inspiration. At Prevea, we provide continuous education, training and support so every member of the team contributes to our success. Together we are the best place to get care and the best place to give care.

Job Summary
At Prevea Health, the Advanced Practice Provider Surgical is an advanced practice nurse or physician assistant in a specified surgical care department, working alongside surgeons to ensure optimal patient outcomes. They play a vital role in pre-operative assessments, surgical procedures, and post-operative care, enhancing the efficiency and quality of our surgical services in both inpatient and outpatient settings. Their expertise helps deliver compassionate, comprehensive care to patients throughout their surgical journey.

What you will do

  • Assist in surgical procedures as a first or second assist, adhering to aseptic techniques and surgical protocols.
  • Perform surgical procedures under supervision or independently, as per scope of practice and credentialing.
  • Provide postoperative follow-up care, including wound management, suture/staple removal, and patient education. Also provides services as appropriate to assigned specialty, which may include the ordering of appropriate diagnostic and laboratory tests, the prescription of pharmacological agents, and other non-pharmacological treatment modalities
  • Provides assessment, evaluation, and management to patients that may include but is not limited to minor, acute, chronic, & episodic illness & injuries. Including performance of follow up exams if required.
  • Maintains and reviews patient records, charts, and other pertinent information, documenting all details in the electronic medical record.

title: Wet End Operator
description:
Description

At Pratt Industries, where we believe in unboxing your best life, you will be joining a team committed to sustainable solutions in a supportive and innovative environment. As a wet end operator, you become an integral part of our vision to lead in providing sustainable packaging solutions that protect and transport creativity and craftsmanship. Your work here contributes significantly towards our mission of driving efficiency and excellence.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Operate the single-facers to produce the highest level of production and quality.
  • Check wet end line-ups to verify correct roll stock is received and used.
  • Put rolls of paper in mill roll stands ensuring proper size and grade of paper to be run and make splices and paper changes as necessary.
  • Trim only the necessary amount of paper from the rolls when preparing for splices.
  • Remove roll stock from the machine when necessary, mark the proper size, grade, diameter and lineal footage on the roll, and place core plugs in each end of the butt rolls.
  • Continuously monitor the board during runs to ensure quality and make adjustments as necessary.
  • Clean starch pan, glue roll and singlefacer area after changing flutes and at the end of the production week.
  • Take all paper off cores of stub rolls.
  • Cross Train on different areas of the machine as needed
  • Comply with all company policies and procedures, including safety and maintaining good housekeeping.

Additional duties may be assigned by management.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Able to read and follow instructions on factory masters.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

Beyond the day-to-day tasks, you'll be part of a culture that emphasizes safety, integrity, and sustainability, aligning with our core values of innovation and customer focus. Your efforts here directly propel company success, offering personal growth and an entrepreneurial spirit that encourages new ideas.

If you have a high school diploma or GED, and you're eager to join a dedicated team striving towards a greener future, we welcome you to apply. Prior experience in the corrugated or fulfillment industry is advantageous, but not necessary.

Ready to Unbox Your Best Life?

Join us in Hebron, KY and start your journey with a company where your needs come first, and your work fuels progress. If you resonate with our vision and are excited to make a difference, apply now. Let's drive sustainability and excellence together, one innovative package at a time.

title: Purchasing and Inventory Coordinator
description:
The Purchasing & Inventory Coordinator is responsible for executing procurement and inventory support activities required to maintain uninterrupted mill operations. This position manages purchase order creation, vendor communications, RFQs, delivery tracking, inventory reporting, and purchasing administration while supporting cost control and inventory optimization initiatives.

SCOPE

Acts as the primary day-to-day coordinator between vendors, contractors, accounting personnel, maintenance, operations, and storeroom personnel. Responsible for timely procurement of materials, delivery management, vendor communication, and purchasing system accuracy.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create and process purchase orders.
  • Enter and maintain purchase orders within SAP and iMaint.
  • Process MRO purchase requests.
  • Process miscellaneous purchasing requests.
  • Review rebuilt versus new equipment cost comparisons.
  • Obtain supplier quotations.
  • Prepare RFQs and bid packages.
  • Review vendor lead times and pricing.
  • Evaluate supplier quote competitiveness.
  • Communicate approved purchase orders to vendors.
  • Coordinate machine roll delivery schedules.
  • Track purchase order delivery performance.
  • Monitor open purchase orders.
  • Track overdue and past-due purchase orders.
  • Expedite delayed shipments.
  • Resolve delivery issues and supplier concerns.
  • Communicate with freight carriers and shipping companies.
  • Support budget management through purchasing controls.
  • Maintain vendor delivery records.
  • Assist with work order parts usage reviews.
  • Assist accounting with invoice discrepancies.
  • Coordinate food orders and special event purchasing.
  • Coordinate parts pickup activities.
  • Identify obsolete inventory opportunities.
  • Collect and maintain vendor onboarding documentation.
  • Assist with inventory analysis and purchasing reports.
  • Support spend analysis and procurement reporting.
  • Audit vendor-managed inventory programs.
  • Provide receiving support during staffing shortages.
  • Coordinate contractor orientation requirements.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Associate or bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Three years purchasing, inventory, procurement, manufacturing, or supply chain experience preferred.
  • Manufacturing purchasing experience preferred.
  • SAP and iMaint experience preferred.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

  • Purchase order accuracy
  • RFQ completion
  • On-time delivery performance
  • Invoice discrepancy resolution
  • Vendor responsiveness
  • Reporting accuracy
  • Cost control support

Note: This role requires the ability to work in a loud industrial environment, stand/walk for extended periods, and lift up to 50 lbs.

We value our employees and offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package designed to support your well-being and career growth.

title: Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist based in South Africa.

We are seeking a detail-oriented Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist to manage provider enrollment, credentialing, and medical billing operations in a remote healthcare environment. In this role, you will coordinate with insurance payers, healthcare providers, and internal teams to ensure accurate documentation, timely claims processing, and reliable reimbursement. You will oversee credentialing applications and renewals while maintaining compliance with payer requirements and applicable healthcare regulations. Your expertise in insurance billing, coding, and claims resolution will help minimize denials and prevent delays in provider network participation. You will also monitor payment discrepancies, maintain comprehensive records, and identify opportunities to improve revenue cycle processes. This is an opportunity to contribute to efficient healthcare administration while supporting providers and delivering operational accuracy.

Accountabilities:

As a Medical Insurance Credentialing Specialist, you will oversee the full lifecycle of provider credentialing, insurance enrollment, and claims management. You will ensure that provider records remain accurate, billing activities meet payer requirements, and reimbursement issues are addressed promptly through effective coordination and follow-up.

  • Prepare and submit credentialing applications for new healthcare providers across commercial insurance carriers, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care organizations.

  • Manage provider re-credentialing within required timelines to prevent lapses in insurance network participation.

  • Maintain accurate provider information in credentialing databases, payer portals, and related systems.

  • Coordinate with providers to collect required documentation, professional licenses, certifications, and signatures.

  • Review, prepare, and submit medical insurance claims accurately using electronic health record (EHR) and billing systems.

  • Apply appropriate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes, including relevant modifiers, in accordance with applicable billing guidelines.

  • Verify patient demographics, insurance eligibility, and coverage details before submitting claims.

  • Apply payer-specific policies, fee schedules, and filing deadlines to support accurate and timely claims processing.

  • Monitor claim status through payer portals, manage claim edits and rejections, and coordinate necessary adjustments.

  • Post insurance payments, contractual adjustments, and write-offs accurately, identifying underpayments and payment discrepancies.

  • Reconcile daily, weekly, and monthly payment reports and maintain accurate billing records.

  • Investigate claim denials and rejections, prepare supporting documentation, and submit timely appeals.

  • Maintain detailed follow-up logs to track outstanding claims through resolution.

  • Ensure compliance with HIPAA, CMS requirements, payer policies, and applicable federal and state regulations.

  • Collaborate with clinical, administrative, and revenue cycle teams to resolve billing and credentialing issues.

  • Serve as a liaison between healthcare providers and insurance payers, resolving enrollment discrepancies and network participation issues.

  • Monitor changes in payer requirements, credentialing policies, and coding guidelines to maintain compliance.

  • Maintain credentialing logs, spreadsheets, databases, and expiration-date trackers to ensure deadlines are met.

  • Audit credentialing files for completeness and accuracy and prepare management reports on application progress, pending items, and compliance status.

  • Identify recurring payer issues and recommend process improvements to strengthen operational efficiency and reimbursement outcomes.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines hands-on medical credentialing and billing experience with a strong understanding of insurance payer processes, coding standards, and healthcare compliance. You should be highly organized, comfortable managing multiple deadlines, and able to communicate effectively with providers, insurance representatives, and internal stakeholders.

    • High school diploma or equivalent required; an associate or bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, or a related field is preferred.

    • At least two years of experience in medical credentialing, medical billing, or both, preferably working with multiple insurance payers.

    • Strong working knowledge of commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care credentialing and reimbursement processes.

    • Familiarity with CAQH ProView, NPPES, PECOS, Availity, payer portals, and EHR or medical billing software.

    • Demonstrated experience preparing accurate claims, resolving denials, following up on outstanding payments, and maintaining compliance with payer requirements.

    • Understanding of CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding systems, including modifier requirements.

    • Knowledge of provider enrollment, re-credentialing procedures, insurance eligibility verification, claim submission deadlines, and payer-specific policies.

    • Medical billing or coding certification, such as Certified Professional Biller (CPB), Certified Professional Coder (CPC), or an equivalent qualification, is an advantage.

    • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate, complete, and well-organized records.

    • Strong organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple applications, claims, and deadlines simultaneously.

    • Effective written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with healthcare providers, insurance representatives, patients, and colleagues.

    • Proficiency in credentialing, billing, and documentation systems, with the ability to learn new tools and workflows.

    • Understanding of HIPAA, CMS, NCQA, and other applicable healthcare compliance standards.

    • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining productivity, accuracy, and consistent follow-through.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote work arrangement.

      • Full-time employment.

      • Standard Monday-to-Friday business hours.

      • Opportunity to develop expertise across provider credentialing, medical billing, insurance claims, and revenue cycle operations.

      • Collaborative work with healthcare providers and administrative, clinical, and revenue cycle professionals.

      • Opportunity to contribute to improved reimbursement accuracy, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.

title: Master Operator
description:
Master Machine Operator

SUMMARY

Responsible for all activities associated with safely operating production machines including setup, operation, cleanup, and recommending improvements to operations to meet customer demand.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

· Train, lead and develop entry level Machine Operators.

· Develop production teams.

· Ensure training is done effectively and safety.

· Work safely at all times, be aware of surroundings and understand and comply with Pratt Industries Safety rules, operating procedures, and help hold co-workers responsible for safety related items. Participate in Plant Safety Committee.

· Follow at all times GMPs (Good Manufacturing Processes)

· Learn and comply with Pratt Industries quality procedures and policies. Stop bad quality from leaving the facility to the Customer. Catch it on the front end of manufacturing the product. Strong attention to detail for poor quality; prevent bad quality being sent to customer.

· Maximize the utilization of equipment by operating the machinery at available capacity and speed. Improve set up times daily, improve downtime daily. Identify and address mechanical concerns and report to Production Supervisor or Production Manager or Plant Mechanical Tech/Specialist

· Housekeeping and cleaning of work areas – keep clean and free of tripping hazards during shift and end of shift cleaning of the area. In addition, good housekeeping of areas employee utilizes; break rooms, bathrooms, refrigerators etc.

· Learn and understand capability and capacity of machine and drive efficiencies limiting waste and downtime. Do not sacrifice quality for machine speeds – must have both excellent quality and high efficiencies with minimal downtime.

· Train and assist Assistant Machine Operators, Machine Helpers and Production Utility with job duties on the machine, downtime, setup times and quality.

· Cross-train on other machines and learns other positions in the plant.

· Complete necessary reports in an accurate and timely manner, including but not limited to: Production Data, Machine Operational Status, Safety Data, Quality Data.

· Turn in maintenance work order requests to supervision for needed repairs on the machine or machines. Be proactive in the maintenance and housekeeping of equipment.

· Switch duties with co-workers as necessary. Learning environment to learn as many job duties to assist with plant growth and personal and professional growth opportunities.

· Comply with all company policies and procedures, including safety and maintaining good housekeeping.

· Adheres to production schedule. Makes recommendations for optimizing the schedule to meet cost, quality and service goals. Reports any unusual scheduling issues to Supervisor.

· Must be able to work overtime as necessary, sometimes on short notice. We serve our customers 24x7 – 365 days a year and sometimes work on holidays not avoidable.

· Additional duties may be assigned by management.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED.

Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:

Prior work experience in the packaging industry; paper, plastics, converting

6 months’ experience in some type of manufacturing operation.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Able to read and follow instructions; quality, safety, job packets

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving one or more concrete variables in standardized situations.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee may occasionally be required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

title: Travel Coordinator
