Education:

  • High school diploma or associate degree with equivalent hands-on experience in corporate travel, hospitality, or travel agency operations is required; a bachelor’s degree is preferred.

title: Salesforce Solution Analyst
description:
DeterTech's purpose is giving greater peace of mind to people and communities, every day, and clear, well-documented solutions are how we make sure our Salesforce platform keeps pace with the business. This role supports the Salesforce Technical Lead by turning conversations and requirements into properly analysed and documented solutions, while also being hands-on enough to contribute directly to configuration and build.


This is not a purely functional Business Analyst role: you'll be comfortable moving between stakeholder conversations, solution documentation and hands-on Salesforce configuration, giving the Technical Lead more time to focus on the areas where specialist technical input matters most.


ABOUT DETERTECH


DeterTech is a security technology company operating across six countries, with principal UK sites in Prestwick and Telford. We predict, deter and detect risk on behalf of the people and communities we serve. Our values – Committed, Inclusive and Ambitious – shape how we work every day: we are accountable and deliver excellence; we collaborate and build trust; and we never stop learning while winning in the right way.

This is a remote role, although we value regular face-to-face collaboration. We would ideally like someone who can attend our Telford office around once a week if based locally, or a couple of office visits per month for those based further afield.

1. Requirements and discovery

• Gather requirements through stakeholder interviews and workshops.


• Support the Salesforce Technical Lead during discovery and design.


• Partner closely with BPO stakeholders (including Sales, Customer Success, Field Operations, and Finance) to understand their day-to-day challenges, operational bottlenecks, and strategic needs.


• Facilitate process discovery workshops to map out processes and collaborate with the Technical Lead to define efficient, scalable future-state ('to-be') solutions.


2. Analysis and documentation

• Produce clear process maps, requirements documentation and solution designs.

• Translate business requirements into Salesforce functional/technical requirements.

• Independently follow up with stakeholders to close gaps and ambiguities.

• Write well-structured, detailed user stories in Jira, complete with clear business value statements, functional specifications, wireframes or mock-ups where helpful, and unambiguous acceptance criteria.

• Work closely with the Technical Delivery Manager during backlog refinement and sprint planning to ensure stories meet the team's 'Definition of Ready' before entering active development sprints.


3. Hands-on configuration

• Build appropriate elements of agreed solutions directly within Salesforce.

• Support testing and validation of delivered solutions alongside the QA/Test Analyst.

• Deliver configuration and lightweight automations (such as custom fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, and straightforward Salesforce Flows), freeing the Technical Lead and Senior Administrator for complex architecture and deep technical build.

• Collaborate with the QA / Test Analyst to walk through user stories, clarify expected behaviour and edge cases, and assist with functional validation in sandboxes prior to release.

• Partner with the Senior Salesforce Administrator to prepare change communications, end-user guidance, and support materials to drive smooth user adoption.


4. Solution governance and continuous improvement

• Work within the architectural guardrails, data model standards, and best practices established by the Salesforce Technical Lead, avoiding over-customisation or technical debt.

• Regularly review system adoption, gathering user feedback after releases to identify opportunities to simplify workflows and improve the user experience.

Essential

• Proven requirements gathering and stakeholder interviewing skills.

• Excellent process mapping, requirements and solution documentation skills.

• Able to independently follow up with stakeholders to close gaps and ambiguities.

• Able to translate business requirements into Salesforce functional/technical requirements.

• Hands-on Salesforce configuration capability – this role needs to build, not just document.

• Comfortable supporting the Technical Lead during discovery and design.

• Experience working as a Business Analyst, Solution Analyst, or functional consultant within a Salesforce environment.

• Hands-on ability to configure core Salesforce elements (custom objects, fields, validation rules, record types, and basic Flows).

• Experience writing clear user stories with formal acceptance criteria within an Agile team.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, comfortable engaging with operational users as well as technical developers and delivery managers.


Desirable

• Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst certification.

• Experience working in a multi-country or matrix organisation.

• Familiarity with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Field Service.

• Understanding of how Salesforce integrates with other enterprise systems (such as ERP, finance systems, or customer portals) via middleware like MuleSoft.

We are committed to creating an inclusive recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

title: Media Partnerships Executive
description:
Media Partnerships Executive

Luton | Full-time | Hybrid

20% bonus • 7% pension • Staff travel benefits

We support hybrid working, and you’ll spend 60% of your time each month in the office.

You turn moving parts into partnership campaigns that land smoothly, on time and with commercial impact.

You’re organised, commercially aware and confident bringing suppliers, agencies and internal teams together. You enjoy keeping complex delivery on track, solving problems early and using results to make the next campaign even stronger.

The opportunity

As Media Partnerships Executive, you’ll deliver and evaluate partnership campaigns across customer touchpoints while keeping the operational engine behind easyJet’s inflight media proposition running effectively.

You’ll combine campaign delivery with supplier partnerships media planning, print production and delivery, supplier coordination and commercial support. It’s a varied role where strong organisation and clear communication help turn partnership plans into reliable delivery.

“This role suits someone who loves making campaigns happen. You’ll need curiosity, commercial judgement and the confidence to coordinate lots of detail, while building strong relationships and keeping delivery moving.”
IFR Team, easyJet

The team & culture

You’ll work across Media Partnerships and build collaborative relationships with Marketing, Retail, Operations, our in-flight retail suppliers and creative agencies. Success comes from sharing clear updates, coordinating decisions and helping everyone deliver against agreed timelines.

The pace is varied and practical. You’ll balance campaign priorities, production schedules and operational issues, with the space to spot improvements and support new commercial opportunities.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll deliver and evaluate media partnership campaigns, making sure contractual commitments are met and performance reporting supports future planning.

You’ll coordinate the onboard partnerships media programme, working with our in-flight retail supplies as well as print and production suppliers on schedules, content planning, distribution and continuity of delivery.

You’ll manage approvals, stakeholder sign-off, production, delivery and invoicing workstreams, resolving operational challenges before they affect campaign execution.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Job Description

Who We Are:
Venus Aerospace is revolutionizing rocket engine propulsion. With the first generational leap in rocket engine technology since Apollo, our proprietary Rotating Detonation Rocket Engine and Venus Detonation Ramjets deliver historic efficiency and performance across aerospace applications. We are building the next generation of propulsion platforms that enable breakthrough capabilities in space, defense, and commercial high-speed flight. Our team thrives on solving the toughest engineering challenges and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in aerospace. At Venus, we’re looking for bold engineers and innovators who want to make history and redefine the future of propulsion.

The Role: Software Engineer
We are seeking a full‑stack developer who is equally passionate about building high‑quality software and ensuring its reliability through robust automated testing. We are helping to accelerate amazing advances in propulsion by building internal platforms to store, analyze, share, and integrate data with teams across the company. This role is ideal for someone who wants to contribute across our software stack while leading the creation of a scalable QA and test strategy for our integrated aerospace software ecosystem.

You’ll be part of a small, high-impact software team that is developing front-end applications, back-end microservices, database platforms, automation tools, embedded systems support, and hardware test interfaces. You will also be the primary engineer driving software quality efforts across all these systems.

What You'll Get To Do

  • Test Strategy & Quality Engineering: Build and maintain automated test frameworks for front-end, back-end, and integrated systems. Develop end-to-end, integration, regression, and performance test suites. Oversee CI/CD-driven quality gates, coverage metrics, and continuous testing practices. Work with embedded, hardware test, and propulsion teams to validate cross-functional systems. Establish a scalable QA process for the team, including documentation and best practices.
  • Full‑Stack Development: Create user-focused front-end tools using React, Grafana, and other modern UI technologies. Build and maintain back-end services using GoLang and PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB. Collaborate with other Venus teams to design software that simplifies workflows and enhances productivity.
  • Integrated Hardware, Test, and Data Systems: Support development of hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) systems, test stands, and automation platforms that are controlling the development of future propulsion systems. Help unify data acquisition, telemetry, and real-time systems into robust, testable architectures. Contribute to ground software and embedded system integration as needed.

What You Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, plus a minimum of three years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience building and maintain automated test frameworks (unit, integration, E2E)
  • Experience designing tests for distributed systems, microservices, or large data platforms.
  • Experience with React, JavaScript, CSS, and other modern front-end technologies.
  • Experience with fundamental CRUD operations for PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB.
  • Experience with GraphQL for API interactions.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflow (GitLab), and DevOps testing practices.
  • Ability to write documentation define QA processes, and partner with cross-functional teams.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Experience with large-scale QA environments or having built QA foundations from scratch.
  • Experience with GitLab pipelines, Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence), or systems engineering practices.
  • Experience with GoLang or Rust
  • Experience validating embedded systems, telemetry, or real-time hardware interfaces.
  • Experience with Hardware in the Loop (HIL) validation systems.

Location:On-site in Houston, TX

Benefits:Venus Aerospace employee benefits include a 401(k) plan, stock options, and medical benefits, including dental and vision. We have a flex-Friday flexible schedule, unlimited PTO, and receive professional development opportunities.

This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls. To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be able to meet ITAR requirements (U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State). title: New Business Specialist (Acquisition and Retention)
description:
Capital.com is a global trading and investing platform operating across regulated markets worldwide. Capital.com Kenya is a regulated online forex and trading services to clients in Kenya, acting as a compliant counterparty and providing onboarding, execution, and client support in line with CMA requirements.

The New Business Specialist (Client Acquisition and Retention) is responsible for guiding prospective and newly approved clients through the critical early stages of their trading journey. The role focuses on converting approved applications into active and engaged client relationships by removing onboarding friction, supporting account funding, introducing clients to the platform and guide clients on how to usebthe platform to place their trades.

Responsibilities:

The New Business Specialist will be responsible for delivering a smooth, responsive and commercially effective onboarding experience that helps new clients become confident and active users of Capital.com’s platform.

  • Manage the client journey from approved application through account funding, first trade and early-stage engagement, with an appropriate handover to the Premium Client Manager where relevant.
  • Proactively contact newly approved clients to welcome them, understand any barriers to activation and guide them through the next steps in their onboarding journey.
  • Support the conversion of approved applications into funded and active accounts by reducing friction, answering process and platform-related questions and coordinating the resolution of outstanding matters.
  • Introduce new clients to Capital.com’s platform features, trading tools, risk-management functionality and educational resources through clear and practical onboarding support.
  • Help clients build confidence in using the platform while ensuring all communications remain fair, balanced, accurate and within the boundaries of a non-advisory service.
  • Drive early client engagement and retention through proactive outreach, structured follow-ups and personalised communication that demonstrates Capital.com’s commitment to the client experience.
  • Identify clients whose onboarding has stalled or who have become inactive and conduct appropriate re-engagement and reactivation activity.
  • Identify clients who may benefit from a higher-touch relationship and coordinate an effective handover to the Premium Client Manager, where appropriate.
  • Maintain accurate and complete CRM records, including client interactions, onboarding status, follow-ups, activation progress and agreed actions.
  • Work closely with Compliance, Operations, Customer Support, Marketing and the Premium Client Manager to resolve client matters and improve the end-to-end onboarding experience.
  • Provide structured feedback on recurring client questions, onboarding obstacles, platform usage and reasons for non-activation to support continuous process improvement.
  • Support approved client webinars, platform demonstrations, seminars, events and other engagement initiatives where required.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of financial markets, competitor activity and Capital.com’s product and service offering.

Requirements:

  • 1–2 years’ experience in client onboarding, customer success, account management, business development, sales support, or a related financial-services environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree or relevant recognised qualification in Commerce, Business Management, or a related field.
  • Eligibility to be appointed and registered as a CISI member and done CISI module one.
  • Good understanding of financial markets and an interest in online trading, including products such as FX, indices, equities, commodities and CFDs.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain platform features and processes clearly and confidently.
  • A commercially minded and client-focused approach, with the ability to balance activation outcomes, client experience and regulatory requirements.
  • Comfortable conducting proactive outbound client engagement by telephone, email and video call.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage a high-volume pipeline of clients, follow-ups and onboarding actions.
  • Ability to identify client needs and obstacles without providing financial advice or personalised trading recommendations.
  • High attention to detail and disciplined use of CRM and client-management systems.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, regulated environment.
  • Fluent in English.

Nice to have:

  • Understanding of the Kenyan financial-services environment, retail investor behaviour and client conduct expectations.
  • Awareness of CMA expectations regarding fair client communication, financial promotions, non-advisory services and conduct risk.
  • Additional language skills would be beneficial but are not essential.

description:

Why You’ll Love Working Here
• Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else
• A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win
• A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond
• Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best
• Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter
• Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable
A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started
Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work
Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment
ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)

For Contractors – Proof of incorporation and up‑to‑date insurance is required
A Quick Note on Applications
We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, AI Platform
description:

This is an opportunity to build the core AI infrastructure powering a digital platform used by millions of people. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will work closely with platform architects and engineering teams to design, develop, and scale production-ready AI capabilities from the ground up. You will bring deep expertise in large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation, model serving, and reliable backend architecture to deliver practical AI features at scale. The role offers significant technical ownership, from system design and API development to deployment, monitoring, and ongoing production support. You will help establish engineering standards, improve AI quality and reliability, and shape the platform's evolution as the team grows. This is a full-time, remote opportunity for a US-based engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges in a fast-moving environment.

  • AI Platform Development: Design, build, and scale the backend infrastructure required to deliver production-grade AI features across a platform serving millions of users.

  • LLM Integration and Serving: Develop and maintain services that integrate multiple LLM providers, supporting model routing, failover, token streaming, and cost and usage tracking.

  • Production Operations: Monitor live services, troubleshoot incidents, improve system resilience, and support ongoing performance and reliability improvements.

    • Requirements

    • Production LLM Expertise: Demonstrated experience shipping and maintaining LLM-powered features in production, including retrieval-augmented generation, streaming responses, and tool use.

    • LLM Serving Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with model-serving systems, including multi-provider routing, failover strategies, token streaming, and cost and usage metering.

title: Converting Supervisor

POSITION TITLE: CONVERTING SUPERVISOR

REPORTS TO: Converting Superintendent

SUMMARY

Supervise approximately 30 people in the daily routine of producing quality corrugated products in a safe, productive manner with minimum waste. Cross-train employees in key positions.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain quality, efficiencies, and production levels set by management. Communicate these standards to your staff.
  • Report quality concerns to Converting and Plant Superintendent. Assist in determining quality guidelines.
  • Establish high morale within your department by showing fairness, consistency, and an interest in employee problems. Maintain confidentiality.
  • Maintain inventories of sheets, inks and other converting supplies.
  • Coordinate with your supervisor and Maintenance Superintendent on any repairs or preventive maintenance done in the department.
  • Keep upper management informed of problems or situations that may affect the performance of your department.
  • Conduct weekly Production/Safety meetings with departmental personnel.
  • Communicate with necessary supervision to avoid problems between shift changes.
  • Improve career skills by enrolling yourself in seminars, technical courses, and related college courses.
  • Implement, maintain, and support all company policies and procedures, including safety program, and good housekeeping.
  • Comply with company policies and procedures.
  • Additional duties may be assigned by management.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Directly supervises all employees assigned to the department.
  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
  • Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; conflict resolution; team building; coaching and leading employees to improve; addressing complaints and resolving problems; documentation; and setting an example of superior behavior, attitude and performance.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Two years prior supervisory experience.

REQUIRED:

  • Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

  • Able to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

  • Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy.
  • Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form.
  • Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

  • Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation. This also supports the supervisor's role of teacher and trainer for his/her personnel.
  • Cost issues in order to make daily decisions that will reduce overall costs and will help the supervisor find areas that require improvement.
  • Quality standards.
  • Regulatory requirements including but not limited to wage and hour requirements, environmental and waste minimization, company policies, and personnel requirements including OSHA, DEQ and EEO.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear.
  • The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
  • The employee is occasionally required to sit.
  • The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts.
  • The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions.
  • The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

LEADERSHIP ATTRIBUTES

The individual must possess the following:

  • Superior time management skills including the ability to manage multiple issues concurrently and the ability to lead an effective and efficient meeting.
  • Teaching skills in order to function effectively as a teacher for his personnel both in the technical and administrative parts of the position.
  • Excellent crisis manager who demonstrates that he/she has a high emotional control under adverse conditions and can lead his/her personnel to a successful resolution.
  • Excellent employee relations skills including being an active listener, understanding how to appraise personnel, applying both positive and corrective feedback, being able to resolve conflicts either involving the supervisor directly or as a third party, understands and demonstrates positive motivational skills including coaching and delegation techniques.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

title: PMO- Intern
description:
PMO Intern

As a PMO Intern, you will support the PMO team in managing workforce operations, including attendance, leave, timesheets, and incentive data. You will help ensure accurate, timely reporting and work closely with the HR team while gaining hands-on experience coordinating these processes across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

1. Attendance Data and Reporting

  • Run pre-built Python scripts to process biometric attendance data and generate regular reports for all three sites.
  • Use basic SQL queries to pull, verify, and cross-check attendance records.
  • Audit attendance data for gaps, mismatches, and anomalies across time zones, and flag issues for review.

2. Leave and Loss of Pay Tracking

  • Calculate and maintain employee leave balances and loss-of-pay (LOP) data.
  • Prepare accurate summaries for HR to support payroll.
  • Keep trackers updated and reconcile discrepancies.

3. Incentive Data Preparation

  • Compile incentive data using employee performance and productivity metrics.
  • Validate inputs, check calculations, and maintain clear records for review.

4. Timesheet Setup and Tracking

  • Set up timesheets for new projects, teams, and employees, keeping them aligned with project and allocation details.
  • Track timesheet submissions, follow up on missing or late entries, and ensure data is complete before deadlines.
  • Review timesheet entries for errors or inconsistencies and flag them for correction.

5. Reporting and Documentation

  • Build and maintain reports and trackers in Excel and Google Sheets.
  • Prepare summaries, simple presentations, and process documents using PowerPoint and Word.
  • Coordinate with teams across regions to resolve data queries and meet reporting deadlines.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Education: Graduate or fresher from any discipline.
  • Skills: Strong proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets, including formulas, XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and data cleaning. Comfortable running pre-written scripts. Working knowledge of PowerPoint and Word.
  • Communication: Fluent in spoken and written English, with the ability to coordinate across teams and time zones.
  • Attributes: Exceptional attention to detail, comfort with accuracy-critical and recurring work, a high standard for data confidentiality, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Job Title:

Clamp Truck Operator

Job Description:

RESPONSIBILITIES: The Clamp Truck Operator responsibilities include safety, quality of product produced, quantity of product produced, and effective operation of the corrugator by operating a clamp truck to supply the corrugator with paper material. The operator assists the corrugator team as needed to maximize the set up and operation of the corrugator in a timely manner. All individuals assigned to the Clamp Truck Operator position are to work together in a safe, efficient and effective manner to ensure the production of a quality product. To achieve this level of operations all employees are required to comply with all applicable Plant and OSHA safety rules.

NORMAL DUTIES include the following.

  • Move rolls and organize work-in-process area.
  • Maintain a clean work area to include sweeping and removal of Trash.
  • Manage roll room inventory and roll room presentation.
  • Reconcile end of shift consumption Daily
  • Report any incoming damaged rolls and dress rolls down when needed
  • Complete stock take/cycle count daily
  • Manage butt rolls
  • Complete all task associated with Preventative maintenance program
  • Correct delivery of all roll stock.
  • Removes all waste at end of shift or as needed from docks and corrugator.
  • Provides back up to the Roll Handler as required.
  • Maintain enough paper on the floor to prevent corrugator from going down.
  • Adjust to scheduling changes as customer needs require.
  • Additional duties as assigned by supervision

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS:

License: Employee must have successfully completed the appropriate training programs for the operation of powered industrial trucks.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE: High School diploma or general education degree (GED); experience operating a lift truck is preferred.

LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read and interpret written documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, factory orders, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to communicate effectively.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS: Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure (English and Metric systems), using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to read an English and Metric system tape measure.

REASONING ABILITY: Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization may exist. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

title: Onboarding Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Onboarding Engineer based in France.

We are seeking an Onboarding Engineer to lead the technical implementation and coordination of customer onboarding in a fast-growing SaaS environment. This role combines hands-on engineering expertise with project management to ensure seamless integrations and successful customer launches. You will work closely with onboarding, customer success, and engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and deliver a consistent customer experience. Your work will directly influence customer retention, product adoption, and long-term growth. You will also help build scalable processes, documentation, and metrics to improve onboarding efficiency. This is an opportunity to shape technical onboarding practices while contributing to an innovative, AI-driven approach to partnership management.

Accountabilities:

As an Onboarding Engineer, you will own the technical execution of customer implementations, ensuring that each onboarding progresses smoothly from initial kickoff to go-live and handoff. You will collaborate across teams to resolve issues, improve processes, and establish scalable technical standards.

  • Lead the technical setup of customer onboarding, including API integrations, data mapping, CRM configuration, authentication, and security setup.

  • Partner with the Onboarding Manager to coordinate the full onboarding lifecycle, from kickoff through go-live and handoff to Customer Success.

  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues, including integration failures, data synchronization problems, and configuration challenges.

  • Develop and maintain onboarding runbooks, integration guides, technical documentation, and repeatable implementation processes.

  • Collaborate with Engineering to escalate product issues, document bugs with clear reproduction steps, and advocate for product improvements that support successful onboarding.

  • Coordinate with Customer Success to ensure smooth transitions from onboarding to ongoing customer support.

  • Define, monitor, and improve onboarding success metrics, including time to first value, technical blockers, and integration completion rates.

  • Identify onboarding risks proactively, communicate potential delays, and recommend solutions to keep projects on track.

  • Support the Onboarding Manager in customer communications concerning technical requirements, implementation progress, and timelines.

  • Contribute to the growth of the onboarding function by helping establish scalable practices and mentoring future onboarding engineers.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with customer-facing implementation experience, excellent organizational abilities, and a collaborative approach. You should be comfortable managing multiple onboarding projects while communicating complex technical concepts clearly to different stakeholders.

    • 3–4 years of technical experience in B2B SaaS implementation, customer onboarding, or customer success engineering.

    • Hands-on experience with APIs, data integrations, technical configuration, and troubleshooting.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical customers and present implementation plans to leadership.

    • Experience managing customer implementations or onboarding projects throughout the full lifecycle, from kickoff to go-live.

    • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple customer onboardings and maintain close attention to detail.

    • Familiarity with CRM integrations, particularly Salesforce or HubSpot, or comparable enterprise tools, is an advantage.

    • A consultative mindset, with the ability to understand customer needs, ask thoughtful questions, and proactively recommend solutions.

    • A strong commitment to quality, including identifying potential issues early and implementing measures to prevent recurring problems.

    • Ability to collaborate effectively and build strong relationships across Sales, Customer Success, and Engineering.

    • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience demonstrating technical expertise.

      • Nice to Have:

      • Experience with Bubble.io, n8n, or other low-code/no-code platforms.

      • Familiarity with partnership management or ecosystem tools.

      • Experience creating technical documentation, implementation guides, or knowledge bases.

      • Knowledge of AWS Lambda or similar serverless architectures.

        • Benefits:

        • Competitive salary and benefits package.

        • Stock options offering an opportunity to participate in the company's growth.

        • The opportunity to directly influence customer onboarding quality, retention, and expansion.

        • A hybrid technical and operational role with potential for progression into leadership.

        • Close collaboration with experienced onboarding and Customer Success professionals.

        • The opportunity to contribute to a high-growth, profitable SaaS business operating at the forefront of AI-driven innovation.

title: Entry-Level Contract Specialist
description:
Our Site Contracts Team is currently seeking a full-time, Contract Specialist to join our Sites Contracts Team in Leuven. This position plays a key role in the study start-up and clinical trial management processes at Medpace. As a Site Contract Specialist, you will have full responsibility for the life cycle of each contract through the preparation, negotiation, and finalization of contracts. If you want an exciting career where you use your previous expertise and can develop and grow your career even further within a global environment, then this is the opportunity for you.

We invite both entry and experienced candidates to apply for this position


Responsibilities

  • Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and finalizing Clinical Site Agreements or other Site specific legal agreements required for a clinical study;
  • Act as first-line subject matter expert for your respective country regarding CSA strategy, timelines and expectations for all such CSA execution elements and challenges.
  • Negotiate within client approved contract and budget templates and negotiation parameters;
  • Build strong site/external stakeholder relationships, to accelerate Site contract negotiations.
  • Identify and assesses legal, financial, and operational risks and escalate to appropriate Contract Lead/ Contract Manager or other internal stakeholders;
  • Provide recommendations and alternative resolutions throughout negotiations using established escalation channels;
  • Coordinate with internal functional departments to ensure various site startup activities are aligned with contractual process and mutually agreed up timelines; and
  • Keep up to date with applicable local regulations impacting clinical trial contracts.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree; preferably in Law or Sciences.
  • At least 1 year of relevant work experience; preferred but not required
  • Prior contract negotiation experience preferred but not required;
  • Ability to work within a team environment and independently;
  • Strong attention to detail;
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills and
  • Strong Dutch and English written and spoken communication skills. French is a plus.

Please submit your CV in English.



Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.


Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

    • Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

Collaborative Culture

    • Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
    • Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

    • Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
    • Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
    • Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
    • Company-sponsored social events

title: Engineer III GT – Integration Operations
description:
Role Summary:

The Engineer III is an experienced individual contributor who independently designs, develops, implements, and supports secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable enterprise integration solutions. The role combines strong EDI and API engineering capabilities with technical ownership across middleware, messaging, file-based interfaces, automation, modernization, and platform services. The Engineer III consistently delivers high-quality work, contributes to technical decisions and design reviews, guides peers and junior engineers, and helps shape solutions across systems, services, platforms, and products within the assigned domain.

Working across engineering teams and business stakeholders, the Engineer III drives complex integration delivery, strengthens operational resilience, improves code quality and performance, promotes engineering standards, and translates business and customer needs into effective technical solutions. The role also contributes through mentoring, knowledge sharing, documentation, continuous improvement, and portfolio or department-level initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

Software, API, and Platform Development

  • Design, develop, configure, test, implement, and support application components, services, APIs, EDI translations, middleware integrations, and platform capabilities.
  • Independently develop and maintain REST-based APIs, web services, system interfaces, reusable components, and automation utilities using established engineering standards and architectural patterns.
  • Perform thorough self-reviews and code reviews, provide actionable feedback to peers and junior engineers, and improve the maintainability, reliability, security, and performance of solutions.
  • Develop and maintain automated testing strategies, including unit, integration, API, and end-to-end test coverage to improve software quality and reliability
  • Optimize complex code, mapping logic, services, and integration flows to reduce processing time, resource usage, defects, and repeated implementation effort.
  • Use approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly to support coding, testing, documentation, defect detection, and technical analysis while maintaining established quality and security standards.

EDI and Enterprise Integration Delivery

  • Design, develop, and support enterprise integrations across ANSI X12, EDIFACT, XML, JSON, CSV, flat files, APIs, middleware, messaging, event-driven communication, and managed file-transfer patterns.
  • Own complex EDI and integration projects, including requirement interpretation, mapping and transformation logic, interface design, validation, testing, implementation, deployment, and post-production support.
  • Analyze input and output data, envelopes, acknowledgements, partner configurations, routes, canonical structures, and downstream system behavior to confirm accuracy, completeness, and expected processing.
  • Troubleshoot complex applications, API, middleware, mapping, dataflow, transactions, communication, and performance issues by isolating root causes and implementing sustainable solutions.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, and downstream impacts early, and recommend mitigation approaches for complex or cross-system changes.
  • Contribute reusable integration patterns, utilities, templates, and documentation that improve quality and consistency, accelerate time to market, and strengthen team effectiveness.

API Engineering and Modernization

  • Design, consume, test, secure, document, and support REST APIs and related system interfaces, including API contracts, request and response structures, validation, error handling, and versioning considerations.
  • Contribute to API enablement that complements EDI capabilities and supports modern, reusable, and self-service integration experiences where appropriate.
  • Apply microservices, messaging, event-driven, distributed system, and domain-driven design concepts to assign solutions when applicable.
  • Contribute to application modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy platforms to modern architecture and engineering practices.
  • Collaborate with platform, architecture, security, product, and adjacent engineering teams to align API and integration solutions with enterprise patterns and strategic objectives.

Technical Design and Architecture

  • Lead or actively contribute to technical design for systems of significant size and near- to mid-term business impact.
  • Participate actively in technical design reviews, provide feedback on other designs, incorporate feedback, and help shape technical decisions of significant complexity, ensuring alignment with Engineering Principles and architectural standards.
  • Apply Engineering Principles and approved architectural patterns to improve modularity, interoperability, reliability, scalability, maintainability, security, and observability.
  • Evaluate system dependencies, design tradeoffs, operational impacts, failure modes, and downstream effects when developing or changing solutions.
  • Document technical designs, API contracts, data mappings, implementation decisions, test evidence, deployment details, operational procedures, and support findings.

Engineering Practices and Operational Excellence

  • Own technical decisions for daily work and ensure conformity to Engineering Principles, coding standards, development processes, security practices, and deployment procedures.
  • Actively enable Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery through automated builds, testing, quality checks, and deployment practices.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring, observability, telemetry, logging, alerting, and operational automation capabilities to improve system resilience and operational excellence.
  • Participate in production support and on-call rotations; guide operational resilience for systems contributed to and engage effectively in incident management and response.
  • Contribute to operational and security automation and identify recurring support or delivery activities that can be simplified or automated.
  • Continuously improve code quality, system performance, delivery efficiency, and customer experience through root-cause analysis and preventive action.

Minimum Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Experience

  • 8+ years of professional experience in software development, application integration, platform support, API development, middleware, or related engineering discipline
  • Progressive experience in software development, enterprise application integration, API development, EDI, middleware, platform engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Experience independently delivering complex integration solutions and contributing to technical design and solution architecture decisions.
  • Experience developing and supporting production integrations, participating in incident response and operational support, and improving system resilience.
  • Experience performing code and design reviews, providing technical feedback, and mentoring less experienced engineers.
  • Experience collaborating across teams to deliver technology solutions and business outcomes using agile delivery, source control, testing, and modern engineering workflows.

Technical Skills and Knowledge

  • Strong knowledge of software development lifecycle, object-oriented programming, software design, testing principles, defect resolution, release processes, and deployment practices.
  • Strong EDI knowledge, including ANSI X12, EDIFACT, XML, JSON, CSV, flat files, mapping and transformation, envelopes, acknowledgements, partner setup, routing, and transaction troubleshooting.
  • Experience designing, developing, consuming, testing, securing, and documenting REST APIs, web services, and system interfaces.
  • Experience with integration concepts and technologies including middleware, messaging, event-driven communication, file transfer, communication protocols, canonical data models, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with middleware or integration platforms such as webMethods, IBM Sterling, Seeburger, MuleSoft, Boomi, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with API management concepts, microservices architecture, error handling, versioning, authentication and authorization, and interface observability.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, relational database concepts, data structures, data relationships, and database connectivity.
  • Experience with source control, code review, CI/CD, GitHub or Azure DevOps, DevOps methods, cloud technologies, and automated testing.
  • Understanding of secure development, telemetry, observability, monitoring, incident management, operational automation, and production support.
  • Ability to analyze complex technical problems, optimize code and integration logic, evaluate design tradeoffs, and recommend effective solutions.
  • Ability to leverage AI-powered engineering tools for code generation, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, design analysis, and productivity improvements.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience in Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain, Freight Forwarding, Retail, Distribution, customs, order management, or related business processes.
  • Experience with webMethods Integration Server, Trading Networks, Universal Messaging, EDI standards, canonical models, shared services, or comparable enterprise integration capabilities.
  • Experience with API management, microservices, event-driven architecture, domain-driven design, distributed systems, GraphQL, Apache Kafka, JMS, or MQ.
  • Experience with Java and modern frameworks, automated test frameworks, and development environments relevant to the assigned team.
  • Knowledge on Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration platforms is an added advantage.
  • Knowledge on cloud-native application development and deployment patterns.
  • Experience implementing security automation and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with AI-assisted testing, AI-driven code analysis, and Generative AI technologies.
  • Exposure to Agentic AI concepts and AI-enabled software engineering practices.
  • Experience designing reusable integration frameworks, shared utilities, self-service capabilities, or automation that accelerates onboarding and delivery.
  • Experience contributing to cross-team initiatives, technical communities of practice, standards, job aids, technical training, or internal knowledge publications.
  • Exposure to ERP, WMS, TMS, customs, order management, or other enterprise business applications.
  • Experience using observability, telemetry, operational analytics, and performance tuning to improve production reliability and customer outcomes.

description:

As a Machine Helper at Pratt Industries – Tulsa, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the safe and efficient operation of production machinery. This position involves a variety of tasks, including machine setup, operation, cleanup, and troubleshooting, with a focus on safety, meeting customer demand, and maintaining high-quality standards. You’ll work in a fast-paced environment, constantly striving for improvements in equipment efficiency while ensuring safety and cleanliness in your work area.

Give and Get

  • Excellent benefits package including medical, dental, short-term disability and HSA

Ability to lift regularly, and vision requirements include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

If you are ready to take the next step in your career and join a company that values growth and teamwork, apply today and help us continue to make Pratt Industries a leader in the Corrugating industry!

title: Spare Parts Order Specialist - Commercial Vehicles
description:
About BYD

Our Purpose is to build a zero-emission future that reconnects humanity with nature. We are looking for talent that connects with this mission and want to create positive impact by joining a diverse and dynamic team.

BYD is a leading, high-tech multinational, based in Shenzhen, China. Operates in four core fields of IT, automotive, new energy, and rail transit and employs over 300,000 people worldwide. As a global pioneer in New Energy Solutions BYD is dedicated to building a zero-emission ecosystem.

About BYD Hungary

BYD Hungary is central to BYD's European strategy, with its European headquarters located in Budapest.



Spare Parts Order Specialist – Commercial Vehicles

Location: Hungary, Budapest Dombóvári út

About the Role

The Spare Parts Order Specialist – Commercial Vehicles is responsible for managing spare parts orders and providing professional support to customers, service providers, and internal stakeholders across Europe.

The role focuses on accurate and timely order processing, effective customer communication, coordination of deliveries and backorders, and resolution of order-related issues. The position plays an important role in maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction and supporting the smooth operation of the European commercial vehicle spare parts business.

Key Responsibilities

• Maintain daily communication with European customers, service providers, and internal teams.

• Process and monitor spare parts orders in the online ordering system.

• Verify order information, including part numbers, quantities, prices, delivery addresses, and requested delivery dates.

• Provide customers with information regarding spare parts specifications, availability, pricing, lead times, and order status.

• Follow up on backorders, delayed deliveries, urgent orders, and other order-related exceptions.

• Coordinate with warehouse, logistics, planning, procurement, finance, and after-sales teams to ensure timely and accurate order fulfilment.

• Support customers in identifying and ordering the correct spare parts.

• Handle customer enquiries, complaints, returns, claims, and order discrepancies.

• Maintain accurate customer, order, pricing, and delivery information in the relevant systems.

• Support the maintenance and improvement of spare parts catalogues and ordering processes.

• Maintain effective communication with European and international suppliers.

• Assist with spare parts availability, inventory monitoring, and service-level improvement.

• Support technical campaigns and vehicle upgrade projects by coordinating spare parts requirements and deliveries between BYD headquarters and European teams.

• Prepare and analyse order, delivery, backorder, and customer-service reports.

• Identify recurring operational issues and contribute to process and system improvements.

Your Profile

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in business administration, logistics, supply chain management, international trade, or a related field.

• At least three years of relevant experience in spare parts order management, customer service, sales administration, logistics, supply chain, or after-sales operations.

• Previous experience in the automotive, commercial vehicle, technical service, or spare parts industry is preferred.

• Strong experience in processing customer orders and coordinating with warehouses, logistics providers, and internal departments.

• Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

• Knowledge of another major European language—particularly German, Italian, or French—is strongly preferred.

• Strong customer-service orientation and commercial awareness.

• Good problem-solving skills, particularly in relation to supply chain, order fulfilment, and delivery challenges.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in an international and cross-functional environment.

• Good analytical skills, attention to detail, and a strong sense of ownership.

• Advanced Excel skills and practical experience with ERP, CRM, order management, or warehouse management systems.

• Ability to prioritise multiple tasks, work under pressure, and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.

• Proactive, accurate, organised, and able to work both independently and as part of a team.

title: Senior Cloud Security & Compliance Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Cloud Security & Compliance Engineer based in the United States.

We are seeking an experienced cloud security engineer to strengthen security posture and compliance across complex, multi-cloud environments. In this hands-on role, you will serve as a key technical resource for cloud security posture management, using Wiz or equivalent platforms to improve threat detection and reduce risk. You will develop automated security controls, custom policies, and reusable infrastructure solutions to help engineering teams build secure-by-default systems. Working extensively with Python, Terraform, and policy-as-code frameworks, you will translate security requirements into scalable technical safeguards. You will also support regulated cloud environments, including those subject to federal security standards, through continuous monitoring and automated compliance controls. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on enterprise and government cybersecurity while collaborating with technical teams to improve security and resilience.

Accountabilities

  • Cloud Security Engineering: Administer and optimize the Wiz platform or an equivalent Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP), improving cloud security posture through scalable policies, accurate detection, and actionable findings.

  • Policy Development and Automation: Create, maintain, and refine custom security rules and policies as code using frameworks such as OPA/Rego, supported by Python scripting and API integrations.

  • Infrastructure Security: Develop reusable Terraform modules and secure-by-default infrastructure patterns that embed security controls into cloud environments.

  • Multi-Cloud Protection: Implement and scale security capabilities across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), adapting controls to each platform's architecture and requirements.

  • Risk Assessment and Remediation: Evaluate security findings based on exploitability, potential impact, and blast radius; prioritize remediation efforts and reduce false positives to improve detection quality.

  • Compliance and Continuous Monitoring: Support FedRAMP and other regulated cloud environments by automating security controls, mapping requirements to technical guardrails, and maintaining continuous monitoring capabilities.

  • Engineering Enablement: Help engineering teams resolve vulnerabilities and configuration risks efficiently through automation, clear remediation guidance, and secure infrastructure patterns.

  • Security Integration and Collaboration: Integrate security controls into development workflows and CI/CD pipelines, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to technical discussions and knowledge sharing.

    • Requirements

    • Professional Experience: At least five years of hands-on cloud security engineering experience, including production-level implementation and maintenance of cloud security controls.

    • Cloud Security Platforms: Experience administering Wiz or a comparable CNAPP solution, such as Prisma Cloud, Orca, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, or Lacework, with the ability to adapt quickly to new platforms.

    • Programming and Automation: Proficiency in Python for scripting, security automation, and API integrations, with experience using tools such as the Wiz GraphQL API, AWS boto3, or equivalent technologies.

    • Multi-Cloud Expertise: Deep knowledge of AWS and strong practical experience with either Azure or GCP, alongside working knowledge of all three major cloud platforms.

    • Infrastructure as Code: Hands-on experience with Terraform and HCL, particularly developing reusable modules that enforce secure-by-default configurations.

    • Policy as Code: Experience with OPA/Rego or an equivalent policy-as-code framework for defining, implementing, and maintaining automated security guardrails.

    • Security Analysis: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to evaluate vulnerabilities, assess exploitability, prioritize risk, and distinguish genuine threats from false positives.

    • U.S. Citizenship: U.S. citizenship is required to support the applicable regulatory requirements associated with FedRAMP environments.

    • Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, GovCloud, or Impact Level environments is preferred, particularly experience translating compliance requirements into technical controls.

    • Additional Technical Skills: Experience with Kubernetes manifests, container security, CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab, or Jenkins, and audit support or continuous monitoring is an advantage.

    • Leadership and Communication: Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly, collaborate effectively with engineering teams, mentor colleagues, and lead technical discussions.

    • Certifications: Relevant credentials are beneficial, including AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500), Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP).

      • Benefits

      • Competitive Salary: Annual base salary ranging from $120,000 to $170,000, depending on qualifications, experience, location, and other relevant factors.

      • Remote Work: Remote position within the United States.

      • Technical Impact: Opportunity to work on advanced cloud security solutions supporting enterprise and government environments.

      • Professional Development: Exposure to modern cloud security platforms, automation frameworks, infrastructure-as-code practices, and regulatory compliance initiatives.

      • Inclusive Workplace: Commitment to diversity and equal opportunity, welcoming professionals from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.

title: TechOps Engineer
description:
Role Summary:
We are seeking a Technical Operations Engineer to support the Staples Promotional Products application portfolio. This hands-on engineering role will focus on proactive application health management, daily operational review, observability support, technical incident investigation, environment validation, runbook execution, operational automation, and backup support for core DevOps delivery processes.
The role is intended for an engineer who can help SPP become more proactive and efficient by identifying issues before business users report them, improving dashboard and alert coverage, producing clear investigation summaries, turning recurring operational work into repeatable processes or automation, and providing operational continuity when the primary DevOps Engineer is unavailable or release activity requires additional support. The engineer will not own release governance, release scheduling, release communications, or DevOps management responsibilities; those responsibilities remain with the DevOps Manager.

Duties & Responsibilities:
• Perform a daily operational health review for critical SPP applications, integrations, scheduled jobs, services, and business-critical paths using New Relic or similar observability tools.
• Review overnight and current-day alerts, error spikes, failed jobs, integration failures, service health indicators, and recurring support patterns to identify concerns before they become business-impacting incidents.
• Maintain a practical daily operations view or health summary that identifies green/yellow/red application status, open risks, investigation needs, and follow-up actions for the SPP technology team.
• Create and maintain New Relic dashboards or similar operational dashboards that provide actionable visibility into application availability, error trends, performance signals, failed jobs, integrations, and post-deployment health.
• Recommend improvements to alert coverage, dashboard design, alert thresholds, noise reduction, and early-warning indicators based on recurring issues and operational trends.
• Support technical incident investigation by reviewing logs, traces, monitoring data, application behavior, database indicators, service errors, failed jobs, and integration failures.
• Partner with business support and QA resources to reproduce issues, validate defects, collect evidence, and produce concise technical investigation summaries for development, infrastructure, security, DevOps, and leadership review.
• Maintain and execute environment health validation checks for lower and production environments, including application availability, service readiness, configuration concerns, recurring failures, deployment validation signals, and operational readiness indicators.
• Develop and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, operational handoff notes, dashboard documentation, health-check procedures, and incident investigation playbooks for recurring issues.
• Identify repetitive operational, support, validation, monitoring, and environment tasks that can be automated through scripts, workflow tooling, dashboards, checklists, or standard operating procedures.
• Develop working knowledge of Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, TFS workflows, GitHub repositories, deployment pipelines, and release automation processes to provide backup coverage and operational continuity when primary DevOps resources are unavailable.
• Assist with deployment execution support, deployment validation, pipeline monitoring, release readiness checks, and post-deployment verification during high-volume release periods or DevOps resource gaps.
• Support first-level troubleshooting for deployment failures, pipeline execution issues, Octopus deployment/package issues, environment readiness concerns, and source control integration issues; escalate complex engineering changes to the DevOps Engineer or DevOps Manager as appropriate.
• Maintain familiarity with core DevOps tooling documentation, deployment runbooks, pipeline support procedures, and release-support handoff processes to reduce single points of failure across the SPP technology organization.
• Support security and compliance follow-up by helping identify certificate concerns, vulnerability evidence, configuration issues, dependency concerns, recurring risks, and technical remediation needs.
• Track operational improvement opportunities and recommend practical changes that reduce reactive work, improve mean time to investigation, increase system visibility, and strengthen SPP operational maturity.

Requirements

Minimum Years of Experience: 3+ years
Minimum of 3 years of experience in Technical Operations, Application Operations, DevOps, Production Support Engineering, or related field.

Basic Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• 3+ years of professional experience in Technical Operations, Application Operations, DevOps, Production Support Engineering, or related field.
• Hands-on experience supporting application health, operational monitoring, incident investigation, technical triage, and production or lower-environment troubleshooting.
• Experience with monitoring, alerting, logging, dashboards, and production troubleshooting using New Relic or similar observability tools.
• Ability to review alerts, failed jobs, integrations, error trends, and operational signals to identify issues and summarize follow-up actions.
• Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts, release automation, deployment validation, source control management, and software delivery lifecycle practices.
• Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, TFS, GitHub, or similar software delivery and deployment platforms.
• Ability to investigate application issues by analyzing logs, traces, metrics, failed jobs, application behavior, database indicators, and service dependencies.
• Scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Shell, SQL, YAML, Power Automate, or similar technologies.
• Experience creating technical documentation, operational runbooks, troubleshooting guides, investigation summaries, dashboard documentation, deployment validation notes, health-check procedures, and support handoff notes.
• Problem-solving skills with the ability to address monitoring, application support, deployment validation, environment, operational readiness, and recurring issue patterns.
• Good written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical findings to cross-functional stakeholders.
• Ability to work independently, manage technical tasks across time zones, produce clear handoff documentation, and collaborate with GCC and CST-based teams.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with New Relic dashboard creation, alert tuning, service health reporting, recurring error trend analysis, post-deployment health checks, or production-readiness reporting.
• Experience supporting release validation, deployment monitoring, post-deployment verification, pipeline monitoring, or production readiness activities.
• Experience with Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy, TFS, GitHub, Windows/IIS application hosting, SQL troubleshooting, enterprise application support, or similar operational environments.
• Experience building or improving a daily operations review model, system health scorecard, operational checklist, or proactive monitoring process.
• Exposure to DevSecOps or security operations support including certificate monitoring, vulnerability remediation tracking, dependency review, configuration risk tracking, or security scan follow-up.
• Experience supporting business-facing applications, incident evidence collection, application reproduction support, or collaboration with QA/manual testing resources.
• Exposure to workflow automation, Power Automate, infrastructure automation, configuration management, cloud operations, or automation tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Bicep, ARM templates, or similar technologies.
• Interest or experience with AI technologies to automate operational workflows, system management, documentation, monitoring analysis, incident investigation, and release-support tasks.

title: Stacker
description:
POSITION TITLE: STACKER

REPORTS TO: Corrugating Supervisor

SUMMARY

Responsible for all activities associated with stacking the equipment and helping the operators including setup, operation, cleanup, and recommending improvements to operations.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Read and follow instructions on factory masters.

Set-up bundler, hold down arm, load former, and delivery end of machine accurately in accordance with proper setup techniques.

Secure proper cover sheets, tie sheets, and load tags for production runs.

Stack finished boxes in accordance with factory master.

Ensure each unit has proper top and bottom cover sheets, tie sheets, and load tags.

Monitor quality of boxes and report quality problems to Operator.

Assist operator and first helper as necessary.

Be willing to move up the line of progression to operator regardless of shift.

Ensure correct bundle and unit counts.

Report final count of piece unit to operator.

Complete necessary reports in an accurate and timely manner.

Turn in maintenance work orders to supervision for needed repairs. Be proactive in the maintenance of equipment.

Comply with all company policies and procedures, including safety and maintaining good housekeeping.

Helps operators adhere to production schedule. Makes recommendations for optimizing the schedule to meet cost, quality and service goals. Reports any unusual scheduling issues to Supervisor.

Additional duties may be assigned by management.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED.

Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:

1. Prior work experience in the corrugated industry.

2. 6 months’ experience as a Bundler.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Able to read and follow instructions on factory masters.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Able to read a tape measure with speed and accuracy. Able to calculate figures and amounts such as percentages, measurement, volume and rate. Able to apply concepts of high school math.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or graphic form. Ability to deal with problems involving one or more concrete variables in standardized situations.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:

Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation.

Product layouts and production specifications

Product quality specifications

Quality standards

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

May be required to maintain a current Lift Truck Operator License.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

PERFORMANCE MEASUREMENTS

The performance of the employee will be measured as follows:

Operating standards - the employee will need to meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the employee.

Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the employee to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the employee and his/her superior.

Employee relations - through observations the employee will be evaluated regarding his/her behaviors associated with appropriate human interaction, respect and communication.

Creativity - this will be evaluated by how active the employee is in participating in advancing the business through new and innovative ideas.

Great Benefits!

Paid Holidays from DAY ONE

Insurance benefits and wellness reimbursement program within ONE MONTH of hire

3 Months: 401(k) with match

12 months: FULL tuition reimbursement and PAID childbearing/parenting leave

Our Culture

Growth/Development – we believe strongly in investing in our talented people as we know that their success means our collective success.

Community – we value the relationships we build with one another and are proud to welcome each of you.

Entrepreneurial Spirit - each of our facilities operates independently, allowing the local leadership and team to propose and implement site-specific changes.

This executive-level opportunity offers the chance to lead go-to-market strategy and commercial growth for an expanding portfolio of fintech and AI-powered solutions. You will oversee how products spanning payments, insurance, rewards, embedded financial services, and resident-facing AI are positioned, priced, launched, and adopted. Working closely with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, you will turn an established property management distribution network into a powerful engine for customer engagement and revenue growth. You will build scalable commercialization strategies, establish measurable performance targets, and continuously optimize pricing, packaging, and customer adoption. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, requiring a strong understanding of consumer fintech, partner-led distribution, and data-driven growth. Reporting directly to the Chief Fintech Officer, you will have executive visibility and the opportunity to shape the commercial operating model, launch processes, and long-term growth strategy.

Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success teams to maximize partner relationships.

Lead commercial decisions while collaborating on messaging, campaigns, and marketing content.

You enjoy working closely with product and customer-facing teams and turning complex requirements into practical, maintainable solutions.

title: Workplace Technology Analyst
description:
About Moneybox
At Moneybox, our mission is to give everyone the means to get more out of life. We're guided by our belief that wealth isn't about the money, it's about the means to more - more freedom, opportunities, possibilities, and peace of mind.
